hindi: वाद्य-रहित गायन — बिना साज़ के केवल आवाज़ों से गाना
definition: sung by voices alone, without musical instruments playing along as accompaniment
example: The birthday song was performed a cappella and, alas, without any pitch either.

hindi: और भी अधिक बल से — पहले मानी बात से और मजबूत आधार पर
definition: with even stronger reason, given what has already been granted
example: If she cannot afford the rent, then a fortiori she cannot afford a mortgage.

hindi: पूर्वसिद्ध — अनुभव से पहले, केवल तर्क से जाना हुआ
definition: known by reasoning alone, before any evidence is gathered
example: You cannot decide a priori which headline wins; run the test.

hindi: आरंभ से — बिल्कुल शुरुआत से ही
definition: from the very beginning, starting from the first moment or earliest stage of the entire undertaking
example: The project was doomed ab initio, when someone named it Titanic 2.

hindi: आदि से — बिल्कुल शुरुआत से
definition: from the very beginning, starting a story, argument or explanation right at its earliest origin
example: Asked how the project slipped, he began ab ovo, and the meeting ran into lunch.

hindi: पश्चभाग में — जहाज़ के पिछले हिस्से की ओर
definition: toward or behind the stern, the rear back part of a ship's hull and deck
example: The snack table stood abaft the projector, where nobody could see who took the last samosa.

hindi: राजत्याग करना — सिंहासन या ज़िम्मेदारी छोड़ देना
definition: to formally give up a throne or royal power; loosely, to abandon a duty or responsibility
example: Dad abdicated all barbecue duties after the smoke alarm incident and now merely supervises the salad.

hindi: नौसिखिया — वर्णमाला सीखता शुरुआती विद्यार्थी
definition: a beginner still learning the alphabet, or a novice grasping the first basic rudiments of any subject
example: An abecedarian in investing, he asked whether a bear market sold actual bears.

hindi: उकसाने वाला — अपराध में सहायता करने या बढ़ावा देने वाला
definition: person who knowingly encourages, assists or supports another person committing crime or wrongdoing
example: The friend who said 'just one more episode' at two a.m. was an abettor.

hindi: स्थगन — अस्थायी रूप से रुकी या निलंबित अवस्था
definition: a state of temporary suspension, where something is paused and waits for later
example: The gym membership has been in abeyance since January, charging monthly all the same.

hindi: परित्याग करना — किसी विश्वास या आदत को शपथपूर्वक त्यागना
definition: to solemnly renounce a belief, claim or habit, often publicly and under formal oath
example: Every January he abjures sugar, and every February sugar forgives him.

hindi: परित्याग — अपने सुख या अधिकार का त्याग
definition: giving up your own desires, comforts or rights through willing self-denial
example: Parents practise quiet abnegation every time they surrender the last chocolate.

hindi: आवास — रहने का ठिकाना
definition: the place where someone lives, their home or dwelling place, however grand or humble
example: My humble abode is a studio where the fridge is also, technically, the bedside table.

hindi: संक्षिप्त करना — लंबे पाठ को छोटा करना
definition: to shorten writing or speech by cutting words while keeping its meaning
example: The audiobook was abridged so heavily that the villain never appears.

hindi: पापमुक्ति — पादरी द्वारा दी गई पापों की औपचारिक क्षमा
definition: formal forgiveness of sins granted by a priest after confession; hence any release from guilt or blame
example: The client's 'no worries' email offered absolution for the missed deadline.

hindi: पापमुक्त करना — किसी को दोष या उत्तरदायित्व से छुटकारा देना
definition: formally free someone from blame, guilt or duty for something they have done
example: Saying 'per my last email' does not absolve you of reading the reply.

hindi: मिताहारी — खान-पान में अत्यंत संयमी
definition: sparing and restrained in eating and drinking, always avoiding indulgence, luxury or excess
example: The abstemious guest ordered sparkling water and still paid a quarter of the wine bill.

hindi: अन्यमनस्कता — ध्यान का कहीं और खोया होना
definition: absent-minded withdrawal into private thoughts, drifting away from what happens around
example: In a fit of abstraction she put the milk in the cupboard and her phone in the fridge.

hindi: अत्यंत निकृष्ट — गुणवत्ता में सबसे निचले स्तर पर
definition: extremely awful, sunk to the lowest depths of quality, like a bottomless chasm
example: The hotel Wi-Fi was abysmal, which did wonders for the family holiday.

hindi: विद्वत्-जगत — विश्वविद्यालयों का बौद्धिक संसार
definition: the scholarly world of universities, academic learning and research, often seen as removed from ordinary life
example: She left academe for a startup and found the meetings shorter but the jargon strangely familiar.

hindi: आध्यात्मिक आलस्य — कर्तव्य और प्रयास से उदासीन सुस्ती
definition: spiritual sloth; a slack, listless indifference toward duty, prayer and any honest effort
example: The monks called it accidie; the modern office calls it Wednesday afternoon.

hindi: ख्याति — व्यापक और उत्साहपूर्ण सार्वजनिक प्रशंसा
definition: enthusiastic public praise, especially widespread praise from critics and audiences
example: The indie game arrived to critical acclaim and a server that promptly crashed.

hindi: जयघोष — ज़ोरदार तालियों और हर्षध्वनि से स्वीकृति
definition: loud public praise and applause, or approval given by shouting rather than voting
example: The motion to order pizza passed by acclamation before anyone saw the agenda.

hindi: सम्मान — किसी उपलब्धि के लिए मिली प्रशंसा या पुरस्कार
definition: an award, honour or public expression of praise given in recognition of real achievement
example: The highest accolade in our house is being allowed to choose the takeaway.

hindi: सह-अपराधी — अपराध या शरारत में साथ देने वाला
definition: a partner who knowingly helps another person commit a crime, prank or wrongdoing
example: The dog was clearly the accomplice, holding the fridge door open with his nose.

hindi: समझौता — मतभेद सुलझाने वाला औपचारिक सहमति-पत्र
definition: a formal agreement settling differences between parties, or general harmony of opinion
example: After six meetings, the committee reached an accord on the font for the newsletter.

hindi: तदनुसार — उसी के अनुरूप
definition: formal word meaning therefore, as a result, or in a manner suited to circumstances
example: The budget was halved, and the office party was planned accordingly: tap water and a playlist.

hindi: साज़-सामान — किसी काम या भूमिका से जुड़े अतिरिक्त उपकरण
definition: additional clothing, equipment and accessories that accompany a particular activity, office or role
example: He bought every accoutrement of home-barista life, then kept ordering coffee on an app.

hindi: कटु — खट्टा-कड़वा; व्यंग्य से तीखा
definition: sour and bitter in taste; more often, sharply and wittily critical in speech or writing
example: Her acerbic restaurant review ended with a single word: 'Why?'

hindi: एकमात्र घातक कमज़ोरी — मज़बूती के बीच दुर्बल बिंदु
definition: a single fatal weakness in something otherwise strong
example: The engine is superb; the gearbox is its Achilles heel.

hindi: चरमोत्कर्ष — किसी वस्तु का सर्वोच्च बिंदु
definition: the highest point or peak of achievement, perfection or development that something ever reaches
example: His acme as a cook was a single perfect omelette in 2019, never repeated.

hindi: सेवक-शिष्य — पूजा में सहायक; किसी का निष्ठावान अनुयायी
definition: an assistant who serves a priest during worship; hence a devoted follower or helper
example: The founder arrived with three acolytes, each carrying his laptop, oat latte and opinions.

hindi: बरी करना — अदालत द्वारा आरोप से मुक्त घोषित करना
definition: formally declare in court that an accused person is cleared of the criminal charge against them
example: The jury acquitted him in an hour, mostly because the prosecution's slides would not load.

hindi: तीक्ष्ण कटु — नाक और गले को जलाने वाला
definition: having a sharp, bitter smell or taste that stings the nose and burns the throat
example: The acrid smoke from the toaster confirmed that nobody had read the instructions.

hindi: अपराध-कृत्य — अपराध का बाहरी, भौतिक कार्य
definition: the physical deed of a crime, the guilty action itself as distinct from intention
example: Planning to eat a colleague's labelled yogurt is only a thought; the spoon supplies the actus reus.

hindi: तीक्ष्णता — देखने, सुनने या सोचने की पैनी शक्ति
definition: sharpness of sight, hearing or thought, especially the power to notice fine detail
example: Her mental acuity peaks at eleven at night, exactly when nobody needs it.

hindi: सूझबूझ — किसी क्षेत्र में तेज़ और सही निर्णय लेने की क्षमता
definition: sharp practical skill at making quick, sound judgements, especially in business matters
example: His business acumen amounts to cancelling every free trial the day before it starts charging.

hindi: नक्षत्रों की ओर — ऊँचे लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़ते हुए
definition: toward the stars, a motto for lofty ambition and daring aspiration beyond ordinary limits
example: The startup's pitch deck said ad astra on slide one and asked for a second coffee machine on slide nine.

hindi: मूल स्रोतों की ओर — मूल ग्रंथों तक लौटने का आह्वान
definition: back to the original sources, the scholar's call to read primary texts directly
example: Ad fontes, said the professor, which meant reading the actual study rather than the headline about it.

hindi: तदर्थ — केवल उसी एक काम के लिए, बिना स्थायी योजना
definition: made for one particular purpose, without any general plan
example: An ad hoc committee formed at noon and dissolved before tea.

hindi: व्यक्तिगत आक्षेप वाला — तर्क छोड़कर व्यक्ति पर हमला करने वाला
definition: attacking the person making an argument instead of the argument itself
example: The debate turned ad hominem the moment his numbers were questioned.

hindi: अनंत तक — बिना अंत के, लगातार
definition: continuing endlessly, with no stopping point in sight
example: The thread forked ad infinitum until nobody remembered the question.

hindi: अंतरिम — बीच की अवधि के लिए, अस्थायी तौर पर
definition: for the meantime, serving temporarily in the interval before a lasting, permanent arrangement finally begins
example: The intern was made editor ad interim and immediately changed the font.

hindi: स्वेच्छानुसार — जितना चाहें, जैसा चाहें
definition: freely and as much as one likes, without fixed limits, often said of performing or feeding
example: The office snacks were supplied ad libitum until finance discovered the intern's granola strategy.

hindi: ईश्वर की महत्तर महिमा के लिए — हर कर्म ईश्वर को समर्पित
definition: for the greater glory of God; the Jesuit motto dedicating every piece of work to divine honour
example: The choir director signed each rehearsal schedule ad majorem Dei gloriam, and also 'no phones'.

hindi: उकताने की हद तक — इतनी बार कि जी भर जाए
definition: repeated so often that it becomes tiresome
example: We discussed the logo ad nauseam and shipped the first version anyway.

hindi: मूल्यानुसार — वस्तु के मूल्य के अनुपात में लगने वाला
definition: charged as a fixed percentage of the declared value of goods being imported or taxed
example: The ad valorem duty on the imported espresso machine cost more than the espresso habit it was meant to fund.

hindi: मंद लय — धीमी, शांत गति में बजने वाला संगीत-अंश
definition: a musical passage played at a slow, leisurely tempo, calm and stately in pace
example: Sunday mornings in our house move at adagio until someone mentions pancakes.

hindi: परिशिष्ट — बाद में जोड़ी गई अतिरिक्त सामग्री
definition: extra material added at the end of a document, book or agreement after writing
example: The contract's addendum quietly took back everything the contract promised.

hindi: भ्रमितबुद्धि — उलझे और गड़बड़ दिमाग़ वाला
definition: having a confused, muddled mind; foolish, scatterbrained and rather slow in grasping simple matters
example: The addle-pated plan involved three spreadsheets that disagreed about everything.

hindi: प्रमाण रूप में प्रस्तुत करना — दावे के समर्थन में देना
definition: to put something forward as evidence for a claim
example: He adduced three studies, two of which said the opposite of what he claimed.

hindi: बैठक स्थगित करना — कार्यवाही को बाद के समय तक रोक देना
definition: break off a meeting or court hearing, planning to resume the proceedings at a later time
example: The book club adjourned the moment someone admitted they had actually finished the novel.

hindi: न्याय-निर्णय करना — विवाद पर आधिकारिक फ़ैसला देना
definition: make a formal judgement on a disputed matter, acting as judge between parties
example: Mum was asked to adjudicate whose turn it was to take out the recycling.

hindi: मिलावट — किसी चीज़ में मिलाया गया बाहरी अंश
definition: something added into a mixture, or the process of blending different things together
example: His optimism carries a healthy admixture of spreadsheets.

hindi: चेताना — किसी को उसकी ग़लती पर गंभीरता से सावधान करना
definition: warn or firmly advise someone against their behaviour, usually with mild disapproval
example: The app admonished him to stand up, as if it had ever tried standing.

hindi: रूपवान युवक — अत्यंत सुंदर और सुगठित देह वाला पुरुष
definition: a strikingly handsome young man widely admired for his sculpted physique and beauty
example: The gym's new Adonis spends more time with the mirror than with the weights.

hindi: अलंकृत करना — गहनों या सजावट से सुंदर बनाना
definition: to decorate or beautify something by adding ornaments, jewels or attractive features
example: Framed quotes about hustle adorn the office walls, mostly above desks that empty at six.

hindi: स्तुतिगान — अत्यधिक, अंधी प्रशंसा और पूजा-भाव
definition: excessive admiration and flattering praise heaped upon a person, given uncritically like worship
example: The influencer's adulation lasted exactly until the sponsored toothpaste post.

hindi: रूपरेखा देना — धुँधली झलक दिखाना, पूर्वाभास देना
definition: to outline faintly, sketch in shadow, or hint at something still coming
example: The first trailer merely adumbrated the plot, which saved everyone the full film.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी — विरोधी या शत्रु
definition: opponent or enemy engaged against someone in battle, contest or dispute
example: My greatest adversary this year has been the office printer.

hindi: संरक्षण — किसी शक्ति की छत्रछाया
definition: protection or sponsorship extended by a larger power
example: The trial runs under the aegis of the health ministry, which also pays for the coffee.

hindi: वायव्य — हवा से उत्पन्न या हवा से जुड़ा
definition: relating to winds or produced by them, from Aeolus, Greek keeper of winds
example: The Aeolian whistle through the office window ran all winter, and facilities called it character.

hindi: सौंदर्यप्रेमी — कला और सुंदरता को सर्वोपरि मानने वाला
definition: a person with refined sensitivity to beauty, valuing painting, music and style above practicality
example: An aesthete to the end, he returned the ergonomic chair because it clashed with the rug.

hindi: वचनबद्ध — विवाह के लिए औपचारिक रूप से तय
definition: formally engaged and promised to be married, with the wedding agreed but still ahead
example: The affianced pair registered for gifts before they had agreed on a city.

hindi: शपथ-पत्र — शपथ लेकर लिखित बयान
definition: a written statement sworn under oath before an official, usable as court evidence
example: She swears by affidavit that she only watched one episode.

hindi: समृद्धि — धन-संपत्ति की प्रचुरता, संपन्नता
definition: abundance of money and material goods; comfortable wealth, plenty and prosperity
example: Suburban affluence is two cars in the drive and a third on finance.

hindi: मारपीट — सार्वजनिक स्थान पर झगड़ा
definition: public fight or brawl between people that disturbs the peace and badly alarms bystanders
example: Two uncles nearly caused an affray over the correct way to cook biryani.

hindi: रसिक — किसी शौक़ का जानकार और समर्पित प्रेमी
definition: a keen, knowledgeable enthusiast devoted to a particular sport, pastime or interest
example: Any coffee aficionado will tell you, at length and unprompted, that your beans are wrong.

hindi: पूर्वोल्लिखित — पहले जिसका उल्लेख हुआ
definition: formal word describing something already named earlier in writing or speech
example: The aforementioned budget cuts explain why the office plants now water themselves.

hindi: पूर्वोक्त — पहले कहा गया
definition: formal word describing something already mentioned earlier in this document or speech
example: The aforesaid sandwich, left in the office fridge since March, has now developed opinions.

hindi: उकसाने वाला गुप्तचर — अपराध के लिए भड़काने वाला भेदिया
definition: a secret agent who provokes people into illegal acts so they can be arrested
example: The man shouting loudest for the barricade turned out to be an agent provocateur with a police pension.

hindi: प्रचार-कला — नाटक, साहित्य और चित्रों द्वारा राजनीतिक प्रचार
definition: political propaganda spread through theatre, literature, posters and other creative works
example: The all-hands video was pure agitprop, set to swelling strings and drone shots of the car park.

hindi: संघर्ष — दो पक्षों के बीच नाटकीय प्रतिस्पर्धा
definition: a dramatic contest or struggle between two rival sides, especially in drama
example: The group chat became an agon between the pineapple-on-pizza camp and everyone else.

hindi: सभास्थल — सार्वजनिक चौक जहाँ लोग मिलते, बहस करते हैं
definition: a public square where citizens gathered to trade goods, meet and debate
example: The office kitchen is the true agora, where every rumour is traded before lunch.

hindi: कृषिप्रधान — खेती और खेत की ज़मीन से संबंधित
definition: relating to farming, farmland and the ownership or working of rural land by farmers
example: Grandpa's politics are agrarian, which is why every conversation reaches potato prices.

hindi: जाड़ा-बुख़ार — कँपकँपी के साथ आने वाला ज्वर
definition: archaic: a fever with shivering fits, especially malaria, returning in bouts
example: The ague of the office air conditioning strikes every afternoon at three.

hindi: हाँक — दूर के जहाज़ या व्यक्ति को पुकारने का नाविक-स्वर
definition: a sailor's call used for hailing another ship or distant person
example: "Ahoy!" shouted the manager across the empty office, having clearly watched too many films.

hindi: स्मरण-पत्र — याद दिलाने वाला संक्षिप्त लेख
definition: a brief written note or list kept to help memory recall the important points
example: She taped an aide-mémoire to her monitor: breathe, mute, then speak.

hindi: रुग्णता — छोटी-मोटी बीमारी या तकलीफ़
definition: an illness or disease of the body, usually a minor, nagging or lasting physical complaint
example: Each colleague arrived at lunch with a new ailment and a strong recommendation for ginger.

hindi: खुले में — बाहर खुली हवा में (भोजन)
definition: done outdoors in the fresh open air, especially eating a meal outside in a garden or terrace
example: Our al fresco dinner lasted until the mosquitoes voted to join.

hindi: हाय — अफ़सोस, दुःख की पुकार
definition: archaic: an exclamation expressing sorrow, regret or dismay over something lost or spoiled
example: Alack, the coffee machine displays an error code nobody has ever seen.

hindi: तत्परता — फुर्ती और उत्साह से झट काम में जुट जाना
definition: brisk and cheerful readiness, doing something promptly and quickly without any delay
example: He accepted the free pizza with an alacrity never shown toward the spreadsheet.

hindi: यद्यपि — हालाँकि, भले ही
definition: even though, although, admitting something while still holding the main point
example: The meeting ended early, albeit forty minutes after it was supposed to.

hindi: पासा फेंका जा चुका — अब निर्णय अटल है, पीछे लौटना संभव नहीं
definition: the die is cast; a decisive, irreversible choice has been made and no turning back remains possible
example: She hit send on the resignation email, whispered alea iacta est, and went to make tea.

hindi: आहार-संबंधी — भोजन और पाचन से जुड़ा
definition: relating to food, nourishment, and the bodily digestion of whatever meals someone eats
example: After the all-you-can-eat challenge, his alimentary system filed a formal complaint.

hindi: वफ़ादारी — किसी देश, दल या व्यक्ति के प्रति निष्ठा
definition: loyalty and faithful commitment owed to a country, cause, leader or group
example: Family allegiance splits sharply every time the cricket reaches a final.

hindi: द्रुत लय — तेज़, प्रसन्न गति वाला संगीत-अंश
definition: a musical passage played at a brisk, lively tempo, quick and cheerful in pace
example: The last hour before a deadline is always played allegro, with frantic typing for percussion.

hindi: अनुप्रास — शब्दों के आरंभ में एक ही ध्वनि की आवृत्ति
definition: the repetition of the same starting consonant sound across several nearby words
example: "Bold, bright, bursting with berries" — the cereal box leans hard on alliteration.

hindi: जलोढ़ — नदी द्वारा बहाकर लाई मिट्टी से बना
definition: made of sand, soil and silt that flowing rivers have carried and deposited
example: The vineyard tour guide said alluvial so often it became a drinking game.

hindi: वीथिका — पेड़ों की कतारों से घिरा सीधा बाग़-पथ
definition: a straight formal garden walkway lined with evenly spaced rows of trees
example: The office park added an allée of saplings, so the walk to parking is now technically picturesque.

hindi: मातृसंस्था — वह विद्यालय या विश्वविद्यालय जहाँ से पढ़ाई की
definition: the school, college or university that a person once attended and graduated from, remembered fondly afterwards
example: My alma mater remembers me only when the fundraising emails go out.

hindi: भिक्षा — ग़रीबों को दिया गया दान
definition: money, food or goods given freely to poor people as charity
example: A tip jar at the self-checkout: alms for the machine.

hindi: आदि और अंत — किसी चीज़ का सार और संपूर्णता
definition: the beginning and ending of something, its whole essence and most important element
example: For this chef, butter is the alpha and omega of every sauce.

hindi: दूसरा स्वरूप — व्यक्ति का छिपा दूसरा रूप, या उसका अभिन्न विश्वासपात्र
definition: a second self, either another side of a person or a trusted intimate
example: By night the accountant became his alter ego, a fairly bad stand-up comic.

hindi: कहा-सुनी — गरमागरम झगड़ा
definition: a noisy, heated argument or quarrel, usually between people in public
example: An altercation over the last trolley briefly made the supermarket car park feel gladiatorial.

hindi: परमार्थ — निःस्वार्थ भाव से दूसरों की भलाई करना
definition: unselfish concern for the welfare of others, putting their good before your own
example: Pure altruism is letting someone merge in traffic and not expecting a wave.

hindi: पूर्व छात्र — किसी संस्था से पढ़कर निकला व्यक्ति
definition: a former student or graduate of a school, college or university, still linked to that institution
example: As a proud alumnus, he still wears the hoodie to meetings with clients.

hindi: सम्मिश्रण — अलग तत्वों को मिलाकर बना एक रूप
definition: a mixture of different elements blended together into a single whole
example: Her accent is an amalgam of Delhi, Glasgow and too many years of Netflix.

hindi: लिपिक — बोलकर लिखवाई बातें लिखने वाला सहायक
definition: an assistant who writes down words spoken by another, or copies manuscripts
example: Voice-to-text is my amanuensis, and it hears 'duck' far too often.

hindi: प्रणयी — प्रेम और प्रेमालाप से जुड़ा
definition: relating to romantic love, sexual desire and the eager pursuit of lovers and sweethearts
example: His amatory history reads like a group chat nobody should have screenshotted.

hindi: वीरांगना-सी — लंबी, बलशाली और निडर स्त्री
definition: tall, powerfully strong and formidable, especially describing a woman warrior's physique
example: Her Amazonian deadlift made the men at the next rack suddenly remember urgent phone calls.

hindi: वातावरण — किसी जगह का माहौल और मिज़ाज
definition: the mood, character and surrounding atmosphere that gives a particular place or setting its feeling
example: The café charges extra for ambiance, which apparently means dim bulbs and a playlist of sighing jazz.

hindi: अमृत — देवताओं का भोजन
definition: the food of the Greek gods, granting immortality, or any food with heavenly delicious taste
example: After a twelve-hour flight, reheated dal tasted like ambrosia.

hindi: अमृततुल्य — दिव्य स्वाद या सुगंध वाला
definition: divinely delicious or fragrant, truly worthy of the heavenly food eaten by the gods
example: The ambrosial smell of fresh parathas pulled everyone out of bed.

hindi: चलने-फिरने योग्य — अपने पैरों पर चल सकने वाला
definition: able to walk about, or relating to walking and moving around on foot
example: Two days after the marathon he was ambulatory again, though stairs remained negotiable.

hindi: मैत्रीपूर्ण — बिना कटुता के, शांतिपूर्ण ढंग से
definition: friendly and peaceful, settled calmly without quarrels, anger or bitter feelings
example: Their breakup was so amicable that they still split the streaming subscription.

hindi: न्यायमित्र — अदालत को सलाह देने वाला बाहरी व्यक्ति
definition: an outside expert who offers a court advice on a case without being party to it
example: Every uncle at the wedding appointed himself amicus curiae in the seating dispute.

hindi: सौहार्द — दो पक्षों के बीच मैत्रीपूर्ण, शांत संबंध
definition: peaceful friendly relations and goodwill between people, groups or whole nations
example: The two roommates maintained perfect amity right up until someone ate the labelled yoghurt.

hindi: प्रेम-प्रसंग — गुप्त या अवैध प्रेम-संबंध
definition: a romantic love affair, especially a secret or illicit one kept hidden from society
example: Every season of the show hinges on some doomed amour between rival chefs.

hindi: आतिथेय — उदार और शानदार मेज़बान
definition: a generous host who entertains guests lavishly at dinner, named after a mythical king
example: The group's reliable amphitryon owns the only apartment with a table big enough for twelve.

hindi: रक्षा-कवच — बुरी शक्तियों से बचाने के लिए पहना जाने वाला ताबीज़
definition: a charm worn around the neck or body, believed to give protection against evil, danger or disease
example: Her noise-cancelling headphones are the open-plan office's most effective amulet.

hindi: मुखरंजक — शेफ़ की ओर से एक कौर का व्यंजन
definition: a single bite-sized dish served free before a meal at the chef's choice
example: The amuse-bouche was a foam on a spoon, which we photographed more than tasted.

hindi: कठिन अभियान — दुर्गम भीतरी प्रदेश की ओर लंबी यात्रा
definition: a military march inland, or any arduous expedition; named after Xenophon's famous Greek chronicle
example: Getting the sofa up four flights of stairs became our family's anabasis.

hindi: कालदोष — अपने समय से बेमेल वस्तु या बात
definition: something wrongly placed in time, belonging to another period than its surroundings
example: The chequebook at the self-checkout was an anachronism, and the whole queue watched it happen.

hindi: कालविरुद्ध — अपने समय से मेल न खाने वाला
definition: belonging to another period of time, strikingly outdated or misplaced in history
example: His anachronistic insistence on printing emails makes the recycling bin work overtime.

hindi: वाक्य-भंग — वाक्य बीच में अपनी व्याकरणिक दिशा बदल लेना
definition: an abrupt shift within a sentence from one grammatical structure to another, leaving the first unfinished
example: "The report I was going to — actually, has anyone seen my charger?" Anacoluthon, powered by low battery.

hindi: श्रृंखला आवृत्ति — पिछले वाक्यांश का अंतिम शब्द अगले की शुरुआत में दोहराना
definition: repeating the final word of one clause as the opening word of the next, linking them like a chain
example: Meetings lead to minutes, minutes lead to follow-ups, follow-ups lead to more meetings: the anadiplosis of corporate life.

hindi: प्रत्यभिज्ञान — सत्य को पहचान लेने का क्षण
definition: the moment in a story when a character finally recognises the hidden truth
example: His anagnorisis arrived at checkout, when he realised the free trial was annual.

hindi: अनिवार्यता — अटल आवश्यकता, जिससे कोई नहीं बचता
definition: inescapable necessity or fate, the force even deities cannot resist
example: Monday morning arrives with the calm certainty of ananke, weekend plans notwithstanding.

hindi: लघु-लघु-गुरु चरण — दो हल्के अक्षरों के बाद एक ज़ोरदार
definition: a metrical foot of verse with two unstressed syllables followed by one stressed syllable
example: "In a sec" is an anapest, which is the only precise thing about it.

hindi: आवृत्ति-आरंभ — हर वाक्यांश की शुरुआत में वही शब्द दोहराना
definition: repeating the same word or phrase at the start of several successive clauses or sentences
example: We will fix the bug, we will write the test, we will never speak of this sprint again: pure anaphora from the tech lead.

hindi: घोर वर्जित — जिससे सख़्त नफ़रत हो
definition: something detested and flatly rejected
example: Untested migrations are anathema to anyone who has been paged at three in the morning.

hindi: पुरानी व्यवस्था — बदलाव से पहले की सत्ता-प्रणाली
definition: the former order of things, originally French royal rule before the revolution
example: Under the ancien régime, meetings had agendas; the new CEO prefers vibes.

hindi: सहायक — मुख्य वस्तु का पूरक, गौण
definition: supporting the main thing without being part of it
example: The ancillary costs of travel, printing and coffee quietly doubled the budget.

hindi: मध्यम लय — चलने की सहज गति वाला संगीत
definition: a musical passage played at a moderately slow tempo, like an easy walking pace
example: The queue at the passport office proceeded at a dignified andante, never once breaking into allegro.

hindi: अग्नि-दंड — चूल्हे में लकड़ी टिकाने की लोहे की टेक
definition: one of a pair of metal stands that hold burning wood above a fireplace floor
example: The flat has a decorative fireplace, two antique andirons and a strict landlord ban on fire.

hindi: आक्षेप — किसी पर की गई आलोचनात्मक टिप्पणी
definition: critical comment or pointed remark that finds fault with someone's conduct or work
example: The memo contained several animadversions on 'certain people' who microwave fish.

hindi: ईसवी सन् — ईसा के जन्म से गिने जाने वाले वर्ष
definition: in the year of our Lord, counting calendar years forward from the traditional birth of Christ
example: The office printer was installed in some remote year anno Domini and has resented us since.

hindi: दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण वर्ष — विपत्तियों से भरा बुरा साल
definition: a horrible year, marked by many misfortunes, disasters, setbacks or painful personal troubles
example: The team's annus horribilis began with a data breach and ended with karaoke.

hindi: अद्भुत वर्ष — उपलब्धियों से भरा यादगार साल
definition: a wonderful year, remarkable for many great achievements, lucky breaks or fortunate events
example: It was my annus mirabilis: a promotion, a flat and a parking space.

hindi: पीड़ाहर — दर्द कम करने वाली औषधि
definition: a medicine or remedy that relieves pain, soothes the body and dulls physical suffering
example: A hot water bottle remains the cheapest anodyne known to science.

hindi: अभिषेक करना — तेल लगाकर पवित्र पद पर नियुक्त करना
definition: to smear someone with consecrated ointment during sacred ritual, marking them chosen for office
example: The outgoing CEO anointed her successor at the offsite, between the kayaking and the karaoke.

hindi: शीघ्र ही — थोड़ी देर में, अभी आते हैं
definition: archaic: soon, shortly, in a little while; promised later rather than right away
example: The manager replied that the raise would be discussed anon, which is to say never.

hindi: कलहंसवत्‌ — हंस-बत्तख जैसा मूर्ख और बेवजह शोर मचाने वाला
definition: like geese; foolish, silly, senseless, gawking and noisily honking
example: The anserine chorus of car horns did nothing whatsoever to move the traffic jam.

hindi: विरोधी — सक्रिय रूप से मुक़ाबला करने वाला शत्रु
definition: a person who actively opposes or fights another; an enemy, rival or opposing character
example: Every sitcom needs an antagonist, and in their building it was the parking warden.

hindi: युद्ध-पूर्व — किसी युद्ध से पहले के काल का
definition: belonging to the period before a major conflict, especially America before its 1861 civil fighting
example: The wedding venue sold its antebellum charm by the hour, porch photographs extra.

hindi: उपकक्ष — बड़े कक्ष से पहले का प्रतीक्षा-कक्ष
definition: a small waiting room or entrance hall leading into a larger, more important chamber
example: The video-call waiting room is the modern antechamber, where you sit in silence until someone important admits you.

hindi: प्रलय-पूर्व — इतना पुराना मानो जलप्रलय से पहले का हो
definition: so ancient and outdated it seems to date from before the great biblical flood
example: The office printer runs on antediluvian drivers that only Gary still knows how to install.

hindi: संकलन — अनेक रचनाओं का चुना हुआ संग्रह
definition: a published collection of selected poems, stories or other writings, often by several different authors
example: His phone holds an anthology of screenshots he will never look at again.

hindi: मानवारोपी — पशु या वस्तु को मनुष्य जैसे गुण देने वाला
definition: giving human qualities, feelings or shapes to animals, objects or gods
example: His anthropomorphic account of the cat's resentment ran to three paragraphs.

hindi: शब्द-विपर्यय — वही शब्द उलटे क्रम में दोहराकर नया अर्थ देना
definition: repeating the same words in reversed order, a strict mirrored pattern of chiasmus using identical words
example: "I don't own my phone; my phone owns me" — an antimetabole typed, naturally, on that phone.

hindi: पुरावस्तुविद् — प्राचीन वस्तुओं का संग्रहकर्ता और अध्येता
definition: a scholar or collector who studies and gathers antiquities, relics and records of the past
example: The office antiquary still keeps a fax machine, and insists it will be vindicated.

hindi: पुरातन — ज़माने से पीछे छूटा, अब अनुपयोगी
definition: outdated and old-fashioned, belonging to a past period rather than present times
example: Our expense process is so antiquated that receipts must be faxed, apparently to 1994.

hindi: विरोधाभास-रचना — विपरीत विचारों को संतुलित वाक्य में आमने-सामने रखना
definition: placing sharply contrasting ideas side by side in balanced, parallel phrases for striking effect
example: "Small steps for the product, giant leaps for the invoice" — the pitch deck's antithesis was the only honest slide.

hindi: नामांतर — किसी व्यक्ति को नाम के बजाय उपाधि या विशेषण से पुकारना
definition: replacing a proper name with an epithet or title, or using a famous name to stand for a whole type
example: The office calls him "the Oracle" by antonomasia, mostly because he knows where the stapler lives.

hindi: द्रुत गति से — तेज़ी से, फुर्ती से
definition: literary: quickly, swiftly, at a rapid pace; progress moving forward with real speed
example: The group chat grew apace once someone mentioned free pizza.

hindi: क्षुधावर्धक पेय — भोजन से पहले का पेय
definition: an alcoholic drink taken shortly before a meal to sharpen the appetite and stimulate hunger
example: The aperitif was meant to spark appetite, but it mostly sparked opinions.

hindi: सूक्ष्म अवलोकन — एक झलक में कही गई गहरी बात
definition: a brief, illuminating remark or insight that neatly captures something in a single flash
example: Her best aperçu of the offsite: we flew four hundred miles to have the same meeting.

hindi: शीर्ष — वह नुकीला सबसे ऊँचा बिंदु जहाँ रेखाएँ मिलती हैं
definition: the highest point or peak of something, where all its sloping lines meet
example: The apex predator of the office is whoever controls the thermostat.

hindi: अपसौर — कक्षा का सूर्य से सबसे दूर बिंदु
definition: the point in a planet's or comet's orbit where it swings farthest from the solar centre
example: By mid-month his motivation had reached aphelion, farthest from any deadline.

hindi: सूत्र — एक छोटी पंक्ति में कहा गया गहरा सत्य
definition: a brief memorable saying that expresses a general truth or wisdom
example: His favourite aphorism, 'done beats perfect', has excused many unfinished projects.

hindi: कामोद्दीपक — कामवासना को जगाने वाला पदार्थ
definition: something, such as food or drink, believed to arouse romantic and sexual desire
example: For some, oysters are an aphrodisiac; for others, a partner who does the dishes.

hindi: मधुमक्षिकालय — मधुमक्खियों के छत्तों का स्थान
definition: a place, garden or rooftop where beehives stand, kept by beekeepers for honey
example: The rooftop apiary gave the bank a sustainability report and its staff several stings.

hindi: वानर-अनुकारी — बंदर की तरह मूर्खतापूर्ण नकल करने वाला
definition: like apes or monkeys; foolishly imitating others and mimicking their manners
example: His apish copying of the founder's black turtlenecks fooled nobody at the pitch.

hindi: धीरता — कठिन स्थिति में भी आत्मविश्वासी संयम
definition: calm self-confidence and composure, especially when facing a difficult or awkward situation
example: He presented the demo with aplomb, even as the screen froze behind him.

hindi: सर्वनाश — संसार के अंत जैसी भीषण तबाही
definition: a sweeping catastrophe bringing total destruction, as though the whole world were ending
example: The group project apocalypse began when someone clicked 'reply all' with the wrong draft.

hindi: अप्रामाणिक — मशहूर पर संदिग्ध, शायद गढ़ी हुई
definition: widely told and repeated but probably untrue, or of doubtful authorship and uncertain origin
example: The story of the founder coding the app in a single night is apocryphal.

hindi: पराकाष्ठा — उन्नति का सबसे ऊँचा शिखर
definition: the farthest point of an orbit, and so the highest peak of someone's success or power
example: The band reached its apogee with one viral song and a very long reunion tour.

hindi: आत्म-पक्ष-समर्थन — अपने विचारों या आचरण की लिखित सफ़ाई
definition: a formal written defence justifying one's opinions, beliefs or conduct against critics
example: His four-page apologia for buying a third guitar cited mental health and resale value.

hindi: कथित मौन — यह कहकर कुछ बता देना कि हम उसे नहीं बताएँगे
definition: mentioning something by pretending not to mention it, raising a subject while claiming silence
example: "I won't bring up who broke the build," said Priya, glancing at Dev, a masterclass in apophasis.

hindi: रक्ताघात — अचानक होश खोना; लाक्षणिक रूप से भारी क्रोध
definition: a sudden stroke causing loss of consciousness; also, figuratively, extreme fury
example: The finance director nearly suffered apoplexy on seeing the team's taxi receipts.

hindi: अधूरा वाक्य — बीच में बात रोककर मौन हो जाना
definition: stopping speech abruptly midway, falling silent and leaving a sentence deliberately unfinished
example: 'If you touch my leftovers again, I will…' is aposiopesis doing its job.

hindi: धर्मत्याग — अपने धर्म या निष्ठा को छोड़ देना
definition: the complete abandonment of one's religious faith, or of a political cause once loyally held
example: Switching from iPhone to Android was treated at dinner as outright apostasy.

hindi: धर्मत्यागी — जिसने अपना धर्म या दल छोड़ दिया
definition: a person who abandons their religious faith, political party or long-held principles for another
example: Once a vim loyalist, she became a cheerful apostate the day she discovered autocomplete.

hindi: संबोधन अलंकार — किसी अनुपस्थित व्यक्ति या निर्जीव वस्तु को सीधे संबोधित करना
definition: turning away to address directly an absent person, abstract idea or lifeless object as though present
example: "Oh, printer, why do you hate me?" he cried, an apostrophe the printer answered with a paper jam.

hindi: औषधविक्रेता — दवाएँ बनाने और बेचने वाला
definition: archaic: a person who prepared and sold medicines, drugs and remedies from a shop
example: The organic shop sells lavender oil in brown bottles like an apothecary with a loyalty app.

hindi: सूक्ति — छोटा, चुटीला और शिक्षाप्रद कथन
definition: a brief, pointed saying that states practical wisdom in memorable words
example: 'Ship it, then fix it' is the apothegm printed on every mug in the office.

hindi: चरम उत्कर्ष — देवत्व जैसी सर्वोच्च अवस्था
definition: the highest, near-divine form a thing can reach
example: That sandwich is the apotheosis of everything a lunch break can be.

hindi: देवत्व प्रदान करना — किसी को आदर्श के सर्वोच्च पद पर बिठाना
definition: to honour someone so highly that they become a perfect, godlike ideal beyond ordinary criticism
example: Business magazines apotheosize any founder whose company survives past its second year.

hindi: अनिष्टनिवारक — बुरी नज़र और अपशकुन को दूर रखने वाला
definition: intended to ward off evil, danger or misfortune, like a protective charm or ritual gesture
example: Nobody says 'quiet shift' in the emergency ward; the silence is apotropaic.

hindi: राजवृत्ति — राजकुमारों को भरण-पोषण हेतु दी गई जागीर
definition: land or income granted to younger royal children for their maintenance; also a customary perquisite
example: Free parking had become the senior partners' appanage, defended as fiercely as any ancestral estate.

hindi: दलीय कार्यकर्ता — संगठन का आँख मूँदकर वफ़ादार नौकरशाह
definition: a loyal functionary of a party or organisation who follows orders without question
example: The new hire turned out to be a perfect apparatchik, forwarding every memo with enthusiastic agreement.

hindi: पाठभेद-सूची — संपादित ग्रंथ के नीचे दिए पाठांतर
definition: the notes beneath an edited text recording the variant readings found in different manuscripts
example: The patch notes now come with an apparatus criticus explaining which bug fix broke which other feature.

hindi: प्रेत-दर्शन — अचानक दिखाई देने वाली भूतिया आकृति
definition: a ghostly figure or spirit that suddenly appears; any sudden and startling sight
example: The CEO's apparition at the intern happy hour silenced the karaoke mid-chorus.

hindi: तुष्टीकरण — आक्रामक की माँगें मानकर शांति खरीदना
definition: policy of giving an aggressor concessions to keep peace, often only inviting further demands
example: Handing the toddler your phone at dinner is appeasement, and he knows it.

hindi: प्रसंगवश — इसी संदर्भ में
definition: regarding, concerning or connected with something just mentioned, often introducing related remarks
example: Apropos of nothing, he announced in the budget meeting that he'd adopted a tortoise.

hindi: मेरे बाद प्रलय — भविष्य की परवाह न करने वाली लापरवाही
definition: a reckless indifference toward whatever disaster follows after one's own departure from the scene
example: The departing lead's final commit message read like après moi le déluge, with no tests and no documentation.

hindi: अर्धगोल गर्भ — गिरजे में वेदी के पीछे का अर्धगोल मेहराबदार भाग
definition: a semicircular vaulted recess behind the altar at the eastern extremity of a church, often domed above
example: The restaurant, a converted chapel, seats the chef's table in the apse, with prices to match.

hindi: गरुड़नासा — बाज़ की चोंच जैसी मुड़ी, तीखी नाक वाला
definition: like eagles; especially of a nose, hooked, curved and sharply beaked
example: Her aquiline profile made every passport photo look like an ancient Roman coin.

hindi: बेल-बूटा — गुँथी पत्तियों और रेखाओं का सजावटी नक़्श
definition: an elaborate decorative design of intertwined leaves, stems and flowing lines
example: The latte art began as a heart and ended as a confused arabesque.

hindi: पंच — विवाद का अंतिम निर्णायक
definition: person given authority to settle a dispute between opposing parties
example: In our house, the dog is the final arbiter of who gets the sofa.

hindi: वृक्षवासी — पेड़ों से संबंधित या पेड़ों पर रहने वाला
definition: relating to trees, or living high among the branches of forest trees
example: The squirrels treat our bird feeder as an arboreal all-you-can-eat buffet.

hindi: वृक्षोद्यान — अध्ययन और प्रदर्शन हेतु पेड़ों का बाग़
definition: a botanical garden devoted to growing many different trees for study and display
example: Their second date was an arboretum walk, which is dating for people who own fleeces.

hindi: लताकुंज — बेलों से ढका छायादार कुंज
definition: a shady garden shelter formed by climbing plants trained over a wooden framework
example: The wedding planner promised a rose arbour; the venue delivered a trellis and a hopeful clematis.

hindi: ग्रामीण स्वर्ग जैसा — सरल, शांत और सुखी जीवन वाला
definition: belonging to an idealised, unspoiled countryside where rural life feels simple, peaceful and happy
example: The listing promised an Arcadian cottage; the photos carefully cropped out the motorway.

hindi: स्वर्गिक ग्राम्यलोक — चरवाहों का आदर्श, सुखद संसार
definition: archaic: poetic name for Arcadia, an imagined pastoral paradise of simple rural contentment
example: The glamping brochure sold Arcady; the reality included Wi-Fi at one bar and wasps.

hindi: गूढ़ — केवल कुछ ही लोगों को समझ आने वाला रहस्यमय
definition: understood only by a handful of people with secret or specialist knowledge; mysterious and obscure
example: The coffee machine's descaling ritual is so arcane that the manual has a manual.

hindi: अखाड़ा — मुकाबले का घिरा हुआ मैदान
definition: an enclosed space where contests are staged and watched
example: Politics is an arena, and the sand underfoot still soaks up whatever gets spilled.

hindi: साहसी अभियानी — किसी बड़े लक्ष्य की खोज में निकला वीर
definition: a bold adventurer who sets out on a daring quest for some great prize
example: A new generation of crypto Argonauts sailed off in search of golden fleeces.

hindi: धनपोत — माल से लदा विशाल व्यापारी जहाज़ या बेड़ा
definition: a large merchant ship, or whole fleet, richly laden with valuable cargo
example: The first delivery truck of the holiday sale arrived like an argosy of cardboard boxes.

hindi: सजग-दृष्टि — चौकस, जिसकी नज़र से कुछ न बचे
definition: extremely watchful and vigilant, noticing everything like the hundred-eyed guardian giant
example: The Argus-eyed invigilator caught the phone before it cleared the pocket.

hindi: एकल गीत — ओपेरा में एक पात्र का भावपूर्ण गायन
definition: an elaborate song for a single voice in an opera, expressing a character's feelings
example: When the printer jammed again, Dev launched into an aria of despair that reached three floors.

hindi: भूलभुलैया से निकलने का सूत्र — उलझन सुलझाने का मार्गदर्शक
definition: a guiding clue that leads someone safely through a tangled maze or problem
example: The commit history was her Ariadne's thread through the legacy codebase.

hindi: अभिजात वर्ग — जन्म से उच्च, वंशानुगत शासक तबक़ा
definition: the highest social class, holding hereditary titles, privilege and often political power
example: Silicon Valley insists it has no aristocracy, only founders whose children become founders.

hindi: जंगी बेड़ा — युद्धपोतों का विशाल समूह
definition: a great fleet of armed warships, or any huge moving company of vessels sailing together
example: An armada of scooters descended on the office the moment the rain stopped.

hindi: महाप्रलय — सर्वनाश का अंतिम युद्ध
definition: a final, catastrophic battle or disaster that threatens total destruction of everything
example: A spilled coffee on the only laptop before the pitch felt like Armageddon.

hindi: वलय-गोलक — आकाशीय वृत्तों का ढाँचा-मॉडल
definition: a model of the heavens built from rings showing celestial circles around Earth
example: The architect put an armillary sphere in the lobby, and visitors kept asking where the Wi-Fi password was.

hindi: युद्धविराम संधि — लड़ाई रोकने का औपचारिक समझौता
definition: formal agreement between warring sides to stop fighting while peace terms are settled
example: The siblings signed an armistice over the remote, pending the season finale.

hindi: अलमारी — कपड़े रखने की ऊँची नक्काशीदार अलमारी
definition: a large, tall and often ornate wardrobe or cupboard for storing clothes
example: The antique armoire would not fit up the stairs, so it now lives majestically in the hallway.

hindi: कुलचिह्नीय — वंश के प्रतीकों और ढालों से संबंधित
definition: relating to heraldry and coats of arms, or bearing a family's heraldic shield
example: The hotel's armorial napkins suggested ancient lineage; the receipt suggested a very modern markup.

hindi: अभियुक्त को पेश करना — अदालत में बुलाकर आरोप सुनाना
definition: call someone before court to hear the formal criminal charge against them
example: The group chat arraigned him for leaving everyone on read for a week.

hindi: पक्का — पूरी तरह, निरा (बुरी बात के लिए)
definition: complete, total and absolute, used only of something shameful; utter and downright
example: Calling the bug a feature was arrant nonsense, and it shipped anyway.

hindi: महत्वाकांक्षी अवसरवादी — किसी भी तरह ऊपर चढ़ने को आतुर
definition: an ambitious person who has recently risen in social rank, often by ruthless means
example: The arriviste learned every senior partner's birthday within his first week.

hindi: मानसिक दुराव — मन में छिपा दूसरा इरादा
definition: a hidden thought or unspoken intention kept back behind what is openly said
example: His generous offer to host came with an arrière-pensée: nobody would notice his unfinished kitchen.

hindi: हथियाना — बिना अधिकार के कोई शक्ति अपने नाम कर लेना
definition: to claim or seize power, rights or credit for oneself without any proper justification
example: The new committee arrogated to itself the power to approve every team's lunch order.

hindi: कला का गुण कला को छिपाना है — महान कौशल कठिन काम को सहज दिखाता है
definition: true artistry hides its own effort; great skill makes difficult creative work look effortless
example: The keynote looked improvised, but ars est celare artem: she rehearsed it forty times.

hindi: कला, कला के लिए — रचना का मूल्य स्वयं में, उपयोगिता या लाभ में नहीं
definition: art for art's sake; artistic creation valued purely for itself rather than usefulness or profit
example: Her latte art is pure ars gratia artis, since the customer drinks it in ten seconds.

hindi: कला दीर्घ, जीवन अल्प — कला सीखने को जीवन छोटा है
definition: artistry lasts long while human life is short; mastering any craft outlasts a lifetime
example: Forty hours into learning guitar and still no barre chord: ars longa, vita brevis.

hindi: काव्य-कला — कविता की प्रकृति पर लिखी कविता या सिद्धांत
definition: a poem or essay setting out the writer's principles about the craft of poetry
example: His LinkedIn bio has quietly become an ars poetica about writing better emails.

hindi: आर्ट डेको — ज्यामितीय, चमकदार सजावटी शैली
definition: a bold decorative artistic style of the 1920s using sleek geometric shapes
example: Mumbai's Marine Drive flaunts its art deco facades like a film set that forgot to close.

hindi: आर्ट नूवो — बेलबूटेदार घुमावदार रेखाओं वाली सज्जा-शैली
definition: a decorative artistic style using flowing curves, plants and flowers, popular around 1900
example: The new metro station copies art nouveau ironwork, down to the lilies nobody notices.

hindi: चालाक उचक्का — बातों से बच निकलने वाला चतुर जेबकतरा
definition: Dickens's streetwise young pickpocket, hence any cunning, nimble thief who charms himself clear of trouble
example: The intern who expensed a gaming chair as 'ergonomics' is the office's Artful Dodger.

hindi: सुस्पष्ट वक्ता — विचारों को साफ़ शब्दों में रखने वाला
definition: able to express thoughts and ideas clearly, fluently and effectively in words
example: The articulate intern explained the outage better than the three engineers who caused it.

hindi: कृत्रिमता — छल भरी चतुराई
definition: clever trickery or cunning devices used to deceive people or create false impressions
example: The influencer's candid morning routine required considerable artifice and three ring lights.

hindi: सहज — बनावट और चालाकी से मुक्त, स्वाभाविक
definition: natural and innocently honest, without cunning, pretence or calculated effect
example: Her artless reply-all won more sympathy than any carefully drafted apology.

hindi: लग्न; उत्कर्ष — उदीयमान राशि; बढ़ता प्रभुत्व
definition: the zodiac sign rising at birth; hence, a position of rising power and dominance
example: With three viral videos in a month, the intern was clearly in the ascendant.

hindi: तपस्वी — कठोर संयम और सादगी वाला
definition: practising severe self-discipline and avoiding pleasure, comfort and indulgence
example: His ascetic desk holds one laptop, one pen and a deep contempt for novelty mugs.

hindi: राख-सा फीका — डर या सदमे से सफ़ेद पड़ा
definition: very pale and greyish in the face, drained of colour by shock or fear
example: He went ashen when he realised the email had gone to the whole company.

hindi: गधे जैसा — अत्यंत मूर्खतापूर्ण, बेतुका
definition: extremely stupid or foolish, showing the slow, stubborn understanding people mock in donkeys
example: Requiring a password change every nine days is asinine, and everyone's is now Password9.

hindi: रूखापन — बोली और स्वभाव की कठोरता
definition: harshness of tone or temper
example: She corrected the intern with an asperity the whole floor could hear.

hindi: लांछन — किसी के चरित्र पर लगाया गया आक्षेप
definition: a damaging remark or false suggestion attacking someone's character or reputation
example: Nobody cast aspersions on the chef's cooking; they simply left the plates full.

hindi: आक्रमण करना — ज़ोर से हमला बोलना
definition: attack violently and repeatedly, whether with blows, weapons, fierce criticism or harsh words
example: Reviewers assailed the sequel for killing off the only likeable character.

hindi: ज़ोर देकर कहना — गंभीरता से सत्य होने की घोषणा करना
definition: to declare solemnly and emphatically that something is true, insisting upon it firmly
example: He asseverated, hand on heart, that he had definitely pressed save.

hindi: संकेत-मिलन — गुप्त रूप से तय प्रेमी-भेंट
definition: a secret appointment arranged between lovers so they might meet privately, away from watchful eyes
example: The hotel app's 'discreet check-in' feature was clearly designed for assignations.

hindi: सत्र न्यायालय — पुराने इंग्लैंड की घूमती अदालत
definition: historical: periodic court session held across English counties to judge serious cases
example: Dickens's villains always seem to meet their fate at the county assizes, rarely on time.

hindi: स्वरानुप्रास — निकट शब्दों में एक ही स्वर-ध्वनि की आवृत्ति
definition: the repetition of the same vowel sound across several nearby words
example: "Fleet street feet" is assonance; it is also what the marathon did to mine.

hindi: पीछे की ओर — जहाज़ के पिछवाड़े या उसके पीछे
definition: behind a ship's stern, or moving backward toward its rear across the water
example: The rival startup, once ahead, now trails far astern in the app rankings.

hindi: तारकीय — तारों से जुड़ा, नक्षत्र-लोक का
definition: relating to the stars and the heavens, or to a starry spiritual plane beyond the body
example: The yoga retreat promised astral travel, though most guests only reached the snack table.

hindi: कसैला — मुँह सिकोड़ने वाला; कठोर और तीखा
definition: having a sharp, drying taste that puckers the mouth; also severely and harshly critical
example: The astringent green tea matched the tone of her code review perfectly.

hindi: नक्षत्रमापी — तारों की ऊँचाई मापने का प्राचीन यंत्र
definition: an ancient instrument measuring the height of stars and planets, used by sailors and astronomers for navigation
example: He navigated the new office building like a sailor without an astrolabe.

hindi: चतुर — स्थिति और लोगों को परखकर लाभ उठाने वाला
definition: quick and sharp at judging situations and people, turning that judgement into practical advantage
example: An astute buyer waits for the last week of the quarter, when the sales team turns generous.

hindi: संयोजक-लोप — शब्दों या वाक्यांशों के बीच 'और' जैसे जोड़ हटा देना
definition: omitting conjunctions such as 'and' between words or clauses, making the list feel swift
example: Woke, scrolled, panicked, showered, sprinted — her morning was pure asyndeton.

hindi: पूर्वज-लक्षण — दूर के पूर्वजों के गुणों का पीढ़ियों बाद लौट आना
definition: the reappearance of traits from distant ancestors after many generations of absence
example: Grilling meat over open flame every weekend is his atavism, complete with grunting.

hindi: आदिम-प्रवृत्त — पूर्वजों की आदिम प्रवृत्तियों से जुड़ा
definition: relating to ancient ancestral instincts or traits returning after generations of absence
example: The last slice of pizza awakens an atavistic hunger that ends office friendships.

hindi: कलाशाला — कलाकार या शिल्पी की कार्यशाला
definition: an artist's or designer's studio or workshop, often where apprentices train
example: His garage became an atelier the moment he bought a second soldering iron.

hindi: ज्ञानशाला — पुस्तकालय या विद्वानों का सभागृह
definition: a library, reading room or institution where scholars gather for literary and learned pursuits
example: The coworking space calls itself an athenaeum because it has one bookshelf and oat milk.

hindi: आड़े — किसी चीज़ के पार तिरछे
definition: across from side to side, especially lying crosswise over a ship's length or blocking a path
example: His bicycle lay athwart the corridor, a trap for anyone carrying coffee.

hindi: अतिबलशाली — आकाश थामने वाले जैसा अपार बल
definition: having enormous strength, like the titan who carried the heavens upon his shoulders
example: The Atlantean intern carried the office water cooler up four flights without a word.

hindi: प्रायश्चित्त से भरपाई करना — अपनी भूल या अपराध की क्षतिपूर्ति करना
definition: to make amends for wrongdoing, sins or offences, repairing the harm done and seeking forgiveness
example: She atoned for forgetting the anniversary with a weekend in Goa.

hindi: प्रांगण — कई मंज़िलों तक खुला ऊँचा केंद्रीय कक्ष
definition: a large open central hall inside a building, often rising several storeys beneath a skylight
example: The headquarters' five-storey atrium cost millions, and the whole company still crams into the smallest meeting room.

hindi: सहचारी अधिकारी — दूतावास में विशेष कार्य का अधिकारी
definition: a diplomatic official attached to an embassy with responsibility for a particular specialist area
example: The cultural attaché spent the evening explaining cricket to diplomats who had only come for the canapés.

hindi: साक्ष्य देना — किसी बात के सत्य होने की पुष्टि करना
definition: to declare or clearly show that something is true, serving as witness or supporting evidence
example: The crumbs on his keyboard attest to a thriving desk-lunch habit.

hindi: वेशभूषा — किसी अवसर के लिए पहने गए कपड़े
definition: clothing worn for a particular occasion, especially formal or carefully chosen dress
example: The invite said business casual attire, which left forty engineers staring into their wardrobes of hoodies.

hindi: जानकार — ताज़ा घटनाओं से पूरी तरह परिचित
definition: fully informed and thoroughly up to date with current events, trends and fashions
example: To stay au courant with office politics, simply linger near the coffee machine at ten.

hindi: पारंगत — किसी विषय से भलीभाँति परिचित
definition: thoroughly familiar and well informed about a particular subject, practice or procedure
example: The new hire was surprisingly au fait with the legacy codebase, having apparently written it at her previous job.

hindi: प्रभात-गीत — भोर में प्रेमियों के बिछड़ने पर कविता
definition: a morning poem or song about lovers parting sadly when dawn arrives
example: His snooze button gets a fresh aubade every day at 6:40.

hindi: भाग्य साहसी का साथ देता है — जोखिम उठाने वाले की जीत
definition: fortune favours the bold; those with courage to take risks are rewarded
example: Audentes fortuna iuvat, he said, and asked for the window seat on a full flight.

hindi: दूसरे पक्ष को सुनो — प्राकृतिक न्याय का मूल सिद्धांत
definition: the principle of natural justice that both sides must be heard before judgment
example: Before banning the office playlist, the manager honoured audi alteram partem and endured three minutes of polka.

hindi: महा-मलिन — जड़ से सफ़ाई माँगने वाला
definition: filthy or corrupt on a scale that demands a total clean-out
example: The new commissioner inherited an Augean department and a very small broom.

hindi: कुछ भी — कोई भी चीज़
definition: archaic: anything whatever, anything whatsoever; the opposite of naught, which means nothing
example: For aught I know, the password is still password123.

hindi: शकुन देना — आगामी परिणाम का संकेत होना
definition: to be a sign of how something is likely to turn out
example: A quiet first week augurs well for a term everyone expected to be loud.

hindi: शकुन-विचार — संकेतों से भविष्य बाँचना
definition: foretelling future events by reading signs and omens, as ancient priests read birds in flight
example: The team treated the first sprint's velocity as augury, and the roadmap trembled accordingly.

hindi: स्वर्णिम — सुनहरे रंग का; अत्यधिक अलंकृत
definition: golden in colour or brilliance; also richly ornate and elaborate in style
example: The aureate lobby promised luxury; the lift promised tetanus.

hindi: प्रभामंडल — सिर के चारों ओर दिव्य आभा
definition: a radiant circle of heavenly light around a head or a shining body
example: Backlit by the window, the new manager wore an aureole that lasted until his first reorg.

hindi: उषा — भोर की पहली लाली
definition: the rosy glow of dawn, named after Aurora, Roman goddess of the morning
example: The aurora over the harbour was glorious, and I saw it only because my flight was at six.

hindi: उत्तरी ध्रुवीय ज्योति — रात के आकाश में रंगीन रोशनी
definition: northern lights: shimmering bands of coloured light dancing across polar night skies
example: We flew to Norway for the aurora borealis and photographed mostly clouds and each other.

hindi: उषाकालीन — भोर जैसा, उषा की लाली वाला
definition: relating to dawn, rosy and bright like the early morning glow of sunrise
example: The auroral pink sky lasted four minutes, and three of them went on finding the camera app.

hindi: संरक्षण — जिसके आश्रय और समर्थन में कोई काम हो
definition: the protection and sponsorship under which something is carried out
example: The talks resume under the auspices of the UN, and no birds were consulted.

hindi: कठोर मितव्ययिता — खर्च में सख़्त कटौती की नीति
definition: strict policy of sharply cutting spending, especially government spending during hard times
example: Office austerity began with the biscuits and ended with the windows.

hindi: रचनाकार निर्देशक — अपनी अलग छाप वाला फ़िल्मकार
definition: a film director whose personal style marks every film as distinctly theirs
example: He shoots his cat's breakfast in slow motion and calls himself an auteur.

hindi: निरंकुश शासक — जो अकेले, बिना जवाबदेही राज करे
definition: a ruler holding absolute power alone, answerable to nobody and governing without consent
example: My grandmother is a benevolent autocrat of the kitchen, and the menu is not open to debate.

hindi: स्वाध्यायी — बिना गुरु के ख़ुद से सीखने वाला
definition: a person who teaches themselves a subject through reading and practice rather than formal schooling
example: The autodidact learned Swift from forum threads and still writes comments apologising to the compiler.

hindi: स्वाध्यायी — बिना गुरु के स्वयं सीखा हुआ
definition: self-taught, gaining knowledge through personal study without teachers, lessons or formal schooling
example: His autodidactic plumbing skills come entirely from late-night videos, and it shows.

hindi: और समय, और रीतियाँ — ज़माने के साथ चलन बदलता है
definition: other times, other customs; manners, morals and habits change along with passing ages and generations
example: Grandma posted letters; her grandson sends voice notes — autres temps, autres mœurs.

hindi: शारदीय — पतझड़ की ऋतु से जुड़ा, ढलती रौनक वाला
definition: belonging to autumn, the mellow season when leaves turn golden, drift down and evenings darken early
example: The café rolled out its autumnal menu while the thermometer still insisted on July.

hindi: अग्रगामी — कला में नए, प्रयोगधर्मी और परंपरा-विरोधी
definition: boldly experimental and ahead of its time in artistic style, method or ideas
example: His avant-garde haircut was, according to his barber, an accident.

hindi: लोभ — धन की अति और कंजूस लालसा
definition: an excessive, grasping desire for wealth
example: The estate was carved up in a single afternoon of open avarice.

hindi: रुको — नाविकों का 'थमो' या 'बंद करो' का आदेश
definition: archaic: a sailor's command meaning stop, cease or hold fast immediately
example: Avast with the scope creep, the product manager declared, and nobody listened.

hindi: प्रणाम और विदा — दिवंगत को अंतिम अभिवादन
definition: hail and farewell, a poet's final greeting and parting words spoken to someone who has died
example: He signed his last email before retirement with a quiet 'ave atque vale'.

hindi: दृढ़ता से कहना — पूरे विश्वास से सत्य घोषित करना
definition: to state firmly and positively that something is true, making a confident, formal declaration
example: The estate agent averred that the damp was merely 'character'.

hindi: पक्षीशाला — पक्षियों को रखने का बड़ा पिंजरा या घर
definition: a large cage, enclosure or building for keeping, breeding and displaying birds
example: The open-plan office sounded like an aviary once the phones started ringing.

hindi: प्रमाणित करना — सत्य होने की पुष्टि करना
definition: archaic: to affirm firmly, vouch for, or declare openly and solemnly that something stated is true
example: I can avouch that the 'quick sync' ran ninety minutes.

hindi: खुलकर स्वीकारना — सार्वजनिक रूप से घोषित करना
definition: to declare or admit something openly and firmly, standing publicly behind the statement
example: He avowed his love of pineapple pizza before the whole team.

hindi: खुली स्वीकारोक्ति — किसी बात की सार्वजनिक घोषणा
definition: an open, firm declaration or admission of something, made publicly and sincerely
example: Her avowal that she never reads the minutes drew nervous applause.

hindi: स्वयंसिद्ध — जो बिना प्रमाण के सत्य माना जाए
definition: so obviously true that it is taken as a starting point, not proved
example: In this office it is axiomatic that the deadline will move at least once.

hindi: संकीर्ण सफलताजीवी — दिखावटी, अनुरूपतावादी व्यापारी मानसिकता
definition: a smug, conformist businessman devoted to material success and middle-class respectability
example: The Babbitt at the barbecue compared every neighbour's lawn to his quarterly earnings.

hindi: कोलाहल — अनेक भाषाओं और आवाज़ों का शोरगुल
definition: a confused, deafening noise of many voices or different languages speaking at once
example: The conference call became a Babel of echoes, dogs and someone's unmuted kettle.

hindi: विलास-नगरी — भोग, वैभव और भ्रष्टाचार का प्रतीक नगर
definition: a great city seen as a symbol of luxury, decadence, pleasure and moral corruption
example: To his grandmother, a weekend in Las Vegas was a pilgrimage to Babylon.

hindi: मदोत्सव — शराब और रंगरलियों से भरा उन्मत्त जश्न
definition: a wild, drunken party of feasting and revelry, named after Bacchus, Roman wine deity
example: The quiet team offsite became a bacchanal the moment someone found the karaoke machine.

hindi: मदमत्त — शराब और हुल्लड़ से भरा उत्सवी
definition: marked by drunken, riotous revelry and wild celebration in honour of wine
example: The team offsite turned bacchanalian somewhere between the karaoke and the second cheese board.

hindi: फिर से पतित होना — सुधार के बाद पुरानी बुराई में लौटना
definition: to relapse into former vices or sinful habits after having promised or started to reform
example: Dry January lasted until the seventh, when he backslid at a book launch.

hindi: हास-परिहास — हल्की, चतुर छेड़छाड़
definition: light, playful and witty conversation full of teasing remarks and clever jokes
example: Their badinage in the comments section was sharper than anything in the actual post.

hindi: सुहावना — मंद, गुनगुना और मनभावन (मौसम)
definition: pleasantly mild, soft and warm weather, gentle breezes without harsh heat
example: A balmy March evening and suddenly every pub garden becomes a festival.

hindi: स्तंभिका-जंगला — छोटे नक्काशीदार खंभों पर टिकी मुंडेर
definition: a railing supported by a line of small ornamental pillars along a staircase, terrace or balcony
example: Every wedding photographer poses the couple against the balustrade, which is why every album looks the same.

hindi: शोक-चुड़ैल — मृत्यु की सूचना देती चीखने वाली आत्मा
definition: a female spirit in Irish folklore whose wailing warns that a family member will soon be dying
example: The smoke alarm, wailing like a banshee at 3 a.m., wanted only a fresh battery.

hindi: नाई-वैद्य — बाल काटने के साथ चीर-फाड़ करने वाला
definition: a barber who also pulled teeth, bled patients and performed simple surgery
example: The barber-surgeon offered a shave, a tooth pulling and a bleeding, all without an appointment.

hindi: द्वार-बुर्ज — किले के प्रवेश की रक्षा करने वाला बाहरी गढ़
definition: an outer fortified gateway or tower defending the entrance to a castle or city
example: The receptionist's desk functions as the barbican, repelling salespeople long before they reach the executives.

hindi: चारण — वीरगाथा गाने वाला कवि
definition: a poet, originally a travelling singer who recited verses about heroes and history
example: Every friend group has one bard who turns a missed train into a three-act legend.

hindi: अलंकार-प्रधान — भारी सजावट और भव्यता से भरा
definition: extravagantly elaborate and heavy with ornate decoration, grandeur, gilding and dramatic flourish
example: The wedding invitation was so baroque it needed its own table of contents.

hindi: उथला उभार — सतह से थोड़ा उभरी नक्काशी
definition: sculpture whose carved figures project only slightly from a flat stone or metal surface
example: Years of sitting had pressed a bas-relief of the keyboard into his forearms.

hindi: उत्कर्ष-पतन — ऊँचे गंभीर स्वर से अचानक तुच्छ बात पर उतर आना
definition: an abrupt, often comic drop from lofty, serious tone into something trivial or ridiculous
example: "For freedom, for justice, for a longer lunch break!" — the union rep's bathos won the room.

hindi: कंगूरा — किले की दीवार पर दाँतेदार रक्षा-मुंडेर
definition: a fortified parapet along a castle wall, with regular gaps through which defenders could shoot
example: The toddler's sandcastle had battlements, a moat and, briefly, a siege by the family dog.

hindi: सस्ता ज़ेवर — दिखावटी, कम मोल की सजावटी वस्तु
definition: a small, showy trinket or ornament, pretty to look at but cheap and trivial
example: The employee-of-the-month plaque was a bauble handed out instead of a raise.

hindi: जानवरों-सा बुरा — घृणित, अप्रिय और निर्दय
definition: nasty, unpleasant, cruel and horrid, behaving like savage animals
example: It was a beastly trick to schedule the all-hands at eight on a Monday.

hindi: धन्य वह — खेत-गाँव के सरल जीवन का गुणगान
definition: Horace's praise of the happy person who lives simply, farming ancestral fields distant from cities
example: Every burned-out banker eventually quotes beatus ille and prices out a farmhouse in Umbria.

hindi: प्रियतम — किसी स्त्री का प्रेमी या साथी
definition: a woman's boyfriend or male admirer who courts her attention and escorts her about
example: She brought her new beau to the wedding and the aunties began their interrogation.

hindi: सजीला शौक़ीन — बेहद सुरुचिपूर्ण कपड़े पहनने वाला पुरुष
definition: an eponym for a fashionable, elegantly dressed gentleman, after the Regency dandy George Brummell
example: The new hire turned up a Beau Brummell in a tailored overcoat, and the hoodie brigade felt quietly audited.

hindi: उदात्त भाव — सुंदर, उदार या सम्मानजनक कदम
definition: a noble, generous gesture, sometimes grand but of little practical effect
example: Paying for the whole table was a beau geste, until the card was declined.

hindi: आदर्श सौंदर्य — पूर्णता का कल्पित प्रतिमान
definition: the perfect model or highest imagined ideal of beauty and excellence in some type
example: Her beau idéal of a Sunday involves no alarms and one enormous croissant.

hindi: अभिजात समाज — फ़ैशनेबल और धनी लोगों की दुनिया
definition: the fashionable world of wealthy, elegant society people and their glittering social gatherings
example: Half the beau monde turned up to the gallery opening, mostly for the canapés.

hindi: रूपवान — देखने में मनोहर और सुंदर
definition: literary word for beautiful: lovely to look upon and deeply pleasing to behold
example: The beauteous sourdough loaf was photographed eleven times before anyone was allowed a slice.

hindi: निस्पंद — हवा न होने से ठहरा हुआ, प्रगति रुकी हुई
definition: stuck motionless, like a sailing ship without wind, unable to make progress
example: The merger talks sat becalmed while both lawyers waited for the other to blink.

hindi: सुसज्जित — फूलों, गहनों या झंडियों से सजा
definition: decorated or adorned lavishly, covered with ornaments, flowers, flags or jewels
example: The team's desks were bedecked with balloons the day the funding round closed.

hindi: भड़कीला सजा — बेढंगे, चटकीले गहनों-वस्त्रों से लदा
definition: dressed or decorated gaudily, loaded with showy ornaments and vulgar finery
example: The office tree stood bedizened with tinsel, fairy lights and a disconcerting number of lanyards.

hindi: हंगामा — पागलखाने जैसा शोरगुल और अव्यवस्था
definition: a scene of wild noisy uproar and confusion, named after a London madhouse
example: The airport gate became bedlam the moment the flight was cancelled, and the snack kiosk sold out in minutes.

hindi: लथपथ — भीगा, मैला और बदहाल
definition: left untidy and dirty, especially soaked and muddy, looking sorry and thoroughly worn
example: The bedraggled trekkers reached the hostel just as the kitchen closed.

hindi: कंगाल करना — किसी को दरिद्र बना देना
definition: make someone very poor, draining away all their money and resources
example: The hidden fees on that phone plan could beggar a small nation.

hindi: दीन-हीन — भीख जैसा तुच्छ और नगण्य
definition: pitifully small or poor, fitting only a beggar's meagre portion of charity
example: The beggarly raise covered one extra oat-milk latte per month.

hindi: मोहित कर छलना — लुभाकर धोखा देना
definition: to charm or trick someone deceptively into believing something false or doing something foolish
example: The listing photos beguiled us into renting a flat that turned out smaller than the bathtub.

hindi: भीमकाय वस्तु — अत्यंत विशाल और शक्तिशाली चीज़ या संस्था
definition: something huge and massive in size or power, especially a giant organisation
example: The startup kept pivoting while the retail behemoth simply bought the street.

hindi: उचित होना — कर्तव्य बनना, शोभा देना
definition: archaic: to be fitting, necessary or a proper duty for someone, given their position or situation
example: It behooves anyone who borrows a car to return it with fuel.

hindi: रत्नजड़ित — बहुत से रत्नों-गहनों से सजा
definition: adorned or decorated with many jewels, often lavishly and conspicuously, to display wealth
example: The bejewelled phone case cost more than the phone, which was rather the point.

hindi: मधुर गायन-शैली — सुंदर, प्रवाही और अलंकृत गायन की इतालवी परंपरा
definition: an Italian operatic singing style prizing beautiful tone, smooth phrasing and effortless ornament
example: Shower acoustics convince every commuter that they are a master of bel canto until the water turns cold.

hindi: विलंबित — जो अपने उचित समय के बाद आए
definition: coming or happening later than the proper time, arriving after its expected moment
example: His belated birthday message arrived in March, heavy with emoji and remorse.

hindi: घेर लेना — चारों ओर से घेरकर दबाव डालना
definition: surround with hostile forces and besiege; also to beset someone with constant, wearing trouble
example: The beleaguered helpdesk faced forty tickets about the same frozen printer.

hindi: घंटाघर — मीनार का वह ऊपरी कक्ष जहाँ घंटे टँगे होते हैं
definition: the upper room of a tower where bells hang, or the whole tower that holds them
example: The belfry is officially closed to visitors and unofficially the best phone signal in the village.

hindi: स्वर्णिम युग — युद्ध से पहले का समृद्ध, सुखद काल
definition: the comfortable, glamorous decades of peace and prosperity in Europe before the First World War
example: Scrolling old photos, he called his college days the belle époque of cheap samosas.

hindi: ललित साहित्य — सौंदर्य के लिए लिखे गए निबंध और रचनाएँ
definition: elegant literary writing such as essays and criticism, valued for style rather than information
example: His travel expense reports have drifted from accounting into belles-lettres.

hindi: ललित साहित्यकार — सौंदर्य-प्रधान साहित्य लिखने वाला
definition: a writer of elegant literary essays and prose valued chiefly for style rather than information
example: The belletrist's newsletter about coffee runs nine paragraphs before mentioning a single bean.

hindi: युद्धप्रिय — लड़ाई और झगड़े के लिए सदा उत्सुक
definition: eager to fight, quick to threaten hostile force, and fond of picking quarrels
example: The group chat turned bellicose the moment someone suggested splitting the bill by item.

hindi: आक्रामक — लड़ने-भिड़ने को तत्पर, शत्रुतापूर्ण
definition: hostile and aggressive, openly ready to fight or start quarrels with others
example: He grew belligerent with the self-checkout machine, and the machine, wisely, said nothing.

hindi: दृश्य-मंडप — मनोरम दृश्य देखने के लिए बनी ऊँची छतरी
definition: a raised turret or summerhouse built to command a fine view over the surrounding landscape
example: The developer called the rooftop a belvedere, which is estate-agent for a lovely view of the motorway.

hindi: विश्वासघाती — अपने पक्ष को शत्रु के हाथ बेचने वाला
definition: America's notorious traitor of the Revolution, hence anyone who betrays their side, friends or country to the enemy
example: Our star engineer joined the rival startup, and the Slack channel called him Benedict Arnold.

hindi: आशीर्वचन — पूजा के अंत में दिया गया आशीर्वाद
definition: a spoken blessing, especially the short prayer that closes a religious service and sends worshippers home
example: The manager's final benediction, 'ship it', sent everyone home before seven.

hindi: दान — भलाई के लिए उदारता से दिया गया धन या उपहार
definition: generous gift or donation of money given freely to help a worthy cause
example: The alumni benefaction funded a new gym, a new wing and one very large plaque.

hindi: परोपकारी — दूसरों का भला चाहने वाला
definition: kindly and generous, wishing good for others and acting to help them
example: A benevolent landlord, he fixed the boiler before anyone had to send a second email.

hindi: अज्ञानांधकारग्रस्त — ज्ञान के प्रकाश से वंचित, अंधकार में पड़ा
definition: living in ignorance, kept in the dark without knowledge, learning or moral enlightenment
example: The benighted intern still believes the printer responds to shouting.

hindi: फटकारना — किसी पर देर तक गुस्से से बरसना
definition: scold someone angrily, loudly and at great length for their fault or failure
example: He berated the printer for ten minutes before noticing it was unplugged.

hindi: अनुनय करना — गिड़गिड़ाकर विनती करना
definition: archaic: to plead, implore or entreat someone urgently and earnestly for help, mercy or some favour
example: I beseech you, stop sending voice notes that last eleven minutes.

hindi: घेराबंदी करना — सेना से चारों ओर घेरना
definition: surround a fortified place or city with armed forces in order to force its surrender
example: Fans besieged the stadium ticket counter three hours before it opened.

hindi: कीचड़ उछालना — किसी की प्रतिष्ठा पर दाग़ लगाना
definition: damage someone's honour or reputation as though smearing dirt across it
example: He felt that a two-star rating had besmirched his family's cooking for three generations.

hindi: सितारों-जड़ा — झिलमिलाते सितारों से सजा
definition: decorated with spangles, sequins or small glittering ornaments that catch the light
example: The karaoke host wore a bespangled jacket that did most of the singing.
