hindi: नाप-अनुसार — किसी एक ग्राहक के लिए ख़ास बनाया
definition: made to order for one particular customer, especially tailored clothing measured and fitted individually
example: The consultancy sold them a bespoke solution that turned out to be a spreadsheet with a logo.

hindi: पाशविक — पशुओं जैसा क्रूर, असभ्य और विवेकहीन
definition: savagely cruel and brutal, behaving like wild animals without reason or restraint
example: The bestial scramble for the last discounted television required three security guards.

hindi: पशु-कथाकोश — असली-काल्पनिक जीवों का मध्यकालीन वर्णन-ग्रंथ
definition: a medieval book describing real and fabulous animals, often with moral lessons
example: The office Slack had become a bestiary of emojis nobody could explain.

hindi: उद्यत होना — आलस छोड़कर सक्रिय होना
definition: archaic: to rouse oneself, shake idleness away and become active, lively or busy again
example: Only the smell of bacon could bestir him before noon on a Sunday.

hindi: प्रदान करना — सम्मान या उपहार उदारता से देना
definition: give something valuable, such as honour, title or gifts, as a generous formal present
example: The committee bestowed upon him the title of Chief Fun Officer, and nothing else.

hindi: स्मरण करना — सोचकर याद आना
definition: archaic: to think carefully about something, or remind oneself of something worth remembering
example: Bethink yourself before replying all; the whole company is on that thread.

hindi: घटित होना — आ पड़ना, बीतना
definition: archaic: to happen, befall, occur to someone; woe betide warns that trouble awaits somebody
example: Woe betide the colleague who books a meeting over lunch.

hindi: समय से पहले — तड़के, जल्दी
definition: archaic: early, in good time, before the usual or expected moment arrives, ahead of schedule
example: She rose betimes to beat the queue, and found the queue had also risen betimes.

hindi: वाग्दत्त — जिसकी सगाई हो चुकी हो, मंगेतर
definition: the person someone has formally promised to marry, a fiancé or fiancée awaiting their wedding
example: Her betrothed insisted on a spreadsheet for the guest list, which is how she knew.

hindi: मध्य में — दोनों के बीच, इधर-उधर के दरम्यान
definition: archaic: between, placed in the middle of two things, choices or positions, belonging fully to neither
example: Stuck betwixt a reply-all storm and a calendar invite, she chose lunch.

hindi: ग्रंथोन्माद — पुस्तकें जमा करने का जुनून
definition: an obsessive passion for collecting books, gathering many more volumes than anyone could ever read
example: Her bibliomania means the unread pile now has its own postcode.

hindi: ग्रंथप्रेमी — पुस्तकों से प्रेम करने और उन्हें संजोने वाला
definition: a person who loves books, especially collecting fine, rare or beautiful editions
example: A true bibliophile moves flats and discovers the boxes of books outnumber the boxes of everything else.

hindi: पुस्तक-विक्रेता — विशेषकर दुर्लभ ग्रंथों का व्यापारी
definition: a dealer in books, especially one who sells rare, antique or collectable editions
example: The bibliopole on the corner prices a water-stained first edition as if it survived a shipwreck, which it may have.

hindi: मद्यप्रेमी — पीने का अत्यधिक शौकीन
definition: excessively fond of drinking alcohol, especially in cheerful, talkative company over long evenings
example: His bibulous uncle calls every toast 'just a quick word' and means forty minutes.

hindi: सुविचार-दंभी — सही राय रखने का दिखावा करने वाला
definition: holding fashionable, correct opinions with smug confidence, often without much independent thought
example: The bien-pensant dinner party agreed on everything except who would pay.

hindi: अर्थी — शव या ताबूत रखकर ले जाने का ढाँचा
definition: a movable wooden stand or frame carrying a coffin or corpse before burial
example: Four interns shouldered the retired office sofa as solemnly as a coffin on a bier.

hindi: विकास-उपन्यास — नायक के बड़े होने और परिपक्व होने की कथा
definition: a novel tracing a young hero growing from childhood into maturity, learning hard lessons about life and self
example: Her first year at the startup was a bildungsroman compressed into twelve very long sprints.

hindi: प्रेम-पत्र — प्रेमी को लिखी मीठी चिट्ठी
definition: a love letter, especially one written tenderly and sent privately to a secret sweetheart
example: Her billet-doux was a voice note, which counts in the modern courtly tradition.

hindi: बाज़ारू गाली-गलौज — भद्दी, अपमानजनक भाषा
definition: coarse, abusive and vulgar language, named after London's rowdy fish market
example: The group chat descended into billingsgate over who ate the last samosa.

hindi: नीच — बदमाश और बेशर्म व्यक्ति
definition: a thoroughly dishonourable, contemptible scoundrel who behaves with shameless, deliberate villainy
example: The blackguard dropped out of the group gift the moment the card was signed.

hindi: जुआरी ठग — घुड़दौड़ में धोखा देने वाला; हड़ताल-तोड़क
definition: archaic: a swindler, especially a cheating gambler at racecourses; also a worker who breaks a union strike
example: The fantasy-league blackleg quietly traded his whole squad the night before the deadline.

hindi: कोणीय लिपि — मध्यकालीन यूरोप के मोटे नुकीले अक्षर
definition: a dense, angular Gothic script of thick strokes used in medieval manuscripts and early printing
example: Nothing says heavy-metal band or small-town newspaper masthead quite like blackletter.

hindi: अतुकांत छंद — बिना तुक के लयबद्ध पंक्तियाँ
definition: verse with regular meter, usually iambic pentameter, but without any rhyme
example: Shakespeare wrote in blank verse; my landlord writes in blank threats.

hindi: लच्छेदार बातें — चतुर, मीठी चापलूसी भरी बकबक
definition: charming, flattering talk meant to persuade, deceive or amuse listeners, usually with playful exaggeration
example: His cover letter was pure blarney, yet somehow it landed the interview.

hindi: ईशनिंदा — ईश्वर या पवित्र वस्तु के बारे में अपमानजनक बात
definition: speech or action that insults the divine or mocks things believers hold sacred
example: Suggesting pineapple on pizza in the Italian family group chat was treated as blasphemy.

hindi: बकवास — लंबी, मूर्खतापूर्ण और निरर्थक बातें
definition: long-winded talk that is foolish, empty and without real sense or meaning
example: The horoscope app's blather said Tuesday would bring "energetic shifts", which it always does.

hindi: कुलचिह्न-वर्णन — ढाल पर अंकित प्रतीकों का विधिवत वर्णन
definition: a coat of arms, or the formal heraldic wording that describes a shield's colours and design
example: The startup's logo guidelines ran forty pages, a corporate blazon specifying every permitted shade of teal.

hindi: सहमना — डर से पीछे हटना
definition: to flinch or draw back from fear, losing courage when facing danger
example: He did not blench when the dentist said the word root canal.

hindi: एकांगी — एक ही नज़रिये में बँधा, दूसरा पक्ष न देखने वाला
definition: narrow in outlook, refusing to consider other ideas or points of view
example: A blinkered focus on engagement gave us an app everyone opens and nobody enjoys.

hindi: तूफ़ानी आक्रमण — तेज़ और प्रचंड सैन्य हमला
definition: swift, intense military attack using massed forces to overwhelm enemies quickly
example: Her spring-cleaning blitzkrieg cleared the entire garage before lunch.

hindi: नाकाबंदी — रसद और आवागमन को सैन्य रूप से रोकना
definition: military sealing of ports or roads, stopping supplies from entering or leaving
example: My cat maintains a strict blockade on the keyboard whenever deadlines approach.

hindi: जड़बुद्धि — लकड़ी जैसी मोटी खोपड़ी वाला
definition: a very stupid person, as thick-headed and unthinking as a solid block of wood
example: Only a blockhead leaves the car running with the keys locked inside, twice.

hindi: रक्तमोक्षण — रोग मिटाने को रक्त बहाना
definition: the former medical practice of draining blood from patients, believed to restore health
example: Cutting the marketing budget to fix low sales is corporate bloodletting: weaker patient, same disease.

hindi: डींग भरा प्रवचन देना — आडंबर से देर तक बोलना
definition: talk at length in a pompous, empty, self-important way, saying little of substance
example: The pundit bloviated for six minutes before admitting he hadn't read the report.

hindi: विदुषी — पढ़ी-लिखी, बौद्धिक रुचियों वाली स्त्री
definition: a learned, intellectual woman devoted to literary and scholarly pursuits, once said mockingly
example: The book club's resident bluestocking arrived with footnotes, and the wine went largely untouched.

hindi: नौकाध्यक्ष — जहाज़ के डेक, रस्सों और नाविकों का प्रभारी
definition: a ship's officer in charge of sailors, rigging, anchors and deck equipment
example: The office manager runs the supply cupboard like a boatswain inspecting the rigging.

hindi: गँवार — असंस्कृत, नीरस और कला से अनभिज्ञ
definition: dull, uncultured and ignorant of learning, as Athenians sneered at their neighbours from Boeotia
example: His Boeotian verdict on the gallery was that his nephew could paint that.

hindi: शब्दाडंबरी — खोखले भारी-भरकम शब्दों से भरा
definition: full of pompous, inflated language that sounds impressive but means little
example: His bombastic campaign promised to end traffic, taxes and Mondays.

hindi: शुभ भोजन — अच्छे से खाइए
definition: a wish that someone enjoys their meal, spoken before eating
example: He said bon appétit to the table and then started on everyone else's fries.

hindi: चुटकी भरा वाक्य — सटीक और चतुर टिप्पणी
definition: a brief, clever and witty remark delivered at exactly the right moment
example: He spent all evening polishing a bon mot and delivered it after everyone had left.

hindi: सुरुचि — उच्च समाज का शिष्ट और फ़ैशनेबल आचरण
definition: fashionable, well-mannered behaviour or style regarded as correct in polite society
example: Once bon ton meant a calling card; now it means muting yourself when the dog barks.

hindi: ज़िंदादिल रसिक — खाने-पीने और मौज का शौकीन
definition: French for 'good liver': a sociable person who enjoys fine food, drink and company
example: Every friend group has one bon vivant who knows a sommelier and none of the rent dates.

hindi: शुभ यात्रा — विदा होते यात्री के लिए शुभकामना
definition: a farewell wishing someone a pleasant journey as they depart on their travels
example: The team wished him bon voyage and divided his snack drawer before the taxi left.

hindi: खरा — सच्चा और असली, धोखे की नीयत के बिना
definition: genuine, and undertaken without any intention to deceive
example: She turned out to be a bona fide expert, not a man with a slide deck.

hindi: प्रामाणिकता — किसी की सच्चाई और योग्यता का प्रमाण
definition: evidence of someone's honest intentions, genuine credentials or good faith
example: The plumber's bona fides looked solid until he asked where the water went in.

hindi: बंधक सेवक — स्वामी की सेवा से बँधा दास
definition: a medieval serf or slave bound to serve a lord without freedom to leave
example: Signing that three-year phone contract made me a bondsman to a carrier with no signal.

hindi: ज़िंदादिली — खुला, हँसमुख मिलनसार स्वभाव
definition: cheerful easygoing friendliness that makes people feel welcome and relaxed
example: His bonhomie at the office party lasted exactly until someone mentioned the quarterly targets.

hindi: किताबी — पढ़ने-लिखने में डूबा रहने वाला
definition: devoted to reading and studying books, preferring quiet learning over sport, parties or social life
example: The bookish intern brought a novel to the team-building paintball day.

hindi: घनिष्ठ संगी — मौज-मस्ती का प्रिय साथी
definition: a close cheerful friend who shares your pleasures, meals and good times
example: A boon companion is someone who will split the dessert without being asked.

hindi: उजड्ड — असभ्य, अशिष्ट और रूखा व्यक्ति
definition: a rude, insensitive person with rough manners and no regard for others
example: The boor in seat twelve reclined fully before the plane even left the gate.

hindi: अक्खड़ — रूखा, अशिष्ट और असंवेदनशील
definition: rough, insensitive and rude in manners, with little regard for others' feelings
example: His boorish habit of taking calls at dinner ended the second date early.

hindi: निष्फल — व्यर्थ, बेकार
definition: archaic: useless, fruitless, without success or profit; effort that gains nothing
example: Arguing with the parking machine proved bootless, though deeply satisfying.

hindi: उत्तरी — उत्तर दिशा या ठंडे उत्तरी क्षेत्रों का
definition: relating to northern regions, north wind, or their cold forests and climate
example: The boreal chill crept south just as my heating bill crept north.

hindi: उत्तरी पवन — कड़कड़ाती ठंडी हवा का देवता
definition: Greek north wind, personified; hence bitter, icy northern gusts blowing winter weather southward
example: Boreas arrived at the bus stop precisely as I discovered my gloves were at home.

hindi: झाड़ीदार — घने पेड़-झाड़ियों से ढका हुआ
definition: covered with bushes and small trees, thickly wooded like shady forest undergrowth
example: The bosky corner of the park is where every dog suddenly forgets its name.

hindi: श्रृंगार-कक्ष — स्त्री का निजी कमरा
definition: a woman's private sitting room or dressing chamber inside a house
example: Her boudoir is now a home office, though the ring light still looks faintly theatrical.

hindi: रंगीन शहरी — शहर की शौकीन महफ़िलों में घूमने वाला
definition: a fashionable gentleman about town who frequents stylish coffeehouses, boulevards and smart society
example: Freshly relocated to Lisbon, he reinvented himself as a boulevardier with a laptop and a very small espresso.

hindi: उलट-पुलट — चीज़ों का पूरी तरह उलट जाना
definition: a complete overturning or violent upheaval that throws everything into turmoil
example: Remote work caused a bouleversement of commuting, housing and office snacks.

hindi: उदार — दिल खोलकर और खुले हाथ से देने वाला
definition: generous and giving freely; plentifully abundant, supplied in generous measure
example: The bounteous buffet was the only reason anyone stayed for the keynote.

hindi: प्राचुर्य — उदारता से मिली भरपूर देन
definition: generous giving, or the plentiful gifts, riches and abundance freely given
example: The bounty from Grandma's garden arrives each August in the form of unwanted zucchini.

hindi: सुवास — मदिरा या भोजन की विशिष्ट महक
definition: the distinctive pleasant smell of wine, perfume or cooking, enjoyed slowly before actually tasting
example: He swirled the supermarket wine, praised its bouquet, and fooled absolutely nobody.

hindi: मध्यवर्गीय रूढ़िवादी — संपत्ति और सम्मान का पुजारी
definition: typical of the comfortable middle class, especially its conventional concern with property and respectability
example: He mocked the matching patio furniture as bourgeois, then asked where they bought it.

hindi: गोवत्‌ — गाय-बैल जैसा धीमा, शांत और भावहीन
definition: like cattle or oxen; slow, placid, heavy and dully patient
example: He sat through the three-hour budget review with bovine calm, chewing gum like cud.

hindi: काट-छाँट करना — आपत्तिजनक अंश हटाकर रचना को नीरस बनाना
definition: to remove passages from a text considered improper, weakening its original force
example: The school edition bowdlerized the play until even the villain said 'gosh'.

hindi: लताकुंज — बेलों और डालियों से छाई छायादार जगह
definition: a shady resting place in a garden or forest, roofed by twining branches and vines
example: She strung fairy lights through the balcony creeper and now calls it her bower.

hindi: खारा — थोड़ा नमकीन, मीठे और खारे पानी का मिश्रण
definition: slightly salty, like water where river water mixes with ocean water
example: The hotel's 'artisan' tap water tasted faintly brackish, which they probably call terroir.

hindi: डींगबाज़ी — खोखली शेखी, आत्मप्रशंसा
definition: empty boasting and swaggering talk meant to impress, usually without substance behind it
example: The founder's braggadocio about 'disrupting sleep' ended with him napping under his desk.

hindi: मानसपुत्र — किसी के मन की मौलिक योजना
definition: an original idea, plan or invention imagined and produced by one person's mind
example: The four-day week was her brainchild, and she guards it like a dragon guards gold.

hindi: दिखावटी साहस — डर छिपाने या रौब जमाने का शेखी भरा प्रदर्शन
definition: a boastful show of boldness meant to impress others or hide fear
example: "I never read the terms and conditions," he declared with bravado, and later with lawyers.

hindi: शाबाश — किसी प्रदर्शन पर प्रशंसा की पुकार
definition: a shout of praise and approval for a fine performance, borrowed from Italian theatre audiences
example: When the toddler finally ate a vegetable, the whole table cried bravo.

hindi: चमत्कारी कौशल — दर्शकों को चकित करने वाला साहसी प्रदर्शन
definition: a brilliant, daring display of technical skill designed to dazzle an audience
example: He fixed the production bug live, on the demo call, with pure bravura and no tests.

hindi: संक्षिप्तता — कम शब्दों और कम समय में बात
definition: the quality of speaking or writing briefly, using minimal words and little time
example: The best man's brevity was the finest gift the couple received.

hindi: रंग-बिरंगा कबाड़ — छोटी सजावटी चीज़ों का ढेर
definition: a jumble of small decorative objects and ornaments of little monetary value
example: The spare room is a museum of bric-a-brac from every hobby he abandoned.

hindi: लगाम कसना — किसी आवेग पर नियंत्रण रखना
definition: restrain and control something wild, like an impulse, temper, anger or tongue
example: Bridle your enthusiasm before promising the client features that exist only in dreams.

hindi: दस्यु — बीहड़ में राहगीरों को लूटने वाला डाकू
definition: a member of a roving gang of robbers who ambush travellers in lawless country
example: The airport taxi rank at midnight felt less like transport and more like a brigand's toll road.

hindi: एकपृष्ठी पत्रक — एक ओर छपा बड़ा कागज़; तीखा प्रहार
definition: a large sheet printed on one side only, historically carrying ballads, notices or fierce attacks
example: Her resignation email was a broadside worthy of an eighteenth-century pamphleteer, copied to the entire company.

hindi: विराटकाय — भीमकाय, बहुत बड़ा
definition: enormous in size, gigantic and towering compared with everything ordinary around
example: The cafe served a Brobdingnagian muffin that needed its own chair.

hindi: बवाल — किसी छोटी बात पर मचा बड़ा हंगामा
definition: a noisy excited public fuss or uproar, usually over something quite small
example: A brouhaha erupted online over the new shape of a chocolate bar.

hindi: गहन तल्लीनता — ख़यालों में डूबी उदास-सी चुप्पी
definition: a state of deep absorbed thought, drifting so completely inward that surroundings vanish unnoticed
example: He sat in a brown study over his cold coffee until the barista started stacking chairs around him.

hindi: रूखा और उतावला — झटपट, बेरुखी से बोलने वाला
definition: abrupt and brief in speech or manner, blunt words that border on outright rudeness
example: The surgeon's brusque bedside manner was forgiven once the knee worked again.

hindi: पशुवत्‌ — जंगली, भद्दा, असंस्कृत और क्रूर
definition: coarse, crude, cruel and unthinking, behaving like wild animals without refinement
example: His brutish parking across three spaces told you everything about his quarterly reviews.

hindi: जलदस्यु — समुद्र में जहाज़ लूटने वाला साहसी लुटेरा
definition: a pirate who raided merchant ships for plunder, or a reckless adventurer in business
example: The investor strode in like a buccaneer, already planning to plunder the cap table.

hindi: ग्राम्य — गाँव और खेत-खलिहान के सुहावने जीवन से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the pleasant, peaceful rural life of the countryside, its farms and shepherds
example: The bucolic weekend cottage came with sheep, silence, and a rooster that ignored the time zone.

hindi: विदूषक — हास्यास्पद मूर्ख, मसख़रा
definition: a ridiculous but amusing person whose clowning foolishness invites laughter, often unintended
example: The panel show booked him as the expert and he played the buffoon.

hindi: पल्लवित होना — कोंपलें फूटना, तेज़ी से बढ़ना
definition: to begin growing and sprouting buds, and figuratively to expand rapidly and flourish
example: Her side project burgeoned until it quietly ate every weekend she owned.

hindi: विडंबन-नाट्य — गंभीर विषय की हास्यपूर्ण नकल
definition: a comic stage parody that mocks serious works by treating them with exaggerated absurdity
example: The team's re-enactment of the board meeting was a burlesque so accurate that it was nearly minuted.

hindi: रसद-कक्ष — अन्न-पेय रखने का कमरा
definition: a storeroom in a large house or college where drink and food provisions are kept
example: The college buttery still sells toasties at midnight, the only tradition students truly defend.

hindi: अरे वाह! — आश्चर्य या ज़ोर देने का पुराना उद्गार
definition: dated exclamation expressing surprise or emphasis, swearing mildly by Jupiter himself
example: By Jove, the printer actually worked on the first attempt.

hindi: विगत — बीता हुआ, जो अब लौटकर नहीं आएगा
definition: belonging to a past period of time that has gone and will never return
example: Dial-up tones belong to a bygone era, yet I still hear them in my dreams.

hindi: विद्रोही-रूमानी — उदास, अक्खड़ और रहस्यमय रूप से आकर्षक
definition: brooding, rebellious, passionate and darkly attractive, like the moody romantic heroes of Byron
example: He cultivated a Byronic air, mostly by never charging his phone.

hindi: अत्यंत जटिल और गूढ़ — उलझी, चालबाज़ व्यवस्था
definition: so intricate and devious that an outsider cannot follow it
example: The refund policy is Byzantine by design; nobody reaches the end of it.

hindi: आँख की किरकिरी — जिससे किसी को विशेष चिढ़ हो
definition: a person or thing that someone particularly dislikes and constantly complains about
example: The reply-all button is the office manager's bête noire.

hindi: मूर्खता — बेवकूफ़ी भरी बात या हरकत
definition: a foolish, stupid remark or action; borrowed from French for a piece of silly nonsense
example: Calling the client by his rival's name was a bêtise the account never survived.

hindi: यही जीवन है — जो हुआ उसे सहज भाव से स्वीकारना
definition: said to accept calmly that disappointing things simply happen in life
example: The flight was cancelled, the hotel lost the booking, and she just shrugged: c'est la vie.

hindi: षड्यंत्रकारी गुट — गुप्त योजनाएँ बनाने वाला छोटा दल
definition: a small secret group plotting privately to gain power or influence
example: A cabal of interns quietly plotted to replace the office coffee machine, and frankly they had public support.

hindi: प्रतिष्ठा — किसी चीज़ से जुड़ी साख और गरिमा
definition: the prestige and distinction that makes something admired, desired and quietly respected
example: A fountain pen still carries a cachet that no free promotional biro has ever managed.

hindi: कोलाहल — बेसुरी, कर्कश आवाज़ों का शोर
definition: a harsh, jarring mixture of loud, unpleasant sounds heard together
example: Forty phones announcing forty notifications made a cacophony the meeting never recovered from.

hindi: धूर्त पुरुष — स्त्रियों से बेईमानी करने वाला
definition: a gentleman who behaves dishonourably, especially by courting women with false promises and then deserting them
example: Only a cad breaks up by changing his relationship status first.

hindi: शवतुल्य — लाश जैसा पीला और कंकालवत्
definition: extremely thin and pale, looking like a corpse, with bones showing sharply
example: The cadaverous night-shift editor has not seen daylight since the spring.

hindi: कलाप्रदर्शन-अंश — एकल वादक का स्वच्छंद अलंकृत खंड
definition: an elaborate solo passage near the close of a concerto where the soloist shows off freely
example: The keynote was fine until the CEO's twelve-minute cadenza on his personal journey to founding the company.

hindi: यति — पंक्ति के बीच आने वाला विराम
definition: a pause or break falling within a line of verse, often marked by punctuation
example: There was a long caesura after "we need to talk," and the whole team stopped typing.

hindi: अधम — नीच और कायर व्यक्ति
definition: archaic: a base, despicable coward, mean in character and without courage
example: The caitiff dodged the dinner bill by discovering an urgent phone call.

hindi: सुनितंबिनी — सुंदर नितंबों वाला
definition: having shapely, beautifully rounded buttocks, named after a famous ancient Greek statue of Venus
example: Half the squat-rack videos online are quiet campaigns for callipygian glory.

hindi: अनुभवहीन — कच्ची उम्र का, दुनियादारी से अनजान
definition: young, inexperienced and immature, lacking the sound judgment and worldly sense that experience brings
example: The callow founder promised investors a billion users by spring.

hindi: मिथ्या अपवाद — किसी पर झूठा दोषारोपण
definition: false and malicious statements made deliberately to damage another person's good reputation publicly
example: The rival campaign's calumny collapsed the moment anyone checked the dates.

hindi: भाईचारा — साथ काम या संघर्ष करने वालों का आपसी अपनापन
definition: friendly trust and loyalty among people who share work, hardship or adventure
example: Nothing builds camaraderie like a team of five surviving the same broken deployment at 2 a.m.

hindi: दरबारी गुट — शासक के कान भरने वाले गुप्त सलाहकार
definition: a small secret group of private advisers who influence a ruler behind the scenes
example: The CEO's camarilla of old college friends decides everything before the board meeting even begins.

hindi: घंटा-मीनार — गिरजे के पास अलग खड़ी ऊँची घंटाघर मीनार
definition: a tall freestanding bell tower, especially one standing beside an Italian church
example: Climbing the campanile's four hundred steps felt spiritual right up until the bells rang with us inside.

hindi: अधम जनता — नीची समझी गई आम भीड़
definition: the common crowd or lowest class of people, spoken of with aristocratic contempt
example: From his penthouse terrace he sneered at the canaille below while waiting for their pizza.

hindi: अफ़वाह — जान-बूझकर फैलाई गई झूठी ख़बर
definition: a deliberately false rumour or story spread around to deceive people
example: The canard that the office coffee machine was being removed caused a genuine stampede.

hindi: निष्कपट — खुलकर और ईमानदारी से बात कहने वाला
definition: frank, open and honest in speaking, even when the truth is uncomfortable
example: The candid feedback form was anonymous, so naturally everyone guessed who wrote it.

hindi: उम्मीदवार — पद, नौकरी या चुनाव का प्रत्याशी
definition: someone formally seeking an office, a job, or a place
example: Every candidate turned up in the same bright white shirt, a habit older than they know.

hindi: स्पष्टवादिता — खुली और ईमानदार बातचीत का गुण
definition: the quality of speaking frankly, openly and honestly without hiding uncomfortable truths
example: The intern's candour about the roadmap was refreshing, briefly, until the VP read it.

hindi: सयाना — व्यवहार में होशियार और सावधान
definition: shrewdly careful and sharp in practical matters, especially money, deals and people
example: A canny shopper photographs the price tag before the cashier can find a different one.

hindi: मान्य ग्रंथावली — प्रामाणिक मानी गई रचनाओं का समूह
definition: the body of writings accepted as genuine, authoritative or the most important works in a tradition
example: Fans still argue whether the holiday special belongs in the canon.

hindi: संत घोषित करना — किसी को औपचारिक रूप से संत मानना; आदर्श बना देना
definition: to officially declare someone a saint; hence to treat any person as heroic and beyond criticism
example: Fans have canonized the retired striker, forgiving every missed penalty.

hindi: धार्मिक ढोंग-भाषा — पवित्रता का खोखला दिखावटी प्रलाप
definition: insincere pious talk, especially moral phrases repeated without genuine belief
example: The brochure's cant about 'family values' did not survive its unpaid-overtime policy.

hindi: स्तोत्र — धार्मिक ग्रंथ से लिया गया भक्ति-गीत
definition: a hymn or chant of praise sung in church, with words taken directly from scripture
example: The choir's canticle filled the chapel while the tourists photographed the ceiling.

hindi: सर्ग — लंबी कविता का एक बड़ा खंड
definition: one of the major divisions of a long narrative poem, like a chapter in a book
example: His account of the airport delay ran to several cantos and one descent into the underworld of Terminal 3.

hindi: छोटा टोटका — मामूली जादू या शरारती करतब
definition: a small magic spell or charm, or a playful trick; a minor piece of mischief
example: Her spreadsheet cantrip turned three hours of copying into one keystroke.

hindi: विस्तीर्ण — बहुत समाने वाला, खुला और बड़ा
definition: having a large capacity; roomy and able to hold a great amount
example: Her capacious handbag contains snacks, chargers and possibly a spare umbrella stand.

hindi: साज़-सज्जित — सजे घोड़े की तरह भव्य आवरणों से ढका
definition: decked out in rich ornamental coverings, originally the decorated cloth draped over a horse
example: The wedding horse arrived caparisoned in gold, looking noticeably calmer than the groom.

hindi: आत्मसमर्पण करना — शर्तों पर हथियार डालना
definition: surrender to an enemy, usually after agreed terms, and finally stop resisting their demands
example: After a week of begging, the parents capitulated and bought the puppy.

hindi: मनमौजी — बिना कारण अचानक मन बदलने वाला
definition: given to sudden, unaccountable changes of mind or behaviour without reason
example: The capricious office thermostat decides between Sahara and Siberia every afternoon.

hindi: सद्भाव-याचना — शुरुआत में ही श्रोताओं की सहानुभूति जीतने का प्रयास
definition: opening a speech or letter by winning the audience's goodwill, often through flattery or modesty
example: "I'm sure you're all far smarter than me," the keynote speaker began, captatio benevolentiae before forty slides.

hindi: छिद्रान्वेषी — छोटी-छोटी ग़लतियाँ पकड़कर आपत्ति करने वाला
definition: quick to find fault and raise objections over trivial points, mainly to score points
example: A captious reviewer left forty comments on the pull request, thirty-nine of them about commas.

hindi: सराय — कारवाँ के ठहरने की पुरानी धर्मशाला
definition: a roadside lodging with a large courtyard where desert caravans and travellers rested overnight
example: The motorway service station is the caravanserai of our age, minus the romance.

hindi: पत्तेबाज़ — ताश में चालाकी से साथियों को ठगने वाला
definition: a skilled cheat who swindles fellow players at cards through marked decks, sleight and trickery
example: Grandma plays bridge like a cardsharp and insists it is simply good memory.

hindi: लुढ़कना — जहाज़ का एक ओर झुकना; बेकाबू होकर तेज़ी से दौड़ना
definition: to tilt a beached ship onto its side for hull repair, or to hurtle along wildly
example: The delivery cart careened down the corridor and parked itself in the CEO's doorway.

hindi: वातहर — पेट की वायु निकालने वाली दवा
definition: a medicine or herb that relieves trapped wind and griping pain in the stomach after meals
example: The fennel after dinner is a carminative, which sounds far classier than what it prevents.

hindi: नरसंहार — भारी रक्तपात और मार-काट
definition: large-scale slaughter of people, especially the bloody, merciless killing that follows battle
example: The Black Friday sale ended in carnage: trampled boxes, abandoned trolleys and one weeping shop assistant.

hindi: मस्ती में पीना — शोर-शराबे के साथ शराब पीकर जश्न मनाना
definition: to drink alcohol plentifully and noisily with friends while celebrating late
example: They caroused until the bar's playlist started repeating out of spite.

hindi: आज का दिन जी लो — वर्तमान क्षण को हाथ से न जाने दो
definition: seize the present moment instead of saving it for later
example: He quit on Friday, bought a boat on Saturday, and called it carpe diem.

hindi: नुक्ताचीन — लगातार छोटी बातों पर शिकायत करने वाला
definition: constantly finding fault and complaining about small, unimportant things in a petty manner
example: Ignore the carping reviews about the font; the app itself saved my tax return.

hindi: कठोर संधि — पराजित को पूरी तरह कुचल देने वाली शांति
definition: brutally harsh peace settlement imposed to crush a defeated enemy completely
example: The divorce settlement was a Carthaginian peace: he kept only the ironing board.

hindi: कार्थेज नष्ट हो — किसी प्रतिद्वंद्वी के विनाश की बार-बार दोहराई माँग
definition: Carthage must be destroyed; a relentless demand, repeated endlessly, that a rival be completely wiped out
example: Every meeting, whatever the agenda, he ended with a Carthago delenda est about the legacy billing system.

hindi: स्त्री-स्तंभ — खंभे की जगह छत थामे खड़ी स्त्री की मूर्ति
definition: a carved female figure used in place of a column to support a classical building
example: Holding three coffees, a laptop and the door, she stood in the doorway like a weary caryatid.

hindi: रसिया प्रेमी — अनेक प्रेम-प्रसंगों में लिप्त व्यक्ति
definition: a charming seducer famous for many romantic conquests and love affairs
example: Grandpa claims he was a Casanova in 1971, though the photographs remain unconvinced.

hindi: अपमानपूर्वक निकालना — किसी को सेवा से बर्ख़ास्त करना
definition: dismiss someone from military service or public office in open disgrace
example: The colonel was cashiered for selling ration biscuits on an online marketplace.

hindi: अनसुना चेतावनीकर्ता — सच कहने पर भी अविश्वसनीय
definition: one whose true warnings are never believed
example: He was the Cassandra of the flood report, and the city filed it away.

hindi: दुर्गपाल — स्वामी की ओर से किले का रखवाला
definition: the governor who kept, defended and managed a medieval castle on behalf of its lord
example: My flatmate appointed himself castellan of the fridge and now guards the good cheese like a drawbridge.

hindi: कड़ी भर्त्सना करना — किसी की कठोर शब्दों में आलोचना करना
definition: criticise someone severely and harshly, often in full public view
example: The columnist castigated the ministry in eight hundred words and one devastating footnote.

hindi: युद्ध का बहाना — जिस घटना को आधार बनाकर युद्ध छेड़ा जाए
definition: an act or event held up as the justification for going to war
example: The border skirmish was less a cause than a convenient casus belli.

hindi: अपप्रयोग — शब्द या रूपक का ग़लत या खिंचा हुआ प्रयोग
definition: misusing a word, or stretching a metaphor beyond its normal sense, sometimes from error, sometimes for effect
example: "Let's table this and circle back to the elephant" was catachresis at a quarterly review.

hindi: भूगर्भ-क़ब्रिस्तान — सुरंगों वाला प्राचीन भूमिगत शवाधान
definition: an underground cemetery of long tunnels and wall recesses holding tombs of the dead
example: The hospital car park was a catacomb of identical grey levels and flickering lights.

hindi: शव-मंच — ताबूत रखने का सजा हुआ ऊँचा चबूतरा
definition: a raised decorated platform holding a coffin during a grand state funeral
example: The dead server lay in state on the desk as if on a catafalque while engineers filed past.

hindi: प्रलेप — घाव पर बाँधा जाने वाला गरम लेप
definition: a poultice, a moist warm plaster of herbs or meal applied to sore skin
example: The herbal blog renamed a poultice a cataplasm and doubled the price of the kit.

hindi: प्रतिश्याय — नाक-गले में बलगम की सूजन
definition: inflammation of the nose and throat producing heavy mucus, as with a lingering cold
example: The open-plan office passes catarrh around faster than it passes decisions.

hindi: प्रश्नोत्तरी धर्मशिक्षा — प्रश्न-उत्तर में रटवाए गए धार्मिक सिद्धांत
definition: a summary of religious teaching learned by rote through questions and answers
example: The onboarding quiz felt like a catechism: recite the company values or no laptop.

hindi: दीक्षार्थी — किसी सिद्धांत की शिक्षा पा रहा नवशिष्य
definition: a beginner receiving instruction in basic principles, originally a convert learning religious teachings
example: The new hire sat through onboarding like a catechumen, nodding at acronyms he would google later.

hindi: बिल्ली-सा रोना — कर्कश, चीखती आवाज़ में गाना या चिल्लाना
definition: to make a shrill, howling noise like fighting cats; to sing badly and loudly
example: Karaoke night is when the finance team caterwauls its way through power ballads.

hindi: रेचन — भावनाओं के बह जाने से मिली राहत
definition: emotional release that leaves a person lighter afterwards
example: Deleting the old codebase was less a cleanup than a catharsis.

hindi: सर्वरोगहर — हर रोग की एक दवा
definition: archaic: a universal remedy believed to cure every disease, a supposed medicine for everything
example: The consultant's slide deck presents microservices as the catholicon for every engineering ailment.

hindi: दलीय बैठक — किसी गुट के सदस्यों की निजी सभा
definition: a closed meeting of party members or faction supporters to choose candidates or policy
example: Before the vote, the frontend team held a caucus by the coffee machine and emerged united.

hindi: सैनिक तानाशाह — बलपूर्वक सत्ता हथियाने वाला सैन्य नेता
definition: a military strongman who seizes and holds political power by armed force
example: The homeowners' association president rules the cul-de-sac like a caudillo with a clipboard.

hindi: चर्चित मुक़दमा — सार्वजनिक बहस छेड़ने वाला प्रसिद्ध मामला
definition: famous legal case or controversy that attracts huge public attention and debate
example: The missing office stapler became a cause célèbre with its own Slack channel.

hindi: वार्ता — हल्की-फुल्की, सहज बातचीत या लेख
definition: an informal, chatty conversation, or a light essay written in that conversational style
example: His newsletter is a weekly causerie that wanders from coffee grinders to Roman emperors without apology.

hindi: वाक्पटु — बातचीत में निपुण, रोचक वक्ता
definition: a person admired for skilful, witty and charming conversation in social company
example: A born causeur, he could make a delayed train sound like the evening's best entertainment.

hindi: चेतावनी — दावे की सीमा बताने वाली शर्त
definition: a warning that limits how far a claim should be trusted
example: The study is promising, with the caveat that it followed only forty people.

hindi: खरीदार सावधान — जाँच का जोखिम खरीदने वाले का
definition: the buyer carries the risk of checking what is being sold
example: The listing said 'as is', which is caveat emptor in two words.

hindi: मीन-मेख निकालना — तुच्छ बातों पर आपत्ति करना
definition: to raise petty objections and find fault over small, unimportant details
example: One could cavil about the kerning, but the wedding invitation otherwise looks flawless.

hindi: द्रुतता — गति, वेग, फुर्ती
definition: swiftness of movement or action, great speed in getting things done
example: The celerity with which the office empties at five would impress any fire marshal.

hindi: खगोलीय — आकाश या नक्षत्रों से जुड़ा
definition: relating to heavens or visible skies, where stars, planets and moons shine
example: The rooftop party promised celestial views and delivered mostly the neighbour's satellite dish.

hindi: स्मृति-स्तंभ — उनकी याद में स्मारक जिनके शव कहीं और दफ़न हैं
definition: a monument honouring people who died but whose bodies are buried somewhere else entirely
example: A lone sock on the radiator stood as a cenotaph to its missing partner.

hindi: काट-छाँट कर दबाना — प्रकाशन से पहले अंश रोकना
definition: to cut or suppress parts of something before the public can see it
example: The studio censored four minutes of the film and called it a creative decision.

hindi: भर्त्सना — किसी आचरण की औपचारिक कड़ी निंदा
definition: strong formal criticism or official disapproval of someone's conduct or decision
example: The council passed a motion of censure, then broke for samosas.

hindi: शतायु — सौ या अधिक वर्ष की आयु का व्यक्ति
definition: a person who has lived a full hundred years of life or even longer
example: The centenarian credits her longevity to whisky, gossip and never once reading the terms and conditions.

hindi: कठोर द्वारपाल — प्रवेश रोकने वाला सख़्त रखवाला
definition: a fierce, vigilant guard or gatekeeper who allows nobody past without permission
example: The CEO's assistant is a Cerberus with a shared calendar.

hindi: मस्तिष्क-क्रिया — दिमाग़ की सोचने की मेहनत
definition: the working of the brain, careful thinking and hard mental effort spent upon a problem
example: The crossword demanded more cerebration than anything else she did before breakfast.

hindi: कफ़न-वस्त्र — शव लपेटने की मोम-लगी पट्टियाँ
definition: archaic: waxed cloths or wrappings used to wind a dead body for burial
example: The mummy costume, made from kitchen roll, passed for cerements until it rained.

hindi: औपचारिक — रस्म और विधि-विधान पर ज़ोर देने वाला
definition: excessively formal and polite, giving close attention to ritual and correct procedure
example: With ceremonious care, the intern unboxed the new laptop as though it were a royal relic.

hindi: आसमानी — गहरा साफ़ आकाशी नीला
definition: deep clear blue in colour, like a bright cloudless summer sky overhead
example: The brochure's cerulean sea arrived as a grey drizzle over a car park.

hindi: तिमिवर्गी — व्हेल, डॉल्फ़िन जैसे विशाल समुद्री स्तनधारी
definition: a whale, dolphin or porpoise; any member of the great ocean mammal family
example: The new cruise ship lumbered out of port like a bewildered cetacean.

hindi: तुलना करें — इस स्रोत से मिलाकर देखें
definition: compare with; tells readers to check another source or passage for contrast
example: The author claims the idea is original (cf. her own blog post from 2019).

hindi: मैदान — खुला, समतल ग्रामीण भूभाग
definition: archaic: open level countryside of fields and plains, free of woods and hills
example: From the train window the champaign rolled past, interrupted only by warehouses and a lone llama.

hindi: बदली संतान — परियों द्वारा चुपके से छोड़ा गया बच्चा
definition: a child believed to be secretly swapped by fairies for the real baby in folklore
example: The teenager who happily unloaded the dishwasher unasked was clearly a changeling.

hindi: वीरगाथा — वीरों के पराक्रम का प्राचीन फ़्रांसीसी काव्य
definition: a medieval French epic poem celebrating the heroic deeds of knights and legendary kings like Charlemagne
example: His retelling of fixing the office wifi had grown into a full chanson de geste by Friday.

hindi: पटरी-पुस्तिका — फेरीवालों द्वारा बेची जाने वाली सस्ती छोटी पुस्तिका
definition: a small, cheaply printed booklet of ballads, tales or tracts once sold by peddlers
example: Her poetry chapbook sold out at the open-mic night, all eleven copies, mostly to her aunts.

hindi: सलाम — किसी की उपलब्धि पर सम्मान से सिर झुकाना
definition: French for 'hats raised', said to express admiring praise for someone's impressive achievement
example: You finished the marathon and still made brunch; chapeau.

hindi: पुष्पमाला — सिर पर पहनी फूलों या पत्तियों की माला
definition: a wreath or garland of flowers or leaves worn upon the head, often as a festive crown or honour
example: At the festival every third person wore a chaplet of plastic daisies and a lanyard.

hindi: कार्यवाहक राजदूत — राजदूत की अनुपस्थिति में दूतावास प्रमुख
definition: a diplomat who temporarily heads an embassy while the ambassador is absent or away
example: With the manager on leave, the intern acted as chargé d'affaires and approved every snack order.

hindi: आकर्षण-शक्ति — लोगों को मोह लेने वाला व्यक्तित्व
definition: a compelling personal charm that attracts, inspires and persuades other people
example: His charisma could sell a timeshare to a man who already owns three.

hindi: ढोंगी — झूठा ज्ञानी बनकर ठगने वाला
definition: a fraud who falsely claims special knowledge or skill to deceive people
example: The charlatan sold detox bracelets that removed nothing except money.

hindi: अस्थि-घर — मृत शरीर और हड्डियाँ जमा करने का भवन
definition: a building or underground vault where corpses and bones of the dead are gathered and piled
example: After the tournament, the changing room smelled like a charnel house.

hindi: ताड़ना देना — किसी को सख़्ती से डाँटना या दंड देना
definition: scold or punish someone severely and sternly for their fault, error or wrongdoing
example: Chastised by the group chat, he finally returned the borrowed charger.

hindi: गृहस्वामिनी — बड़े घर की मालकिन और व्यवस्थापिका
definition: the woman who runs and manages a large household, historically carrying its keys at her waist
example: She is chatelaine of the family group chat, keeper of birthdays, passwords and grudges.

hindi: अंधराष्ट्रवाद/अहंभाव — अपने देश, दल या लिंग की अंधी श्रेष्ठता
definition: aggressive, unreasoning belief that your nation, group or gender is naturally superior
example: His chauvinism about his hometown's pizza has ended three friendships.

hindi: क्षुद्र कंजूसी — मामूली बचत के लिए भी ओछा हिसाब
definition: stingy in a petty manner, saving trivial amounts through mean little economies
example: The cheeseparing airline now charges extra for the armrest.

hindi: श्रेष्ठ कृति — किसी कलाकार की सर्वोत्तम रचना
definition: a masterpiece; the finest work an artist, writer or craftsman ever produced
example: Of all his slide decks, the one that got the budget approved remains his chef-d'oeuvre.

hindi: अश्वारोही वीर — शिष्ट और वीर सामंत योद्धा
definition: a knight or mounted nobleman, and more loosely a gallant, courteous gentleman with polished manners
example: He held the lift, carried her boxes and fixed the printer, a chevalier of the open-plan office.

hindi: छाया-प्रकाश — चित्र में उजाले और अँधेरे का नाटकीय मेल
definition: the dramatic contrast of bright light and deep shadow in painting or photography
example: A single desk lamp gave his video call the chiaroscuro of a Caravaggio and the mood of a hostage tape.

hindi: विपर्यय संरचना — दूसरे भाग में पहले भाग का क्रम उलट देना
definition: reversing the grammatical order of the first phrase in the second, creating a mirrored crossing pattern
example: "Work to live, don't live to work," said the poster, a chiasmus hung above a desk nobody leaves before nine.

hindi: छल-छद्म — चालाकी भरी धोखेबाज़ी
definition: clever deceitful trickery used to cheat people or gain unfair advantage
example: The raffle's chicanery came to light when the organiser won three years running.

hindi: दराज़दार अलमारी — कपड़ों या बर्तनों की ऊँची संदूकी
definition: a tall chest of drawers or ornamental cabinet for storing clothes or dishes
example: Grandma's chiffonier arrived with the inheritance and a drawer full of other people's receipts.

hindi: मृगतृष्णा — असंभव कल्पना
definition: a hoped-for thing that proves impossible
example: A permanently clean inbox is a chimera he keeps chasing anyway.

hindi: कपोल-कल्पित — केवल कल्पना में संभव
definition: existing only in imagination; wildly improbable
example: The plan to power the whole city on tides by spring was frankly chimerical.

hindi: हस्तरेखा-शास्त्र — हथेली की रेखाओं से भाग्य बताना
definition: palmistry; foretelling a person's character and future by reading the lines of their hand
example: He claims the calluses from his keyboard are chiromancy enough to predict another decade in engineering.

hindi: शूरवीरोचित — उदार, विनम्र और सम्मानपूर्ण आचरण वाला
definition: courteous, generous and honourable, especially in protecting or helping others, like knights
example: His chivalrous surrender of his charging cable at the airport cost him six hours of regret.

hindi: पाठ-संचयन — भाषा सीखने हेतु चुने हुए गद्यांश
definition: a collection of selected passages from writers, compiled especially to help students learn a language
example: The language app is basically a chrestomathy of sentences about apples, boys and the whereabouts of the library.

hindi: कोषावस्था — तितली बनने से पहले का कोष; परिवर्तन का दौर
definition: the protective casing where a caterpillar becomes a butterfly; any stage of transformation
example: The gap year was her chrysalis, though her parents called it sleeping until noon.

hindi: पातालवासी — धरती के नीचे के देवताओं और लोकों से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the underworld or the spirits and deities dwelling deep beneath the earth
example: The metro's chthonic rumble tells you the train is coming, eventually.

hindi: गँवार — अशिष्ट, कंजूस व्यक्ति
definition: archaic: a rude, surly, mean-spirited person; originally a peasant of lowly rank
example: Only a churl would take the last slice of birthday cake without asking.

hindi: रूखा — बेवजह अशिष्ट और कृपणतापूर्ण
definition: rudely ungracious or mean-spirited, especially when politeness would cost nothing
example: It would be churlish to refuse the colleague's homemade cake, however experimental.

hindi: धृष्टता — हर मर्यादा लाँघने वाला बेशर्म साहस
definition: shameless boldness; audacious nerve that ignores every normal limit of manners
example: It takes chutzpah to arrive late to your own apology meeting.

hindi: भूतपूर्व — जो पहले कुछ था, अब नहीं
definition: former or erstwhile, describing someone who once held a title or status they lost
example: The ci-devant unicorn now rents half its old office to a yoga studio.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक — दर्शनीय स्थलों का जानकार पथ-प्रदर्शक
definition: a knowledgeable guide who shows visitors around sites and explains their history
example: Our cicerone at the museum knew every painting and every cafe with decent restrooms.

hindi: सखा-प्रेमी — विवाहिता का स्वीकृत पुरुष साथी
definition: the openly acknowledged male companion, escort or lover of a married woman in society
example: Her husband tolerated the cicisbeo because he was excellent at assembling furniture.

hindi: घोर अंधकारमय — जहाँ कभी उजाला न पहुँचे
definition: wrapped in thick, gloomy darkness, like a mythical land that sunlight never reaches
example: The Cimmerian gloom of the cinema was broken only by one glowing phone in row three.

hindi: यथार्थ सिनेमा — बिना बनावट के वास्तविक जीवन दिखाने वाली फ़िल्म-शैली
definition: documentary filmmaking that records real life candidly, showing unscripted truth without staging
example: Our family video of Christmas dinner is pure cinéma vérité, arguments included.

hindi: लगभग — अनुमानित तिथि या संख्या से पहले प्रयुक्त
definition: approximately or around, placed before a date, year or figure whose exact value remains uncertain
example: The fridge leftovers date from circa last Tuesday, possibly earlier.

hindi: मोहिनी — ऐसा आकर्षण जो मनुष्य को पतित कर दे
definition: dangerously alluring and bewitching, luring people toward pleasure that degrades them
example: The Circean glow of the phone kept him scrolling until three in the morning.

hindi: घुमावदार — सीधे के बजाय लंबे चक्कर वाला
definition: taking a long, roundabout route instead of the direct path to somewhere
example: The ride-share took a circuitous route that somehow toured every surge zone in town.

hindi: परिक्रमा करना — किसी चीज़ के चारों ओर चलना
definition: walk completely around something, often slowly, ceremonially or as a devout ritual
example: Before buying, she circumambulated the used car three times as if it might confess.

hindi: घुमा-फिराकर कहना — सीधी बात के लिए लंबा चक्कर
definition: using many words to talk around something instead of saying it directly and plainly
example: After ten minutes of circumlocution, the manager finally admitted the project was cancelled.

hindi: परिक्रमा करना — समुद्र द्वारा पूरी पृथ्वी या किसी द्वीप का चक्कर लगाना
definition: to sail completely around the whole world, an island, or some obstacle blocking passage
example: She circumnavigated the awkward topic for forty minutes and never once landed on it.

hindi: दुर्ग — नगर पर छाया गढ़, संकट का अंतिम आश्रय
definition: a fortress commanding a city, serving as the final stronghold in times of siege
example: The finance team's shared drive is a citadel: impregnable, forbidding and possibly empty inside.

hindi: और तेज़, और ऊँचा, और बलवान — सीमाओं से आगे बढ़ने का ओलंपिक आदर्श
definition: faster, higher, stronger; the Olympic motto urging athletes beyond their limits
example: His fitness tracker's weekly report reads like citius, altius, fortius, and his knees disagree.

hindi: अतींद्रिय द्रष्टा — भविष्य या छिपी बातें देख लेने वाला
definition: claiming or seeming to perceive future events or hidden things beyond ordinary senses
example: Our clairvoyant barista starts the oat latte before I reach the counter.

hindi: कोलाहलपूर्ण — शोर मचाता, ज़ोर-ज़ोर से माँग करता
definition: making loud, confused noise, often shouting demands insistently
example: A clamorous queue formed the moment the café announced free refills.

hindi: भाड़े के ताली-बाज़ — पैसे लेकर तालियाँ बजाने वाला दल
definition: a group hired to applaud a performer in a theatre; hence any band of paid, loyal flatterers
example: The founder's every tweet is greeted by a claque of investors applauding on cue.

hindi: तूर्यनाद-सा — तुरही-सा ऊँचा, साफ़ और प्रेरक
definition: loud, clear and rousing, like the ringing sound of a medieval trumpet calling soldiers
example: Her clarion email subject line, 'Please Read,' was read by nobody.

hindi: क्षमादान — दंड देने की शक्ति रखते हुए दिखाई गई दया
definition: mercy shown by someone holding the power to punish
example: The governor granted clemency eleven hours before the sentence was due.

hindi: सौम्य — मौसम जो नरम और सुहाना हो
definition: mild, gentle weather; neither harsh cold nor fierce heat, pleasant enough outdoors
example: The forecast called for clement weather, so naturally the barbecue was rained out.

hindi: प्रकाश-गवाक्ष — ऊँची दीवार में बनी खिड़कियों की पंक्ति
definition: an upper wall of windows rising above a lower roof, letting daylight into a tall interior
example: The renovated barn's clerestory floods the kitchen with light and the heating bill with ambition.

hindi: पादरी-संबंधी — पादरी वर्ग या उनके धार्मिक पद का
definition: relating to clergy, priests and ministers, or their religious office, dress and duties within the church
example: He wore his black turtleneck with a clerical gravity that made the startup demo feel like mass.

hindi: चरित-हास्य कविता — किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति पर चार पंक्तियों की चुटकी
definition: a comic four-line verse about a famous person, with clumsy rhymes and whimsical rhythm
example: The class wrote a clerihew about the headmaster, and he laminated it.

hindi: विद्वत्-समाज — शिक्षित, विद्वान लोगों का वर्ग
definition: the educated, learned class of a society, regarded as guardians and teachers of its culture
example: The new clerisy debates culture on podcasts sponsored by mattress companies.

hindi: चरमोत्कर्ष — कथा या घटना का सबसे तीव्र क्षण
definition: the most intense and exciting point of a story, event or long struggle
example: The climax of the quarterly review was someone finally finding the mute button.

hindi: गुटबंदी — बाहर वालों को दूर रखने वाला छोटा समूह
definition: a small exclusive group of friends who keep outsiders firmly away from their circle
example: The marketing clique had its own lunch table, its own slang and its own Slack channel.

hindi: मठ-वीथी — मठ के आँगन के चारों ओर ढका खंभेदार गलियारा
definition: a covered walkway around a monastery courtyard, with an open colonnade along the inner side
example: The college cloister is ideal for quiet reflection until the tour group with the selfie stick arrives.

hindi: मठवासी — संसार से अलग, एकांत आश्रम जैसा जीवन
definition: secluded from worldly life and its distractions, like monks or nuns living quietly within a monastery
example: After a month of cloistered thesis writing, the supermarket felt like a carnival.

hindi: अतिमधुर — इतना मीठा कि जी भर जाए
definition: sickeningly sweet or rich, pleasant initially though soon excessive and tiresome
example: The anniversary post was so cloying that his followers checked on him privately.

hindi: मिलनसार — संगति के योग्य, सहज साथी
definition: sociable, companionable and agreeable enough to be warmly welcomed as a member of any club
example: He is eminently clubbable, which explains why he knows everyone and remembers nothing they said.

hindi: उपसंहार — संगीत या कथा का समापन-अंश
definition: a concluding passage that brings a musical piece, story or event to its final close
example: The meeting had a coda nobody wanted: 'One more quick thing.'

hindi: पोथी — प्राचीन हस्तलिखित ग्रंथ, पन्नों वाली जिल्द में
definition: an ancient handwritten manuscript text with pages bound together in book form, rather than a scroll
example: She guards her recipe notebook like a medieval codex.

hindi: पांडुलिपि-विज्ञान — हस्तलिखित ग्रंथों की भौतिक बनावट का अध्ययन
definition: the study of manuscripts as physical objects, including their parchment, binding and page structure
example: Any student of codicology could date that library book by the coffee rings alone.

hindi: समवयस्क — एक ही युग या आयु का
definition: having the same years or date of origin, belonging to exactly the same period of history
example: The office sofa is coeval with the company and has seen every reorganisation.

hindi: युक्तिसंगत — ठोस तर्क वाला, सहज ही मन को मना लेने वाला
definition: clear, logical and forceful, making an argument genuinely convincing to listeners
example: Her cogent case for a four-day week left the board searching for a counterpoint and finding only lunch.

hindi: विचार करना — गंभीरता से सोचना
definition: to think deeply and carefully about something, turning every possibility over slowly and deliberately
example: He cogitated over the menu for ten minutes and then ordered what he always orders.

hindi: विचार-मंथन — गहरी, सधी हुई सोच
definition: long careful thinking, earnest mental effort turning a problem over deliberately
example: After much cogitation the committee concluded that the meeting should have been an email.

hindi: अवगत — किसी बात की पूरी जानकारी और समझ रखने वाला
definition: fully and clearly aware of something, having knowledge and understanding of its importance
example: Cognizant of the open microphone, he praised the client's slides with unusual warmth.

hindi: मर्मज्ञ — किसी क्षेत्र के भीतरी जानकार विशेषज्ञ
definition: people with expert, insider knowledge of a particular field, especially the arts
example: The cognoscenti swear the band's first album was better, mainly because nobody else heard it.

hindi: केशविन्यास — सजाया-सँवारा हुआ बालों का ढंग
definition: a person's hairstyle, especially an elaborate one carefully arranged and styled by professional hands
example: His coiffure survived the rooftop party's wind better than his pitch did.

hindi: अल्पाहार — हल्का-फुल्का भोजन
definition: a light meal, often served informally between the main meals
example: The conference promised a collation, which turned out to be biscuits guarding a thermos.

hindi: विचार-गोष्ठी — विद्वानों की शैक्षणिक चर्चा-सभा
definition: an academic meeting where scholars present papers and discuss a particular topic together
example: The department colloquium promised fresh insight and delivered forty minutes of someone's dissertation slides.

hindi: संवाद — गंभीर विषय पर औपचारिक वार्तालाप
definition: a formal conversation or serious dialogue between people exchanging views on a subject
example: Their colloquy on sourdough starters lasted longer than most of the relationships at the party.

hindi: साँठगाँठ — ग़लत उद्देश्य के लिए गुप्त सहयोग
definition: secret cooperation between parties to cheat, deceive or gain unfair advantage
example: The identical price rises at every petrol station on the street smelled strongly of collusion.

hindi: स्तंभावली — बराबर दूरी पर खड़े खंभों की लंबी क़तार
definition: a long line of columns standing at even intervals, often carrying a roof along a building
example: The campus colonnade photographs beautifully, which is why nobody mentions it floods every monsoon.

hindi: पुष्पिका — ग्रंथ के अंत में मुद्रण और लेखक का विवरण
definition: a note printed on the final page of a book, giving printing, typeface and publishing details
example: Only typographers and insomniacs read the colophon.

hindi: अलंकृत गायन — तीव्र तानों और सजावटी स्वरों से भरा गायन
definition: elaborate ornamental singing full of rapid runs and trills, or the soprano who performs it
example: The toddler's midnight coloratura hit notes that no baby monitor was built to survive.

hindi: सुदर्शन — देखने में सुघड़ और आकर्षक
definition: pleasant to look upon, attractive in face and figure in a wholesome, modest manner
example: The comely new barista has quietly doubled the café's oat-milk sales.

hindi: खाद्य पदार्थ — खाने योग्य कोई भी चीज़
definition: anything that can be eaten, especially food items kept as supplies or stock
example: The office kitchen held three comestibles and a fourteen-month-old jar of mustard.

hindi: शिष्टाचार-सौहार्द — राष्ट्रों या संस्थाओं का परस्पर सम्मानपूर्ण व्यवहार
definition: courteous friendly respect between nations or institutions, each honouring the other's laws and customs
example: In a spirit of comity, the two office floors agreed to share the good coffee machine on alternate days.

hindi: यथोचित — जैसा होना चाहिए, वैसा ही
definition: correct and proper according to accepted social standards and polite behaviour
example: A handwritten thank-you note is still comme il faut, even if you type the address into a delivery app.

hindi: इतालवी लोक-प्रहसन — स्थिर पात्रों वाला तात्कालिक हास्य-नाटक
definition: Italian improvised comic theatre using masked stock characters such as Harlequin and Pantalone
example: Our planning meeting is pure commedia dell'arte: same stock characters, fresh improvised chaos every week.

hindi: सहभोजी — एक ही मेज़ पर साथ खाने वाला
definition: a person who regularly shares meals with others, sitting together at the same dining table
example: After a year of shared lunches, the finance and design teams have become unlikely commensals.

hindi: प्रशस्त — खुला-खुला, आराम से बड़ा
definition: roomy and comfortable; offering plenty of space inside for people or belongings
example: The listing called the flat commodious, which it was, for one small cat.

hindi: सामान्य जनवर्ग — कुलीनों से अलग आम लोग
definition: the ordinary common people as a body, distinct from the nobility and ruling classes
example: The royal wedding was televised so the commonalty could admire canapés it would never taste.

hindi: संचय-पुस्तिका — पढ़े हुए उद्धरणों और विचारों की निजी कॉपी
definition: a personal notebook collecting memorable quotations, passages and ideas copied from reading
example: His Notes app is a digital commonplace book of quotes, recipes and forgotten passwords.

hindi: आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति — सरकार या संस्था की औपचारिक सूचना
definition: an official statement or announcement released to the press by a government or large organisation
example: The landlord's communiqué on the broken lift ran two pages and fixed nothing.

hindi: समकक्ष — बराबरी का साथी या प्रतिद्वंद्वी
definition: an equal in rank, ability or standing; a peer, fellow or close companion
example: Among her compeers in the coding bootcamp, she alone understood regular expressions, and they resented it.

hindi: संक्षिप्त पर व्यापक — थोड़े में सब कुछ समेटने वाला
definition: containing much information within brief, compact writing that still covers the whole subject
example: The compendious onboarding doc fit the entire codebase history onto two pages.

hindi: संग्रह-ग्रंथ — किसी विषय का संक्षिप्त पर संपूर्ण संकलन
definition: a concise but complete collection of information, writings or knowledge gathered about one subject
example: Her fridge door is a compendium of takeaway menus and unpaid parking fines.

hindi: अनुवर्ती — दूसरों को ख़ुश रखने को सहज ही राज़ी
definition: willing to please others politely and accept their wishes without objection
example: The complaisant guest praised every dish, including the one that was clearly still frozen.

hindi: सहभागी — किसी गलत काम में शामिल या उसमें मौन साथ देने वाला
definition: involved with others in doing something wrong, even by quietly allowing it
example: Everyone who laughed at the boss's joke about skipping code review is now complicit.

hindi: आचरण — व्यक्ति का व्यवहार और बर्ताव
definition: the manner in which someone behaves and conducts themselves in public or formal company
example: The judge praised the witness's calm comportment, then asked him to remove the sunglasses.

hindi: स्वस्थचित्त — पूरे होश-हवास में, सोचने-समझने योग्य
definition: of sound mind, fully able to think clearly and answer for personal decisions
example: Before coffee I am barely compos mentis; after the third cup, dangerously so.

hindi: रण-साथी — संघर्ष में कंधे से कंधा मिलाने वाला सहयोगी
definition: a companion who fought beside another soldier, or who shares a long hard struggle
example: After three years fighting the same printer, the two accountants were true comrades-in-arms.

hindi: समाधानकारी — शांति और मेल बढ़ाने वाला
definition: intended to calm anger and restore goodwill between quarrelling parties
example: His conciliatory email opened with 'Hope you're well' and three separate apologies.

hindi: गुप्त सभा — बंद कमरे में होने वाली निजी मंत्रणा
definition: a private, closed meeting of powerful people, especially the cardinals electing a pope
example: The founders retreated into a conclave, and the rest of us waited for white smoke over the Slack channel.

hindi: सहवर्ती — साथ-साथ घटित होने वाला
definition: happening alongside something else and bound up with it
example: Growth came with the concomitant problem of nobody knowing anyone's name.

hindi: सामंजस्य — मतों और भावनाओं में मेल
definition: friendly agreement and peaceful harmony between people, groups or nations
example: Concord reigned in the group chat for almost four minutes after the dinner venue was chosen.

hindi: शब्दानुक्रमणिका — ग्रंथ के हर शब्द की स्थान-सूची
definition: an alphabetical index listing every word in a book or author's works with its passages
example: A fan built a concordance of the band's lyrics, which is how we learned they rhyme 'fire' with 'desire' forty times.

hindi: धर्म-संधि — चर्च और राज्य के बीच समझौता
definition: formal treaty agreement between the Pope and a national government, settling church rights
example: The two editors reached a concordat: Oxford commas stay, exclamation marks go.

hindi: कामवासना — तीव्र शारीरिक इच्छा
definition: strong sexual desire; lust, especially viewed as a moral failing
example: The theology lecture on concupiscence was, ironically, the most attended class of term.

hindi: यथोचित — अपराध के अनुसार उचित और पूरा (दंड)
definition: fitting and fully deserved, used especially of punishment matching the wrongdoing
example: Being assigned the next on-call rotation was condign punishment for breaking the build.

hindi: अनदेखी करना — गलत बात को माफ़ या स्वीकार कर लेना
definition: to forgive, overlook or quietly accept behaviour that is morally wrong or offensive
example: By laughing, the manager seemed to condone the reply-all disaster.

hindi: भाड़े का सेनापति — धन के लिए लड़ने वाला सैनिक-नायक
definition: leader of hired soldiers who sells military service to whoever pays
example: The freelance consultant, a modern condottiere, switched sides the moment budgets shifted.

hindi: गपशप — अनौपचारिक, इत्मीनान भरी बातचीत
definition: an informal, leisurely conversation or friendly chat between companions, colleagues or neighbours trading news
example: A quick question at the printer turned into a forty-minute confabulation about everyone's landlord.

hindi: महासंघ — राज्यों या व्यक्तियों का साझा गठजोड़, कभी षड्यंत्र हेतु
definition: an alliance of states or people united for common action, sometimes for plotting
example: A confederacy of toddlers had clearly planned the simultaneous meltdown at the supermarket.

hindi: सहयोगी — किसी योजना या षड्यंत्र में साथ देने वाला
definition: an ally or partner united with others in a common plan, often a secret or unlawful scheme
example: The magician's confederate in the third row was suspiciously good at picking cards.

hindi: विश्वासपात्र — जिससे मन के भेद कहे जाएँ
definition: a trusted close friend with whom private secrets, hopes and worries are safely shared
example: Her cat remains her most discreet confidant, largely because it cannot type.

hindi: विश्वासघाती ठग — पहले भरोसा जीतकर फिर पैसे ऐंठने वाला
definition: a smooth swindler who first wins a victim's trust and friendship, then cheats them out of their money
example: The confidence man now wears a hoodie and calls his scheme a presale.

hindi: व्यवसाय-बंधु — एक ही पेशे या विद्वत-संस्था का सम्मानित साथी
definition: a fellow member of the same profession, learned society or scholarly body; a respected colleague
example: The surgeon consulted a confrère before admitting that neither of them could read the handwriting on the chart.

hindi: निरस्त करना — प्रमाण से किसी को ग़लत सिद्ध करना
definition: to prove a person or an argument wrong through decisive evidence or careful, convincing reasoning
example: One photograph confuted his story about the diet going "really well".

hindi: पुंज — असंबद्ध चीज़ों का एकत्र ढेर
definition: a disorderly heap or mass of different things gathered together without any unifying design or order
example: The city council inherited a congeries of apps, spreadsheets and handwritten ledgers.

hindi: समूहन — बेमेल हिस्सों का एक गठ्ठर
definition: a mass of different things gathered together into one untidy whole
example: The company is a conglomeration of acquisitions that still use four different email systems.

hindi: जमा होना — किसी स्थान पर समूह में इकट्ठा होना
definition: to gather together into a crowd or group, usually collecting in a particular place for some shared purpose
example: At every party the interesting people congregate in the kitchen, far from the curated playlist.

hindi: अटकल — बिना पक्के प्रमाण के बनी राय
definition: an opinion or guess formed from incomplete evidence rather than proof, awaiting later confirmation
example: Everything about the product launch date remains conjecture until someone finally books the venue.

hindi: दांपत्य-संबंधी — पति-पत्नी के आपसी रिश्ते का
definition: relating to marriage or the intimate relationship and rights shared between married partners
example: Their conjugal arrangement included separate duvets and a shared streaming password.

hindi: आवाहन — मंत्र से आत्मा या चमत्कार को प्रकट करना
definition: the summoning of a spirit, or the working of magic, through spoken spells and ritual ceremony
example: Producing a working demo from last night's broken build was pure conjuration.

hindi: साँठगाँठ करना — गलत काम को चुपचाप होने देना या उसमें गुप्त साथ देना
definition: secretly allow or plot wrongdoing, pretending ignorance while quietly helping it happen
example: The whole office connived at the birthday surprise, and Priya pretended to be amazed.

hindi: पारखी — कला या रुचि का गहरा जानकार
definition: an expert judge of taste in fine painting, food, wine or other refined matters
example: A connoisseur of airport lounges, he can rank them by the quality of their croissants.

hindi: दांपत्य — पति-पत्नी के वैवाहिक जीवन से संबंधित
definition: relating to marriage or the married relationship and life shared between husband and wife
example: Connubial bliss, they discovered, depends mostly on who unloads the dishwasher.

hindi: कर्तव्यनिष्ठ — अपना काम पूरी लगन और ईमानदारी से करने वाला
definition: careful and thorough in doing what is right, taking duties seriously and honestly
example: The conscientious flatmate labels leftovers with the date, the owner and a warning.

hindi: अभिषिक्त करना — किसी वस्तु या स्थान को विधिवत पवित्र घोषित करना
definition: to formally declare something sacred through ritual and dedicate it permanently to religious service
example: She consecrated one corner of the flat to plants and forbade laptops within it.

hindi: परिणामतः — फलस्वरूप
definition: formal word meaning therefore, as a direct result of what happened before
example: She forgot to renew the domain; consequently, the company website now sells discount sunglasses.

hindi: धर्माध्यक्ष-परिषद — पोप और कार्डिनलों की सभा
definition: a solemn council of church officials, especially the pope meeting with his cardinals
example: Promotions were settled in a consistory of vice presidents that met behind frosted glass.

hindi: व्यंजनानुप्रास — निकट शब्दों में एक ही व्यंजन-ध्वनि की आवृत्ति
definition: the repetition of the same consonant sounds across several nearby words, often within them
example: "Pitter-patter" is consonance, and so is the neighbour's drum practice at midnight.

hindi: संगति करना — किसी के साथ मेलजोल रखना
definition: to keep company or associate habitually with someone, often with disapproval implied by the speaker
example: His manager worried he was consorting with the sales team, who had lured him to karaoke twice.

hindi: दिखावटी उपभोग — रुतबा जताने के लिए महँगा खर्च
definition: lavish spending on luxuries mainly to display wealth and status to others
example: A gold-leaf burger is conspicuous consumption with a side of fries.

hindi: स्थिरता — निष्ठा और स्वभाव में अटल रहना
definition: the quality of staying faithful and firmly unchanging in loyalty, affection or purpose
example: The cat's constancy was admirable: same windowsill, same scowl, eleven years.

hindi: सेहत की सैर — स्वास्थ्य के लिए नियमित टहलना
definition: a regular daily walk taken purely for the sake of good health, exercise and digestion
example: His morning constitutional is a brisk stroll to the bakery and a slow one back.

hindi: अर्थ लगाना — शब्दों या कर्मों की व्याख्या करना
definition: to interpret or explain the meaning of written words, remarks or actions in a particular manner
example: Do not construe my silence in the meeting as agreement; I was muted.

hindi: सिद्धहस्त — अपनी कला में पूर्ण रूप से निपुण
definition: showing complete, perfect skill; supremely accomplished in every respect
example: A consummate diplomat, she declined the meeting and somehow made them feel honoured.

hindi: क्षयरोग — शरीर को धीरे-धीरे गलाने वाला रोग
definition: archaic: tuberculosis of the lungs, a wasting disease that slowly consumed the body
example: In Victorian novels a delicate cough means consumption, and the heroine never makes the final chapter.

hindi: संक्रमण — छूत से रोग का फैलना
definition: the spreading of disease from person to person through close contact
example: Yawning spreads through a Monday meeting with the efficiency of any contagion.

hindi: चिंतन — शांत, गहरी और लंबी दृष्टि से सोचना
definition: long quiet thinking, gazing thoughtfully upon something and turning it over in mind
example: She stood in contemplation before the vending machine as though it held life's final answer.

hindi: समकालीन — एक ही समय में घटित या विद्यमान
definition: existing or happening during the same period of time as something else
example: The contemporaneous notes, scribbled during the meeting, contradicted the polished minutes entirely.

hindi: प्रतिपादित करना — तर्क सहित किसी बात पर दृढ़ रहना
definition: to argue or maintain firmly that something is true, especially during a debate or dispute
example: I contend that the thermostat war was started by accounts, not by us.

hindi: विवादास्पद — झगड़ा और गरम बहस भड़काने वाला
definition: likely to cause heated argument, or fond of starting quarrels with other people
example: Pineapple on pizza remains the most contentious item on the team lunch agenda.

hindi: विरोधवादी — जान-बूझकर प्रचलित मत के उलट चलने वाला
definition: a person who deliberately argues against whatever most people around them happen to believe
example: The office contrarian defended Mondays with such conviction that we almost scheduled more of them.

hindi: इसके विपरीत — उलटी दिशा में
definition: literary word meaning conversely, reversing the relation, or in the opposite direction
example: Cats prize independence; dogs, contrariwise, treat every doorbell as a personal triumph.

hindi: मनमुटाव — छोटा-सा अप्रिय विवाद
definition: a minor argument or awkward, embarrassing disagreement, from French for an unlucky mishap
example: After a brief contretemps over the thermostat, the flatmates settled on wearing jumpers.

hindi: प्रतिवाद करना — किसी मत का तर्क से विरोध करना
definition: to argue against a claim, dispute its truth, or deny outright that it could be correct
example: The receipts controverted his claim that he had "barely ordered anything" online.

hindi: हठपूर्ण अवज्ञा — अदालत या अधिकार का ज़िद्दी अनादर
definition: stubborn refusal to obey court orders or lawful authority, often shown openly
example: The teenager's contumacy about bedtime would impress any judge.

hindi: उद्दंड अपमानकारी — घमंडी तिरस्कार से भरा
definition: scornfully and insolently insulting in speech or behaviour, treating another person with arrogant contempt
example: Her contumelious reply-all ended the email thread and, nearly, the partnership.

hindi: अपमानजनक व्यवहार — घमंड भरा तिरस्कार
definition: insolent, scornful and insulting treatment or language shown toward another person with arrogant contempt
example: The customer service script somehow managed to deliver contumely with a smiley emoji.

hindi: स्वास्थ्यलाभी — बीमारी के बाद धीरे-धीरे ठीक होता हुआ
definition: gradually recovering health and bodily strength after a serious illness, injury or operation
example: The convalescent patient was well enough to criticise the hospital coffee.

hindi: आहूत करना — सभा बुलाना या एकत्र होना
definition: to summon people together for a formal meeting, or to assemble together for such a gathering
example: She convened an emergency meeting to decide, at last, who keeps eating the office biscuits.

hindi: गुप्त उपासना-सभा — छिपकर होने वाली धार्मिक बैठक
definition: a secret or unlawful religious meeting, especially of dissenters outside the established church
example: The engineers who still prefer tabs meet in a quiet conventicle on the fourth floor.

hindi: संभाषणीय — जिससे बात करना सुखद हो
definition: archaic: easy, pleasant and agreeable to talk with, making good company in any social gathering
example: The new neighbour proved wonderfully conversable, provided nobody mentioned his fantasy football league.

hindi: विद्वत्-सम्मिलन — कला-विज्ञान पर चर्चा हेतु सभा
definition: an evening gathering of learned society members for conversation about painting, science or literature
example: The museum's members' night was billed as a conversazione, which mostly meant wine beside the dinosaur bones.

hindi: इसके विपरीत — उलटे रूप में
definition: formal word introducing the opposite case, reversing the relation just stated
example: Early risers love the morning meeting; conversely, night owls attend it as ghosts.

hindi: उल्लासपूर्ण — मित्रवत, आनंदमय और मेलजोल भरा
definition: friendly, lively and cheerful, especially describing company enjoying food and drink together
example: The convivial dinner ran three hours past the reservation, and the waiters knew better than to rush it.

hindi: दीक्षांत सभा — औपचारिक रूप से बुलाई गई सभा
definition: a large formal assembly summoned for ceremony, especially a university gathering for conferring degrees
example: At convocation the graduates sweltered in black gowns while the speaker quoted Steve Jobs yet again.

hindi: युगांतरकारी — सूर्य को केंद्र मानने वाला; पूरी दृष्टि पलट देने वाला
definition: following Copernicus in placing the solar centre, not Earth, at the middle of the heavens; hence, overturning an established worldview
example: Discovering the office had no meetings on Fridays was a Copernican shift in his week.

hindi: प्रचुर — बहुत अधिक मात्रा में, भरपूर
definition: plentiful and abundant; produced or supplied in a large, generous amount or quantity
example: She took copious notes during the lecture and never looked at them again.

hindi: छँटा झुरमुट — बार-बार काटकर घना उगाया गया पेड़ों का समूह
definition: a small group of trees regularly trimmed back so fresh shoots grow thickly
example: The council called it a managed coppice; the kids called it the good hiding spot.

hindi: झुरमुट — छोटे पेड़ों का छोटा-सा घना समूह
definition: a small thick group of trees or bushes standing together in open country
example: Every family walk ends in the same copse, where someone finds a stick worth keeping forever.
