hindi: नखरेबाज़ — जो बिना गंभीरता के लुभाती है
definition: a woman who flirts playfully to attract admiration without serious romantic intention
example: A seasoned coquette, she left every like on read and every heart on hold.

hindi: उत्तेजक पेय — हृदय को बल देने वाला पेय
definition: a sweet restorative drink or medicine meant to stimulate and strengthen the heart
example: The elderflower cordial at the wedding did more for morale than the speeches.

hindi: आत्मीयता — गर्मजोशी भरा, विनम्र मैत्रीभाव
definition: warm polite friendliness shown between people, often with some formal restraint
example: The rival founders greeted each other with a cordiality that fooled nobody at the conference.

hindi: पाककला-निपुण — उत्कृष्ट स्तर का रसोइया या व्यंजन
definition: describing cooking of the highest classical standard, or a skilled cook formally trained to produce it
example: He claims cordon bleu skills, but his signature dish is instant noodles with an egg.

hindi: सुरक्षा घेरा — किसी ख़तरे को अलग-थलग रखने की रेखा
definition: a protective barrier or policy isolating a dangerous country, party or disease
example: The mainstream parties kept a cordon sanitaire around the fringe candidate, and the snack table.

hindi: छज्जा — दीवार के ऊपरी सिरे पर उभरी सजावटी पट्टी
definition: an ornamental moulding projecting along the summit of a wall, just beneath the roof of a building
example: The pigeons have claimed the cornice of the town hall and review every pedestrian below.

hindi: अक्षय भंडार — प्रचुरता का कभी न खाली होने वाला कोष
definition: an abundant, overflowing supply of good things, symbolised by the horn of plenty
example: The breakfast buffet was a cornucopia of pastries and bad decisions.

hindi: उपसिद्धांत — सिद्ध बात से स्वतः निकलने वाला परिणाम
definition: something that follows automatically from what has already been established
example: The corollary of trusting your team is having to live with their decisions.

hindi: किरीट — सामंतों का छोटा मुकुट
definition: a small crown worn by nobles below royal rank, or a decorative circlet for the head
example: The birthday girl wore a paper coronet through three meetings without a flicker of shame.

hindi: स्थूलकाय — भारी-भरकम और मोटा शरीर
definition: having a large, heavy, bulky body; very stout and fleshy in build
example: The corpulent office cat has learned exactly which desk drawers hold biscuits.

hindi: रचना-समूह — किसी लेखक या विषय के सारे ग्रंथ
definition: the complete body of writings produced by one author, or collected together about one subject
example: The entire corpus of his poetry fits on a single coffee receipt.

hindi: अपराध का मूल प्रमाण — यह तथ्य कि अपराध सचमुच हुआ
definition: body of the crime; the essential facts proving that a crime actually happened
example: With the cookie jar empty and crumbs on the rug, the corpus delicti was established.

hindi: संशोधन-पत्र — छपी भूल का औपचारिक सुधार
definition: a formal correction of a single mistake printed in a published book or paper
example: The journal issued a corrigendum admitting the miracle result was a spreadsheet typo.

hindi: भ्रष्ट होने योग्य — जिसे रिश्वत से डिगाया जा सके
definition: open to bribes; easily persuaded by money or favours to abandon honesty and duty
example: Every referee seems honest until you learn how corruptible one becomes when the sponsor's watch is on offer.

hindi: समुद्री लुटेरा — सरकार-समर्थित दस्यु जहाज़ या उसका नाविक
definition: a pirate, or pirate ship, that raided merchant vessels and coastal towns
example: The corsair of the shared fridge struck again, leaving only an empty yoghurt pot.

hindi: शव-यात्रा — अर्थी के पीछे चलते शोकाकुल लोगों का जुलूस
definition: a solemn funeral procession of mourners walking or driving slowly behind the coffin
example: A slow cortege of delivery vans trailed the lone cyclist up the hill.

hindi: झिलमिलाना — चिंगारियों सी चमक बिखेरना
definition: to flicker and sparkle with quick flashes of light, like glittering sparks
example: Her sequinned dress coruscated under the disco ball while the DJ played ringtones.

hindi: काकवत्‌ — कौए जैसा काला, चतुर और कर्कश
definition: like crows or ravens; black, clever, watchful and harsh voiced
example: A corvine figure in a long black coat haunted the back row of every open mic.

hindi: बेगार — बिना वेतन कराया गया अनिवार्य श्रम
definition: unpaid labour a feudal lord or state demanded from peasants, such as repairing roads
example: Helping every friend move flats each summer has become my annual corvée, paid in pizza.

hindi: सृष्टि-विज्ञान — ब्रह्मांड की उत्पत्ति की कथा या सिद्धांत
definition: a theory, legend or creation myth explaining the origin and birth of the whole universe
example: Every founder has a garage cosmogony, and none of them mention the seed money from Dad.

hindi: विश्वनागरिक — अनेक देशों और संस्कृतियों से परिचित
definition: familiar with many countries and cultures, comfortably at home anywhere across the wider world
example: His cosmopolitan palate extends to six cuisines and exactly one instant noodle brand.

hindi: ब्रह्मांड — व्यवस्थित समग्र सृष्टि
definition: the universe understood as an ordered whole
example: A clear night in the desert makes the cosmos feel closer than the nearest town.

hindi: मंडली — साझी रुचि वाला छोटा, बंद समूह
definition: a small exclusive group of people sharing interests, tastes or influence
example: The director arrived with her usual coterie of assistants, each carrying a different oat-milk order.

hindi: मुखाकृति — चेहरे का भाव और रूप
definition: the face and its expression, showing a person's character, mood, calm or composure
example: She kept a calm countenance while the demo crashed live on stage.

hindi: पलंगपोश — बिस्तर पर बिछी ऊपरी चादर
definition: archaic: a decorative bedspread or quilt laid neatly over the blankets and sheets covering a sleeper's bed
example: The boutique hotel's counterpane was so elaborate that guests photographed it instead of sleeping.

hindi: तख़्तापलट — अचानक बलपूर्वक सरकार को उखाड़ फेंकना
definition: a sudden, often violent seizure of government power by a small group
example: While the chairman was on leave, the marketing team staged a quiet coup d'état over the brand colours.

hindi: एक नज़र में परख — एक झलक में पूरी स्थिति समझ लेना
definition: a single quick glance that takes in and understands a whole situation at once, like a skilled general
example: With one coup d'œil at the fridge, he knew his flatmate had eaten the leftovers.

hindi: प्रथम दृष्टि का प्रेम — बिजली-सा अचानक अनुराग
definition: sudden, overwhelming romantic love felt at the very first meeting
example: It was a coup de foudre over the shared armrest, and the flight was only forty minutes.

hindi: अंतिम प्रहार — जो पहले से कमज़ोर चीज़ को ख़त्म कर दे
definition: a final decisive blow that finishes off something already failing
example: The startup was limping along, and the expired domain name delivered the coup de grâce.

hindi: आकस्मिक धावा — अचानक साहसी हमला
definition: a sudden, bold attack that seizes its target with a single daring stroke
example: Her coup de main at the meeting was booking the room before anyone else could.

hindi: नाटकीय मोड़ — अचानक चौंकाने वाली घटना
definition: a sudden, dramatic turn of events that surprises everyone watching
example: In a real coup de théâtre, the intern revealed she had written the winning pitch.

hindi: द्विपदी — दो तुकांत पंक्तियों की जोड़ी
definition: a pair of successive lines of verse, usually rhyming and equal in length
example: The shampoo ad ends on a rhyming couplet, as if dandruff deserved Alexander Pope.

hindi: तुरंग — तेज़ दौड़ने वाला युद्ध-अश्व
definition: a swift, spirited horse prized in medieval battle, hunting and racing, celebrated in poetry
example: The delivery rider weaved through traffic on his motorbike like a courser at full gallop.

hindi: विनम्र — दूसरों के प्रति शिष्ट और आदरपूर्ण
definition: polite, respectful and considerate in speech and manner toward other people
example: The chatbot was unfailingly courteous while refusing, for the ninth time, to connect him to a human.

hindi: गणिका — धनी प्रेमियों की सुसंस्कृत सहचरी
definition: a refined mistress kept by wealthy or aristocratic lovers in exchange for support
example: The period drama's courtesan had better dialogue than every duke combined.

hindi: दरबारी — राजदरबार जैसी सुरुचिपूर्ण शिष्टता वाला
definition: elegantly polite and dignified in manner, like behaviour at a royal court
example: With a courtly bow, he offered her the last working charger in the airport lounge.

hindi: वस्त्र-शिल्पी — धनी ग्राहकों के लिए ख़ास पोशाकें रचने वाला
definition: a designer who creates, makes and sells fashionable custom clothing for wealthy clients
example: She calls her Figma file couturier work, cut to fit one very demanding stakeholder.

hindi: वाचा — गंभीर, बाध्यकारी प्रतिज्ञा या समझौता
definition: a solemn binding agreement or promise between parties, often sacred or formal
example: The housemates' covenant on dishes lasted until the first dinner party.

hindi: छैला मूर्ख — दिखावटी और घमंडी बेवकूफ़
definition: archaic: a vain, conceited fool who flaunts his looks, clothes and foolish pretensions
example: The coxcomb checked his reflection in the laptop between slides.

hindi: ठगना — चालाकी से धोखा देना
definition: archaic: to cheat, trick or swindle someone out of money or something through clever deceit
example: The app cozened him into a yearly subscription with a single innocent tap.

hindi: सेंधमार — घर या तिजोरी तोड़ने वाला चोर
definition: archaic: a skilled burglar or safe-breaker who breaks into houses, banks and locked strongboxes to steal valuables
example: The hotel safe's default code is 0000, which spares any modern cracksman the effort.

hindi: खुमारी-ग्रस्त — अधिक खाने-पीने से बीमार
definition: sick from drinking or eating excessively; suffering the queasy aftermath of a binge
example: Monday's stand-up was attended by several crapulent survivors of Sunday brunch.

hindi: भोंडा — अशिष्टता और मूढ़ता से भरा
definition: grossly stupid and insensitive, showing a lack of intelligence, taste or delicacy
example: Posting the layoff news with a party emoji was crass even by his standards.

hindi: कायर — बेहद डरपोक और नीच
definition: contemptibly cowardly, lacking any courage and shamefully afraid when facing danger
example: He made a craven exit through the kitchen when the karaoke host called his name.

hindi: पार्श्व-मंजूषा — दीवार से लगी लंबी नीची अलमारी
definition: a long, waist-high cabinet or sideboard for storage, standing against a dining room wall
example: The credenza holds our good plates, spare cables and one mystery key nobody dares throw away.

hindi: भोला-विश्वासी — हर बात झट मान लेने वाला
definition: overly ready to believe things, easily deceived because trusting claims without evidence or doubt
example: Credulous readers shared the story about the city banning Tuesdays.

hindi: कंगूरेदार — दीवार पर दाँतेदार कंगूरों वाला
definition: having battlements with regular notched gaps along the wall's upper edge
example: The kids built a crenellated sandcastle, then defended it against the tide with remarkable seriousness.

hindi: सांध्य — गोधूलि बेला से जुड़ा, धुँधलके में सक्रिय
definition: relating to twilight, the dim half-light around dawn or dusk; active during twilight
example: Our cat is crepuscular, which means breakfast is demanded at five and dinner at dusk, loudly.

hindi: आरोह — धीरे-धीरे बढ़ती हुई तीव्रता या आवाज़
definition: a gradual increase in loudness, music building steadily toward a powerful, thrilling climax
example: The notifications rose to a crescendo as the whole team discovered the typo at once.

hindi: हृदय की पुकार — मन से उठी तीव्र, सच्ची अपील
definition: a passionate, heartfelt appeal or protest made with deep sincerity
example: The flatmate's note on the fridge was a cri de coeur about the unwashed dishes.

hindi: कुबेर — अपार धन वाला अत्यंत अमीर व्यक्ति
definition: extremely rich person, named after Croesus, the fabulously wealthy ancient king of Lydia
example: Nobody at the table was a Croesus, yet everyone ordered like one until the bill came.

hindi: चहेता साथी — विशेषकर सत्ता का लाभ उठाने वाला मित्र
definition: a close friend or companion, often one who gains unfair favours through powerful political connections
example: The minister's crony somehow won the contract to supply the ministry's paperclips.

hindi: भाई-भतीजावाद — योग्यता के बजाय मित्रों को पद और लाभ देना
definition: giving jobs, contracts and favours to friends rather than to people who deserve them
example: The hiring panel denied cronyism, though all three new hires shared the chairman's golf club.

hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ वर्ग — चुने हुओं में भी चुने हुए
definition: the very best people or things within an already elite and fashionable group
example: The invite-only chat was supposedly the crème de la crème of founders, and mostly memes.

hindi: छला हुआ पति — जिसकी पत्नी दूसरे से संबंध रखे
definition: a husband whose wife secretly carries on romantic affairs with another lover, long mocked in literature
example: Shakespeare mocked the cuckold a hundred ways; reality shows found a hundred more.

hindi: किसका लाभ? — असली फ़ायदा किसे होता है, यह प्रश्न
definition: which party benefits, a question asking who actually gains from some event or decision
example: When a meeting about fewer meetings appeared in the calendar, I asked cui bono.

hindi: वक्षकवच — छाती और पीठ की रक्षा करने वाला धातु कवच
definition: a piece of armour covering the chest and back, originally made of leather or metal plates
example: His stiff new blazer fit like a cuirass, protecting him from both arrows and comfort.

hindi: बंद गली — जिस रास्ते या योजना का कोई आगे का छोर न हो
definition: a closed street without through passage, or figuratively any plan leading nowhere further
example: The blockchain pivot turned out to be a very expensive cul-de-sac.

hindi: परिणति — लंबी प्रक्रिया का चरम अंत
definition: the highest point reached at the final finish of a long process of development
example: The culmination of eight months of meetings was a new font.

hindi: दोषी — किसी गलत काम के लिए दोष का भागी
definition: deserving blame for doing something wrong, especially something harmful or unlawful
example: Whoever left the empty milk carton back in the fridge is culpable and knows it.

hindi: सावधानीपूर्वक — पूरे विश्वास के बिना, थोड़े संदेह के साथ
definition: with a grain of salt, accepting a claim with sensible doubt, caution and healthy scepticism
example: Read any review written by the author's mother cum grano salis.

hindi: सम्मान सहित — प्रशंसनीय योग्यता के साथ उत्तीर्ण
definition: with honour, marking a university degree earned with creditable distinction above ordinary passing
example: Cum laude on the diploma, coffee rings on every page of the thesis.

hindi: लोभ — धन-दौलत की अतृप्त लालसा
definition: greedy, excessive desire for money and possessions, the craving that corrupts judgement
example: The auction's opening bid was modest; cupidity handled the rest.

hindi: गुंबदिका — छत के ऊपर बना छोटा गोल गुंबद
definition: a small rounded dome crowning a roof or turret, often letting light into the space below
example: The town hall's gilded cupola is the first thing visitors notice and the last thing the budget ever repairs.

hindi: नीच श्वान — आवारा गुर्राता कुत्ता; तुच्छ, कायर व्यक्ति
definition: a snarling mongrel mutt or hound; figuratively, a mean, cowardly and contemptible person
example: Only a cur would eat a colleague's labelled lunch and then blame the intern.

hindi: जीवन-वृत्त — शिक्षा और काम का विस्तृत ब्योरा
definition: a detailed written account of someone's education, publications and working career
example: His curriculum vitae runs nine pages, three of them about a hackathon.

hindi: रूखा-संक्षिप्त — इतना छोटा उत्तर कि अशिष्ट लगे
definition: rudely brief in speech, replies so short they sound impolite and dismissive
example: A curt 'k' in reply to a heartfelt paragraph is a declaration of war.

hindi: गिरहकट — भीड़ में जेब या थैली काटने वाला चोर
definition: archaic: a thief who snips purses or steals from pockets among jostling crowds in markets and fairs
example: The festival's surge pricing worked like a digital cutpurse, lifting a tenner before you noticed.

hindi: गलाकाट — हत्यारा; निर्मम प्रतिद्वंद्वी
definition: a murderous ruffian or hired killer; hence a ruthless, merciless competitor in fierce rivalry
example: The school bake sale revealed one icing-obsessed parent to be a true cutthroat.

hindi: विराट — भीमकाय, विशाल और भारी-भरकम
definition: gigantic and massive, especially describing enormous stone walls built as if by giants
example: The new data centre is a Cyclopean slab of concrete humming in the desert.

hindi: आकर्षण-केंद्र — सबकी निगाहों का तारा
definition: the centre of attention and admiration, originally the guiding star of Ursa Minor
example: The new espresso machine became the cynosure of the office within an hour.

hindi: मंडली — साहित्यकारों का छोटा घनिष्ठ समूह
definition: a small private circle of writers or artists who gather regularly to share work and conversation
example: The group chat began as a book club and hardened into a cénacle that now reviews every draft before it ships.

hindi: गुरु-लघु-लघु चरण — एक ज़ोरदार और दो हल्के अक्षर
definition: a metrical foot of verse with one stressed syllable followed by two unstressed syllables
example: "Honestly" is a dactyl, and in her Slack messages it always opens a paragraph of grievance.

hindi: जटिल-कौशलपूर्ण — अत्यंत चतुराई से गढ़ा हुआ
definition: ingeniously intricate and skilfully complex, like the maze built by the legendary craftsman
example: The Daedalian tax form seemed designed by someone who hated both taxes and forms.

hindi: अंतर्यामी प्रेरक — भीतर की मार्गदर्शक आत्मा
definition: an inner guiding spirit that drives a person toward their true calling
example: Some daimon keeps her rewriting the novel at midnight instead of sleeping like a sensible person.

hindi: क्षणिक प्रेम-प्रसंग — हल्का, अस्थायी रोमानी रिश्ता
definition: a brief, casual romantic affair that nobody expects will last
example: Her summer dalliance with the barista ended when the café changed its playlist.

hindi: समय गँवाना — खिलवाड़ में देर करना
definition: to waste time idly, putting off action by trifling, lingering or dawdling about
example: The government dallied over the bridge repairs until the bridge made the decision itself.

hindi: हृदय-परिवर्तनकारी — अचानक और पूर्ण बदलाव लाने वाला
definition: marking a sudden, dramatic conversion or complete change of heart and opinion
example: After one hangover, he had a Damascene conversion to herbal tea.

hindi: सिर पर लटकती तलवार जैसा — हर पल मंडराता संकट
definition: describing a danger that hangs constantly overhead, threatening sudden disaster amid apparent comfort
example: The corner office came with a Damoclean quarterly target dangling above the leather chair.

hindi: अटूट मित्र-जोड़ी — एक-दूसरे के लिए प्राण देने को तैयार मित्र
definition: two friends whose devotion was such that each would risk death for the other, from Greek legend
example: They were Damon and Pythias until one of them borrowed the other's charger and never returned it.

hindi: छैला — बनाव-सिंगार का शौक़ीन पुरुष
definition: a gentleman devoted to smart, stylish dress and elegant appearance above most other things
example: The office dandy irons his linen shirt before every video call, though nobody turns their camera on.

hindi: मृत्यु-नृत्य — मृत्यु सबको साथ ले जाती है, इसका प्रतीकात्मक चित्रण
definition: the dance of death, an artistic image showing death leading everyone to the grave
example: The layoffs spread through each department like a corporate danse macabre.

hindi: छैला — सजा-धजा, सलीकेदार पहनावे वाला
definition: neat, trim and stylish in dress and appearance, often describing a small, spry gentleman
example: The dapper grandfather wears a pocket square even to the vegetable market.

hindi: चितकबरा — रोशनी-छाया के धब्बों से भरा
definition: marked with scattered spots or patches of light and shade, giving a mottled, flecked appearance
example: They held the stand-up in dappled sunlight, and it still ran long.

hindi: नीच — कायरतापूर्ण और धोखेबाज़
definition: wicked and cowardly, doing harm by sneaky, underhand means rather than openly
example: Someone committed the dastardly act of eating the labelled lunch in the fridge.

hindi: प्रभाततारा — भोर का तारा, शुक्र या सूर्य
definition: archaic: the morning star heralding dawn, or in poetry the blazing solar disc itself
example: The daystar rose over the marathon coders, who greeted it with the horror of vampires.

hindi: व्यवहारतः — नियम से नहीं, पर असल में ऐसा ही
definition: existing in fact, whether or not any rule or title recognises it
example: He has no title, but he is the de facto head of the department.

hindi: रुचि पर बहस नहीं — व्यक्तिगत पसंद तर्क से तय नहीं होती
definition: there is no arguing about taste; personal preferences cannot be settled by debate
example: Pineapple on pizza again? De gustibus, and please pass the other box.

hindi: ऊपर से नीचे — हेय दृष्टि से, छोटा समझकर
definition: in a condescending manner, treating others as social inferiors from a lofty height
example: The sommelier spoke to us de haut en bas until we ordered the second bottle.

hindi: विधितः — कानून की दृष्टि से, चाहे व्यवहार में न हो
definition: existing by law, whether or not it holds in practice
example: The office is de jure hers; the corner desk is still someone else's.

hindi: नगण्य — इतना छोटा कि ध्यान देने योग्य नहीं
definition: so trivial or minor that courts, regulators or anyone sensible need not take serious notice
example: The auditor ruled the missing biscuits de minimis and moved on to the missing laptop.

hindi: दिवंगत के बारे में केवल भला कहो — मृतक की निंदा न करो
definition: speak nothing but good about the dead, a rule of funeral courtesy
example: De mortuis nil nisi bonum, so nobody mentioned the late uncle's karaoke.

hindi: नये सिरे से — बिल्कुल शुरुआत से दोबारा
definition: starting afresh, beginning again completely from scratch without relying on earlier work
example: After the laptop died, the novel was rewritten de novo, and improved.

hindi: अनिवार्य — रिवाज़ या फ़ैशन के अनुसार ज़रूरी
definition: required by current fashion, custom or etiquette, and therefore strictly expected
example: Hoodies are de rigueur at the startup, and a blazer marks you as either an investor or a lost auditor.

hindi: अवांछित अधिकता — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा और खटकने वाला
definition: French meaning excessive: present beyond what is wanted and therefore unwelcome
example: The fourth reply-all thank-you was, by general agreement, de trop.

hindi: अभाव — किसी चीज़ की भारी कमी
definition: a scarcity or serious lack of something needed or wanted; too little available supply
example: There is no dearth of opinions in the group chat, only of decisions.

hindi: गिराना — मूल्य या चरित्र को नीचा करना
definition: to lower the moral character, quality or value of something, making it cheap
example: Reality television debased the phrase 'here to make friends' forever.

hindi: भ्रष्ट करना — भोग-विलास से किसी का चरित्र बिगाड़ना
definition: to lead someone away from virtue into excessive indulgence of sensual pleasures
example: Three weeks of free office snacks thoroughly debauched the new hire's diet.

hindi: भोगी — विलासिता और कामुकता से पतित
definition: corrupted by excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures, heavy drinking and wild revelry
example: By the fourth day of the stag weekend, the group looked thoroughly debauched and mildly sunburnt.

hindi: व्यभिचार — भोग-विलास और नशे में डूबा अनैतिक आचरण
definition: excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures such as drinking, feasting and lust
example: The bachelor weekend promised debauchery and delivered an early night and a sore back.

hindi: दुर्बल — बीमारी से शक्तिहीन
definition: made very weak and feeble in body, especially by illness or strain
example: Debilitated by a mild cold, he requested a week off and a eulogy.

hindi: छबीला — बेफ़िक्र, सजीला और शिष्ट
definition: confident, stylish and charming in manner, with easy, carefree elegance
example: He looked debonair in the profile photo, which was eleven years and one hairline ago.

hindi: पतनशील विलासिता — भोग में डूबकर नैतिक पतन
definition: moral and cultural decline brought about by excessive indulgence in luxury and pleasure
example: Chocolate cake for breakfast is either decadence or self-care, depending on who is asking.

hindi: पतनशील — विलासिता से नैतिक पतन की ओर
definition: marked by moral decline, self-indulgent luxury and a taste for pleasure over principle
example: The decadent brunch featured gold leaf on the avocado toast and nothing left in the budget.

hindi: डेरा उठाना — अचानक या चुपके से चल देना
definition: leave a place suddenly or secretly, packing up camp and departing without notice
example: The whole design team decamped to a rival agency one Friday afternoon.

hindi: निधन — मृत्यु, विशेषकर विधिक या औपचारिक भाषा में
definition: a person's death, especially as named in formal, legal or official documents and language
example: Upon the decease of the policyholder, the lawyers will begin reading very slowly.

hindi: भारी क्षति पहुँचाना — बड़े हिस्से का नाश करना
definition: to destroy or remove a large part of something
example: The layoffs decimated the team, and nobody stopped to count who was the tenth.

hindi: ओजपूर्ण भाषण देना — नाटकीय ढंग से बोलना
definition: to speak dramatically and forcefully, as though addressing a large audience from a stage
example: She declaimed the takeaway menu aloud as if it were Shakespeare, and ordered the same curry.

hindi: ओजस्वी भाषण — नाटकीय ढंग से ज़ोर देकर बोलना
definition: a dramatic, rhetorical speech delivered loudly and forcefully, often with theatrical passion
example: His declamation on the importance of punctuality began twenty minutes late.

hindi: काढ़ा — उबालकर निकाला गया औषधीय रस
definition: a medicine made by boiling herbs, roots or bark in water to extract their essence
example: Every winter Mum brews a ginger decoction that could strip paint and cure anything.

hindi: मर्यादित — शालीन, गरिमापूर्ण और मौक़े के लायक
definition: behaving in a proper, dignified manner that suits a formal occasion or setting
example: The board meeting stayed decorous until the snack tray arrived.

hindi: शिष्टाचार — मौक़े के अनुरूप संयत और उचित आचरण
definition: behaviour that is proper, dignified and suited to a formal occasion or setting
example: The funeral kept its decorum right up until someone's phone played the ringtone from a dance-off app.

hindi: जर्जर — उम्र या उपेक्षा से टूटा-फूटा और कमज़ोर
definition: worn out and weakened by many years, careless neglect or long hard wear
example: The decrepit elevator groans between floors like it has opinions about Mondays.

hindi: जर्जरता — बुढ़ापे या उपेक्षा से आई दुर्बलता
definition: the state of being worn out and weakened by many years or careless neglect
example: The startup's once-shiny app has slid into decrepitude, one unpatched update at a time.

hindi: धन-अपहरण — सौंपे गए धन का दुरुपयोग या हिसाब में कमी
definition: misuse or theft of money held in trust, leaving funds missing from accounts
example: The shortfall in the office charity jar was blamed on defalcation, or possibly on Kevin.

hindi: मानहानि करना — झूठी बातों से किसी की प्रतिष्ठा गिराना
definition: damage someone's good reputation by spreading false and harmful statements
example: The lawsuit claimed the podcast had defamed the chef by calling his soufflé 'fraudulent'.

hindi: आदरपूर्ण — दूसरों की राय और पद का सम्मान करने वाला
definition: showing polite respect and humble regard for someone's opinion, position or authority
example: The deferential intern agreed with everyone in the meeting, including two people who disagreed with each other.

hindi: दूषित करना — पवित्र या शुद्ध को मलिन कर देना
definition: make something sacred or pure dirty and unholy, spoiling its sanctity
example: A single reply-all meme can defile the solemn quiet of the board channel.

hindi: पदच्युत करना — किसी पुरोहित से उसका पद छीन लेना
definition: formally strip a priest or official of their office and title for serious misconduct
example: The chess club threatened to defrock its president after he quietly moved a bishop.

hindi: पतित — नैतिक रूप से गिरा हुआ व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose morals or standards have sunk shamefully below what decent society accepts
example: Only a degenerate would put pineapple on a pizza, said the man eating it cold at 3 a.m.

hindi: देवता बना देना — किसी को देवतुल्य मानकर पूजना
definition: to praise and honour someone so highly that they are worshipped like a divine being
example: Fans deified the striker right up until his first missed penalty.

hindi: अति-स्वादिष्ट — आनंद देने वाला, लज़ीज़
definition: extremely delicious and delightful, whether describing food, drink or something lovely to look upon
example: The delectable truffle cost more per gram than her phone plan.

hindi: छलिनी — जो मोह में फँसाकर विश्वासघात करे
definition: a seductive, treacherous woman who charms a trusting lover into betrayal and ruin
example: The dessert trolley is the Delilah of every diet, smiling right until the second slice.

hindi: छोटी घाटी — पेड़ों से घिरी छोटी, गहरी और सुरक्षित घाटी
definition: a small hollow valley, usually sheltered and surrounded by trees and grass
example: The wedding photographer led everyone down into a dell, then remembered the bride's heels.

hindi: द्व्यर्थी और रहस्यमय — जान-बूझकर अस्पष्ट
definition: deliberately obscure, and open to more than one reading
example: The chairman's Delphic memo let both factions claim he agreed with them.

hindi: जलप्लावन — मूसलाधार वर्षा, बाढ़
definition: heavy, flooding downpour of rain; also any overwhelming flood of things arriving together
example: After the deluge the basement flooded, and so did my inbox with 'quick question' emails.

hindi: हाव-भाव — बाहरी व्यवहार और रवैया
definition: outward behaviour and manner, especially as others observe and judge them
example: Her cheerful demeanour on Monday mornings made colleagues deeply suspicious.

hindi: निज भूमि — स्वामी द्वारा स्वयं रखी गई जागीर की ज़मीन
definition: land a feudal lord kept for his own use rather than granting to tenants; also any personal domain
example: The corner office is the director's demesne, and the good whiteboard markers never leave it.

hindi: अर्ध-समाज — सम्मानित समाज के किनारे जीने वाला वर्ग
definition: a group living on the edges of respectable society, often thought disreputable or scandalous
example: The late-night poker club drew a demimonde of retired magicians and unlicensed tipsters.

hindi: देहावसान — मृत्यु; किसी चीज़ का अंत या पतन
definition: a person's death, or the final ending, failure or collapse of something that once thrived
example: The demise of the office printer was mourned by nobody except the repair man.

hindi: जनता — किसी राज्य के सामान्य नागरिक
definition: the ordinary citizens of a state, considered as a political body with power
example: Every politician claims to speak for the demos until the demos starts replying online.

hindi: आपत्ति करना — असहमति या संकोच प्रकट करना
definition: to raise a polite objection or show reluctance about agreeing to something
example: When asked to lead the offsite, she demurred, citing a sudden and specific dentist appointment.

hindi: सलज्ज — संकोची, शांत और विनम्र
definition: quiet, modest and reserved in manner, shyly avoiding attention, fuss or boldness
example: She gave a demure smile, then crushed everyone at the pub quiz.

hindi: हेय बताना — किसी को नीचा दिखाकर उसका मूल्य घटाना
definition: criticise another person unfairly and belittle their worth to damage their reputation and public standing
example: Denigrating the previous developer's code is a rite of passage, especially when it was yours.

hindi: उपसंहार — कथा की गुत्थियों का अंतिम सुलझाव
definition: the final part of a story or drama where tangled plot threads finally come untied and resolved
example: The denouement of the office feud arrived quietly, as a calendar invite titled 'Sync'.

hindi: ईश्वर की इच्छा से — यदि भगवान ने चाहा तो
definition: Latin for 'should heaven permit': things will happen provided divine providence and circumstances allow
example: The kitchen renovation will be finished by Diwali, Deo volente and the plumber permitting.

hindi: चाल-ढाल — शरीर का सलीक़ेदार ढंग और आचरण
definition: the manner in which someone carries themselves, stands, walks and behaves in public
example: Her deportment was flawless until she tripped over the conference cable.

hindi: भ्रष्टता — नैतिक पतन की चरम अवस्था
definition: moral corruption sunk deep enough that wickedness feels normal
example: The group chat's depravity peaked when someone ranked the office birthdays by cake quality.

hindi: लूटखसोट — बार-बार की विनाशकारी लूट
definition: repeated acts of plunder, robbery and destructive attack upon property, lands or people
example: The squirrels' depredations on the bird feeder have become a seasonal campaign.

hindi: उन्मूलित — अपनी मूल भूमि और संस्कृति से कटा हुआ
definition: uprooted from a native homeland and culture, left without familiar roots or belonging
example: Six relocations in eight years left the consultant deracinated and permanently jet-lagged.

hindi: परित्यक्त पोत — समुद्र में छोड़ दिया गया जहाज़
definition: a ship abandoned upon open water by its crew, drifting without owner or command
example: The shared project folder is a derelict, drifting with nobody left aboard to steer it.

hindi: नवीनतम फ़ैशन — बिल्कुल ताज़ा चलन
definition: the very latest fashion or newest style that everyone wants
example: Last year's dernier cri was a Stanley tumbler; this year it's whatever your niece says.

hindi: साहसिक करतब — दिलेरी भरे वीर कारनामे
definition: daring, heroic action of the dashing adventurous kind found in stories
example: Changing a flat tyre on the motorway shoulder was his one feat of derring-do.

hindi: दूर से पहचान लेना — कठिनाई से किसी चीज़ को देख पाना
definition: to catch sight of something distant or hard to distinguish, especially after searching
example: From the back row of the stadium we could just descry our friend's giant foam hand.

hindi: अपवित्र करना — पवित्र स्थान या वस्तु को दूषित या नष्ट करना
definition: to violate or spoil something sacred, such as a shrine or grave, treating it with deliberate disrespect
example: Someone desecrated the team's whiteboard roadmap with a doodle of the CEO.

hindi: दुस्साहसी डाकू — किसी भी अपराध को तत्पर बेख़ौफ़ बदमाश
definition: a reckless, violent outlaw ready for any robbery, crime or bloodshed, fearing neither capture nor death
example: He merged straight to production without review, the lone desperado of the sprint.

hindi: लूट लेना — बलपूर्वक सब छीनकर उजाड़ देना
definition: strip a place of valuables by force, leaving it plundered, bare and utterly ruined
example: Holiday crowds despoiled the gift shop of every fridge magnet by noon.

hindi: तानाशाह — क्रूरता से मनमानी सत्ता चलाने वाला शासक
definition: a ruler wielding absolute power cruelly and arbitrarily, governing without consent or restraint
example: The toddler, drunk on absolute power over the remote, became a despot within minutes.

hindi: निराश्रित — सब कुछ खो चुका, अत्यंत दरिद्र
definition: completely poor, lacking money, food, shelter and every basic necessity
example: The collapse left thousands of savers destitute while its founder toured the podcasts.

hindi: रणाश्व — युद्ध में सवार योद्धा का बलवान घोड़ा
definition: a powerful medieval warhorse, trained to carry a heavily armoured knight into battle and tournaments
example: He treats his electric scooter like a destrier, charging through the plaza with lance-level confidence.

hindi: अनुपयोग — लंबे समय से प्रयोग न होने की स्थिति
definition: a state of disuse, when a custom or rule has long stopped being practised
example: The office gym fell into desuetude two weeks after the wellness email went out.

hindi: अनियमित — बिना लगन या क्रम के इधर-उधर भटकता
definition: jumping aimlessly from one thing to another without method, order or enthusiasm
example: After lunch the meeting drifted into desultory chatter about weekend plans.

hindi: आकस्मिक उद्धारक — कहानी को बाहर से आकर सुलझाने वाला असंभव संयोग
definition: an improbable rescue that resolves a story from outside its own logic
example: The finale's deus ex machina arrived as a long-lost uncle with a cheque.

hindi: अनुरागी — किसी शौक़ या कला का समर्पित भक्त
definition: an ardent enthusiast deeply devoted to a particular pursuit, artist, hobby or subject
example: A devotee of mechanical keyboards, he can identify a colleague by the sound of their typing.

hindi: श्रद्धालु — धर्म या किसी आस्था में गहरी निष्ठा वाला
definition: deeply and sincerely religious in faith and practice; hence earnestly devoted to any cause
example: A devout follower of the sourdough starter, she feeds it before she feeds herself.

hindi: विच्छिन्न आवृत्ति — बीच में कुछ शब्द रखकर वही शब्द दोहराना
definition: repeating a word or phrase after a brief interruption of other words, for dramatic emphasis
example: "Bond. James Bond," he told the barista, and his diacope still got the name spelled wrong on the cup.

hindi: मुकुट — राजसत्ता का प्रतीक रत्नजड़ित ताज
definition: a jewelled crown or ornamental headband worn as a symbol of royal power
example: The hackathon trophy, a plastic diadem, now crowns the office coffee machine.

hindi: झीना — इतना महीन कि रोशनी आर-पार दिखे
definition: so fine, thin and delicate that light passes through it, making the fabric almost transparent
example: Her diaphanous scarf was no match for the office air conditioning.

hindi: कटु आलोचना — किसी पर लगातार की गई तीखी बौछार
definition: a forceful, bitter tirade denouncing someone or something with sustained angry criticism
example: One late parcel set off a diatribe that the courier has since framed.

hindi: दुर्दशा-भरा — गंदगी और घोर ग़रीबी वाली पुरानी दुनिया जैसा
definition: recalling the squalid poverty and harsh conditions described in Dickens's novels
example: The office kitchen, with its single shared fork, had become frankly Dickensian.

hindi: सूक्त-वचन — किसी अधिकारी व्यक्ति का प्रसिद्ध कथन
definition: a brief, formal saying or pronouncement stated with authority by someone respected
example: The editor's dictum, 'cut the first paragraph', has saved a thousand essays.

hindi: उपदेशात्मक — सीख देने के उद्देश्य से रचा गया
definition: intended mainly to teach a moral lesson or instruct, often in a heavy-handed preachy manner
example: The children's film was so didactic that even the talking dog recycled.

hindi: पाचक पेय — भोजन के बाद पिया जाने वाला
definition: a drink, usually alcoholic, taken after a meal to help digestion
example: The digestif arrived just as someone suggested splitting the bill by exact items.

hindi: विषयांतरी — मूल बात से बार-बार भटकने वाला
definition: tending to wander away from the main subject into unrelated side topics
example: His digressive tax tutorial detoured through Roman coins and his uncle's boat.

hindi: थोपा गया आदेश — बिना सहमति के जबरन लागू हुक्म
definition: an order imposed by authority without consent, especially one forced upon defeated parties
example: The return-to-office diktat arrived by email at 11 pm, signed by nobody who ever comes in.

hindi: विलंबकारी — जान-बूझकर देर करने वाला, सुस्त
definition: slow to take action, tending to delay things, often deliberately or through idleness
example: The landlord's dilatory repairs mean the dripping tap now has a name and a birthday.

hindi: शौक़िया — किसी कला में केवल ऊपरी रुचि रखने वाला
definition: a person who dabbles in painting, music or scholarship for amusement, without serious study or lasting commitment
example: He was a dilettante of sourdough: three starters, two photographs, and no bread since April.

hindi: शौकियापन — गंभीरता के बिना विषयों को छूते रहना
definition: casual dabbling in the arts or learning for amusement, without serious study, discipline or commitment
example: His dilettantism produced three half-built apps and one confident LinkedIn headline.

hindi: अवरोह — धीरे-धीरे घटती हुई आवाज़
definition: a gradual decrease in loudness, music fading slowly toward softness
example: The argument ended in a diminuendo of mutters once dinner arrived.

hindi: लघुकाय — छोटे आकार का, नन्हा
definition: unusually small in size or stature; tiny, compact and little compared with others
example: The diminutive dog runs the entire household with an iron paw.

hindi: शोरगुल — लगातार, ऊँचा और खिझाने वाला शोर
definition: a loud, prolonged, confused noise that becomes unpleasant, wearing and hard to ignore
example: Above the din of the construction site, the architect explained the building would be very quiet.

hindi: मातमी धुन — अंत्येष्टि में गाया जाने वाला धीमा शोक-गीत
definition: a slow, mournful song or hymn lamenting someone dead, often sung at funerals
example: The Monday stand-up had the tempo of a dirge and roughly the same energy.

hindi: अस्त-व्यस्तता — बिखराव और अव्यवस्था की दशा
definition: a state of untidy disorder and confusion where nothing stays organised
example: The opposition party was in such disarray that it forgot to oppose anything.

hindi: पारखी — गुणवत्ता को बारीकी से परखने वाला
definition: able to judge well, especially telling good from poor quality in things
example: The café calls its customers discerning, which explains the seven-dollar flat white.

hindi: विवेक — अच्छे-बुरे और सच-दिखावे को परखने की क्षमता
definition: the ability to judge well, telling good from poor quality and truth from pretence
example: Discernment means skipping the five-star reviews and reading the one-star ones.

hindi: विसंवादी — बेसुरा, आपस में मेल न खाने वाला
definition: harsh and jarring because sounds clash rather than blend together
example: Two ringtones went off at once in a discordant duet during the eulogy.

hindi: साख गिराना — किसी की विश्वसनीयता और सम्मान घटाना
definition: damage someone's good reputation so that people stop trusting or respecting them
example: A single leaked group chat did more to discredit the campaign than any rival ad.

hindi: बिखरा-बिखरा — अस्त-व्यस्त कपड़े और बाल
definition: untidy in hair and clothing, rumpled, messy and disordered in overall appearance
example: He arrived at the interview dishevelled, having sprinted from a cancelled metro.

hindi: अपयश — मान-मर्यादा का भंग होना
definition: shameful loss of honour and respect caused by disgraceful conduct or treatment
example: He treats a missed standup as a stain of dishonour on the entire family line.

hindi: कपटपूर्ण — भोलेपन का ढोंग कर सच छिपाने वाला
definition: insincere and misleading, pretending innocence or honesty while knowing more
example: It was disingenuous to ask who ate the cake while holding the fork.

hindi: उत्खनन करना — दफ़न चीज़ को फिर से बाहर निकालना
definition: to unearth and remove a buried body from its grave or tomb, digging it back out
example: She disinterred her school diary from the attic and immediately regretted it.

hindi: अवमानना करना — किसी को तुच्छ बताकर उसकी बुराई करना
definition: speak about another person or thing as unimportant, worthless or inferior, belittling its real value
example: The critic disparaged the film as 'long', which was, to be fair, accurate.

hindi: निर्विकार — भावनाओं से अलग, निष्पक्ष
definition: calm and fair, judging things without being swayed by strong personal feeling
example: A dispassionate look at the spreadsheet revealed the office plant budget was the real villain.

hindi: विवादप्रिय — हर बात पर बहस छेड़ने वाला
definition: fond of arguing and quick to dispute almost anything other people happen to claim
example: My disputatious uncle once argued with the satnav, and in fairness he won.

hindi: विवेचन — किसी विषय पर लंबा विद्वत्तापूर्ण विचार
definition: a long, elaborate, scholarly discussion or essay examining a subject in great detail
example: He answered 'how was your weekend' with a disquisition on the history of the brunch.

hindi: बदनाम — जिसका नाम और साख ख़राब हो
definition: having a poor public reputation and not considered respectable, honest or trustworthy
example: The most disreputable-looking dhaba on the highway serves the finest dal in the state.

hindi: अपकीर्ति — अच्छा नाम खो देने की स्थिति
definition: the state of having lost public respect and fallen into shameful standing
example: One fake review scandal brought the whole bakery into disrepute.

hindi: भाव छिपाना — असली मंशा पर पर्दा डालना
definition: to hide your true feelings, motives or intentions behind a false appearance
example: He dissembled so well at the surprise party planning that even he believed he knew nothing.

hindi: छद्म रचना — असलियत छिपाकर दिखावा करना
definition: to conceal your true feelings or intentions by putting on a false appearance
example: She dissimulated interest in his crypto portfolio for a full forty minutes.

hindi: विलासी अपव्यय — भोग में धन और जीवन लुटाना
definition: wasteful, excessive indulgence in pleasure that slowly squanders health and money
example: His twenties were a decade of dissipation; his thirties are a decade of paying for it.

hindi: उच्छृंखल — भोग-विलास में डूबा, संयमहीन
definition: lacking moral restraint; given over to sensual pleasures, drink and indulgence
example: His dissolute gap year was mostly hostels, hangovers and one regrettable tattoo.

hindi: विसंवाद — स्वरों का टकराव, बेसुरापन
definition: a harsh, jarring combination of musical notes that clash and sound unresolved together
example: The dissonance of the jazz trio was intentional, which is more than the drummer could say.

hindi: विकार — (पुराना प्रयोग) शरीर या मन का रोग
definition: archaic: a disease or disorder of the body, once blamed on an imbalance of the four bodily humours
example: Whatever distemper has seized the Wi-Fi router, rebooting it has not cured it.

hindi: अन्यमनस्क — ख़यालों में खोया, ध्यान से दूर
definition: absent-minded and distracted, with thoughts drifting elsewhere, often from private worry
example: The groom looked distrait at the rehearsal, clearly still rewriting his speech in his head.

hindi: उन्मत्त स्तुति — जोश और उत्साह से भरा बेलगाम प्रशंसा-गान
definition: a wildly enthusiastic speech or piece of writing, full of passionate praise
example: One sip of the natural wine and the sommelier launched into a dithyramb about volcanic soil.

hindi: नाना — अनेक, कई प्रकार के
definition: archaic: several or sundry; various separate ones, numbering more than merely a couple
example: Divers delivery drivers have left divers parcels with divers wrong neighbours.

hindi: मनोरंजक अंतर-नृत्य — नाटक या ओपेरा के बीच का हल्का नृत्य या गीत
definition: a short light dance or musical piece inserted between acts of a ballet or opera for pleasure
example: The office quiz was a welcome divertissement between two brutal sprints.

hindi: फूट डालो और राज करो — विरोधियों को बाँटकर शासन करना
definition: divide and rule; keeping power by setting subjects or rivals against each other
example: Giving only one twin the bigger slice of cake was divide et impera, and the parents enjoyed an hour of peace.

hindi: भविष्य-कथन — गूढ़ संकेतों से आने वाले समय को जानने की कला
definition: the practice of foretelling future events by reading hidden signs, omens or supernatural messages
example: Predicting which meeting will run over is less analytics than divination.

hindi: प्रकट करना — गुप्त बात खोलकर बता देना
definition: to reveal or openly disclose information that was previously private, hidden or closely kept secret
example: The toddler divulged the surprise party plans within minutes.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक व्याख्याता — संग्रहालय या विश्वविद्यालय का शिक्षक
definition: a teacher or knowledgeable guide who lectures visitors in a museum, gallery or university
example: The docent explained the abstract painting so well that three visitors asked whether it was upside down.

hindi: लड़खड़ाता — उम्र से काँपता और डगमगाता
definition: shaky, trembling and unsteady in movement or thought because of advanced elderly years
example: The doddering laptop needs a full minute of prayer before it opens a browser tab.

hindi: भीषण गर्मी के दिन — सबसे तपते, सुस्त दिन
definition: hottest, sultriest weeks of summer, linked anciently with Sirius, the Dog Star
example: In the dog days of August, even the email servers seem to move slower.

hindi: तुकबंदी — बेढंगी, हल्की और घटिया कविता
definition: comic, clumsy verse with irregular rhythm and forced rhymes, trivial or badly written
example: Every birthday card from Uncle Raj arrives with fresh doggerel rhyming 'forty' with 'naughty'.

hindi: मधुर निष्क्रियता — कुछ न करने का सुखद आनंद
definition: the pleasant, sweet idleness of doing nothing whatsoever, enjoyed without guilt
example: Phone off, hammock swaying, she mastered the art of dolce far niente by noon.

hindi: शांत कटिबंध — भूमध्यरेखा का वह क्षेत्र जहाँ हवा थम जाती है
definition: equatorial ocean regions where winds fail, leaving sailing ships stalled for weeks
example: Sales entered the August doldrums, and the whole team drifted toward the coffee machine.

hindi: अपराध-अक्षम — अपराध का दोष समझने में असमर्थ माना गया
definition: presumed legally incapable of criminal intent, usually because the person is a young child
example: The toddler who drew on the rental walls was doli incapax, but his parents' deposit was not.

hindi: भोंदू — मूर्ख, मोटी बुद्धि वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a stupid, slow-witted person, dull in understanding and rather thick in the head
example: Some dolt microwaved fish in the office kitchen again.

hindi: गृहस्थी-प्रेम — घरेलू जीवन में रमना
definition: home life and family routines, or a contented devotion to household matters
example: Once the bread maker arrived, their weekends surrendered completely to domesticity.

hindi: निवास-स्थान — जहाँ कोई विधिवत रहता हो
definition: a person's settled home or dwelling place, especially the residence recognised in formal legal terms
example: The bank insists my domicile is the flat I left in 2019, and no form will let me move.

hindi: ग्राम्य अध्यापक — गाँव की पाठशाला का शिक्षक
definition: archaic: a Scottish schoolmaster or village teacher, sometimes a clergyman, instructing local pupils
example: The group chat's self-appointed dominie corrects every 'your' within ninety seconds.

hindi: प्रभुत्व — किसी क्षेत्र पर संप्रभु अधिकार और नियंत्रण
definition: sovereign authority and control over a territory, or the territory itself under such overlordship
example: The cat has extended her dominion from the sofa to both pillows and my laptop keyboard.

hindi: मुख्य बुर्ज — किले का सबसे भीतरी और मज़बूत गढ़
definition: the great inner tower of a medieval castle, its strongest final refuge
example: During exam week my bedroom became a donjon, supplied by snacks passed under the door.

hindi: पंडिताऊ — विश्वविद्यालयी विद्वान जैसा गंभीर
definition: resembling a university scholar; bookish, pedantic and fussily academic in manner or speech
example: His donnish reply to a birthday message included a correction and a suggested reading list.

hindi: धमाचौकड़ी — खुली, बेकाबू मारपीट
definition: a wild noisy brawl or public fight, named after a rowdy Irish fair
example: The book-club meeting turned into a donnybrook over the ending.

hindi: हमशक्ल — किसी जीवित व्यक्ति का विचित्र रूप से मिलता-जुलता प्रतिरूप
definition: a person who looks strikingly like another living person; an uncanny double
example: My doppelgänger apparently owes a bar in Goa a considerable sum, judging by the stares I get.

hindi: सठियापन — बुढ़ापे की कमज़ोर, भुलक्कड़ अवस्था
definition: the late period of life when mental powers weaken with very many years
example: In his dotage, Grandpa has decided the TV remote is personally conspiring against him.

hindi: द्वयर्थक उक्ति — दो अर्थों वाली, प्रायः शरारती बात
definition: a witty phrase carrying a double meaning, where the hidden second sense is usually cheeky or risqué
example: The bakery's sign promising 'buns you'll never forget' is a double entendre the owner denies.

hindi: साहसी — निडर और दृढ़ योद्धा जैसा
definition: brave, stout-hearted and persistent, especially facing hard odds with courage
example: A doughty volunteer took on the shared-drive cleanup and was never seen again.

hindi: कुलीन विधवा — दिवंगत पति की उपाधि सँभालने वाली
definition: a widow holding a title or property from her late husband; hence a dignified elderly woman
example: The dowager of the residents' committee rules the recycling rota with an iron teaspoon.

hindi: वयोवृद्ध अग्रणी — किसी क्षेत्र का सबसे वरिष्ठ और सम्मानित सदस्य
definition: the most senior, experienced and respected member of a learned profession or scholarly field
example: The doyen of food critics still reviews every new café, mostly unfavourably.

hindi: अत्यंत कठोर — अपराध से कहीं बड़ा दंड
definition: harsh and severe out of all proportion to the offence
example: The attendance rules are draconian: one late train and you lose a day's pay.

hindi: पात्र-सूची — नाटक के सभी पात्रों की सूची
definition: the full list of characters appearing in a play, printed before the script; hence the people involved in any affair
example: By the third reply-all, the dramatis personae of the thread included legal, finance and somebody's uncle.

hindi: सामंती अधिकार — स्वामी का अपनी प्रजा पर मनमाना कथित हक़
definition: a feudal lord's supposed right over his vassals, and today any arrogant privilege claimed by powerful people
example: The founder treated first pick of every intern's snacks as a droit du seigneur.

hindi: जलोदर — शरीर में पानी भर जाने का रोग
definition: archaic: swelling of the body caused by watery fluid gathering under skin
example: After the holiday salt binge her ankles looked like a case of dropsy.

hindi: खटने वाला — नीरस मेहनत में पिसता व्यक्ति
definition: a person made to do hard, dull and menial household work without relief
example: Nobody volunteers to be the drudge who defrosts the office freezer, so the ice keeps winning.

hindi: नीरस पांडित्यपूर्ण — सूखे तथ्यों में डूबा, उबाऊ विद्वत्ता वाला
definition: dull and dreary in a scholarly manner, burying lively subjects under tedious facts and details
example: The dryasdust documentary on pirates never once mentioned treasure.

hindi: धाय-संरक्षिका — युवती की देखरेख करने वाली बुज़ुर्ग स्त्री
definition: an older woman employed to guard and supervise a young woman's courtship and chaperone her meetings
example: Her grandmother acted as duenna on every video date, visible just behind the laptop.

hindi: देश हेतु मरना मधुर और गौरवपूर्ण है — वीरमृत्यु का आदर्श
definition: it is sweet and fitting to give your life for your country; the ideal of heroic sacrifice, often quoted bitterly
example: He treated working the holiday shift as dulce et decorum est, with overtime pay.

hindi: मधुर — कोमल, मीठा और सुखद (प्रायः व्यंग्य में भी)
definition: sweet, soft and pleasing to hear, often used teasingly about voices
example: I was woken at six by the dulcet tones of a neighbour's leaf blower.

hindi: मंदमति — नीरस और धीमी बुद्धि वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a slow, stupid person lacking liveliness of mind, dull in thought and conversation
example: He is no dullard; he simply prefers to hide his brilliance during meetings.

hindi: जब तक साँस, तब तक आस — जीवन रहते आशा बनी रहती है
definition: while breathing, I keep hope; hope lasts as long as life itself continues
example: The flight is delayed six hours, but dum spiro, spero: the lounge still has croissants.

hindi: जब तक जीवित हैं, जी भरकर जिएँ — जीवन का आनंद अभी लो
definition: while we are living, let us enjoy life fully, since death arrives soon enough
example: He booked the concert tickets on a Tuesday, murmuring dum vivimus, vivamus at the checkout page.

hindi: मंदबुद्धि छात्र — पढ़ने-सीखने में सुस्त व्यक्ति
definition: a person slow at learning, especially a hopeless pupil; mockingly named after the scholar Duns Scotus
example: I was a dunce at algebra and am now, somehow, in charge of the budget.

hindi: द्वादशपत्री — बारह पन्नों के मोड़ से बनी छोटी पुस्तक
definition: a small book size made by folding each printed sheet to form twelve leaves
example: Victorian travellers carried duodecimo guidebooks, the pocket ancestors of every travel app we now ignore.

hindi: कपटी — दोमुँहा, दिखावे में कुछ और भीतर कुछ और
definition: deceitfully double-dealing, saying one thing openly while secretly doing another thing entirely
example: The duplicitous group chat praised the plan and then complained in a second group chat.

hindi: दोहरापन — मुँह पर कुछ और मन में कुछ रखना
definition: double-dealing; saying one thing while intending another
example: The emails revealed a duplicity that no apology was going to cover.

hindi: कठोर विधि, फिर भी विधि — कठिन क़ानून भी मान्य है
definition: the principle that a harsh statute must still be obeyed because it remains binding legislation
example: The library's overdue fines were brutal, but dura lex, sed lex, and she paid in coins.

hindi: दरबार — राजा या शासक की औपचारिक सभा
definition: a ceremonial court or public reception held by an Indian prince or colonial ruler
example: The CEO's quarterly all-hands has the feel of a durbar, complete with petitioners and gracious nods.

hindi: अजीर्ण — अपच, पेट की गड़बड़ी
definition: indigestion; painful discomfort, burning and bloating in the stomach after eating rich food
example: The all-you-can-eat buffet delivered value, then dyspepsia, in that order.

hindi: कटूक्ति — साधारण बात के लिए जान-बूझकर कठोर या अपमानजनक शब्द चुनना
definition: a harsh, blunt or offensive word deliberately substituted for a neutral one, the opposite of euphemism
example: Calling the office canteen "the trough" is dysphemism, though the lasagne makes a case for it.

hindi: पदच्युत — सामाजिक प्रतिष्ठा से नीचे गिरा हुआ
definition: having fallen from a higher social rank, or considered socially inferior and unfashionable
example: Paper napkins were once thought déclassé; now they are 'sustainable'.

hindi: गहरा गला — महिला की पोशाक का नीचे तक कटा गला
definition: a deeply plunging neckline on a woman's dress, leaving the neck and shoulders exposed
example: The red-carpet commentary spent more words on one décolletage than on the film's entire plot.

hindi: सहज-मुक्त — बिना बनावट के आराम भरे ढंग वाला
definition: relaxed and unconstrained in manner, casually free from stiffness, fuss or worry about appearances
example: He strolled into the board meeting in sneakers, perfectly dégagé, as though he owned the building, which he did.

hindi: पूर्वानुभूति — अभी घट रहे क्षण के पहले भी घट चुके होने का आभास
definition: the strange feeling that a moment happening now has already happened before
example: Third reorg this year: the all-hands slides gave everyone serious déjà vu.

hindi: राजनयिक पहल — किसी सरकार से औपचारिक विरोध या अनुरोध
definition: a formal diplomatic protest or request made to a foreign government through official channels
example: The neighbours' démarche about the leaf blower arrived as a laminated letter.

hindi: फ़ैशन-बाहर — पुराने ढंग का, चलन से उतरा
definition: outdated and unfashionable, dropped from style by changing tastes, trends and times
example: Skinny jeans went démodé the very week he finally bought three pairs.

hindi: उपसंहार — कथा की गुत्थियों के सुलझने वाला अंत
definition: the final part of a story where the plot's mysteries and tangled threads are finally resolved
example: The dénouement of the office mystery: the missing stapler was in the manager's drawer.

hindi: अर्धवसन — अधूरे या ढीले-ढाले कपड़ों में होना
definition: the condition of being only partly or casually dressed, typically in loose clothing worn at home
example: Half the team attends morning calls in déshabillé: formal shirt above the desk, pyjamas below.

hindi: तनाव-शैथिल्य — दो विरोधी पक्षों के बीच तनाव का ढीला पड़ना
definition: easing of hostility and tension between rival nations, without full friendship returning
example: The roommates reached a détente: she stopped playing drums at midnight, he started washing his mugs.

hindi: अनेक में से एक — अलग-अलग राज्यों या लोगों से बनी एकता
definition: out of many, one; a single union formed from many separate states or peoples
example: The potluck was e pluribus unum: twelve dishes, one gloriously confused dinner.

hindi: उतरना — ज्वार की तरह धीरे-धीरे पीछे हटना
definition: to flow back or decline gradually, weakening slowly like the tide retreating from shore
example: His patience ebbed with every hold-music loop of the same saxophone solo.

hindi: आबनूसी — आबनूस की लकड़ी सा गहरा काला
definition: deep glossy black in colour, dark like polished ebony wood
example: Her ebon hoodie was declared business casual by sheer confidence.

hindi: इस मनुष्य को देखो — काँटों का मुकुट पहने मसीह का चित्रण
definition: behold the man; the words of Pilate presenting Christ, also a painting of Christ crowned with thorns
example: He limped in from his first marathon, sunburnt and wrapped in foil, an ecce homo in running shoes.

hindi: धर्मसंघीय — चर्च और उसके पादरी-तंत्र से संबंधित
definition: relating to the Christian church, its clergy, bishops, courts and formal institutional authority
example: The group chat's rules had grown so ecclesiastical that posting a meme required three approvals.

hindi: खरा, असली — अपने प्रकार का पूर्णतः प्रामाणिक
definition: genuine and typical; authentically true to its kind, without imitation or dilution
example: The café is echt Berlin: concrete walls, oat milk and a disapproving barista.

hindi: चरवाहा-संवाद काव्य — ग्रामीण जीवन पर लघु कविता
definition: a short pastoral poem, often a dialogue between shepherds, celebrating rural countryside life
example: Their podcast about moving to a farm is a modern eclogue with more mud and sponsorships.

hindi: स्वर्गोद्यान — पूर्ण सुख और निर्दोषता का आदर्श स्थान
definition: a place or state of perfect happiness, innocence and unspoiled natural beauty
example: The cabin was an Eden until someone discovered it had phone signal.

hindi: अदन वाटिका जैसा — निष्पाप, सुंदर और आनंदमय
definition: like a perfect, unspoiled paradise garden where life is innocent, peaceful and happy
example: The resort looked Edenic right up until the Wi-Fi password turned out to cost extra.

hindi: राजाज्ञा — शासक द्वारा जारी आधिकारिक आदेश
definition: an official order issued by a ruler or authority, carrying legal force
example: The landlord's latest edict bans drying clothes on balconies, plants on balconies, and joy on balconies.

hindi: भव्य भवन — विशाल, प्रभावशाली इमारत; कोई जटिल खड़ा किया गया तंत्र
definition: a large, imposing building, or figuratively any elaborate system built up over time
example: The whole edifice of our quarterly plan rested on one spreadsheet nobody had opened since March.

hindi: प्रथम मुद्रित संस्करण — किसी प्राचीन ग्रंथ की पहली छपाई
definition: the first printed edition of a work that previously survived only in handwritten manuscripts
example: Collectors chase the editio princeps the way sneakerheads chase the first colourway of a drop.

hindi: प्रस्फुटन — फूलों का खिल उठना, किसी चीज़ का भरपूर पनपना
definition: the process of flowering, and figuratively any rich blossoming of creative or cultural growth
example: The lockdown saw an efflorescence of sourdough starters, most now quietly deceased.

hindi: दुर्गंधित वाष्प — किसी चीज़ से उठती अप्रिय गंध या धुआँ
definition: an unpleasant smell or vapour released by something, especially rubbish, waste or decaying matter
example: The effluvium from the overflowing bin reached the boardroom before the quarterly figures did.

hindi: देदीप्यमान — तेज़ चमकती, प्रकाश बिखेरती
definition: shining brilliantly and pouring radiant light outward in every direction around itself
example: The new phone's effulgent screen lit the whole cinema the moment she checked a message.

hindi: हे भगवान — अचरज भरा हल्का उद्गार
definition: archaic: a mild oath expressing surprise or excitement, a softened, disguised form of swearing by the Almighty
example: Egad, the meeting actually ended early.

hindi: घोर — अत्यधिक और खुलेआम बुरा
definition: outstandingly awful in a glaring, shocking, obvious manner; wrong to an extreme degree
example: Pineapple on the team pizza was ruled an egregious breach of trust.

hindi: चित्र-स्मृति वाला — देखी चीज़ को हूबहू याद रखने वाला
definition: able to recall images from memory with vivid, almost photographic detail
example: Her eidetic memory for spreadsheets made her terrifying in every quarterly review.

hindi: छायारूप — आदर्श प्रतिमा या प्रेत-सी छवि
definition: a ghostly image or idealised phantom of a person or thing, more appearance than substance
example: The perfect influencer family is an eidolon, assembled from forty takes and good lighting.

hindi: चित्र-वर्णन — किसी कलाकृति का शब्दों में सजीव वर्णन
definition: vivid writing that describes a painting, sculpture or other visual artwork in words
example: Her review of the new phone's camera samples drifted into full ekphrasis about one blurry sunset.

hindi: स्वर्ण नगरी — धन-वैभव का काल्पनिक, अप्राप्य स्थान
definition: a fabled place of boundless riches that people chase but never actually find
example: For a generation of app makers, the viral hit was an El Dorado glimpsed only in other people's screenshots.

hindi: अलौकिक-भयावह — अजीब, डरावना और इस दुनिया से परे
definition: weird, eerie and unearthly in frightening fashion, as though touched by something supernatural
example: A low eldritch hum came from the server closet, and nobody volunteered to investigate.

hindi: अवलेह — शहद में मिली चाटने वाली दवा
definition: archaic: a medicinal paste made by mixing powdered drugs with honey or syrup
example: The cough syrup is really an electuary with better branding and a childproof cap.

hindi: शोकाकुल स्वर वाला — बीती चीज़ों पर करुण स्मरण भरा
definition: having the mournful, wistful tone of an elegy lamenting something lost or passing
example: His toast to the old flat grew elegiac somewhere around the landlord's broken boiler.

hindi: शोक-गीत — किसी की मृत्यु या खोई चीज़ पर लिखी कविता
definition: a mournful poem or song lamenting someone dead or something lost
example: His farewell post for the office's broken coffee machine read like an elegy.

hindi: गजसदृश — हाथी जैसा विशाल, भारी और बेढब
definition: like elephants; huge, heavy, lumbering, clumsy and slow moving
example: The elephantine terms and conditions scrolled on for forty screens.

hindi: अमृत — रोग मिटाने या जीवन बढ़ाने वाली दवा
definition: a magical or medicinal liquid believed to cure illness or prolong life
example: For the night shift, the vending machine coffee is treated as an elixir.

hindi: लोप — समझ में आने वाले शब्दों को वाक्य से छोड़ देना
definition: omitting words from a sentence that the reader or listener easily supplies from context
example: "She ordered the salad; he, the triple burger" — an ellipsis that says plenty about both.

hindi: अधूरे वाक्यों वाला — शब्द छोड़कर संकेत से कही बात
definition: speaking briefly by leaving words unsaid, so meaning must be guessed
example: His elliptical texts, 'so… yeah', required a decoder ring and a therapist.

hindi: उच्चारण कला — स्पष्ट और शुद्ध बोलने का कौशल
definition: the skill of clear, expressive speaking, especially correct pronunciation and voice control
example: Years of elocution lessons left him able to mispronounce "quinoa" with perfect diction.

hindi: वाक्पटु — प्रभावशाली और सुंदर ढंग से बोलने वाला
definition: speaking or writing fluently, forcefully and persuasively, moving listeners with well-chosen words
example: Her eloquent two-line reply ended a thread that forty emails had failed to settle.

hindi: परमानंददायी — स्वर्गिक शांति और सौंदर्य वाला
definition: blissfully peaceful and beautiful
example: Three days on that quiet coast were Elysian, and then the phone found me.

hindi: क्षीणकाय — भूख या रोग से अत्यधिक दुबला
definition: abnormally thin and wasted away, especially through starvation or long illness
example: The emaciated houseplant was, in fairness, watered only during quarterly reviews.

hindi: शव-लेपन करना — सड़न से बचाने हेतु शव में लेप या रसायन भरना
definition: to preserve a dead body from decay using spices, oils or chemicals before burial
example: The band's greatest hits album embalms their sound exactly as it was in 1994.

hindi: समृद्धि की दुविधा — इतनी अधिकता कि चुनना कठिन हो
definition: French for 'embarrassment of riches': more good choices than anyone could manage
example: Forty-two pizza toppings is an embarras de richesses that ends with plain cheese.

hindi: संघर्षरत — चारों ओर से हमलों में घिरा
definition: surrounded by enemies or constant attack, and fighting hard to hold ground
example: The embattled manager defended the new timesheet software to a hostile room.

hindi: गबन करना — सौंपा गया धन चुपके से हड़पना
definition: secretly steal money placed in your trust, especially funds belonging to an employer
example: He embezzled the snack budget one granola bar at a time.

hindi: गदराया बदन — भरा-पूरा, मांसल शरीर
definition: plump fullness of body, a pleasantly heavy and rounded figure carrying extra flesh
example: After the festive season his embonpoint returned with the reliability of a subscription renewal.

hindi: उलझाना — किसी झगड़े या झंझट में फँसाना
definition: to drag someone deep into a tangled quarrel, conflict or confusing situation
example: The intern was embroiled in a feud between two managers over a stapler.

hindi: पाठ-शोधन करना — ग्रंथ की त्रुटियाँ सुधारना
definition: to correct errors in a written text through careful scholarly editing, restoring what the author meant
example: She emended the menu from 'expresso' before the barista's customers noticed.

hindi: अवकाशप्राप्त सम्मानित — पद छोड़कर भी उपाधि धारण किए हुए
definition: retired from a post but keeping its title as a mark of honour
example: Professor emeritus: no teaching, no committees, and the parking space survives.

hindi: वमनकारी — उल्टी कराने वाली दवा
definition: a medicine or substance that makes a person vomit, once used to purge sickness
example: The hotel buffet's reheated prawns worked as a surprisingly effective emetic.

hindi: दूत — विशेष संदेश लेकर भेजा गया प्रतिनिधि
definition: trusted person sent on a special mission to deliver a message or negotiate peace terms
example: The kids sent the youngest as their emissary to ask for a later bedtime.

hindi: शामक — कटुता को नरम करने वाला
definition: soothing in tone, designed to soften anger and calm a tense situation
example: The CEO's emollient statement used the word 'journey' four times and 'layoffs' zero.

hindi: पारिश्रमिक — पद या काम से मिलने वाला वेतन या लाभ
definition: salary, payment or profit received from employment or holding public office
example: The consultant's emolument arrived faster than any of her recommendations.

hindi: नीम-हकीम — अनुभव के भरोसे इलाज करने वाला
definition: archaic: a healer working from rough experience without training, often little better than a quack
example: The wellness influencer is a modern empiric: no degree, strong opinions, discount code.

hindi: परमव्योम — सबसे ऊँचा दिव्य आकाश
definition: the highest heaven, the pure upper reaches of sky beyond clouds and weather
example: From thirty thousand feet the empyrean looked serene, unlike the queue for the lavatory.

hindi: पारिवारिक रूप से — घर जैसी सहजता में
definition: at home among family members, informally and without ceremony, fuss or outside guests
example: The launch party was cancelled, so they celebrated en famille with pizza and a single sparkler.

hindi: सामूहिक रूप से — सब एक साथ, झुंड में
definition: all together as one single group; moving or acting in a large body or great number
example: The team left en masse the moment someone mentioned free pizza downstairs.

hindi: प्रसंगवश — बात-बात में, चलते-चलते
definition: mentioned briefly and casually, in passing, while discussing something else
example: She noted, en passant, that she had already booked the flights.

hindi: खुले आकाश तले — बाहर, प्रकृति के बीच चित्र बनाना
definition: painting outdoors in natural daylight rather than inside a studio
example: She answers emails en plein air, which means the balcony and a laptop wrestling with glare.

hindi: रास्ते में — गंतव्य की ओर जाते हुए
definition: along the route while travelling toward a destination, already moving and underway
example: 'En route,' he texted, from the shower.

hindi: लघु-पुस्तिका — हाथ में रखने योग्य मार्गदर्शक ग्रंथ
definition: a handbook or short manual of essential teachings, compact enough to carry in hand
example: The new hire's enchiridion was a sticky note listing which microwave is safe and which printer lies.

hindi: प्रशस्ति — किसी की औपचारिक, भरपूर प्रशंसा
definition: a formal speech or piece of writing that praises someone warmly and at length
example: The retirement card turned into a three-page encomium, which was more than her manager ever said aloud.

hindi: निस्तेज — शक्तिहीन और थका हुआ
definition: drained of energy and vitality, left weak, sluggish and unable to take action
example: Enervated by the heatwave, the city's pigeons simply stopped bothering to move.

hindi: उद्दंड प्रतिभा — नियम तोड़कर सबको चौंकाने वाला नवोदित
definition: a brilliant newcomer whose shocking, unconventional behaviour embarrasses the established group
example: The fashion world's enfant terrible sent his models down the runway in hiking boots and ball gowns.

hindi: पहेली — जो समझ में न आए
definition: someone or something that resists explanation
example: The bug is an enigma: it fails only on Tuesdays, and only in Berlin.

hindi: पंक्ति-प्रवाह — वाक्य का बिना रुके अगली पंक्ति में बहना
definition: the running of a sentence past the line ending into the next line without pause
example: His texts arrive in six separate bubbles, a masterclass in unwanted enjambment.

hindi: शत्रुता — दो पक्षों के बीच गहरा, स्थायी वैर
definition: deep lasting hostility between people, groups or nations who regard each other as enemies
example: The enmity between the two food trucks outlasted three changes of street parking rules.

hindi: घोरता — किसी अपराध या दुष्कर्म की भीषण गंभीरता
definition: the monstrous wickedness of a crime or wrong, or the shocking, outrageous scale of its harm
example: Only at the audit did the enormity of the expense claims sink in: seventeen 'client lunches' at one kebab stall.

hindi: सम्मोहित करना — जादू से वश में कर लेना
definition: to enchant or bewitch, holding someone under the power of a magic spell
example: The new game ensorcelled the whole team, and the sprint quietly died.

hindi: शीर्षपट्ट — खंभों पर टिका क्षैतिज पट्टियों का ढाँचा
definition: the horizontal band resting upon classical columns, made up of architrave, frieze and cornice
example: The architecture student can name every layer of an entablature and still cannot hang a shelf.

hindi: सौहार्दपूर्ण समझ — राष्ट्रों के बीच मैत्रीपूर्ण सहमति
definition: friendly understanding between nations, looser than a formal alliance or treaty
example: The two cats have an entente: one owns the sofa, the other owns the sunny windowsill.

hindi: हार्दिक सहमति — राष्ट्रों के बीच मैत्रीपूर्ण, अनौपचारिक समझौता
definition: warm friendly understanding between nations, named after the 1904 Anglo-French agreement
example: The neighbours' hedge-trimming entente cordiale collapsed the moment a leaf blower appeared.

hindi: परिजन-मंडली — किसी बड़े व्यक्ति के साथ चलने वाला दल
definition: the group of attendants, aides and followers who surround and accompany an important person
example: The influencer arrived with an entourage of three assistants, one ring light and a man whose only job was holding the oat milk.

hindi: अंतरांक — दो अंकों के बीच का विराम या उसमें बजने वाला अंश
definition: the interval separating successive acts of a play, or a short piece of music performed during that break
example: The buffering wheel gave the whole family an unwanted entr'acte right before the finale.

hindi: हमारे बीच — गोपनीय रूप से, केवल आपस में
definition: between ourselves; spoken confidentially and meant to stay private within this conversation
example: Entre nous, the famous product roadmap is a spreadsheet nobody has opened since spring.

hindi: विघटन — व्यवस्था का धीरे-धीरे बिखरते जाना
definition: a gradual decline from order into disorder, randomness and decay
example: Entropy claims every kitchen drawer eventually, no matter how many dividers you buy.

hindi: उपसंहार-छंद — कविता के अंत का छोटा समापन छंद
definition: a short closing stanza that ends certain poems, often addressing a patron or reader
example: Every email she sends ends with an envoi: "Let me know if you have any questions!"

hindi: क्षणिक वस्तुएँ — थोड़े समय के लिए बनी चीज़ें, जैसे टिकट, पर्चे
definition: printed things made to last only briefly, such as tickets, posters, flyers and pamphlets, later collected
example: Her drawer of concert ephemera now outweighs her actual furniture.

hindi: क्षणभंगुर — पल भर में मिट जाने वाला
definition: lasting only a very brief time, fading quickly away and leaving nothing permanent behind
example: The office's enthusiasm for standing desks proved ephemeral; they are now expensive coat racks.

hindi: रसज्ञ — उत्तम भोजन और पेय का पारखी
definition: a person with refined taste who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink
example: The epicure sent back the tap water for being 'too municipal'.

hindi: अनुगामी नक़लची — किसी महान कलाकार का कमतर अनुकरणकर्ता
definition: a lesser follower or imitator of a great artist, copying their style without their spark
example: Every famous founder spawns epigones who copy the turtleneck but not the product.

hindi: सूक्ति-व्यंग्य — छोटा, चतुर, चुभने वाला कथन
definition: a brief, clever and witty saying, often with a surprising twist
example: Wilde could turn an insult into an epigram; most of us just turn it into a group chat.

hindi: उपसंहार-खंड — रचना के अंत में जुड़ा समापन भाग
definition: a closing section added after the main story or play ends, reflecting on what followed
example: The epilogue to the product launch was a quiet patch release that fixed everything the launch broke.

hindi: आत्मबोध — अचानक गहरी समझ या सच्चाई का प्रकाश
definition: a sudden moment of revealing insight when the truth about something becomes clear
example: In the shower came the epiphany: the bug was a missing semicolon.

hindi: पत्रात्मक — पत्रों के रूप में लिखा गया
definition: written as a series of letters, diaries or documents exchanged between characters rather than plain narration
example: Their breakup unfolded as an epistolary novel told entirely in read receipts.

hindi: अंत्य आवृत्ति — हर वाक्यांश के अंत में वही शब्द दोहराना
definition: repeating the same word or phrase at the close of several successive clauses or sentences
example: He wanted the budget, he fought for the budget, he blew the budget — epistrophe with a spreadsheet attached.

hindi: समाधि-लेख — क़ब्र पर खुदा हुआ स्मृति-वाक्य
definition: a short inscription carved on a tomb or gravestone remembering the person buried there
example: 'He replied all' would make a fitting epitaph for most of the finance team.

hindi: विवाह-गीत — दुल्हन-दूल्हे के सम्मान में रचा गया काव्य
definition: a poem or song written to celebrate a wedding, honouring the bride and bridegroom
example: The best man attempted an epithalamium and got as far as rhyming 'Priya' with 'tequila'.

hindi: मूर्त रूप — किसी गुण का सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण
definition: the purest example of a quality
example: Her reply, three words and no greeting, was the epitome of a busy inbox.

hindi: लगातार आवृत्ति — एक ही शब्द बिना रुके बार-बार दोहराना
definition: repeating the same word several times in immediate succession, with nothing between, for emphasis
example: "Deadline, deadline, deadline," the manager chanted, as if epizeuxis could compile the code.

hindi: सम-स्वभाव — एक-सा शांत, न उबलने वाला
definition: steady and calm in temper, rarely changing mood or becoming upset
example: His equable temper survived three toddlers, two dogs and one group project.
