hindi: समता — विचलित हुए बिना संतुलित बना रहने वाला मन
definition: calmness and evenness of mind, especially under strain
example: He took the news of the layoffs with an equanimity nobody else in the room shared.

hindi: विषुव-संबंधी — दिन-रात बराबर होने के समय से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the equinox, when daylight and night stand equal, or its seasonal storms
example: The equinoctial gales arrived on schedule, unlike the delivery driver.

hindi: विषुव — जब दिन और रात बराबर होते हैं
definition: either yearly moment when the sun crosses the equator, making daylight and night equal length
example: Twice a year the equinox gives day and night an equal share, which is more fairness than my team rota manages.

hindi: द्व्यर्थक बोलना — जान-बूझकर गोलमोल भाषा बोलना
definition: to deliberately speak ambiguous words to avoid committing yourself or telling truth
example: Asked if he ate the last samosa, he equivocated about the nature of ownership.

hindi: पूर्व — इससे पहले कि, किसी घटना से पहले
definition: archaic: before, earlier than, prior to some particular moment, event or happening finally arriving
example: Finish your reply ere the typing dots on their side stop.

hindi: शीघ्र ही — अधिक समय बीतने से पहले
definition: archaic: before long, soon, within a fairly short stretch of time
example: Erelong the new phone will feel old, and another will be announced with gasps.

hindi: वैरागी — एकांतवासी संन्यासी जैसा, समाज से दूर
definition: living alone in religious seclusion, like hermits withdrawn from society into deserts or remote places
example: His eremitic weekend without WiFi lasted until the football started.

hindi: अतः — इसलिए, निष्कर्ष रूप में
definition: and so, used to mark the conclusion an argument has earned
example: He was in Delhi that night, ergo he cannot have signed the register in Pune.

hindi: श्वेत समूर — राजसी और न्यायिक वस्त्रों पर लगा सफ़ेद फ़र
definition: the white winter coat of the stoat, trimming robes of royalty, peers and judges as a mark of rank
example: He carries himself as though his fleece vest were trimmed with ermine.

hindi: पथभ्रष्ट — सही राह या नियम से भटका हुआ
definition: straying from the proper course or standard, or wandering abroad in search of adventure
example: One errant reply-all turned a private grumble into company-wide theatre.

hindi: भूल करना मानव स्वभाव है — सब चूकते हैं, इसलिए क्षमा उचित है
definition: to make mistakes is human; everyone errs, so forgiveness is only reasonable
example: He sent the draft to the whole company instead of his boss; errare humanum est, but so is mortification.

hindi: शुद्धिपत्र — छपी रचना की भूलों की सूची
definition: a list of printing or writing mistakes found after publication, with their corrections
example: The errata sheet for the product launch was longer than the product launch.

hindi: भूतपूर्व — पहले का, जो अब नहीं रहा
definition: former, having been something in the past but no longer holding that role today
example: My erstwhile gym buddy now sends me motivational memes from the sofa.

hindi: विद्वान — गहन अध्ययन से भरपूर ज्ञान वाला
definition: having deep knowledge gained from long reading and careful study
example: Her erudite footnotes were longer than the blog post they supported.

hindi: विद्वत्ता — अध्ययन से अर्जित गहरा ज्ञान
definition: deep knowledge gained from long reading and careful study of many books
example: His erudition covered six dead languages and none of the Wi-Fi password.

hindi: प्रलयकाल — संसार का अंतिम, निर्णायक युग
definition: the final event of history, when the world reaches its divine conclusion
example: To judge by the office mood, the quarterly review is the eschaton itself.

hindi: राजगामिता — उत्तराधिकारी न होने पर संपत्ति का स्वामी को लौटना
definition: the reverting of property to the lord or state when its owner dies without heirs
example: Unclaimed lunches in the office fridge pass by escheat to whoever cleans it on Friday.

hindi: परहेज़ करना — जान-बूझकर दूर रहना
definition: deliberately avoid or keep away from something, usually through principle
example: She eschews meetings without agendas, which has freed up most of her week.

hindi: लेखन-मेज़ — दराज़ों वाली लिखने की डेस्क
definition: a small writing desk with drawers and compartments for private papers and letters
example: She bought an elegant escritoire for letter-writing and uses it mainly to charge her phone.

hindi: कुलचिह्न ढाल — वह ढाल जिस पर वंश का प्रतीक अंकित हो
definition: a shield bearing a family's coat of arms, and figuratively its honour and reputation
example: The company's gleaming escutcheon survived the merger, even if half the staff did not.

hindi: दीवार-लता वृक्ष — दीवार से सटाकर समतल उगाया पेड़
definition: a fruit tree trained to grow flat against a wall or framework in patterns
example: Squeezed into a studio apartment, she lives like an espalier: productive, flat and against the wall.

hindi: चुटीली प्रखरता — जीवंत बुद्धि और चटपटी हाज़िरजवाबी
definition: lively, clever intelligence and sparkling humour, especially shown in quick conversation
example: The group chat survives on one friend's esprit and everyone else's reaction emojis.

hindi: सामूहिक मनोबल — दल के प्रति गर्व और एकजुटता की भावना
definition: shared pride, loyalty and team spirit among members of a group
example: The night shift's esprit de corps rested entirely on a secret stash of samosas.

hindi: सीढ़ी पर सूझी बात — मौका निकलने के बाद सूझा चतुर जवाब
definition: the witty reply that only occurs to you after leaving the conversation
example: His esprit de l'escalier struck at 2 a.m., three days after the meeting ended.

hindi: झलक पा लेना — अचानक किसी छिपी या दूर की चीज़ पर नज़र पड़ना
definition: to suddenly catch sight of something, especially something small, distant or partly hidden
example: Across the conference hall she espied the one table with the good pastries.

hindi: आदरणीय — सम्मान और प्रशंसा के योग्य
definition: worthy of respect and admiration for good character, honest conduct or quality
example: The estimable Mrs Kapoor has chaired the residents' committee through four plumbing crises.

hindi: ग्रीष्मकालीन — गर्मी की ऋतु से जुड़ा
definition: belonging to summer, the hottest season when long bright days stretch late
example: Our estival productivity peaks somewhere between the air conditioner and the ice-cream van.

hindi: विमुखता — कभी निकट रहे लोगों के बीच आई दूरी और परायापन
definition: the ending of friendly feelings between people once close, leaving them distant strangers
example: Their estrangement began, as many do, over who got custody of the Netflix password.

hindi: एवं अन्य — पहले लेखक के साथ बाकी सहलेखक
definition: and others; shortens a long list of authors or names after the first person
example: The paper is by Chen et al., which means eleven people and one very tired grad student.

hindi: इत्यादि — और इसी तरह की बाकी चीज़ें
definition: and the rest, meaning further similar things too numerous or obvious to list individually
example: Bring snacks, chargers, patience, et cetera; mostly patience.

hindi: अर्कादिया में भी मैं हूँ — सबसे सुखद स्थानों में भी मृत्यु पहुँचती है
definition: even in Arcadia I exist; a reminder that death reaches even the happiest places
example: A dead phone battery in the most beautiful beach cove of the trip: et in Arcadia ego.

hindi: और तुम भी, ब्रूटस — विश्वासपात्र मित्र के विश्वासघात पर आहत पुकार
definition: and you too, Brutus; a wounded cry of shock at sudden betrayal by a trusted friend or ally
example: My own sister voted for the other pizza place; et tu, Brute.

hindi: व्योम — ऊपरी आकाश का निर्मल वायुमंडल
definition: the clear upper regions of sky, once imagined filled with pure heavenly substance
example: Another password reset email vanished into the ether, never to be seen again.

hindi: अलौकिक — हवा-सा हल्का, स्वर्गिक और नाज़ुक
definition: delicate and light beyond earthly things, seeming almost heavenly and spiritual rather than of this world
example: Her ethereal vocals on the demo made the whole studio forget the broken air conditioning.

hindi: मूल स्वभाव — समूह के मार्गदर्शक मूल्य
definition: the guiding character and values of a group
example: The company ethos survives exactly as long as someone keeps saying it out loud.

hindi: निस्तेज — रोशनी न मिलने से पीला और कमज़ोर
definition: pale and weak from lack of sunlight, like plants grown in darkness
example: The etiolated office fern survived on monitor glow and hope.

hindi: प्रशस्ति करना — किसी की भावपूर्ण और भरपूर प्रशंसा करना
definition: to praise someone or something highly in speech or writing, often after death
example: The team eulogized the old codebase at its farewell party, then refused to open it again.

hindi: श्रद्धांजलि भाषण — दिवंगत के सम्मान में कहे गए प्रशंसा के शब्द
definition: a speech or piece of writing that praises someone, especially someone who has recently died
example: His eulogy for the office printer was moving, considering how often he had kicked it.

hindi: मृदूक्ति — कठोर या अप्रिय बात को नरम शब्दों में कहना
definition: a mild, polite word or phrase substituted for a harsh, blunt or unpleasant expression
example: "Rightsizing" is the euphemism HR chose, and the laid-off team was not soothed.

hindi: सुस्वर — कानों को मीठा और सुखद लगने वाला
definition: pleasing and sweet sounding to the ears, with smooth, harmonious, gentle, flowing tones
example: The startup chose a euphonious name first and worked out what the product did later.

hindi: सुस्वरता — शब्दों या ध्वनियों का मधुर, सुखद मेल
definition: the pleasing, sweet, harmonious quality of sounds or words heard together, gentle to ears
example: Poets chase euphony; brand consultants bill for it.

hindi: अलंकार-बोझिल शैली — अति-सजावटी कृत्रिम भाषा
definition: artificially elaborate, ornate writing style crammed with showy phrases and flourishes
example: Her wedding speech drifted into euphuism, comparing the couple to twin comets of destiny.

hindi: मिल गया! — अचानक खोज पर निकला हर्ष-उद्गार
definition: a triumphant shout announcing that you have suddenly found or solved something
example: Eureka, she cried, holding up the charger that had been in her coat pocket all week.

hindi: क्षणिक — धीरे-धीरे आँखों से ओझल हो जाने वाला
definition: quickly fading from sight or memory, vanishing softly like mist under morning sunshine
example: The evanescent glow of inbox zero lasted until the 9:02 a.m. newsletter.

hindi: सांध्यकाल — संध्या का समय
definition: archaic: evening, the quiet hours towards the close of daytime when the light slowly fades
example: By eventide the inbox was empty and the soul was empty too.

hindi: सर्वाधिकारपूर्वक — पद के पूर्ण अधिकार से कहा गया अंतिम निर्णय
definition: spoken with the full, unquestionable authority of office, like papal pronouncements settling church doctrine
example: The head chef declared ex cathedra that cilantro would never again enter his kitchen.

hindi: अनुग्रहपूर्वक — दया भाव से, क़ानूनी बाध्यता के बिना
definition: done as a favour, paid freely without any legal obligation or admitted liability
example: The airline offered an ex gratia voucher worth roughly one sandwich.

hindi: पुस्तक-स्वामित्व — इस व्यक्ति के ग्रंथ-संग्रह से
definition: from the library of; words printed on a decorative bookplate showing which person owns the book
example: The borrowed novel still says ex libris Rahul, and Rahul has stopped asking.

hindi: पदेन — पद के नाते, पद के कारण
definition: by virtue of office, holding a place because of another position already held
example: The mayor sits ex officio on every committee and awake on none.

hindi: एकपक्षीय — दूसरे पक्ष की अनुपस्थिति में
definition: done by a court on behalf of a single side only, without the other party present
example: The landlord won an ex parte order while the tenant was stuck in traffic.

hindi: भूतलक्षी — बीत चुकी बात पर बाद में लागू किया गया
definition: applied to things already done, after the fact
example: An ex post facto rule cannot punish what was perfectly legal last year.

hindi: महिमा बढ़ाना — किसी को ऊँचा उठाकर उसकी प्रशंसा करना
definition: to praise someone highly and raise them to greater honour, rank or public standing
example: The algorithm exalts whoever posted most recently, which explains a great deal.

hindi: और ऊँचा — निरंतर ऊँचे लक्ष्यों की ओर बढ़ने का आह्वान
definition: ever higher; a motto urging constant upward striving toward loftier goals
example: His running app congratulated him on a new record and then, excelsior, raised next week's target.

hindi: उद्भावना करना — सोच-विचार कर नई युक्ति निकालना
definition: to think something out thoroughly, devising a plan through careful thinking
example: The interns excogitated an elaborate scheme to automate their timesheets, then filled them in by hand.

hindi: बहिष्कृत करना — किसी को धर्मसंघ से औपचारिक रूप से निकालना
definition: to formally expel someone from Christian church membership, cutting them off from its sacraments and fellowship
example: Leave one spoiler about the finale and the group chat will excommunicate you.

hindi: धज्जियाँ उड़ाना — किसी की अत्यंत तीखी आलोचना करना
definition: criticise someone with extreme severity, as though stripping away their skin
example: The reviewer excoriated the sequel so thoroughly that the studio cancelled the trilogy.

hindi: निर्दोष ठहराना — किसी को आरोप या दोष से मुक्त करना
definition: clear someone from blame or guilt by presenting evidence that shows their innocence
example: The timestamped commit log exculpated the intern, who had been asleep when production went down.

hindi: घृणित — अत्यंत बुरा और निंदनीय
definition: extremely poor or wicked, deserving strong public condemnation and loathing
example: The karaoke was execrable, yet somehow everyone requested an encore.

hindi: भाष्य — किसी ग्रंथ की विस्तृत व्याख्या
definition: a careful critical explanation and interpretation of a written text, especially passages of scripture
example: His exegesis of the landlord's two-line email ran to four pages.

hindi: भाष्यकार — ग्रंथों का विस्तृत अर्थ बताने वाला
definition: a scholar skilled in critical explanation and interpretation of texts, especially scripture
example: Every product launch attracts an exegete who reads the release notes like sacred prophecy.

hindi: अनुकरणीय — दूसरों के लिए उदाहरण बनने योग्य
definition: so good or morally admirable that it serves as a model others should follow
example: His exemplary attendance record is mostly because the office has free snacks.

hindi: उदाहरणार्थ — मिसाल के तौर पर
definition: for example, introducing specific instances that illustrate a broader point being made
example: Some habits must go, exempli gratia, answering email in bed.

hindi: प्रोत्साहित करना — दृढ़ता से कुछ करने को उकसाना
definition: to urge someone strongly and earnestly to do something, often with encouragement
example: The app exhorts me to drink water every hour, with the tone of a disappointed aunt.

hindi: क़ब्र खोदकर निकालना — दफ़न शव को बाहर निकालना
definition: to formally unearth a buried body, digging it out of its grave for examination or reburial
example: The auditors exhumed receipts from 2019 that everyone hoped were buried forever.

hindi: अल्प — बहुत थोड़ा, बमुश्किल काम चलाने लायक
definition: very scanty or meagre, barely enough in size or amount to be truly useful
example: The exiguous launch budget covered balloons, but not the helium.

hindi: महाप्रस्थान — बहुत से लोगों का एक साथ किसी जगह से निकल जाना
definition: a mass departure of many people leaving a place together, often all at once
example: The five o'clock exodus from the office is faster than any fire drill.

hindi: दोषमुक्त करना — आरोप से पूरी तरह बरी करना
definition: officially clear someone from blame or guilt after an accusation, restoring their good name
example: The security camera exonerated the dog, and suspicion turned slowly toward the toddler.

hindi: अनाप-शनाप — हद से ज़्यादा महँगा
definition: much beyond reasonable limits, used especially of prices or demands; grossly excessive
example: The airport charged an exorbitant sum for a bottle of perfectly ordinary water.

hindi: भूत-निवारण — प्रार्थना या मंत्र से दुष्ट आत्मा भगाना
definition: the driving out of evil spirits from a person or place by prayer, ritual or magic spell
example: Clearing three hundred unread notifications felt less like admin than exorcism.

hindi: विस्तार से बोलना — किसी विषय पर लंबा वर्णन करना
definition: to speak or write at great length and detail about a particular subject
example: Asked for a quick update, he expatiated on sprint velocity until the lights switched off.

hindi: प्रवासी — अपनी इच्छा से विदेश में बसा व्यक्ति
definition: someone living outside their native country, usually by choice and often for work
example: The expatriate book club meets monthly to complain about the local bread.

hindi: शीघ्रकारी — तेज़ और कुशलता से काम करने वाला
definition: quick and efficient, getting something done promptly without wasted effort
example: The most expeditious route to a refund is apparently speaking to a human, if one exists.

hindi: प्रायश्चित करना — दंड या पश्चाताप से अपराध का परिमार्जन
definition: make amends for guilt or wrongdoing by accepting punishment or doing penance
example: He expiated his missed birthday with a cake, flowers and a very long apology.

hindi: समझाकर टोकना — किसी को उसके इरादे से रोकने के लिए गंभीरता से तर्क करना
definition: to argue earnestly with someone, protesting against what they intend doing
example: I expostulated with my brother about the neck tattoo, but the appointment was already booked.

hindi: भंडाफोड़ — किसी घोटाले का सार्वजनिक खुलासा
definition: a public report revealing hidden scandal, wrongdoing or discreditable facts about someone
example: The newspaper's exposé on the startup's 'artificial intelligence' revealed forty interns typing very quickly.

hindi: काट-छाँट करना — रचना से अनुचित अंश निकालना
definition: to remove passages considered offensive, vulgar or improper from a book or written text before publishing
example: The family newsletter was expurgated before Grandma could read it.

hindi: आशुभाषण से — बिना तैयारी, उसी क्षण सोचकर बोलते हुए
definition: spoken or done right in the moment, without any preparation, rehearsal or written notes
example: He delivered the best-man speech extempore, which explained the story about the goat.

hindi: गुणगान करना — किसी की खुलकर, उत्साह से प्रशंसा करना
definition: to praise something enthusiastically and publicly, often at great length and with obvious admiration
example: He extols the virtues of cold showers to anyone standing still for more than a minute.

hindi: छोर — अंतिम सीमा; घोर संकट
definition: the furthest point or limit of something; also, the utmost danger or need
example: In his extremity he called the IT desk and, worse, listened to the hold music.

hindi: विलंबनीति वाला — सीधे टकराव से बचकर धीरे-धीरे थकाने वाला
definition: winning by slow, cautious delay and avoiding direct battle, after the Roman general Fabius
example: Her Fabian approach to the argument was to agree politely and simply never do it.

hindi: गप्पी — मनगढ़ंत किस्से गढ़ने वाला
definition: a person who habitually invents stories and presents these invented tales as genuine truth
example: The team fabulist claimed he once fixed production from a ski lift.

hindi: सर्वकाम-सेवक — हर काम करने वाला सहायक
definition: a servant or employee who does every kind of household or office chore
example: The founder's factotum books flights, feeds the office plant and occasionally fixes the servers.

hindi: चोर-गुरु — बच्चों को चोरी सिखाने और चोरी का माल रखने वाला
definition: Dickens's receiver of stolen goods, hence an adult who trains children or youths to steal
example: The group chat admin who taught everyone to share streaming passwords is a benign little Fagin.

hindi: सहर्ष — खुशी से, चाहकर
definition: archaic: gladly, willingly, with pleasure; describing someone eager and happy to do something
example: I would fain help you move house, but alas, my back has plans.

hindi: कमज़ोरदिल — हिम्मत हार जाने वाला
definition: lacking courage and resolve, quick to lose nerve when danger or difficulty appears
example: The chilli challenge menu warns that it is not for the faint-hearted.

hindi: निठल्ला — जो काम से बचकर समय गँवाता है
definition: a lazy idler who avoids work and does nothing useful with their time
example: A fainéant by conviction, he treated his inbox as a museum exhibit.

hindi: पूर्ण हो चुका तथ्य — जो किया जा चुका, अब बहस बेकार
definition: something already done and decided before those affected could object or refuse
example: He announced the office move as a fait accompli, boxes already stacked by the lift.

hindi: परती — बिना उपयोग के छोड़ा हुआ, विश्राम में
definition: left unused and inactive for a period, like farmland resting between harvests
example: Her creative instincts lay fallow all winter and then produced a novel in spring.

hindi: मस्तमौला पेटू — मोटा, डींगमार और खाने-पीने का शौकीन
definition: jovial, boastful, portly and fond of drink and feasting, like Shakespeare's Falstaff
example: The Falstaffian regional manager calls every long lunch a strategy session.

hindi: तुरही-नाद — किसी के आगमन पर बजता ऊँचा स्वागत-संगीत
definition: a short, loud flourish of trumpets announcing someone's arrival or ceremony
example: The update shipped without fanfare, which is how the bug shipped too.

hindi: आडंबर — शोर-शराबे वाली शेखी
definition: noisy, showy boasting and bragging display meant to seem brave and grand
example: The product launch was all fanfaronade: fireworks, drumrolls and no product.

hindi: प्रहसन — अतिरंजित हास्य नाटक; हास्यास्पद घटना
definition: a comic stage play built on absurd situations and slapstick; hence any ridiculous sham of an event
example: The 'quick sync' became a farce when four people joined from the same room with echoing laptops.

hindi: खिचड़ी — बेतुकी चीज़ों का उलझा घालमेल
definition: a confused jumbled mixture of assorted things thrown together without sense or order
example: The quarterly strategy deck was a farrago of buzzwords, stock photos and one lonely chart.

hindi: खंड-अंश — किस्तों में छपी पुस्तक का एक भाग
definition: a single instalment of a large printed work published in separate parts over time
example: The fantasy saga now arrives in fascicles, and readers suspect the author will outlive none of them.

hindi: मूर्खतापूर्ण — खोखला और आत्मसंतुष्ट बेवकूफ़ी भरा
definition: silly and empty of sense, pointless and foolish while being smugly complacent and thoughtless
example: He offered the fatuous advice to just be more productive, then left early.

hindi: आत्मघाती सौदा — तात्कालिक लाभ के लिए मूल्यवान चीज़ गिरवी रखना
definition: describing a bargain that trades lasting values or integrity for immediate power or gain
example: Taking the sponsor's money was a Faustian deal: the podcast grew, and its opinions shrank.

hindi: भूल-चूक — सामाजिक मर्यादा में शर्मनाक चूक
definition: an embarrassing social blunder that breaks polite rules or custom
example: Wearing the same outfit as the bride was a faux pas nobody forgot.

hindi: जी-हुज़ूरी भरा — अत्यधिक खुशामद और दिखावटी स्नेह वाला
definition: showing excessive, servile flattery and affection toward someone to gain favour
example: The fawning reviews of the founder's memoir were all written by his investors.

hindi: मुखौटा — भवन का सामने का भाग; असलियत छिपाता दिखावटी रूप
definition: the principal front of a building, or an outward show that hides a less flattering reality
example: The café's Instagram façade is all brass and marble; the back door opens onto the bins.

hindi: स्वामिभक्ति — स्वामी के प्रति शपथबद्ध निष्ठा
definition: sworn loyalty owed to a lord or ruler, now any dutiful faithful allegiance
example: The new hires swore fealty to the espresso machine within their first week.

hindi: ज्वरनाशक — बुखार उतारने वाली दवा
definition: a medicine that reduces fever, such as willow bark or quinine in older remedies
example: Her cure for the Monday feeling is a febrifuge of cold brew and denial.

hindi: ज्वरग्रस्त — बुख़ार से पीड़ित या बुख़ार-सा तप्त
definition: having or showing the symptoms of fever, feeling heated, flushed and restless with illness
example: In a febrile haze he ordered four pizzas and woke with no memory of doing so.

hindi: अकर्मण्य — निकम्मा, कमज़ोर और ग़ैरज़िम्मेदार
definition: lacking initiative, energy and strength of character; ineffective, careless and irresponsible
example: The feckless manager delegated the problem to a meeting that never met.

hindi: उर्वर — फलदायी, भरपूर उपजाऊ
definition: richly fertile and productive, bearing fruit, offspring or ideas in great abundance
example: The group chat is fecund with plans that never survive past Thursday.

hindi: ढोंग करना — झूठमूठ दिखाना
definition: to pretend convincingly to have some feeling, illness or condition that isn't actually real
example: He feigned surprise at the birthday cake he had ordered himself.

hindi: झाँसा — ध्यान भटकाने वाला नकली वार
definition: a deceptive movement or pretended attack meant to distract from the real purpose
example: Offering to help with dishes was a feint; he vanished before the sink was full.

hindi: बधाई देना — किसी की सफलता पर औपचारिक शुभकामना देना
definition: to congratulate someone formally and warmly on a success, achievement or happy event
example: The society felicitated its oldest member, who asked mainly whether there would be cake.

hindi: शुभकामनाएँ — किसी खुशी के अवसर पर दी गई बधाइयाँ
definition: formal congratulations and warm good wishes offered on a happy occasion
example: Felicitations poured into the group chat, each one followed by a request for the recipe.

hindi: मार्जारवत्‌ — बिल्ली जैसा लचीला, सधा हुआ और चुपके चलने वाला
definition: like cats; graceful, supple, stealthy, silent and quietly aloof
example: She crossed the open-plan office with feline grace and ignored everyone who waved.

hindi: साहचर्य — समान रुचि वालों की मित्रवत संगति
definition: friendly companionship among people who share interests, work or beliefs
example: The book club offered deep fellowship, though very little evidence anyone had read the book.

hindi: आपराधिक — गंभीर अपराध जैसा या उससे संबंधित
definition: relating to serious crime; wicked, unlawful or criminal in nature, purpose or intention
example: He eyed my chips with felonious intent.

hindi: मोहिनी — आकर्षण से पुरुषों को विनाश तक ले जाने वाली स्त्री
definition: a seductive, mysterious woman whose charm leads admirers into danger or ruin
example: In every heist film the femme fatale knows the vault code before the crew does.

hindi: गवाक्ष-विन्यास — भवन में खिड़कियों की बनावट और व्यवस्था
definition: the arrangement, proportion and design of windows and doors across the walls of a building
example: The architect praised the fenestration; the tenants merely noted that none of the windows open.

hindi: उफान — समाज या मन में उथल-पुथल और हलचल
definition: a state of churning agitation and turmoil, especially before great change
example: The campus was in ferment after the tuition announcement, and the vending machines took the blame.

hindi: उत्सवी — त्योहार या पर्व से जुड़ा, उल्लासपूर्ण
definition: relating to a feast or festival, and full of joyful, colourful celebration and merriment
example: The flat took on a festal air the moment someone found fairy lights in the cupboard.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे जल्दी करो — तेज़ी से चलो पर सावधानी से, हड़बड़ी में नहीं
definition: make haste slowly; move quickly but carefully, without careless rushing that causes mistakes
example: Festina lente: the migration can ship this week, just not at 5 p.m. on Friday.

hindi: सजाना — मालाओं, झालरों या पताकाओं से उत्सव के लिए सजाना
definition: to decorate something with chains of flowers, ribbons or lights for a festive celebration
example: We festooned the meeting room with balloons, which did not improve the quarterly figures.

hindi: अभिनंदन-ग्रंथ — किसी विद्वान के सम्मान में लेखों का संग्रह
definition: a collection of essays written by colleagues to honour a respected scholar, usually at retirement
example: For her retirement the lab produced a Festschrift, plus a cake shaped like a centrifuge.

hindi: दुर्गंधयुक्त — सड़ी हुई बदबू से भरा
definition: smelling strongly and horribly of decay, rotting food or stale filth left lying around
example: The fetid lunchbox under the desk had clearly been forgotten since the last sprint.

hindi: सामंत — बड़े राजा के अधीन जागीर पाने वाला
definition: a vassal holding land from a feudal lord and owing him loyal service
example: Each regional manager behaves like a feudatory, loyal to headquarters only when bonuses arrive.

hindi: धारावाहिक स्तंभ — अख़बार में किस्तों में छपने वाली रचना
definition: a serialised novel, story or light column published in instalments in newspapers
example: His weekly newsletter is a feuilleton of kitchen disasters, each ending on a cliffhanger.

hindi: अभिशप्त — मृत्यु या विपत्ति की ओर नियति से खिंचा
definition: archaic: fated for approaching death, often showing a strange, elated excitement just before doom
example: He was fey that evening, cheerfully signing up for the office triathlon.

hindi: आदेश — अधिकारपूर्ण, बिना बहस का हुक्म
definition: an authoritative order issued by someone in power, without discussion or consent
example: By executive fiat, the manager declared that Friday meetings would now begin at eight.

hindi: न्याय हो, चाहे आकाश गिर पड़े — हर परिणाम के बावजूद न्याय
definition: let justice be done though the heavens fall; justice upheld regardless of consequences
example: The referee sent off the captain in the final minute, fiat justitia ruat caelum, and the stadium duly fell.

hindi: प्रकाश हो — ज्ञान और आरंभ का उद्घोष
definition: let there be light; a solemn call for knowledge, understanding, clarity or creation itself to begin
example: The electrician flipped the breaker with a grand fiat lux, and the kitchen lights finally came on.

hindi: चंचल — जिसकी पसंद या वफ़ादारी जल्दी बदल जाए
definition: changing loyalties, affections or preferences often, suddenly and without warning or good reason
example: Fickle fans who wore the jersey on Sunday were blaming the coach by Monday.

hindi: निष्ठा — किसी व्यक्ति या वचन के प्रति वफ़ादारी
definition: faithful loyalty to a person, promise or duty, kept steadily over time
example: His fidelity to one barber has survived three moves and a receding hairline.

hindi: विश्वस्त सखा — हर हाल में साथ निभाने वाला मित्र
definition: a faithful, devoted friend and companion, named after the loyal comrade of Aeneas
example: Every best man speech casts the groom's school friend as his fidus Achates.

hindi: छि — धिक्कार, शर्म की बात
definition: archaic: exclamation expressing disgust, shame or disapproval at someone's poor conduct or behaviour
example: Fie on whoever microwaved fish in the shared kitchen.

hindi: जागीर — सेवा के बदले सामंत को दी गई भूमि
definition: land granted by a feudal lord to a vassal in return for loyal military service; also a personal domain of control
example: The shared drive's finance folder is Priya's fief, and trespassers get a very polite, very chilling email.

hindi: भीतरघाती — भीतर रहकर शत्रु के लिए काम करने वाला
definition: a secret sympathiser working inside a country or group to undermine it for the enemy
example: The fifth columnist in the diet club kept leaving doughnuts in the break room.

hindi: कल्पना-उपज — मन की गढ़ी हुई अवास्तविक चीज़
definition: something imagined that does not really exist, invented purely by the mind
example: The promised team offsite turned out to be a figment of the manager's imagination.

hindi: लंबी बहस से रोक — भाषण खींचकर निर्णय टालने की चाल
definition: a very long speech made deliberately to delay or block a vote
example: His toast became a filibuster, and dessert arrived before the vote on the cake.

hindi: जालीदार नक़्क़ाशी — सोने-चाँदी के महीन तारों का काम
definition: delicate decorative lacework of fine twisted gold or silver wire
example: The regex had the beauty of filigree and the maintainability of a cobweb.

hindi: फ़िल्म न्वार — अंधेरी, निराशावादी अपराध-फ़िल्म शैली
definition: a style of crime film with dark shadows, cynical heroes and moral gloom
example: With the power cut and rain on the window, paying bills felt like film noir.

hindi: गंदा धन — बेईमानी या लालच से कमाया पैसा
definition: money, especially profit gained dishonestly or valued with shameless greed
example: He swore he'd never sell out, then the brand deal arrived with its filthy lucre and a free hoodie.

hindi: शताब्दी-अंत — सदी के अंत का थका, ढलता माहौल
definition: the closing years of a century, especially their mood of decadence and weary decline
example: The dying mall has a fin de siècle glamour, all fountains and no shoppers.

hindi: सज-धज — ख़ास मौक़ों पर पहने सुंदर, भड़कीले वस्त्र और गहने
definition: showy, elegant clothing and jewellery worn for special occasions to impress others
example: Guests arrived at the wedding in their finery, then spent the evening photographing the buffet.

hindi: नफ़ासत — नाज़ुक हालात को सलीक़े और बारीकी से सँभालना
definition: delicate skill and graceful subtlety in handling difficult people or situations
example: She declined the third meeting invite with such finesse that the organiser thanked her.

hindi: नरक-भय का उपदेश — दंड और विनाश की डराने वाली चेतावनी
definition: fierce preaching that threatens sinners with divine punishment, hellfire and coming doom
example: The finance team's budget memo was pure fire and brimstone, down to the threat of shared staplers.

hindi: नभमंडल — ऊपर फैला विशाल आकाश
definition: the heavens, the great vaulted arch of open sky stretching overhead, where stars and clouds appear
example: A drone hovered against the firmament, livestreaming a gender reveal nobody asked for.

hindi: राजकोषीय — सरकारी धन, कर और व्यय से संबंधित
definition: relating to public money and how a government raises and spends it
example: Fiscal discipline lasts exactly until the first opinion poll of an election year.

hindi: रुक-रुक कर — अनियमित रूप से चलने और थमने वाला
definition: active only in irregular bursts, starting and stopping without steady rhythm
example: After a fitful night of notifications, she finally switched the phone to aeroplane mode.

hindi: क्षणिक — पलक झपकते बीत जाने वाला
definition: passing very swiftly, lasting barely a brief moment before fading and disappearing entirely
example: He had a fleeting urge to reply-all, then remembered he enjoys being employed.

hindi: भोग-स्थल — विलासिता और ऐश के ठिकाने
definition: places offering luxurious living and sensual pleasure, from the fleshpots of Egypt
example: He left the fleshpots of Las Vegas with a tan, a headache and a timeshare.

hindi: पुष्प-चिह्न — छपाई में सजावटी फूल-आकृति
definition: a printed ornament shaped like a flower or leaf, used to divide sections or decorate pages
example: The boutique hotel's menu scatters fleurons between courses, which apparently justifies the price of toast.

hindi: पुष्पकाल — फूल खिलने का समय या दौर
definition: the state or period of flowering, and figuratively a period of flourishing success or great achievement
example: The band's florescence lasted exactly one album and a very good summer.

hindi: अलंकृत — अत्यधिक सजावटी और रंगीन भाषा
definition: elaborately ornate, flowery language decorated with showy phrases and flourishes
example: The estate agent's florid listing described a damp cupboard as "a cosy reading nook".

hindi: सूक्ति-संग्रह — अनेक लेखकों के श्रेष्ठ अंशों का चयन
definition: a collection of choice passages and quotations gathered from many writers, especially ancient authors
example: Her captions form a florilegium of quotations confidently misattributed to Rumi.

hindi: सक्रियकाल — किसी व्यक्ति के कार्य-उत्कर्ष का समय
definition: the period when a historical person was active, used when exact birth dates remain unknown
example: The poet's floruit is placed around 1200, the rest of his biography being mostly guesswork and swagger.

hindi: लघु बेड़ा — छोटे जहाज़ों या नावों का दल
definition: a small fleet of ships or little boats travelling together in close company
example: A flotilla of rubber ducks followed the toddler across the hotel pool.

hindi: प्लवमान मलबा — डूबे जहाज़ का पानी पर तैरता मलबा
definition: wreckage and cargo floating upon water after a ship sinks or breaks apart
example: Old chargers and unclaimed mugs drift through the office kitchen like flotsam.

hindi: पिछलग्गू — किसी बड़े का हुक्म बजाने वाला छोटा सेवक
definition: a servile follower who carries out orders for powerful people without question
example: The celebrity arrived with three flunkeys, one of whom carried only the phone charger.

hindi: सैलानी — शहर की गलियों में यूँ ही घूमकर जीवन निहारने वाला
definition: an idle city stroller who wanders the streets simply to watch urban life
example: Armed with a flat white and no agenda, he played flâneur until his phone battery died.

hindi: रिपु — शत्रु, वैरी
definition: an enemy or opponent, especially someone faced in battle, combat or bitter rivalry
example: The raccoon, long his foe, had once again defeated the new bin lid.

hindi: पन्ना — बड़े आकार की पुस्तक या पांडुलिपि का एक पत्र
definition: a single leaf of a manuscript, or a large book made of folded sheets
example: The dog chewed only one folio of the manual: the troubleshooting page.

hindi: मूढ़ता — मूर्खतापूर्ण और अविवेकी कार्य
definition: lack of good sense; foolish behaviour, or an idea or undertaking showing poor judgment
example: Building a pool in a drought was folly, and the neighbours said so.

hindi: दुस्साहसी — मूर्खतापूर्ण रूप से जोखिम उठाने वाला
definition: recklessly bold, taking foolish risks without thinking about the danger or consequences
example: Editing production data by hand at midnight was foolhardy, and the logs agree.

hindi: राहज़न — पैदल घात लगाकर राहगीरों को लूटने वाला
definition: archaic: a robber on foot who ambushes lone travellers on dark, lonely roads and footpaths
example: The footpads of old at least had the courtesy to lurk in person, unlike today's phishing texts.

hindi: बाँका — कपड़ों और रूप पर इतराने वाला पुरुष
definition: a vain gentleman excessively concerned with fashionable clothes, grooming and his own appearance
example: The fop in accounts checks his reflection in every monitor on the walk to the kitchen.

hindi: छैलापन-भरा — पहनावे को लेकर अति सजग और इतराने वाला
definition: vain and excessively fussy about fashionable dress, clothes and personal appearance
example: His foppish pocket squares were colour-matched to each quarter's slide deck.

hindi: चूँकि — इस कारणवश कि
definition: archaic: used in 'forasmuch as' meaning because, seeing that, or since something holds true
example: Forasmuch as the coffee machine is broken, all morning meetings are hereby cancelled.

hindi: छापा — शत्रु क्षेत्र में संक्षिप्त आक्रमण
definition: brief, sudden raid into enemy territory, often seeking plunder or supplies
example: His foray into the fridge at midnight left only a lonely pickle behind.

hindi: संयम बरतना — करने से स्वयं को रोक लेना
definition: hold yourself back from doing or saying something, through patience or self-control
example: She forbore from mentioning that the brilliant new idea was her idea last quarter.

hindi: क्षमाशीलता — धैर्य से सहने और रुकने का गुण
definition: patient self-control, holding back anger or punishment despite provocation
example: The teacher showed saintly forbearance when the fourth student claimed the dog ate the laptop.

hindi: एकत्र होना — मिलने के लिए जमा होना
definition: to gather together or assemble in friendly company, typically for some social purpose or reunion
example: The old college friends foregather every December to relive stories that improve with each telling.

hindi: न्यायिक-वैज्ञानिक — अपराध की जाँच में प्रयुक्त वैज्ञानिक विधियों से संबंधित
definition: relating to scientific methods used in courts to investigate crimes and evidence
example: She gave the shared fridge a forensic examination to find who stole her hummus.

hindi: त्याग देना — किसी सुख के बिना काम चलाना
definition: willingly choose to abstain from a pleasant, useful or desired thing, sacrificing that enjoyment by deliberate decision
example: We forgo dessert on weekdays, which makes weekends dangerously ambitious.

hindi: सचमुच — 'वाह, क्या बात है' वाला व्यंग्यपूर्ण भाव
definition: archaic: indeed, truly, in truth; now mostly used mockingly to scoff at someone's pretension
example: He will, forsooth, finish the whole redesign over the weekend.

hindi: शपथ तोड़ना — शपथ लेकर झूठ बोलना या किसी चीज़ का त्याग करना
definition: swear falsely under oath, or solemnly promise to abandon something entirely
example: She forswore sugar on Monday and was eating cake by Wednesday.

hindi: स्पष्टवादी — बिना लाग-लपेट के सीधी बात कहने वाला
definition: speaking frankly and directly, saying plainly what you think without evasion
example: Her forthright review said the slide deck had forty slides and one idea.

hindi: तत्काल — बिना देर किए, इसी क्षण
definition: immediately, without any delay, straight away from this moment, promptly and without waiting
example: Anyone who replies-all to the entire company will be muted forthwith.

hindi: अति उच्च स्वर में — बहुत ज़ोर से
definition: played or sung very loudly, at full musical volume, force and dramatic power
example: The upstairs neighbours practise their drums fortissimo, exclusively after ten.

hindi: धैर्य-साहस — कष्ट और कठिनाई में डटे रहने का बल
definition: courage and steadiness in the face of pain or long difficulty
example: Six months of chemotherapy borne with a fortitude the whole ward noticed.

hindi: मंच — खुली सार्वजनिक चर्चा का स्थान
definition: a public place or occasion for open discussion of shared business
example: The town holds its angriest debates in an online forum, having sold off the square.

hindi: झगड़ा — शोरभरी हाथापाई या तकरार
definition: a noisy disorderly brawl or quarrel involving several angry people shouting and shoving
example: A fracas over the last parking space ended with both drivers taking the bus.

hindi: भस्मासुर-रचना — अपने ही रचयिता को नष्ट करने वाली रचना
definition: a creation that escapes control and turns destructively against the person who built it
example: The automated email system became a Frankenstein, spamming its own developers hourly.

hindi: घुलना-मिलना — विशेषकर विरोधी पक्ष से मित्रवत संबंध रखना
definition: to socialize in a friendly manner with people, especially enemies, rivals or those officially forbidden
example: Management frowned on interns who fraternize with the competitor's staff at the pub quiz.

hindi: भ्रातृघाती — अपने ही भाइयों या साथियों से लड़ने वाला
definition: involving bitter conflict between brothers, kinsmen or members of the same group
example: The startup's founders began a fratricidal war over who invented the logo font.

hindi: मुक्त छंद — बिना नियत लय या तुक की कविता
definition: poetry written without regular meter or rhyme, following natural speech rhythms instead
example: Her grocery list, broken across lines, was either free verse or a cry for help.

hindi: लुटेरा — लूट के लिए भटकने वाला दस्यु
definition: a pirate or lawless adventurer who roams seeking plunder and easy profit
example: A freebooter at heart, he joins every startup just long enough to grab the equity.

hindi: उफान — बर्फ़ पिघलने या वर्षा से नदी में अचानक आई बाढ़
definition: a sudden rise or flood in a stream after heavy rain or melting snow
example: Monday's inbox arrived like a spring freshet after the long weekend.

hindi: भुरभुरा — आसानी से चूर-चूर होने वाला
definition: easily crumbled or broken into small pieces between the fingers, like dried soil
example: The friable biscuit disintegrated the moment it met his tea, as they always do.

hindi: चित्र-पट्टी — दीवार पर चलती नक्काशीदार या चित्रित पट्टी
definition: a broad horizontal band of sculpted or painted decoration running along a wall or building
example: The fridge magnets have formed a frieze depicting, in order, every takeaway we have ever ordered.

hindi: तड़क-भड़क — दिखावटी, बेकार सजावट
definition: showy, trivial ornament on clothing or decoration; needless finery with little real value
example: Strip the frippery from the landing page, the parallax and the confetti, and the product fits in one sentence.

hindi: विद्रोही आलोचक — सत्ता के विरुद्ध आवाज़ उठाने वाला
definition: a rebel or critic who openly opposes established authority, especially within their political party
example: Every committee has one frondeur who reads the minutes and objects to the commas.

hindi: मुखचित्र — पुस्तक के शीर्षक-पृष्ठ के सामने का चित्र
definition: a decorative illustration facing the title page at the front of a printed book
example: The cookbook's frontispiece shows a cake nobody has ever reproduced.

hindi: फलित होना — फल देना, परिणाम लाना
definition: to bear fruit, or to make an idea or effort productive and fruitful over time
example: The mentorship finally fructified when the intern started fixing the senior engineers' bugs.

hindi: मितव्ययी — सादगी से, कम खर्च में जीने वाला
definition: careful and sparing with money, living simply and avoiding needless waste
example: Her frugal lunch of lentils outlasted his fifteen-dollar salad by several hours.

hindi: क्षणिक — पकड़ में आने से पहले निकल जाने वाला
definition: literary: fleeting and hard to hold, slipping away before being grasped
example: A fugitive thought about the perfect tagline escaped the moment the laptop woke up.

hindi: कालिखमय — धुएँ और कालिख सा काला
definition: sooty and smoky, dark and dusky like thick black smoke from burning
example: The fuliginous toast was declared rustic by the man who burnt it.

hindi: गरजना — किसी बात के विरुद्ध क्रोध से प्रहार करना
definition: to protest loudly and angrily against something, as though thundering from above
example: Dad fulminated against the streaming price rise, then renewed for another year.

hindi: अतिरंजित — इतनी प्रशंसा कि झूठी लगे
definition: flattering or praising someone so excessively that the praise seems insincere, cloying and false
example: The fulsome farewell speech made everyone wonder why he was being let go.

hindi: नट — ऊँची रस्सी पर चलने वाला कलाकार
definition: a tightrope walker, performing balanced steps along a high, narrow rope
example: Juggling two deadlines and a toddler, she moved through the week like a funambulist.

hindi: अंत्येष्टि-संबंधी — दफ़न या अंतिम संस्कार से जुड़ा
definition: relating to funerals, burial customs, tombs or the solemn commemoration of the dead
example: The museum's funerary masks drew more selfies than the gift shop.

hindi: मातमी — अंत्येष्टि जैसा गंभीर, धीमा और उदास
definition: solemn, slow and gloomy in a manner suited to a funeral or burial of the dead
example: The Monday meeting moved at a funereal pace until someone mentioned free lunch.

hindi: झालर — कपड़े पर लगी दिखावटी चुन्नट
definition: a showy frill or flounce on a dress; any fussy, needless ornament added for display
example: The slide deck had every furbelow the template offered, and not one number.

hindi: इसके अलावा — और भी
definition: formal word adding further information that strengthens what has already been stated or argued
example: The flat is small and draughty; furthermore, the landlord calls the damp patch a feature wall.

hindi: थोथी भाषा — भारी-भरकम पर खोखला लेखन
definition: pompous, inflated writing or speech that sounds grand but carries little substance
example: The strategy deck was forty slides of fustian wrapped around one sensible idea.

hindi: बासी और दकियानूसी — पुरानी गंध और पुराने विचारों वाला
definition: smelling stale and stuffy from long neglect, or stubbornly old-fashioned in outlook and ideas
example: The fusty conference room smells of 2008 and still has a working overhead projector.

hindi: सम्मान में उत्सव मनाना — किसी का धूमधाम से स्वागत करना
definition: to honour and celebrate someone publicly with lavish parties, feasts and generous praise
example: The returning champions were fêted all week, then asked to help move the chairs.

hindi: वन-विहार उत्सव — खुले में ग्रामीण ढंग की दावत
definition: an elegant outdoor party held in gardens or countryside, styled with rustic pastoral charm
example: The startup's offsite was sold as a fête champêtre, which turned out to be sandwiches in a very damp field.

hindi: भारी भूल — सामाजिक रूप से शर्मनाक चूक
definition: an embarrassing social blunder, usually saying something tactless in public company
example: Replying-all with your honest opinion of the client was a gaffe for the company history books.

hindi: खंडन करना — इनकार या विरोध करना
definition: to deny, contradict or dispute something, usually used with a negative, as nobody could gainsay
example: Nobody could gainsay that the new coffee machine was a triumph of engineering.

hindi: यूनानी-चिकित्सीय — दोषों के संतुलन वाली प्राचीन चिकित्सा से जुड़ा
definition: relating to Galen's ancient medicine of balancing humours with herbal preparations and diet
example: Her aunt's advice about hot and cold foods is thoroughly Galenic and entirely unshakable.

hindi: वीर और शिष्ट — साहसी और सम्मानपूर्ण
definition: brave, honourable and courteous, showing noble spirit in danger or difficulty
example: The gallant attempt to fix the wifi by unplugging everything at once failed spectacularly.

hindi: शौर्य-शिष्टता — स्त्रियों के प्रति विनम्र रसिक व्यवहार
definition: courteous, charming and attentive romantic behaviour paid by a gentleman toward women he admires
example: His gallantry extended to holding the umbrella, never to splitting the bill.

hindi: पालपोत — अनेक पालों और मस्तूलों वाला पुराना विशाल जहाज़
definition: a large sailing ship with several masts and decks, once carrying treasure and cannon
example: His new SUV sails into the parking lot like a galleon, taking up three spaces.

hindi: गड्डमड्ड — बेमेल चीज़ों का बेढंगा ढेर
definition: a jumbled mixture of assorted things, like a stew made from whatever leftovers remain
example: His playlist is a gallimaufry of sea shanties, techno and one podcast episode he never finished.

hindi: सैर-सपाटा करना — मौज-मस्ती में इधर-उधर घूमना
definition: roam around from place to place in cheerful pursuit of pleasure, amusement and social entertainment
example: While the report waited, its author was gallivanting across three rooftop bars.

hindi: उत्तेजित करना — झटके से कार्य में जुटा देना
definition: to shock, rouse or excite people into sudden action or energetic, determined effort
example: Free pizza galvanized the volunteers faster than any speech.

hindi: नटखट छरहरी युवती — लड़कों-सी चुलबुली सुंदरता
definition: a slim, elfin young woman with mischievous, boyish charm and cropped hair; French
example: After the pixie cut she was cast as the gamine in every indie film.

hindi: कारागार — अपराधियों को बंद रखने का स्थान (पुरानी ब्रिटिश वर्तनी)
definition: archaic: British spelling of jail, a prison where offenders are held
example: The old town gaol is now a boutique hotel charging prison prices for boutique cells.

hindi: वेश — किसी पेशे या पहचान को दर्शाने वाला पहनावा
definition: distinctive clothing that marks a person's trade, role, faith or particular social group
example: In the regulation garb of black turtleneck and white sneakers, every founder looks like a keynote waiting to happen.

hindi: विशालकाय — असाधारण रूप से बड़ा
definition: enormous, huge in size, amount or appetite, vastly beyond normal measure
example: The quarterly report arrived as a gargantuan slide deck of three hundred pages.

hindi: विकराल मुखाकृति — भद्दी, डरावनी शक्ल
definition: a grotesquely carved stone spout on buildings, hence any strikingly ugly face
example: Three hours into the flight, the man in seat nine glared like a gargoyle.

hindi: अटारी — छत के नीचे की छोटी कोठरी
definition: a small, often cramped room just under the roof of a house
example: Every poet dreams of a Paris garret until they price the rent and the stairs.

hindi: बकबकिया — बेमतलब की बातें लगातार करने वाला
definition: talking constantly and at length about trivial things, especially rambling personal matters
example: The garrulous neighbour turned a two-minute parcel handover into a forty-minute family history.

hindi: पाक-मर्मज्ञ — अच्छे खाने का जानकार
definition: a person with expert knowledge of fine food, good cooking and the whole culture of eating well
example: The self-styled gastronome posted twelve photos of the soup before tasting it.

hindi: पाक-कला संबंधी — अच्छे भोजन और स्वाद की कला से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the craft and enjoyment of preparing, cooking and eating really good food
example: Their gastronomic tour of Rome ended, predictably, at a burger chain.

hindi: अटपटा — सामाजिक रूप से अनाड़ी और बेढब
definition: awkward and lacking social grace, unsure how to behave politely in company
example: It felt gauche to ask the price of the wine, so he simply ordered water.

hindi: अनाड़ीपन — बेढब, असभ्य-सा सामाजिक व्यवहार
definition: awkward, clumsy behaviour that shows a lack of social grace and polish
example: His gaucherie peaked when he replied all to the condolence email.

hindi: दिखावटी गहना — केवल प्रदर्शन के लिए पहना सस्ता आभूषण
definition: archaic: a showy ornament or trinket of little worth, worn purely for display
example: His smartwatch, blinking with every notification, was a gaud that happened to count steps.

hindi: कृशकाय — दुबला, सूखा और थका चेहरा
definition: very thin and bony, looking hollow and worn from hunger, illness or strain
example: After launch week the whole engineering team looked gaunt and slightly haunted.

hindi: नरक — यातना और दंड का स्थान
definition: a place of fiery torment and eternal punishment, or any scene of dark, hellish misery
example: Three toddlers, one birthday cake and no nap had turned the living room into Gehenna.

hindi: हिमशीतल — बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा
definition: icy, extremely cold, frozen like winter water or bitter frosty wind
example: The office air conditioning keeps a gelid climate all summer, and cardigans are now uniform.

hindi: सर्वोच्च सेनापति — अक्सर देश पर शासन करने वाला तानाशाह
definition: a supreme military commander, often also a dictator ruling the whole country
example: The group-chat admin behaves like a generalissimo, muting dissent and pinning his own messages.

hindi: स्थान-आत्मा — किसी जगह का विशिष्ट स्वभाव और वातावरण
definition: the distinctive spirit or atmosphere of a place, originally its protecting guardian deity
example: The old bookshop's genius loci survived the renovation, mainly as dust.

hindi: शिष्टाचारी — सभ्यता का सधा हुआ, कुछ दिखावटी अंदाज़
definition: polite and refined in manner, often affectedly imitating upper-class society
example: Her genteel email said 'per my last message' with the force of a thrown chair.

hindi: कुलीनता — ऊँचे घराने का शिष्ट, सुसंस्कृत ठाठ
definition: the refined manners and social superiority belonging to polite, well-born society
example: Tea in the good china lends an air of gentility even to a group chat about bins.

hindi: भद्रलोक — ज़मींदार कुलीन वर्ग, अभिजात से ठीक नीचे
definition: well-born landowning people ranking just below the nobility in traditional English society
example: The local gentry now drive electric Range Rovers and still never indicate.

hindi: घुटने टेकना — आदर में झुकना; चाटुकारी ढंग से झुक जाना
definition: to bend the knee in worship or respect, or to behave with servile deference
example: Everyone genuflected before the founder's slide deck, typos included.

hindi: भूकेंद्रित — पृथ्वी को केंद्र मानने वाला
definition: describing the ancient model of the heavens in which Earth stands at the centre, with every planet and star circling around it
example: His geocentric view of the startup assumed every customer revolved around his product.

hindi: भूमि-शकुन — मिट्टी या बिंदुओं के आकार से भविष्य पढ़ना
definition: foretelling future events by reading patterns in scattered earth, sand or randomly marked dots
example: Reading meaning into the coffee grounds on the office counter is geomancy for the caffeinated.

hindi: कृषि-काव्य — खेती और ग्रामीण श्रम पर कविता
definition: a poem about farming and rural labour, celebrating practical countryside work, after Virgil's Georgics
example: Her allotment blog has become a georgic in which every courgette gets a stanza.

hindi: वृद्धतंत्र — बुज़ुर्गों के हाथ में सत्ता
definition: government where power rests with elderly people, often long past fresh ideas
example: The club's gerontocracy voted down the website again because printed newsletters worked fine in 1987.

hindi: सीमा-हेराफेरी करना — चुनावी क्षेत्रों को दल के लाभ हेतु तोड़ना-मरोड़ना
definition: to redraw electoral district boundaries unfairly, giving a single party an advantage
example: They gerrymandered the seating chart so the finance team never sat near the snacks.

hindi: समग्र कलाकृति — अनेक कलाओं को एक साथ पिरोती रचना
definition: a total artwork combining music, drama, painting and architecture into one unified whole
example: Her wedding was a Gesamtkunstwerk: string quartet, custom font, and a signature cocktail with a backstory.

hindi: दिखावटी खिलौना — चमकदार पर मूल्यहीन वस्तु
definition: a showy trinket or ornament that looks pretty but holds little real value
example: The conference swag bag held the usual gewgaws: a stress ball, a sticker and a pen that died on day two.

hindi: फाँसी का खंभा — दंडित व्यक्ति को लटकाने का ढाँचा
definition: wooden post from which executed criminals were hung as public warning
example: The project board kept a metaphorical gibbet for anyone who missed standup twice.

hindi: अर्धाधिक — आधे से अधिक प्रकाशित (चाँद)
definition: describing the shining moon when its bright face is more than half, yet not wholly, illuminated
example: A gibbous moon hung over the stadium as the home team lost in extra time.

hindi: सुनहरी परत वाला — ऊपर से वैभवशाली, भीतर से खोखला
definition: covered thinly with gold; wealthy, luxurious and privileged, though often splendid only on the surface
example: They lived a gilded life on the feed and a rented one off it.

hindi: रोमरहित — चिकना, बिना बालों का
definition: smooth and completely hairless, especially describing skin, leaves or surfaces
example: The influencer's glabrous scalp reflects the ring light like a satellite dish.

hindi: वन-मैदान — जंगल के बीच खुली, धूप भरी जगह
definition: an open grassy space inside a forest where sunlight reaches the ground
example: We found a perfect glade for the picnic, and the mosquitoes found us.

hindi: खुलापन — शासन में पारदर्शिता और स्वतंत्र चर्चा की नीति
definition: a policy of greater openness and transparency in government, first adopted in the Soviet Union
example: The new manager promised glasnost, then made every calendar private.

hindi: भूमि — खेत की मिट्टी, पुरोहित के हिस्से की ज़मीन
definition: archaic: cultivated soil or field land, especially land granted to support a parish priest
example: The allotment committee guards each plot of glebe as fiercely as any medieval bishop.

hindi: सरकता स्वर — एक स्वर से दूसरे तक फिसलती ध्वनि
definition: a continuous sliding movement from one musical note to another, sweeping through every pitch between
example: The kettle announces itself with a rising glissando that the cat takes personally.

hindi: गोधूलि — साँझ का धुँधलका
definition: evening twilight, that soft fading light after sunset before full darkness settles
example: We walked home in the gloaming, which sounds romantic until you step in a puddle.

hindi: भाष्यकार — कठिन शब्दों और विधि-ग्रंथों की व्याख्या लिखने वाला
definition: a medieval scholar who wrote explanatory notes on difficult words in legal or sacred texts
example: Her code reviews read like the work of a medieval glossator, every third line annotated in tiny, merciless script.

hindi: भरमार — बाज़ार या जगह में किसी चीज़ की बाढ़
definition: an excessive supply of something, more than anyone could possibly want or employ
example: The post-holiday glut of fruitcake quietly migrates to the office kitchen.

hindi: भोजनलोलुपता — पेट भर जाने के बाद भी खाते रहने की लालसा
definition: the habit of eating greedily well beyond hunger, counted among the seven deadly sins
example: The buffet promised unlimited sushi, and gluttony took it as a personal challenge.

hindi: सूत्रवत् — छोटा, गूढ़ और रहस्यमय कथन
definition: expressed in brief, cryptic sayings whose wisdom seems deep but puzzling
example: The senior engineer's gnomic 'it depends' answered every question and none of them.

hindi: नास्तिक — ईश्वर को न मानने वाला; अधर्मी
definition: not believing in any deity; hence wicked, irreligious and without moral principle
example: Her aunt called the new brunch place godless because it opens during Sunday service.

hindi: स्वर्ण-बछड़ा — धन या सफलता जैसी झूठी चीज़ जिसे पूजा जाए
definition: a false idol, especially wealth or success, worshipped with misplaced devotion
example: Quarterly growth became the golden calf, and nobody noticed the product had stopped working.

hindi: महाबली — विशाल और अजेय लगने वाला शक्तिशाली विरोधी
definition: a giant, overwhelmingly powerful opponent that seems impossible for anyone smaller to beat
example: The corner bookshop took on the online Goliath armed only with cats and good recommendations.

hindi: सद्भावपूर्ण मध्यस्थता — तटस्थ पक्ष द्वारा बातचीत कराना
definition: help given by a neutral third party to bring opposing sides together for talks
example: Through the good offices of a shared friend, the exes agreed to split the concert tickets.

hindi: दुर्भेद्य उलझन वाला — धीरज से न सुलझने वाला
definition: so tangled that no patient method will undo it
example: She cut the Gordian knot: fire the vendor, rebuild it in-house.

hindi: भयावह स्त्री — जिसकी दृष्टि से ही लोग सहम जाएँ
definition: a fierce, frightening woman whose stern glare seems to turn people to stone
example: The school librarian was a gorgon; one look silenced an entire study hall.

hindi: ठूँस-ठूँसकर खाना — लालच से भरपेट खाना
definition: to gobble food greedily and heartily, eating much more than hunger requires
example: They gormandized through the tasting menu and then asked where the real dinner was.

hindi: महीन — मकड़ी के जाल जैसा अति-सूक्ष्म और हल्का
definition: extremely light, thin and delicate, like fine spider threads floating gently through summer
example: The gossamer scarf offered style, drama, and absolutely no protection from the wind.

hindi: भोजनप्रेमी — खूब और चाव से खाने वाला
definition: a person who loves eating good food heartily and in generous quantities
example: A true gourmand, he rates restaurants by how rarely they make him wait for seconds.

hindi: सौजन्य — उदार, कृपालु और शालीन व्यवहार
definition: kind, courteous and generous behaviour, especially toward those with less power
example: She showed real graciousness in defeat, congratulating the winner before checking the recount.

hindi: शुष्क तथ्यवादी — केवल आँकड़ों को मानने वाला, भावना-रहित
definition: a coldly practical person who values only hard facts and figures, ignoring imagination
example: The Gradgrind in finance asked for the return on investment of the office birthday cake.

hindi: घूसखोरी — पद का दुरुपयोग कर अवैध कमाई
definition: corrupt gain from public office, pocketing bribes or kickbacks in exchange for favours
example: The bridge cost three times its budget, and the difference was graft painted grey.

hindi: जादू-विद्या — प्राचीन तंत्र-मंत्र का ज्ञान
definition: archaic: occult learning and the secret knowledge of magic, spells and enchantment
example: The legacy billing system runs on a gramarye only one retired engineer still understands.

hindi: बहुत धन्यवाद — कृतज्ञता का पुराना उद्गार
definition: archaic: many thanks; an exclamation expressing heartfelt gratitude, sometimes also sudden surprise
example: Gramercy, kind stranger, for holding the lift door.

hindi: भयावह रक्तरंजित नाटक — डराने के लिए बना वीभत्स मंचन
definition: gruesome, sensational horror drama relying on graphic violence and shock, after a Paris theatre
example: The dentist narrated my root canal with the relish of Grand Guignol.

hindi: महायात्रा — यूरोप के नगरों की शिक्षाप्रद लंबी सैर
definition: a long educational journey through European cities once expected of wealthy young aristocrats
example: Her Grand Tour consisted of seven capitals, three hostels and one overdraft.

hindi: सम्मानित वरिष्ठ महिला — अपने क्षेत्र की प्रतिष्ठित कुलीना
definition: an elderly, dignified and highly respected woman who dominates her social circle or field
example: The grande dame of the book club decides which novel wins before anyone finishes it.

hindi: अभिजात — ऊँचे पद वाला प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति जो आदर की अपेक्षा रखे
definition: a person of high rank and influence who expects deference and special treatment
example: Party grandees emerged from the back room to explain what the members had really meant to vote for.

hindi: आडंबरपूर्ण वक्ता — ऊँचे-ऊँचे शब्दों से प्रभाव जमाने वाला
definition: using pompous, lofty language meant to impress others with grandeur and importance
example: The grandiloquent launch speech called a slightly thinner phone "a new chapter for humanity".

hindi: पूज्य मूर्ति — अंधभक्ति से पूजी जाने वाली वस्तु
definition: a carved idol, or anything worshipped with blind devotion in place of genuine faith
example: His signed guitar hangs above the sofa like a graven image nobody may touch.

hindi: गांभीर्य — व्यक्तित्व में गंभीरता और वज़न
definition: a weight of seriousness and dignity in bearing
example: The role needed gravitas, and she brought it the moment she sat down.

hindi: हरित भूमि — घनी हरी घास से ढका खुला मैदान
definition: an open stretch of ground covered with short, thick green grass
example: The croquet club's greensward has a stricter dress code than most weddings.

hindi: यूथचारी — झुंड में रहने वाला; मिलनसार और संगप्रिय
definition: living together in flocks or herds; figuratively, fond of company and sociable
example: The gregarious new neighbour knew every dog's name by Tuesday.

hindi: ठग — भरोसे की चालों से छोटी ठगी करने वाला
definition: a small-time swindler who cheats people through confidence tricks and petty fraud
example: The wellness grifter sells a forty-pound candle that promises to realign your spine.

hindi: जादू-पोथी — मंत्रों और तंत्र-विधियों की किताब
definition: a handbook of magic spells, charms and instructions for summoning spirits and demons
example: The senior dev's tattered notebook of shell commands is the team's grimoire.

hindi: खिचड़ी बालों वाला — उम्र और अनुभव से सफ़ेदी लिए
definition: having grey or greying hair, often marking long seasoned years of hard experience
example: A grizzled sysadmin glanced at the outage and said, calmly, that it was DNS.

hindi: विकृत-विचित्र — भद्दा, बेढब और डरावना
definition: comically or repulsively ugly and distorted, strangely misshapen beyond natural form
example: The Halloween sweater was grotesque enough that nobody dared call it ugly to her face.

hindi: गुफा-कुंज — सीपियों से सजी बाग़ की कृत्रिम गुफा
definition: a small picturesque cave, often artificial, built in a garden and decorated with shells
example: The duke built his grotto for solemn contemplation; his heirs now rent it out for gender reveals.

hindi: कलम-मज़दूरी की दुनिया — पैसे के लिए लिखने वाले ग़रीब लेखक
definition: London street of poor hack writers; hence needy writers producing cheap work for money
example: Content farms are just Grub Street with better lighting.

hindi: धूर्तता — चालाकी भरी कपटी बुद्धि
definition: crafty, cunning intelligence used skilfully to deceive, trick and outwit other people
example: With pure guile, the toddler negotiated two desserts by pretending to forget the first.

hindi: निश्छल — जिसमें कोई छल या चालाकी न हो
definition: completely free of cunning or deceit, innocently honest and open in manner
example: The toddler's guileless report that Daddy calls the neighbours "the drummers" ended the barbecue early.

hindi: उल्लू बनाना — भोले को ठगना
definition: to trick or deceive a trusting, gullible person into believing something false or foolish
example: He was gulled into buying an extended warranty for a phone case.

hindi: रसना-संबंधी — स्वाद की इंद्रिय से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the sense of taste, the tongue, and the whole pleasurable experience of eating flavour
example: The fusion taco was a gustatory adventure nobody had asked for.

hindi: प्रलयकाल — किसी पूरी व्यवस्था का विनाशकारी पतन
definition: the violent, catastrophic collapse of an entire order, regime or established world
example: The quarterly reorg was billed as a refresh, but it played out like a Götterdämmerung for middle management.

hindi: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण — बंदी को अदालत के सामने पेश कराने का अधिकार
definition: the right to have a detained person brought before a court
example: The family filed for habeas corpus when the police stopped answering.

hindi: बिसाती — सुई-धागा, फ़ीते और छोटे पहनावे का व्यापारी
definition: a dealer in men's clothing, hats and accessories, or in sewing goods like ribbons
example: The old haberdasher still measures necks by eye, and no online sizing chart has ever beaten him.

hindi: वेशविन्यास — किसी काम या पद के अनुकूल पहनावा
definition: clothing and garments suited to a particular office, occasion or activity, often worn formally
example: He unpacked the habiliments of the weekend cyclist: lycra, clip shoes and a helmet costing more than the bike.

hindi: वास — बसने और रहने का स्थान
definition: a place where people live, a home or dwelling suitable for human residence and daily life
example: The listing called it a charming habitation; the photos called it a cupboard with ambition.

hindi: नियमित आगंतुक — किसी स्थान का पक्का आने-जाने वाला
definition: a regular visitor who frequently spends time at one particular place, such as a favourite bar or club
example: As a habitué of the corner bakery, he gets the last croissant without asking.

hindi: यमलोक — मृतकों का अंधकारमय अधोलोक
definition: the gloomy underworld where departed souls dwell, or any dark, miserable and joyless place
example: The underground car park at rush hour is a small, fluorescent Hades.

hindi: श्रीहीन — थका, सूखा और बेहाल चेहरा
definition: looking exhausted and unwell, with a drawn, hollow face from worry or sleeplessness
example: New parents arrive at the office haggard and oddly proud of it.

hindi: संत-चरित — संतों की जीवनी; किसी की अति-प्रशंसात्मक जीवनी
definition: a biography of saints; hence any biography that flatters and praises its subject quite uncritically
example: The founder's authorized biography is pure hagiography, down to his breakfast smoothie.

hindi: सुखमय-शांत — बीते दिनों जैसा सुनहरा और निश्चिंत
definition: idyllically calm, peaceful and happy, usually describing a golden period long past
example: He speaks of the halcyon days before group chats, when silence was allowed.

hindi: हट्टा-कट्टा — (प्रायः वृद्ध व्यक्ति) स्वस्थ और तगड़ा
definition: strong and healthy in body, especially of someone elderly who remains vigorous
example: At ninety, Grandpa is hale enough to beat everyone at pickleball and gloat about it.

hindi: पावन मानना — किसी वस्तु को पवित्र मानकर पूजना
definition: to make or honour something as holy, treating it with deep reverence and careful respect
example: The regulars hallow that corner booth, and newcomers learn quickly not to sit there.

hindi: पूजनीय — पवित्र माना गया, गहरी श्रद्धा से सम्मानित
definition: made holy or greatly revered, honoured with deep, lasting respect
example: We stood on the hallowed turf of the stadium and immediately asked where the toilets were.

hindi: घातक दोष — नायक की वह भूल जो उसका पतन लाती है
definition: the fatal flaw or error in judgement that brings about a tragic hero's downfall
example: His hamartia was replying all to a thread that included the entire board.

hindi: हैनिबल द्वार पर — भारी संकट सिर पर आ पहुँचा है
definition: Hannibal is at the gates; an alarm that grave danger has already arrived right outside
example: The auditors are in reception: Hannibal ante portas, and nobody has reconciled March.

hindi: एकप्रयुक्त शब्द — पूरे ग्रंथ में केवल एक बार आया शब्द
definition: a word that appears only once in a whole text, author or language record
example: The word 'synergistic' is a hapax legomenon in his memos, and everyone suspects the intern wrote that one.

hindi: बेतरतीब — बिना योजना या व्यवस्था के
definition: lacking any order, method or planning, so that things happen by random chance and luck
example: The team's haphazard approach to backups worked perfectly until Tuesday.

hindi: संभवतः — शायद, दैवयोग से
definition: archaic: meaning perhaps, possibly, or happening through chance and fortune
example: Haply the parcel will arrive today, though the tracking page has claimed so since Tuesday.

hindi: अग्रदूत — आने वाली घटना की पहली सूचना देने वाला
definition: a person or thing that signals the approach of something about to happen, a forerunner or omen
example: The first pumpkin-spice latte is the harbinger of autumn and of forty marketing emails.

hindi: दिलेरी — कठिनाई झेलने वाली निडर हिम्मत
definition: bold courage and toughness in facing danger or hardship without fear
example: It takes real hardihood to order the office's first-ever salad at a barbecue.

hindi: कठिन गुज़ारे वाला — कड़ी मेहनत से भी मुश्किल से पेट भरना
definition: marked by hard work and poverty, scraping a living from very little
example: He mentions his hardscrabble childhood at every yacht party.

hindi: अविवेकी — बिना सोचे-समझे बनाई गई बेतुकी
definition: rash and foolish, showing reckless thinking and no sensible planning or judgment
example: His harebrained scheme to cycle to Goa began and ended in the car park.

hindi: सुनो — ध्यान देकर सुनो
definition: archaic: listen closely, attend carefully; a call urging others to hear some sound or news
example: Hark, the sound of the ice-cream van, and every adult in the building suddenly needs a walk.

hindi: विदूषक-नाट्य — मसख़रों का हुड़दंगी हास्य दृश्य; बेतुकी धमाचौकड़ी
definition: a comic stage piece featuring Harlequin and clowns; hence any absurd, knockabout buffoonery
example: The move to the new office became a harlequinade of wrong boxes, locked doors and missing chairs.

hindi: कर्कशा — लालची, कटु और झगड़ालू स्त्री
definition: a grasping, shrill and cruel woman, named after the snatching monsters of legend
example: The reality show cast her as the harpy, and she played the part for the cameras.

hindi: सताना — बार-बार छापे मारकर परेशान करना
definition: persistently attack and harass an enemy with repeated small raids, wearing them down without respite
example: Mosquitoes harried the campers all night like a disciplined light cavalry.

hindi: अंतड़ी-पाठक — बलि-पशु की अंतड़ियों से भविष्य बताने वाला पुरोहित
definition: an ancient Roman priest who foretold future events by reading signs in the entrails of sacrificed animals
example: The growth lead pored over the churn dashboard like a haruspex over a goat.

hindi: कवच-कुर्ता — कड़ियों से बना लंबा लौह कवच
definition: a long tunic of chain mail protecting a knight's body in battle
example: Wearing three hoodies to the freezing stadium felt like donning a hauberk against the wind.

hindi: गृहिणी — घर-गृहस्थी में रमी स्त्री
definition: a housewife, especially one devoted to domestic order, cooking and household cleanliness
example: He jokes about being a hausfrau, yet labels every freezer container with its date.

hindi: उच्च फ़ैशन — नाप से हाथ से बने महँगे परिधान
definition: expensive, fashionable clothing designed and made by hand for individual clients
example: He called his thrift-store blazer haute couture, and nobody at the party dared to argue.

hindi: उच्च पाकशैली — बारीकी से पकाया गया परिष्कृत भोजन
definition: elaborate, refined cooking prepared with great skill in expensive restaurants
example: It was haute cuisine: three peas, one foam and a bill the size of rent.

hindi: अभिजात दंभ — दूसरों को तुच्छ समझने वाला ऊँचा रवैया
definition: haughty, proud behaviour that treats other people as socially beneath oneself
example: The sommelier greeted my request for ice with magnificent hauteur.

hindi: शरणस्थल — जहाज़ों के लिए सुरक्षित बंदरगाह; आश्रय
definition: a sheltered harbour where ships anchor safely; hence any quiet place of refuge
example: The library's quiet floor is a haven from the open-plan office.

hindi: तबाही — भारी विनाश और अव्यवस्था
definition: widespread destruction and violent disorder, like that spread across lands by invading armies
example: One unmuted microphone wrought havoc on the entire board meeting.

hindi: चूल्हा — घर की आग, गृहस्थी का केंद्र
definition: the stone floor of a fireplace, and by extension the home and family gathered around its warmth
example: The smart heater has an app, a timer and a voice, but it will never be a hearth.

hindi: चूल्हा-शिला — आग के नीचे का पत्थर, घर का प्रतीक
definition: the flat stone forming a fireplace floor, and by extension the home and family life
example: Grandma's hearthstone is now a laptop stand, and somehow family arguments still gather there.

hindi: गगनोन्मुख — आकाश की ओर
definition: upwards towards the heavens, often with lifted eyes in prayer, hope or weary exasperation
example: She cast her eyes heavenward as the printer jammed for the fourth time.

hindi: ज्वरग्रस्त — क्षयरोग की लाली और ताप वाला
definition: archaic: marked by the flushed cheeks and daily fever of wasting lung disease
example: Before it meant a busy inbox, hectic meant the feverish flush on a consumptive poet's cheek.

hindi: धमकाना — ऊँची आवाज़ में डाँट-डपट करना
definition: to bully with loud, blustering talk
example: Stop hectoring the intern; she has the numbers and you have the volume.

hindi: प्रभुत्वशाली शक्ति — जो बाकी सब पर हावी रहे
definition: a dominant state or power whose overlordship decides what neighbouring states are permitted to attempt
example: In the group chat, whoever owns the only car is the undisputed weekend hegemon.

hindi: वर्चस्व — एक शक्ति का दूसरों पर दबदबा
definition: the dominance one power holds over others
example: English hegemony online decides which jokes travel and which stay home.

hindi: पलायन — संकट से बचने के लिए किया गया प्रस्थान
definition: a flight or journey away from danger; originally Muhammad's migration from Mecca to Medina
example: Our annual hegira from the city begins the moment the heatwave warning appears.

hindi: जघन्य — अत्यंत घृणित और क्रूर
definition: utterly wicked and shocking; hateful and cruel far beyond ordinary wrongdoing
example: Leaving one sip of milk in the carton and putting it back is a heinous crime in this flat.

hindi: सूर्यकेंद्रित — सूर्य को केंद्र मानने वाला
definition: describing the model of the heavens in which Earth and every other planet circles the central solar star
example: In a truly heliocentric household, every family plan orbits around the teenager's schedule.

hindi: कर्णधार — जहाज़ का पतवार थामकर दिशा देने वाला
definition: the sailor who steers a ship's course by holding its wheel or tiller steady
example: On the family road trip, Dad appointed himself helmsman and refused to share the GPS.

hindi: सहधर्मिणी — जीवन की सहायक संगिनी
definition: archaic: a helpful companion or partner, usually a wife or husband sharing household life
example: Her helpmeet assembles the flat-pack furniture; she keeps the leftover screws as evidence.

hindi: हड़बड़ी में — बेतहाशा और बिना क्रम के
definition: in disorderly confused haste, rushing about without order or plan
example: The interns ran helter-skelter when the fire alarm finally went off.

hindi: अतः — इसी कारण से
definition: formal word meaning therefore, for this reason, drawing the result from something stated
example: The server room is freezing, hence the engineer in a woolly hat and fingerless gloves.

hindi: अब से आगे — इस क्षण से भविष्य में
definition: from this time onward, starting at this present moment and continuing into every future period
example: Henceforth all meetings under ten minutes shall be emails, and all emails shall be shorter.

hindi: गुर्गा — सरगना का गंदा काम करने वाला वफ़ादार
definition: a loyal, unscrupulous follower or hired helper who does a villain's dirty, violent work
