example: Every tyrannical manager has a henchman who books the one-to-ones nobody wants.

hindi: द्वि-पद एकार्थ — एक विचार को 'और' से जुड़े दो शब्दों में कहना
definition: expressing a single complex idea through paired words linked by a conjunction, instead of a noun with its modifier
example: The landlord promised "nice and warm" heating, a hendiadys the radiators never read.

hindi: कुलचिह्न-विद्या — वंशीय प्रतीकों और ढालों की कला और शास्त्र
definition: the system of designing, describing and granting coats of arms and noble family shields
example: Fantasy football leagues have developed a heraldry of team logos more elaborate than most royal houses.

hindi: वनस्पति-संग्रह — सुखाए पौधों का व्यवस्थित संग्रह
definition: a systematic collection of dried, pressed plant specimens kept for scientific study
example: Her camera roll is a herbarium of every leaf she found interesting on holiday.

hindi: अतिदुष्कर — विराट बल या श्रम माँगने वाला
definition: demanding enormous strength or effort
example: Rewriting the payroll system in six weeks was a Herculean ask.

hindi: इसके बाद — आगे से, भविष्य में
definition: from this moment onward, afterwards, in all future time following the present statement
example: The shared fridge shelf shall hereafter be known as mine, per the label.

hindi: एतद्द्वारा — इसके द्वारा
definition: formal word meaning through this very statement, document or action, making something official
example: I hereby declare this group chat muted until someone stops sending birthday GIFs.

hindi: इसमें — इसी के भीतर
definition: formal word meaning inside this particular document, place or matter being discussed
example: All opinions expressed herein belong to the author's cat, who does not accept liability.

hindi: इसके आगे — इस दस्तावेज़ में आगे
definition: formal legal word meaning later within this same document, from this point onward
example: The tenant, hereinafter called 'the Victim', agrees to pay for every broken boiler.

hindi: विधर्म — स्वीकृत धार्मिक सिद्धांत के विरुद्ध मत
definition: belief or opinion contrary to accepted religious doctrine or orthodox teaching
example: Suggesting the office skip the Friday pizza was received as heresy of the highest order.

hindi: इससे पहले — इस समय से पूर्व तक
definition: before this moment, until now, found mostly in formal, official and legal writing
example: My heretofore spotless browser history did not survive the wedding-planning month.

hindi: इसी पर — इसके तुरंत बाद
definition: archaic: immediately after this happened, and often directly because of this very event or remark
example: The landlord mentioned a rent increase; hereupon every tenant suddenly discovered the housing market.

hindi: वायुरुद्ध — पूरी तरह बंद, बाहर से अछूता
definition: completely sealed and airtight, or closed off from outside influence altogether
example: The team lives in a hermetic bubble where customer feedback never arrives.

hindi: वीर द्विपदी — पंचचरणी लय में बँधी तुकांत पंक्ति-जोड़ी
definition: a rhyming pair of lines in iambic pentameter, the favourite form of Dryden and Pope
example: Her passive-aggressive fridge note arrived as a heroic couplet about the missing yoghurt.

hindi: संध्यातारा — शाम को चमकने वाला शुक्र
definition: the evening star, the planet Venus shining brightly in the western twilight
example: Hesperus appeared over the parking lot just as the last meeting finally ended.

hindi: अपरंपरागत — प्रचलित धार्मिक या स्थापित मान्यता से भिन्न विचार रखने वाला
definition: holding opinions that depart from accepted or orthodox religious teaching, or from any established view
example: Her heterodox view that meetings could be emails made her a legend in the finance team.

hindi: टोना — किसी पर डाला गया अशुभ जादू
definition: an evil magic spell or curse cast on someone to bring them misfortune
example: The vending machine has clearly placed a hex on everyone who uses exact change.

hindi: षट्चरणी छंद — हर पंक्ति में छह चरण
definition: a line of verse built from six metrical feet, the measure of Homer and Virgil
example: Her complaint about the Wi-Fi ran so long it could have scanned as dactylic hexameter.

hindi: अंतराल — किसी क्रम में लंबा ठहराव या विराम
definition: a pause or break in a continuing activity, series or sequence, often lasting some time
example: After a three-year hiatus, the band returned with the same four chords and higher ticket prices.

hindi: शीतकालीन — जाड़े की ऋतु से जुड़ा, ठिठुरन भरा
definition: belonging to winter, the coldest season when days shorten and frost settles
example: My hibernal routine is simple: blanket, laptop, and a firm refusal to open the balcony door.

hindi: रूढ़िग्रस्त — पुरानी परंपराओं में जकड़ा हुआ
definition: stubbornly clinging to ancient customs and refusing change or fresh ideas
example: The hidebound committee rejected video calls because the minutes template has no field for them.

hindi: शीघ्र जाना — फुर्ती से कहीं पहुँचना
definition: archaic: hurry or hasten somewhere quickly, going with speed and purpose
example: At the first whiff of free pizza, the interns hied themselves to the kitchen.

hindi: पुरोहिती — पुजारियों जैसा औपचारिक, गंभीर और पवित्र
definition: relating to priests, or formal and stiffly solemn like sacred priestly ritual
example: The sommelier's hieratic pause before naming the house red silenced the entire table.

hindi: रहस्य-पुरोहित — गूढ़ अनुष्ठानों का व्याख्याता
definition: a priest who explains sacred mysteries and occult rites; any person who interprets secret knowledge
example: The SEO consultant speaks like a hierophant of the algorithm, and bills like one too.

hindi: उलटा-सीधा — बिना किसी क्रम के बिखरा हुआ
definition: scattered in complete disorder and confusion, lying about without any sensible arrangement or pattern
example: Shoes lay higgledy-piggledy across the hallway like fallen dominoes.

hindi: उदात्तचेता — ऊँचे नैतिक आदर्शों वाला
definition: holding noble moral principles and ideals, sometimes to a slightly lofty degree
example: The high-minded plan to read one classic a month ended at chapter two of Middlemarch.

hindi: कुलीन-जन्मा — ऊँचे घराने में पैदा
definition: born into a noble, aristocratic or socially distinguished family of high rank
example: The highborn intern arrived with a surname the building was named after.

hindi: सुरुचिसंपन्न — गंभीर, बौद्धिक रुचियों वाला
definition: showing refined, intellectual tastes shaped by serious reading, learning and culture
example: The highbrow podcast spent forty minutes on one comma in Proust.

hindi: बटमार — घोड़े पर सवार होकर राह में लूटने वाला
definition: a mounted robber, armed and masked, who held up travellers and stagecoaches on lonely country roads
example: The motorway services charge like a highwayman, minus the mask and the good manners.

hindi: वैद्यधर्मी — प्राचीन यूनानी वैद्य और उनकी चिकित्सा-शपथ से जुड़ा
definition: relating to Hippocrates, the Greek physician, or the medical ethics sworn in his name
example: Code review should carry a Hippocratic pledge: first, don't break production.

hindi: रोमश — घने बालों वाला
definition: hairy or shaggy, having thick growth of hair on face or body
example: The hirsute drummer's beard now has its own fan account.

hindi: चित्रित — जिसके आद्याक्षर में कथा-दृश्य बना हो
definition: of a large initial letter in a manuscript, decorated with painted figures telling a story
example: His signature has grown so elaborate it is practically a historiated initial with a squiggle attached.

hindi: नाटकीय — दिखावटी, अति-भावुक अभिनय जैसा
definition: overly theatrical and exaggerated in behaviour, like a stage actor playing to the crowd
example: His histrionic sigh at the Wi-Fi password rivalled any death scene at the Old Vic.

hindi: इधर — इस स्थान की ओर
definition: archaic: to this place, here, towards the speaker; hither and thither means everywhere
example: Come hither, said the dog trainer, and the puppy went thither instead.

hindi: इधर-उधर — बिना निश्चित दिशा के यहाँ-वहाँ
definition: archaic: moving here and there in various directions, without settled course or purpose
example: Delivery robots trundle hither and thither across campus, politely blocking everyone.

hindi: अब तक — इस क्षण तक, अभी तक
definition: until now, or until the moment being described, marking what held true before something finally changed
example: The hitherto silent group chat exploded the moment someone mentioned free pizza.

hindi: पाला — रात भर में जमी सफ़ेद ओस-बर्फ़
definition: white feathery frost forming overnight when water vapour freezes onto cold surfaces
example: Hoarfrost sparkled across the lawn, and the dog regarded it with deep suspicion.

hindi: पलित — उम्र से सफ़ेद, बहुत पुराना और घिसा हुआ
definition: grey or white with advanced years, or ancient and stale from endless repetition
example: He opened the all-hands with the hoary joke about synergy, and the room aged with it.

hindi: मेल-जोल बढ़ाना — बड़े लोगों के साथ घुलना-मिलना
definition: to socialize in a friendly, familiar manner with important, famous or fashionable people
example: He went to the conference to learn, but mostly to hobnob near the free espresso bar.

hindi: जनसाधारण — आम भीड़, सामान्य लोग
definition: the ordinary masses of people, often mentioned with a touch of snobbery
example: The VIP lounge had its own queue, which the hoi polloi could admire from behind a rope.

hindi: नैतिकता-दंभी — खुद को दूसरों से अधिक पवित्र और नैतिक समझने वाला
definition: smugly convinced that you are more virtuous, moral and righteous than other people
example: She went vegan on Monday and was insufferably holier-than-thou by Tuesday lunch.

hindi: स्वहस्तलेख — लेखक के अपने हाथ से लिखा दस्तावेज़
definition: a manuscript, letter or document written entirely in the author's own personal handwriting
example: In an age of typed apologies, a holograph thank-you note now counts as a grand romantic gesture.

hindi: श्रद्धांजलि — किसी के प्रति सार्वजनिक आदर और सम्मान की अभिव्यक्ति
definition: special public honour or respect shown to someone, often through a creative work
example: The sequel's opening scene pays homage to the original, frame for frame, lawsuit pending.

hindi: महाकाव्यात्मक — विशाल, वीरतापूर्ण और भव्य
definition: epic, heroic and grand in scale, like the ancient poems of legendary warriors
example: The family's Homeric struggle to assemble the flat-pack wardrobe lasted two days.

hindi: धर्मोपदेश — नैतिक शिक्षा देता छोटा प्रवचन
definition: a short religious sermon explaining scripture; hence a tiresome moralizing lecture about proper behaviour
example: Every late invoice earns a homily from accounts about the sacred virtue of deadlines.

hindi: सम्मानसूचक शब्द — आदर प्रकट करने वाली उपाधि या संबोधन
definition: a title or word used to show respect and honour when addressing someone
example: Grandma insists the honorific Madam Chairperson applies at the dinner table.

hindi: मानद — केवल सम्मान के लिए दी गई उपाधि
definition: for the sake of honour, describing a degree awarded without normal study
example: The rock star received a doctorate honoris causa, so please call him Doctor at soundcheck.

hindi: आँखों में धूल झोंकना — बेवकूफ़ बनाकर धोखा देना
definition: to trick or deceive someone cleverly by hiding the truth or distracting their attention
example: The cat hoodwinked two households into believing it was starving.

hindi: मृदु व्यंग्यात्मक — हल्का, विनोदी और स्नेहपूर्ण उपहास
definition: describing gentle, amused satire that mocks human folly with tolerant good humour, after the poet Horace
example: The best-man speech stayed Horatian, teasing the groom's spreadsheets without mentioning the ex.

hindi: कहने में भयानक — किसी चौंकाने वाली बुरी बात की भूमिका
definition: horrible to relate; used to introduce something shockingly unpleasant or unexpected
example: The fridge, horribile dictu, still contained the potluck leftovers from March.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा से परे — इतना श्रेष्ठ कि तुलना ही न हो
definition: excluded from competition, usually because vastly superior to every other contestant entered
example: Grandma's biryani is hors concours at family gatherings, so the rest of us compete for second place.

hindi: क्षुधावर्धक — मुख्य भोजन से पहले के छोटे व्यंजन
definition: a small savoury dish served before the main meal to whet appetite
example: He filled up on hors d'oeuvres and then watched the main course with regret.

hindi: युद्ध से बाहर — घायल या असमर्थ होकर लड़ने योग्य नहीं
definition: disabled or badly injured and therefore unable to continue fighting in battle or combat
example: After the office football match, half the sales team was hors de combat.

hindi: उद्यानविद्या — बाग़-बगीचे उगाने की कला
definition: the science and craft of cultivating garden plants, flowers, fruit and vegetables
example: His horticulture peaked at keeping one basil plant alive through a whole July.

hindi: बंद वाटिका — दीवारों से घिरा पवित्र, निजी बाग़
definition: an enclosed garden walled off from the world, a symbol of purity and private retreat
example: With noise-cancelling headphones on, his commute becomes a hortus conclusus of podcasts.

hindi: शुष्क वाटिका — सुखाए, दबाए पौधों का संग्रह
definition: a dried garden, meaning a collection of pressed, preserved plant specimens kept in albums
example: Grandma's hortus siccus of pressed pansies outlasted three of her phones.

hindi: जय-जयकार — प्रशंसा और आनंद की पुकार
definition: a joyful shout of praise, adoration and triumphant welcome, often greeting deliverance
example: Hosanna — the lift is finally working after three months of stairs.

hindi: शत्रुता — युद्ध की सक्रिय कार्रवाई
definition: acts of open warfare or active fighting between enemies, especially nations
example: Hostilities resumed at dinner the moment someone mentioned the family property.

hindi: मानवता का शत्रु — समूची मानव जाति का वैरी
definition: enemy of all mankind; the legal label once given to pirates and slave traders
example: Whoever designed the unskippable thirty-second advert is surely hostis humani generis.

hindi: तथापि — फिर भी, इसके बावजूद
definition: archaic: even though, nevertheless, admitting something while still holding the main point
example: The diet is going well, howbeit the biscuit tin tells another story.

hindi: शोर-शराबा — अनेक आवाज़ों का मिला-जुला शोर
definition: a noisy confused uproar of many voices talking loudly over each other in a crowded place
example: The hubbub of the open-plan office made noise-cancelling headphones mandatory.

hindi: अहंकार — पतन को न्योता देता दंभ
definition: overreaching pride that invites its own downfall
example: Shipping on Friday with no rollback plan is hubris, and Monday collects the bill.

hindi: पाखंड — छल भरा ढोंग या ढोंगी व्यक्ति
definition: deceptive false talk or behaviour, or a fraud who deceives others with hollow pretence
example: The 'limited time offer' that runs all year is seasonal humbug.

hindi: विनम्रता — अहंकार से रहित, अपनी सीमाओं का बोध
definition: a modest opinion of your own importance, free from arrogance and pride
example: The chess app taught him humility in eleven moves.

hindi: धातुएँ — शरीर के चार दोष
definition: the four bodily fluids that early medicine believed governed health and temperament when kept balanced
example: His diet app promises to rebalance your gut like a physician rebalancing the humours.

hindi: भागदौड़ — शोरभरी हलचल और गड़बड़
definition: noisy busy uproar and confusion of crowded activity, where everyone seems rushing about at once
example: She escaped the hurly-burly of the city for a weekend with no signal.

hindi: सहेजना — संसाधन को सावधानी से बचाकर बरतना
definition: manage scarce resources carefully, using them sparingly so they last longer
example: Husband your phone battery; the hike has no charging stations and many sunsets.

hindi: पशुपालन — पशुओं और खेती की देखभाल; संसाधनों का किफ़ायती प्रबंधन
definition: the careful breeding and raising of farm animals; figuratively, thrifty management of resources
example: Good husbandry of the team's budget meant one biscuit each, strictly rationed.

hindi: वाह-वाह — प्रसन्नता और जयकार का पुराना नारा
definition: archaic: a cheer shouted to celebrate good news or praise a triumph
example: The build finally went green, and someone at the back actually shouted huzzah.

hindi: सहस्रफनी — एक काटो तो कई उग आएँ ऐसा
definition: having many sources, so that removing one problem only makes several more appear
example: Every patch spawned two new bugs; the codebase was truly Hydra-headed.

hindi: सुख-सान्निध्य — घर की गर्म, आत्मीय सुखद अनुभूति
definition: a Danish word for cosy, candlelit comfort and warm togetherness enjoyed at home
example: The café charges extra for hygge, which appears to mean blankets on chairs and slower Wi-Fi.

hindi: वैवाहिक — विवाह और विवाहोत्सव से संबंधित
definition: relating to marriage or weddings, named after Hymen, the classical Greek deity of weddings
example: The hymeneal festivities stretched across five days and three caterers.

hindi: पद-विपर्यय — ज़ोर देने के लिए शब्दों का सामान्य क्रम बदल देना
definition: departing from normal word order in a sentence, rearranging words for emphasis or effect
example: "Strong with this coffee, the caffeine is," he announced, hyperbaton borrowed from Yoda.

hindi: अतिशयोक्ति — बात को जान-बूझकर बहुत बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना
definition: deliberate exaggeration, making something seem much bigger or greater than it really is, for emphasis
example: "I have a million unread emails," he said, and the hyperbole was only off by nine hundred thousand.

hindi: सुदूर-उत्तरी — ध्रुवीय, अत्यंत ठंडा
definition: belonging to regions far north; hence frigid, arctic, bitterly cold, icy
example: The hotel pool was hyperborean, which the brochure described as 'refreshing'.

hindi: रोगशंकी — बिना रोग के ख़ुद को बीमार मानने वाला
definition: a person who wrongly and persistently believes they are seriously sick despite medical reassurance
example: The hypochondriac in our group has diagnosed himself with eleven rare diseases this year, all via search engine.

hindi: स्व-प्रश्नोत्तर — ख़ुद प्रश्न उठाकर तुरंत उसका उत्तर देना
definition: raising a question and then immediately answering it yourself, steering the listener's thinking
example: "Why did we miss the target? Because nobody read the brief," said the director, hypophora with a side of blame.

hindi: कपटी मित्र — भीतर ही भीतर विनाश रचने वाला धोखेबाज़
definition: Shakespeare's scheming villain in Othello, hence a treacherous friend who secretly plots ruin
example: The colleague who praised your pitch then forwarded its flaws to the boss is a quiet Iago.

hindi: लघु-गुरु चरण — पहले हल्का, फिर ज़ोरदार अक्षर
definition: a metrical foot of verse with one unstressed syllable followed by one stressed syllable
example: "Unmute!" the whole call cries in chorus, a perfect iamb delivered every Monday.

hindi: तत्रैव — ठीक पिछले उद्धरण वाला वही स्रोत
definition: in the same book or source cited in the note just before this citation
example: Footnotes 4 through 19 all read ibid., which tells you exactly how many books the author actually opened.

hindi: अतिसाहसी — सीमा लाँघकर गिरने वाला
definition: recklessly ambitious, overreaching so boldly that failure and downfall follow swiftly
example: His Icarian startup promised flying taxis and delivered a very expensive drone.

hindi: मूर्तिभंजन — पवित्र प्रतिमाओं या मान्य विश्वासों पर प्रहार
definition: attacking cherished beliefs and institutions; originally the destruction of holy images
example: Her review of the city's favourite biryani joint was an act of culinary iconoclasm.

hindi: मूर्तिभंजक — प्रचलित मान्यताओं पर प्रहार करने वाला
definition: someone who attacks cherished beliefs and institutions; originally a breaker of holy images
example: The iconoclast on the panel said the beloved classic film was, frankly, rather long.

hindi: प्रतीक-विधान — कला में प्रयुक्त प्रतीकों और चिह्नों की परंपरा
definition: the symbols, images and visual conventions associated with a subject, figure or movement
example: The iconography of startup culture is complete: hoodie, oat latte, whiteboard nobody erases.

hindi: अर्थात् — यानी, दूसरे शब्दों में
definition: namely, in other words, introducing a clearer, simpler restatement of whatever was just written
example: The launch is 'imminent', id est, nobody knows.

hindi: वही लेखक — पहले नामित वही व्यक्ति या स्रोत
definition: the same author or source already named, used in citations to avoid repeating the name
example: The bibliography lists Tolkien, then idem, idem, idem, which is one way to reveal your whole personality.

hindi: मूर्तिपूजा — मूर्तियों की पूजा; किसी की अति-भक्ति
definition: worship of idols or images; hence excessive adoration of anyone or anything
example: The fan-club's idolatry extended to framing a napkin the singer once used.

hindi: ग्राम्य-सुख-चित्र — शांत, सुंदर ग्रामीण जीवन का वर्णन
definition: a short poem or scene describing peaceful, happy rural life in idealised countryside
example: The cottage listing promised a rural idyll and delivered one bar of signal by the gate.

hindi: एकनिष्ठ धुन — मन पर हावी रहने वाला एक ही विचार
definition: a single idea that grips someone's mind and crowds out every other thought
example: Finding the perfect mechanical keyboard became his idée fixe, and his desk now holds seven.

hindi: रूढ़ धारणा — बिना परखे मान ली गई आम राय
definition: a received notion or commonplace opinion accepted without question by most people
example: That meetings boost productivity is an idée reçue that every calendar quietly disproves.

hindi: हीन — नीच और अशोभनीय
definition: lacking honour or decency; shameful, base and wholly unworthy of respect
example: Winning the quiz by googling under the table was an ignoble victory.

hindi: अपमानजनक — शर्म और बेइज़्ज़ती से भरा
definition: deeply shameful and humiliating, bringing public disgrace and embarrassment upon someone
example: The champion's ignominious exit came via a misplaced rook and a sneeze.

hindi: अपमान — सबके सामने होने वाली घोर बेइज़्ज़ती
definition: public shame and disgrace that strips away a person's standing and dignity
example: The ignominy of being unfollowed by your own mother is a very modern wound.

hindi: मूढ़ — अज्ञानी, जिसे कुछ पता ही न हो
definition: an ignorant person lacking basic knowledge, especially one loudly unaware of that ignorance
example: The comment section's resident ignoramus has strong views on vaccines and none on spelling.

hindi: विधि-अज्ञान क्षम्य नहीं — क़ानून न जानना बचाव नहीं
definition: the legal principle that ignorance of written statutes excuses nobody from obeying them
example: He pleaded that nobody reads parking signs, but ignorantia juris non excusat and the ticket stood.

hindi: अपना बाग़ सँवारो — दुनिया की चिंता छोड़ अपना काम करो
definition: Voltaire's closing advice to tend your own garden, working quietly rather than theorising about everything
example: After a week of doomscrolling, she muttered il faut cultiver notre jardin and repotted the monstera.

hindi: असंस्कारी — बुरी परवरिश से अशिष्ट
definition: having rude, impolite manners, as though never taught proper behaviour when young
example: Only the ill-bred, sniffed his aunt, would put ketchup on a steak.

hindi: कुरूप — भद्दी सूरत वाला
definition: archaic: unattractive or ugly in face and general appearance, unpleasant to behold
example: The ill-favoured mascot costume still somehow outsold the whole merchandise line.

hindi: अभागा — बुरे ग्रहों के कारण विफलता को अभिशप्त
definition: doomed by fate from the start, as though born under unlucky stars
example: The ill-starred product launch clashed with a solar eclipse and a server outage.

hindi: प्रबुद्ध वर्ग — ख़ुद को विशेष ज्ञानी मानने वाले लोग
definition: people claiming special enlightenment or superior knowledge, often a self-appointed intellectual elite
example: The office illuminati have read the product roadmap and will explain it to nobody.

hindi: आलोकित करना — प्रकाश डालना, उजागर करना
definition: to brighten something with light; also to make something clearer and easier to understand
example: One slide of actual numbers illumined more than forty slides of arrows.

hindi: पीना — पेय ग्रहण करना
definition: to drink something, especially alcohol, or figuratively to absorb ideas deeply into the mind
example: He imbibed four espressos before the pitch and then presented at double speed.

hindi: उलझन — पेचीदा और शर्मनाक गड़बड़ स्थिति
definition: a complicated embarrassing situation, tangled confusion or misunderstanding that proves hard to escape
example: The seating plan for the wedding became an imbroglio involving three divorces and one parrot.

hindi: अमाप — जिसे नापा न जा सके, असीम
definition: boundless; too great in size, amount or extent to measure, seemingly without any limit
example: The immeasurable patience of anyone teaching their parents video calls deserves a medal.

hindi: अनादि — इतना पुराना कि किसी को आरंभ याद नहीं
definition: so ancient that no living memory or written record reaches back to its beginning
example: The team has argued about tabs versus spaces since time immemorial, which is to say since 2019.

hindi: असंयमित — मर्यादा से बाहर
definition: lacking restraint; going beyond reasonable limits, excessive and extreme
example: Immoderate use of reply-all is now, officially, a disciplinary matter.

hindi: चारदीवारी में क़ैद करना — दीवारों के भीतर बंद कर देना
definition: enclose or imprison someone within walls, shutting them away completely from the world
example: Deadline week immured him in the spare room with three monitors and a kettle.

hindi: अमूर्त — जिसे छुआ या पकड़ा न जा सके
definition: unable to be touched or felt; too faint, subtle or delicate for anyone to grasp
example: An impalpable sense of doom settled over the office whenever the calendar invite said 'quick chat'.

hindi: गतिरोध — ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ आगे बढ़ने का रास्ता न हो
definition: a deadlock where progress is blocked because neither side will yield
example: The tabs-versus-spaces debate reached an impasse, so the team adopted a formatter and stopped speaking.

hindi: गाढ़ा लेप — कैनवास पर मोटी परतों में लगाया रंग
definition: paint laid thickly enough on canvas that brush strokes remain visible as raised texture
example: The birthday cake's frosting had the impasto of a late Van Gogh and roughly the same structural integrity.

hindi: त्रुटिहीन — हर तरह से दोषरहित और उत्तम
definition: without any fault or flaw, perfectly correct in conduct, manners or taste
example: His manners were impeccable right up until someone took the last samosa.

hindi: अकिंचन — जेब में पैसे न होने वाला
definition: having little money to spend, often cheerfully broke for long stretches of time
example: The impecunious founder paid the designer in equity and optimism.

hindi: अनित्यता — किसी भी चीज़ का सदा न टिकना
definition: the condition of never lasting forever; everything eventually fading, changing and passing away
example: Nothing teaches impermanence like a free cloud storage plan.

hindi: अधर्मी — ईश्वर या पवित्र के प्रति श्रद्धाहीन
definition: lacking reverence toward the divine, sacred things or traditional religious duty and observance
example: Ordering a decaf at the city's most serious espresso bar felt faintly impious.

hindi: बहुरूपिया — किसी और का रूप धरकर धोखा देने वाला
definition: a fraud who deceives people by falsely pretending to be someone else entirely, usually for gain
example: The impostor at the wedding was exposed when he toasted the wrong couple.

hindi: शाप-वचन — किसी पर विपत्ति माँगने वाला कटु वचन
definition: a spoken curse calling down harm, misfortune or divine punishment on someone
example: A low imprecation rose from the cubicle whenever the build failed for the fifth time.

hindi: प्रस्तुति-प्रबंधक — नाटक, ओपेरा या संगीत कार्यक्रमों का आयोजक
definition: a person who organises, promotes and finances theatrical, operatic or concert productions for public audiences
example: Aunt Meera is the family impresario, casting relatives and booking venues for every festival.

hindi: प्रकाशन-अनुमति — अधिकारी की आधिकारिक स्वीकृति
definition: official permission to print a book, originally from the Church; hence any authoritative approval
example: The pitch deck finally carried the founder's imprimatur, three fonts and all.

hindi: अनौचित्य — अनुचित या मर्यादा के विरुद्ध आचरण
definition: behaviour that breaks accepted standards of proper, honest or respectable conduct
example: The minister denied any impropriety, which is exactly what the leaked group chat suggested.

hindi: अदूरदर्शी — भविष्य की चिंता किए बिना सब उड़ा देने वाला
definition: failing to save money or provide for future needs, spending everything without thought
example: In an improvident moment he subscribed to four streaming services and one gym.

hindi: आक्षेप करना — किसी की ईमानदारी या नीयत पर सवाल उठाना
definition: dispute or openly attack someone's honesty, motives or character as untrustworthy
example: Nobody impugned her integrity until she claimed the last slice was 'nobody's'.

hindi: आरोपित करना — कोई दोष या गुण किसी पर मढ़ना
definition: attribute blame, fault or some quality to someone, often without proof
example: She imputed the missing socks to the washing machine, which declined to comment.

hindi: अनुपस्थिति में — संबंधित व्यक्ति के बिना उपस्थित हुए
definition: while the person concerned is not present
example: He was sentenced in absentia and is believed to be somewhere in Dubai.

hindi: बंद कमरे में — जनता से दूर, गोपनीय सुनवाई
definition: heard privately in a judge's chambers, with the public and press kept outside
example: The salary review was held in camera, which explains the whispering afterward.

hindi: विस्तारपूर्वक — पूरे विस्तार से, बिना संक्षेप के
definition: at full length, recorded completely and in great detail without shortening anything
example: He recited the terms and conditions in extenso, to a waiter.

hindi: संकटकाल में — घोर विपदा या मृत्यु के निकट की स्थिति में
definition: in desperate circumstances, especially at the very point of death or during some final, terrible crisis
example: In extremis, and only then, the team opened the documentation.

hindi: रंगे हाथों — अपराध करते हुए पकड़ा गया
definition: caught at the very moment of committing a crime or shameful misdeed, leaving the culprit nothing to deny
example: The dog was found in flagrante delicto, nose deep in the birthday cake.

hindi: निर्धन के रूप में — शुल्क-माफ़ी के साथ मुक़दमा लड़ने की अनुमति
definition: legal permission letting someone unable to afford court fees still bring a lawsuit
example: He filed in forma pauperis, which was cheaper than his lawyer's retainer.

hindi: इस चिह्न से तुम जीतोगे — किसी प्रतीक के सहारे विजय का वचन
definition: in this sign you will conquer; a motto promising decisive victory under a chosen banner or symbol
example: The founder raised the new logo at the all-hands like it was in hoc signo vinces rather than a rebrand.

hindi: अभिभावक के स्थान पर — माता-पिता की जगह उनकी ज़िम्मेदारी निभाते हुए
definition: standing in a parent's place, with a parent's responsibilities
example: Boarding schools act in loco parentis, which is a heavy thing to promise.

hindi: कथा के मध्य से — घटना बीच में पहुँच चुकी हो वहाँ से शुरू
definition: beginning in the middle of the action rather than at the start
example: The novel opens in medias res, with the getaway car already on fire.

hindi: स्मृति में — किसी दिवंगत की याद में
definition: in memory of someone who has died, a phrase used in dedications, tributes and grave inscriptions
example: The team wiki now keeps an in memoriam page for every feature the CEO killed in review.

hindi: सदा के लिए — अनंत काल तक
definition: forever, lasting through every future period without ending, pause or interruption
example: Sign up for the free trial and you are subscribed in perpetuum, apparently.

hindi: व्यक्तिगत — किसी विशेष व्यक्ति के विरुद्ध
definition: directed against a particular person's obligations rather than against property itself
example: The judgment ran in personam, following the debtor from one trendy postcode to the next.

hindi: वस्तुगत — किसी वस्तु या संपत्ति के विरुद्ध
definition: directed against property itself rather than against any particular person's obligations
example: The court's action was in rem, so the yacht was seized while its owner sulked safely in Monaco.

hindi: संगणकीय — कंप्यूटर अनुकरण द्वारा किया गया
definition: performed by computer simulation rather than inside the living organism or laboratory
example: The team ran the experiment in silico first, since GPUs complain less than lab mice.

hindi: यथास्थान — अपनी मूल जगह पर ही
definition: in the original place, without being moved
example: The mosaic was cleaned in situ, an inch at a time, over two summers.

hindi: पूर्णतः — संपूर्ण रूप में, बिना कुछ छोड़े
definition: entirely and completely, taken as one whole without leaving any single part omitted
example: The committee rejected the proposal in toto, including the page numbers.

hindi: शून्य में — संदर्भ से कटकर, अलग-थलग
definition: considered in isolation, severed from its surrounding context, facts or wider circumstances
example: Judged in vacuo the tweet looked harmless; judged with the thread, it was a declaration of war.

hindi: मदिरा में सत्य — नशे में आदमी सच उगल देता है
definition: Latin meaning 'truth lies within wine': drinking loosens tongues and reveals honest opinions
example: In vino veritas: after two glasses, the intern shared his honest review of the rebrand.

hindi: पात्रस्थ — प्रयोगशाला के पात्र में, शरीर के बाहर
definition: performed in a test tube or laboratory dish, outside the living organism
example: The drug worked beautifully in vitro, which is also where most of my New Year resolutions succeed.

hindi: जीवस्थ — जीवित शरीर के भीतर
definition: performed or observed inside the living organism rather than in a laboratory dish
example: The diet app worked in theory; tested in vivo, it met a birthday cake and folded.

hindi: प्रेयसी — वह स्त्री जिससे कोई प्रेम करता है
definition: a woman who is loved romantically; the female lover or sweetheart of a devoted, admiring gentleman
example: He introduced his inamorata to the team as 'a friend from yoga', fooling no one.

hindi: निरर्थक — खोखला, बिना किसी अर्थ या तुक का
definition: silly, empty and lacking meaning, sense or thought of any real substance
example: The meeting produced ninety minutes of inane chatter and one decision about snacks.

hindi: यतः — इस कारण से कि, जहाँ तक
definition: used in 'inasmuch as' meaning because, or to the extent that, something holds true
example: The meeting was productive inasmuch as it ended five minutes early.

hindi: अपरिमेय — जिसका हिसाब या माप न लगाया जा सके
definition: countless or boundless; too great in amount or number for anyone to calculate or measure
example: The damage one careless reply-all can cause is incalculable.

hindi: तप्तदीप्त — गरमी से दहकता, जलती चमक वाला
definition: glowing brightly because something is heated intensely, burning white with heat; figuratively, blazing with brilliance or fury
example: The incandescent bulb in the bathroom doubled as the flat's only heater.

hindi: मंत्रोच्चार — जादुई प्रभाव के लिए बोले गए शब्द
definition: a series of words chanted or spoken aloud as a magic spell or charm
example: 'Have you tried turning it off and on again' is the help desk's oldest incantation.

hindi: कारावास देना — जेल में बंद करना
definition: imprison someone or confine them within walls, especially as legal punishment
example: Stuck in back-to-back calls, she felt incarcerated by her own calendar.

hindi: रक्तवर्ण — गहरा लाल, खून सा रंग
definition: deep crimson reddish in colour, like fresh blood or living flesh
example: The incarnadine wine stain on the white sofa became a permanent conversation piece.

hindi: अपरिपक्व — अभी अधूरा, अस्पष्ट और अव्यवस्थित
definition: just begun and not yet fully formed, so still disordered, vague and lacking clear shape
example: The founders had an inchoate vision and a very polished logo.

hindi: पैना — सीधे मूल बात तक पहुँचने वाला
definition: sharp and direct in thought, cutting quickly through confusion to the central point
example: One incisive question about who it was for ended the two-hour branding debate.

hindi: प्रतिकूल — ख़राब, कठोर और तूफ़ानी मौसम
definition: harsh, stormy weather; cold, windy or rainy enough to make outdoors unpleasant
example: Due to inclement weather, the team-building hike became a team-building sofa.

hindi: गुप्त वेश में — अपनी असली पहचान छिपाकर
definition: with your real identity hidden, so that nobody around you recognises who you really are
example: The CEO flew economy incognito, which lasted until the gate agent read his name aloud.

hindi: अनुपम — जिसकी कोई उपमा न हो
definition: so good or great that nothing else anywhere could be compared with it; without equal
example: The view from the rooftop was incomparable, and so was the rent.

hindi: चंचलता — भावना या निष्ठा में बार-बार बदलाव
definition: the quality of frequently changing loyalty, affection or purpose; lack of steadiness
example: His inconstancy with gym memberships has funded three different fitness chains.

hindi: अस्थिर-चित्त — जो एक बात पर टिका न रहे
definition: frequently changing, especially in loyalty or affection; never steadfast, steady or faithful for long
example: The inconstant weather app promised sunshine, then drizzle, then sunshine again within the hour.

hindi: अकाट्य — जिसे किसी तर्क से झुठलाया न जा सके
definition: so plainly and provably true that no sensible argument could ever deny or dispute it
example: The kitchen camera provided incontrovertible proof of who finished the office cake.

hindi: अभ्रष्ट — जिसे रिश्वत या लालच से डिगाया न जा सके
definition: too firmly honest to be bribed, bought, flattered or tempted into dishonest wrongdoing
example: The new auditor proved incorruptible, which the office coffee fund found deeply inconvenient.

hindi: दुःस्वप्न-प्रेत; बोझ — सोते लोगों पर उतरने वाला दुष्ट आत्मा, दमघोंटू चिंता
definition: a male demon believed to descend on sleepers; also a nightmare or crushing burden
example: The unfinished tax return sat on his weekend like an incubus.

hindi: दोषी ठहराना — किसी को अपराध में फँसाना या दोषारोपित करना
definition: accuse someone, or produce evidence that implicates them in blame for criminal wrongdoing
example: The crumbs on his keyboard inculpated him in the Great Biscuit Theft.

hindi: आदिमुद्रित ग्रंथ — छपाई के शुरुआती दौर की किताबें
definition: books printed in Europe before 1501, during the earliest decades of printing with movable type
example: His vinyl shelf is treated with the reverence usually reserved for incunabula.

hindi: आदिमुद्रित ग्रंथ — छापेखाने के शैशव-काल की पुस्तक
definition: a book printed in Europe before 1501, during the infancy of movable type printing
example: The curator turns the pages of an incunabulum more gently than anyone has ever handled a phone charger.

hindi: घुसपैठ — शत्रु क्षेत्र में अचानक आक्रमणकारी प्रवेश
definition: sudden hostile invasion or raid pushing deep into territory that belongs to another power
example: The cat's nightly incursion onto my pillow is now an established border dispute.

hindi: अशोभन — मर्यादा और शालीनता के विरुद्ध
definition: behaving in an improper, undignified manner that breaks polite standards of conduct
example: Cheering at the quarterly earnings call was judged indecorous by the compliance team.

hindi: हानि-पूर्ति — नुकसान के विरुद्ध सुरक्षा या मुआवज़ा
definition: security against loss, or compensation money demanded from a defeated nation after fighting ends
example: The deposit is the landlord's indemnity against my houseplants' ambitions.

hindi: पछेती गर्मी — पतझड़ में लौटे गरम, सुहाने दिन
definition: a spell of warm, sunny weather arriving late in autumn after the first cold
example: An Indian summer in October had everyone pretending the winter coats they bought were an investment.

hindi: अभियोग लगाना — किसी पर औपचारिक रूप से गंभीर अपराध का आरोप लगाना
definition: formally charge someone with a serious crime, which means they must then stand trial
example: The review did not indict the whole team, only the person who named a variable 'temp2'.

hindi: निर्धन — जीवन की बुनियादी ज़रूरतों से वंचित
definition: extremely poor, lacking money for basic needs like food and shelter
example: The clinic treats indigent patients free and bills the insured ones twice as creatively.

hindi: अस्वस्थ — हल्का बीमार, काम के लायक नहीं
definition: slightly unwell, suffering a minor illness that keeps someone from their duties
example: The keynote speaker was indisposed, which the programme described as a scheduling adventure.

hindi: आलस्य — परिश्रम से बचने की जमी हुई प्रवृत्ति
definition: settled laziness; a disinclination to exert oneself
example: Two summers of pure indolence, and he still calls it a sabbatical.

hindi: आलसी — परिश्रम से बचने वाला, काम टालने वाला
definition: habitually lazy, avoiding work and any effort that could possibly be skipped
example: The indolent cat supervised the unpacking from the one box nobody could move.

hindi: अदम्य — जिसे दबाया या हराया न जा सके
definition: having courage and determination that cannot be crushed, beaten or subdued
example: The indomitable toddler climbed the baby gate for the ninth time before breakfast.

hindi: मदमत्त — नशे में धुत
definition: drunk; affected by alcohol so that thinking and movement become unsteady
example: Slightly inebriated, he decided it was the perfect moment to reply-all.

hindi: अक्षय — कभी न ख़त्म होने वाला
definition: so great in supply or amount that it can never be spent, emptied or drained completely
example: Toddlers have an inexhaustible supply of energy and the word why.

hindi: अटल — जिसे रोका या मनाया न जा सके
definition: impossible to stop, slow down, or talk out of its course
example: The math was inexorable: at that burn rate the company had eleven months left.

hindi: कुख्यात — किसी बुरे काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध
definition: widely famous for something shameful, wicked or disgraceful rather than admirable
example: The infamous 2019 office party is still referenced only in whispers.

hindi: कुख्याति — किसी बुरे काम के कारण फैली बदनामी
definition: wide public fame earned through some shameful, wicked or disgraceful deed
example: The reply-all that reached ten thousand staff has passed from error into infamy.

hindi: अतिसूक्ष्म — इतना छोटा कि लगभग मापा न जा सके
definition: extremely small in size or amount; almost too tiny for anyone to measure or notice
example: The chance of the lift arriving when you press the button is infinitesimal.

hindi: अशक्त — बुढ़ापे या रोग से कमज़ोर
definition: weak and frail in body, especially through advanced years or long illness
example: The infirm printer on the third floor works only when nobody needs it.

hindi: प्रतिष्ठा से नीचे — अपनी हैसियत के अयोग्य समझा जाने वाला काम
definition: beneath one's dignity, considered too lowly or humble for one's social standing
example: The chief executive considered refilling the printer infra dig, so the printer stayed empty.

hindi: भोला — छल-कपट से रहित, सरल और विश्वासी
definition: innocently open, honest and trusting, with no hidden motives or cunning
example: His ingenuous question, "but what does the startup actually do?", silenced the whole pitch night.

hindi: अँगीठी — घर के भीतर जलती आग
definition: archaic: a household fire burning brightly on a hearth, or the domestic fireplace itself
example: The pub's gas ingle flickers convincingly until you notice the switch by the menu board.

hindi: अँगीठी-कोना — आग के पास का आरामदेह कोना
definition: a snug recess beside a large open fireplace, often fitted with seats for warmth
example: Estate agents write inglenook in capitals because it adds ten per cent to the price.

hindi: कृपा पाने का जतन करना — चापलूसी से किसी का प्रिय बनना
definition: deliberately gain someone's favour through flattery or eager, calculated pleasing behaviour
example: The new hire ingratiated himself with the team by bringing doughnuts every Friday.

hindi: भोली नवयुवती — मंच पर मासूम, अनुभवहीन युवती का पात्र
definition: an innocent, trusting young woman, especially such a character in plays
example: She played the ingénue in the school musical and has been negotiating contracts ruthlessly ever since.

hindi: अननुकरणीय — जिसकी नकल असंभव हो
definition: so excellent or distinctive that nobody else could ever copy or imitate it
example: He signs off every email in his own inimitable style: 'k.'

hindi: अधर्मी — घोर अन्यायपूर्ण और पापमय
definition: grossly unjust, wicked and sinful, whether in character, conduct or practical effect
example: The iniquitous 'convenience fee' cost more than the concert ticket itself.

hindi: अधर्म — घोर अन्याय और पापपूर्ण आचरण
definition: gross wickedness and injustice; deeply sinful, immoral conduct that wrongs other people
example: The landlord's iniquity was charging for sunlight through the one window that faced a wall.

hindi: अविवेकपूर्ण — विवेक और समझदारी से रहित
definition: showing poor judgment; unwise and foolish in the choices or words used
example: An injudicious tweet cost the minister his job before lunch.

hindi: पंडिताऊ — किताबी, दिखावटी विद्वत्ता से भरा
definition: pedantically bookish, stuffed with showy Latinate words borrowed only to sound learned
example: The strategy memo was so inkhorn that 'leverage synergistic paradigms' was its plainest sentence.

hindi: आभास — किसी बात का हल्का-सा संकेत
definition: a slight suspicion or faint hint of understanding about something hidden, secret or coming
example: I had an inkling the surprise party was on when everyone suddenly stopped talking in the kitchen.

hindi: अगणित — जिसकी गिनती न हो सके
definition: countless; existing in numbers much too large for anyone ever to count properly
example: The team held innumerable meetings about reducing the number of meetings.

hindi: असामयिक — ग़लत समय पर, बेमौक़ा
definition: happening at an awkward, badly chosen time, poorly suited to the moment
example: He sneezed at the inopportune instant the proposal reached its hushed crescendo.

hindi: अत्यधिक — उचित सीमा से कहीं ज़्यादा
definition: going well beyond reasonable limits; unusually large, excessive and quite disproportionate
example: He spent an inordinate amount of time choosing a font for a two-line memo.

hindi: अस्वास्थ्यकर — सेहत के लिए हानिकर, गंदा
definition: unhealthy and unwholesome, likely to harm health through dirt or foul conditions
example: The shared fridge has grown insalubrious enough to qualify as a research project.

hindi: अतृप्य — जिसकी भूख या चाह कभी न मिटे
definition: having an appetite or desire that nothing ever satisfies, however much arrives
example: His insatiable appetite for notifications survives even airplane mode.

hindi: विवेकशून्य — संवेदना और समझ से रहित
definition: lacking sense or reason; foolish and unthinking, blind to judgment or feeling
example: The insensate honking did not, in fact, clear the traffic jam.

hindi: फीका — बेस्वाद, नीरस
definition: lacking flavour or taste entirely; also dull, bland and without anything interesting about it
example: The insipid hospital soup tasted mostly of warm water and good intentions.

hindi: जहाँ तक — जिस सीमा तक
definition: used in 'insofar as', meaning only to the limited extent that something holds true, and not beyond
example: The new diet works insofar as nobody in the office has dared bring doughnuts since.

hindi: इस हद तक — इतना कि
definition: to such a great extent or degree that something follows; found in 'insomuch that' or 'insomuch as'
example: The Wi-Fi was slow, insomuch that half the team drafted their emails on paper.

hindi: विद्रोह — सत्ता के विरुद्ध हिंसक उठान
definition: violent uprising against established authority or government, meant to seize control
example: A small insurrection broke out when the canteen replaced samosas with kale chips.

hindi: बुद्धि-व्यापार — समझने और सोचने की क्रिया
definition: the action of understanding through reasoning, the thinking intellect working steadily upon ideas
example: Her book club claimed to value intellection, though the wine usually won by the second chapter.

hindi: बुद्धिजीवी वर्ग — राष्ट्र के विचार गढ़ने वाले लेखक, चिंतक और कलाकार
definition: the educated class of writers, thinkers and artists who shape a nation's cultural and political ideas
example: The intelligentsia debated the film for weeks; everyone else just enjoyed the car chase.

hindi: असंयम — खाने-पीने या आचरण में संयम का अभाव
definition: lack of moderation or self-restraint, especially in drinking alcohol or eating
example: The dentist credits her new yacht to the nation's intemperance with fizzy drinks.

hindi: दफ़नाना — शव को विधिपूर्वक क़ब्र में रखना
definition: to bury a dead body in a grave or tomb, usually with funeral rites and ceremony
example: They interred the old laptop in a drawer, never to boot again.

hindi: अन्य बातों के साथ — और भी कई बातों के बीच
definition: among other things, when only a few of them are being named
example: The report criticises, inter alia, the catering budget.

hindi: मध्यस्थता करना — किसी के पक्ष में बीच-बचाव करना
definition: to step between opposing parties and plead on behalf of someone facing trouble or punishment
example: My mother interceded with the neighbours when my band practice reached 110 decibels.

hindi: बीच-बचाव करने वाला — किसी की ओर से विनती करने वाला
definition: person who steps between opposing parties and pleads on behalf of another
example: The office manager acts as intercessor whenever the printer and the interns fall out.

hindi: निषेध करना — अधिकारपूर्वक किसी बात पर रोक लगाना
definition: forbid something by official authority; originally a church decree withholding sacraments from a whole region
example: The school interdicted phones at lunch, and a black market in charging cables promptly bloomed.

hindi: आंतरिक एकालाप — पात्र के मन की बातचीत
definition: a literary passage presenting a character's private unspoken thoughts exactly as they flow through the mind
example: The novel's interior monologue runs forty pages while the heroine decides whether to answer the phone.

hindi: वार्ताकार — बातचीत में भाग लेने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person taking part in a conversation or dialogue, especially one speaking on others' behalf
example: The chatbot proved a tireless interlocutor, patiently agreeing with every contradictory thing I said.

hindi: अंतराल — दो बड़े हिस्सों के बीच का छोटा विराम या अंश
definition: a short pause or piece performed between acts or parts of a longer work or event
example: The two-week sunny interlude ended exactly when everyone booked their holidays.

hindi: शवाधान — मृत शरीर को क़ब्र में रखने की क्रिया
definition: the ceremonial burial of a dead body, placing it in a grave or tomb with rites
example: The interment of the office goldfish took place beside the car park hedge.

hindi: मध्यांतर-गीत — बड़ी रचना के बीच हल्का छोटा संगीत-अंश
definition: a short light piece of music performed between acts of an opera or between larger movements
example: The fire drill was a brief intermezzo between the budget meeting and the budget meeting's sequel.

hindi: परस्पर-घाती — अपने ही लोगों के बीच विनाशकारी संघर्ष
definition: destructive conflict fought within a single group, harming every side involved
example: The book club's internecine feud over the ending split the members into two rival WhatsApp groups.

hindi: प्रक्षेप करना — मूल पाठ में बाद में अंश जोड़ना
definition: to insert extra words or passages into a written text later, often misleadingly or without permission
example: Someone interpolated 'free pizza' into the meeting agenda, and attendance tripled.

hindi: अंतराल काल — दो शासनों के बीच का खाली समय
definition: a period between reigns or governments, when normal authority is suspended
example: During the interregnum between team leads, nobody knew who could approve leave, so everybody took some.

hindi: संकेत — अप्रत्यक्ष इशारा या पूर्वाभास
definition: an indirect hint or faint indication that makes something slowly understood
example: The first intimation of layoffs was the sudden disappearance of free snacks.

hindi: आत्मनिरीक्षण — अपने ही मन और विचारों को परखना
definition: the careful examination of one's own thoughts, motives and mental processes from within
example: A week offline brought plenty of introspection and a startling number of unread messages.

hindi: सहज बोध से जानना — बिना तर्क के भाँप लेना
definition: to understand or know something instinctively, without conscious reasoning or explicit evidence
example: The dog intuits a vet appointment the moment the car turns left instead of right.

hindi: रोगी — बीमारी या चोट से लाचार, सेवा पर आश्रित व्यक्ति
definition: a person made weak or disabled by illness or injury who needs care
example: One sprained ankle and he played the invalid for a fortnight, remote control in hand.

hindi: कटु वचन — गालियों भरी तीखी भाषा
definition: harsh, abusive and insulting speech or writing used to attack another person bitterly
example: The comment section dissolved into invective within four minutes of posting.

hindi: आक्रोश जताना — किसी के विरुद्ध कड़ी निंदा करना
definition: to speak or write bitterly and forcefully against something you strongly oppose
example: He inveighs against screen time in long posts written entirely on his phone.

hindi: बहलाकर फँसाना — छल भरी मीठी बातों से राज़ी करना
definition: to persuade someone through clever flattery or trickery into doing something
example: He inveigled me into helping him move house by calling it "a small get-together".

hindi: अलंघनीय — जिसका उल्लंघन या अतिक्रमण कभी न हो
definition: never to be broken, attacked or dishonoured; sacred, protected and beyond any challenge
example: Her rule of no meetings before ten is inviolable, and her calendar says so in capitals.

hindi: रत्ती भर — ज़रा-सा अंश
definition: an extremely small amount; named after the smallest Greek letter
example: The new update did not change one iota of the problems users actually reported.

hindi: अक्षरशः वचन — वक्ता के ठीक वही शब्द
definition: the very words exactly as spoken or written, quoted faithfully without alteration
example: Quote his ipsissima verba, because 'we'll see' is not the same as 'yes'.

hindi: स्वतः ही — उसी तथ्य से अपने आप
definition: by that fact alone, with nothing further needing to be shown
example: Missing three meetings does not ipso facto mean he has quit.

hindi: शांतिप्रिय — झगड़े के बजाय मेल चाहने वाला
definition: aiming for peace and reconciliation rather than argument, especially in religious debate
example: In a comment section full of flames, her irenic reply felt like a glass of water.

hindi: इंद्रधनुषी — कोण बदलने पर रंग बदलती चमक वाला
definition: shimmering with rainbow colours that seem to shift and change whenever the viewing angle moves
example: The iridescent oil slick in the car park was the most colourful thing in town.

hindi: विकिरित करना — प्रकाश या किरणों से भर देना
definition: to shine light or other radiation upon something, flooding every corner with brightness
example: The morning sun irradiated the kitchen and every unwashed plate within it.

hindi: निर्दोष — जिसमें कोई दोष या निंदा योग्य बात न हो
definition: so faultless in conduct that nobody could fairly blame or criticise it
example: Her conduct at the office party was irreproachable, which made her the only reliable witness.

hindi: अनिश्चयी — जो कोई पक्का फ़ैसला न ले सके
definition: unable to decide firmly, wavering between choices without settled purpose
example: The irresolute shopper returned the same jacket twice, then bought it a third time.

hindi: अश्रद्धालु — गंभीर या पूजनीय बातों को हल्के में लेने वाला
definition: showing a cheerful lack of respect for things usually taken seriously
example: The eulogy was gently irreverent, which is exactly what the old joker would have wanted.

hindi: बहिष्कृत — समाज से ठुकराया गया भटकता व्यक्ति
definition: an outcast or restless wanderer rejected by society and living beyond its borders
example: Banned from the family group chat, Uncle Ray now roams the comments section like a digital Ishmael.

hindi: समपद रचना — बराबर लंबाई और बनावट वाले वाक्यांशों की श्रृंखला
definition: a series of parallel phrases or clauses of equal length and matching grammatical structure
example: "Easy to join, hard to leave" — the gym contract's isocolon was also its business model.

hindi: परिव्राजक — रोज़ी के लिए स्थान-स्थान घूमने वाला
definition: travelling from place to place to work, rather than staying settled in one town
example: The itinerant barista now pulls espresso at a different pop-up every weekend.

hindi: ढीठ छोकरा — इतराती, बेअदब शरारतें करने वाला
definition: an impertinent, mischievous rascal who shows off with cheeky, conceited antics and saucy remarks
example: Some jackanapes replied-all with a meme to the chief executive's resignation email.

hindi: दोमुँहा — एक साथ दो विपरीत चेहरे दिखाने वाला
definition: showing two contrasting faces or attitudes, often deceitfully, toward different people
example: The Janus-faced landlord praised the tenants to their faces and billed them for the praise.

hindi: अनिर्वचनीय आकर्षण — ऐसा गुण जिसे शब्दों में बताया न जा सके
definition: an attractive, elusive quality that is difficult to describe or name exactly
example: The café has terrible chairs, slow Wi-Fi and a certain je ne sais quoi that keeps it full.

hindi: अपरिपक्व — भोला-भाला, सतही और नीरस
definition: naive and simplistic in a childish, immature manner; also dull and lacking substance
example: His jejune business plan assumed every stranger online would pay nine dollars monthly.

hindi: दोहरा व्यक्तित्व — कभी सज्जन, कभी दुष्ट
definition: a person with sharply contrasting personalities, alternately good and wickedly cruel
example: Pleasant at breakfast, he becomes a Jekyll and Hyde the moment traffic slows.

hindi: विलाप-गाथा — बुराइयों और आने वाले विनाश पर लंबा शोकपूर्ण प्रलाप
definition: a long mournful complaint lamenting present wickedness and warning of coming doom
example: His resignation email was a four-page jeremiad about the death of the office kettle.

hindi: परित्यक्त माल — जहाज़ हल्का करने को समुद्र में फेंका सामान
definition: cargo deliberately thrown overboard to lighten a ship, later washed ashore
example: Every office move leaves a beach of jetsam: broken chairs, dead monitors, one lonely cactus.

hindi: बौद्धिक विनोद — हल्की-फुल्की चतुर रचना
definition: a light, clever and witty piece of writing or playful remark, made mostly for amusement
example: Her resignation letter, written entirely in haiku, was a jeu d'esprit HR still quotes.

hindi: स्वर्णिम युवा — धनी, फ़ैशनेबल और बेफ़िक्र नौजवान वर्ग
definition: wealthy, fashionable young people from privileged families who enjoy lavish social lives
example: The jeunesse dorée arrived at the charity gala in borrowed yachts and borrowed opinions.

hindi: कुटिल स्त्री — निर्लज्ज, षड्यंत्रकारी और दुष्ट मानी गई स्त्री
definition: a shameless, scheming woman branded wicked, immoral and treacherous by her accusers
example: The tabloids branded her a Jezebel for dating a footballer, which says more about the tabloids.

hindi: अंधराष्ट्रवाद — युद्धोन्मादी उग्र देशभक्ति
definition: loud, boastful patriotism that eagerly favours threats and military aggression against other nations
example: The sports pundit's jingoism peaked when he demanded sanctions over a missed penalty.

hindi: उलटा दिलासा देने वाला — जो सांत्वना के बहाने दुख बढ़ा दे
definition: someone whose attempts at consoling a suffering person only deepen their misery
example: My Job's comforter of a friend reminded me that at least the ex looks happy now.

hindi: जीवनोल्लास — जीवन का खुला, उमंग भरा आनंद
definition: a lively, cheerful zest and hearty delight in simply being alive and enjoying life
example: Nothing tests your joie de vivre quite like a Monday morning with forty unread Slack threads.

hindi: सुंदर-असुंदर — अनोखे नैन-नक्श से उपजा आकर्षण
definition: a person whose unconventional, irregular features make them striking and attractive; French
example: The casting director wanted a jolie laide, not another interchangeable pretty face.

hindi: घुमंतू गवैया — गाँव-गाँव गीत गाकर करतब दिखाने वाला मध्यकालीन कलाकार
definition: a wandering medieval minstrel who sang songs, recited poems and performed tricks for money
example: The busker outside the station works like a jongleur, switching from ballads to juggling whenever tips slow down.

hindi: तनिक — बहुत छोटी मात्रा, कण भर
definition: a very small amount; the least possible quantity or tiniest detail of something
example: She did not care a jot what the parking app thought of her driving.

hindi: भाला-युद्ध करना — घुड़सवार योद्धाओं का आमने-सामने भिड़ना
definition: to fight on horseback with lances in a knightly contest, or figuratively to compete in argument
example: The two candidates jousted over tax policy while the moderator quietly checked the clock.

hindi: राजसी-प्रतापी — देवराज जैसा भव्य और प्रभुत्वपूर्ण
definition: majestic and commanding in the lordly, thundering manner of Jupiter, king of the gods
example: The chairman issued his Jovian verdict from the head of the table and nobody dared reply-all.

hindi: विश्वासघाती — मित्र बनकर धोखा देने वाला
definition: a traitor who betrays a trusting friend or leader, especially for personal gain
example: The Judas who leaked the surprise party plan has been banned from the snack drawer.

hindi: विवेकपूर्ण — सोच-समझकर उचित निर्णय लेने वाला
definition: showing good sense and careful, balanced judgement when deciding which course is wisest
example: A judicious use of the mute button saved the meeting and several friendships.

hindi: अजेय महाशक्ति — सब कुछ कुचलती हुई विशाल ताकत
definition: a huge, massive and unstoppable force that crushes everything standing in its path
example: The streaming juggernaut rolled into town, and the video shop became a vape store.

hindi: राजसी सुडौल — ऊँची, भव्य और गरिमामयी स्त्री
definition: tall, stately and shapely in the regal, commanding manner of the queen goddess
example: She swept into the board meeting, Junoesque in navy, and the agenda quietly rearranged itself.

hindi: सैन्य गुट — बलपूर्वक सत्ता हथियाने वाला सैनिक दल
definition: a military group ruling a country after seizing power by force
example: The three senior cousins formed a junta and seized control of the holiday itinerary by force of volume.

hindi: राष्ट्र-विधि — राष्ट्रों के बीच मान्य सामान्य नियम
definition: the legal code of nations, common rules recognised among all peoples and states
example: Some treat the queue at the airport coffee counter as jus gentium, binding on every traveller.

hindi: रक्त-अधिकार — माता-पिता से मिलने वाली नागरिकता
definition: the rule granting citizenship through the nationality of one's parents, whatever the birthplace
example: Jus sanguinis gave her an Italian passport, though her Italian stops at ordering gelato.

hindi: भूमि-अधिकार — जन्मभूमि से मिलने वाली नागरिकता
definition: the rule granting citizenship to anyone born within a country's territory, whatever the parents' nationality
example: Born during a Toronto layover, the baby picked up Canadian citizenship by jus soli before her parents picked up their bags.

hindi: सुवर्ण मध्य — ठीक संतुलन का बिंदु
definition: the happy middle point, avoiding extremes by choosing sensible balance
example: The juste milieu of thermostat settings has ended more friendships than politics.

hindi: कटु व्यंग्यात्मक — क्रोध भरा, निर्मम उपहास
definition: describing bitter, angry satire that mocks vice and corruption with savage moral ridicule, after the poet Juvenal
example: His review of the airline was fully Juvenalian, and the refund arrived within the hour.

hindi: बाल-रचनाएँ — किसी लेखक की युवावस्था की आरंभिक कृतियाँ
definition: the early writings or artworks produced by an author or artist during youth
example: Her teenage blog is juvenilia now, and she would like the internet to forget it.

hindi: गपशप-बैठकी — कॉफ़ी पर मित्रों की अनौपचारिक चर्चा
definition: an informal social gathering over coffee where friends chat and trade local gossip
example: The weekly standup has drifted into a kaffeeklatsch, and nobody has mentioned a ticket since March.

hindi: दुःस्वप्नवत् — बेतुकी, दमघोंटू और निरर्थक नौकरशाही जैसा
definition: nightmarishly confusing and absurd, like a faceless bureaucracy with baffling, pointless rules
example: Resetting the password required the old password, which made the whole process gloriously Kafkaesque.

hindi: सुअवसर — ठीक समय पर आया निर्णायक क्षण
definition: the right, fleeting moment when an action will have the greatest effect
example: She sensed the kairos and asked for the raise just after the boss praised her slides.

hindi: आत्मघाती — बिना परिणाम सोचे विनाशकारी दुस्साहस वाला
definition: recklessly self-destructive, like a wartime pilot deliberately crashing into a target
example: His kamikaze plan was to deploy the migration on Friday evening and then switch off his phone.

hindi: पाताल-यात्रा — नायक का अधोलोक में उतरना
definition: a hero's descent into the underworld, a recurring journey motif in epic literature
example: Every thriller needs a katabasis, even if the underworld is just the server room in the basement.

hindi: कठोर दंड देना — नाविक को जहाज़ के तले के नीचे घसीटना; कड़ी फटकार लगाना
definition: to punish a sailor by dragging him beneath a ship's keel, or rebuke severely
example: The editor keelhauled the reporter for spelling the mayor's name three different ways.

hindi: मृतक पर रुदन करना — ऊँचे स्वर में विलाप करते हुए शोक मनाना
definition: to wail loudly in grief over someone dead, especially in traditional mourning
example: The toddler keened over the dropped ice cream as though burying a dear friend.

hindi: समझ की सीमा — ज्ञान या दृष्टि का दायरा
definition: the range of someone's knowledge, understanding or perception, usually mentioned when something lies beyond it
example: Why the printer needs a firmware update to print one page is beyond my ken.

hindi: आत्म-रिक्तता — अपने अहं और अधिकार को स्वेच्छा से त्यागना
definition: the voluntary self-emptying of power, pride or status for the sake of others
example: Letting the junior present your work was a small kenosis, and a brilliant career move.

hindi: राजरोग — राजा के स्पर्श से ठीक होने वाली गंडमाला
definition: archaic: scrofula, swollen neck glands believed curable by the royal touch of monarchs
example: Medieval subjects queued for the king's evil cure the way fans now queue for a selfie.

hindi: सत्ता-निर्माता — जो तय करे कि गद्दी किसे मिलेगी
definition: a person whose influence decides who gains power or high office, without seeking it personally
example: The class topper, owning the only complete notes, became the kingmaker of every study group.

hindi: नियति — पहले से लिखा हुआ भाग्य
definition: fate or destiny, the fixed course of events that seems written in advance
example: Finding the last parking space outside the bakery felt less like luck than kismet.

hindi: कीर्ति — वीरता से अर्जित अमर यश
definition: glory and lasting fame won through heroic deeds and remembered in song
example: His kleos lives on in the team legend of the night he fixed production from a wedding.

hindi: चोरतंत्र — जहाँ शासक ही जनता का धन लूटें
definition: government where rulers exploit their power mainly to steal public wealth for themselves
example: The office snack fund became a kleptocracy the day the treasurer started buying himself premium cashews.

hindi: धूर्त — बेईमान और कपटी व्यक्ति
definition: archaic: a dishonest, unprincipled rogue; a deceitful scoundrel who cheats ordinary people
example: Some knave has been eating my labelled yoghurt and leaving the label.

hindi: धूर्तता — बदमाशी भरा छल
definition: dishonest trickery and roguish cheating behaviour typical of scoundrels, rogues and swindlers
example: The knavery of the fantasy football commissioner was finally exposed by spreadsheet.

hindi: कपटपूर्ण — धूर्त और बेईमानी भरा
definition: dishonest and deceitful in a crafty, unscrupulous, roguish manner, like a scheming cheat or trickster
example: The knavish small print cancelled the free trial only by fax.

hindi: मृत्यु-घंटा — मृत्यु या अंत की सूचना देती घंटी की ध्वनि
definition: the slow solemn ringing of a church bell announcing someone's death or their funeral
example: The 5pm calendar alert tolled like a knell for his unfinished to-do list.

hindi: भटकता योद्धा — साहसिक काम खोजता घूमने वाला वीर
definition: a medieval knight wandering in search of adventure, or anyone chivalrously championing causes
example: The knight-errant of the group chat rides out to correct every misattributed quote.

hindi: गाँठ-बाग़ — गुँथे नक्शे में कटी झाड़ियों की क्यारियाँ
definition: a formal garden of clipped hedges and herbs laid out in interlacing geometric patterns
example: Her desk cables now resemble a knot garden, minus the lavender and the order.

hindi: सामान्य भाषा — विभिन्न लोगों की साझा बोलचाल
definition: a common shared language that speakers of different dialects use together
example: Emoji has become the koine of family group chats across three generations.

hindi: दंडवत करना — शक्तिशाली के आगे अत्यधिक झुकना और चापलूसी करना
definition: to behave with excessive humility, flattery and obedience toward someone powerful
example: He swore he would never kowtow to the board, then laughed at every one of their jokes.

hindi: श्रेय और प्रशंसा — काम की सराहना
definition: credit and praise earned for something achieved
example: Kudos to whoever fixed the printer without telling anyone.

hindi: संस्कृति-संघर्ष — समाज में सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक मूल्यों पर कटु टकराव
definition: a bitter struggle over cultural, moral and religious values within a society
example: The neighbourhood's Kulturkampf over pineapple on pizza has now reached the council minutes.

hindi: कलाकार-विकास उपन्यास — किसी कलाकार के बनने की कथा
definition: a novel tracing an artist growing from youth into maturity and finding a creative calling
example: Her documentary about learning the cello at forty is a Künstlerroman with worse posture.

hindi: नीली बेला — सूर्यास्त के बाद का नीला उजाला
definition: French for the blue hour: twilight when the whole evening glows deep blue
example: Every photographer at the wedding vanished at l'heure bleue, leaving the cake unguarded.

hindi: परिश्रम सब पर विजय पाता है — लगातार मेहनत हर बाधा पार करती है
definition: hard work conquers everything; persistent labour overcomes every obstacle in time
example: Labor omnia vincit, said the sourdough starter's owner, on day nineteen of feeding it.

hindi: भूलभुलैया-सा — अत्यंत उलझा और जटिल
definition: intricate and confusing like a maze, with many winding passages and complications
example: The hospital's labyrinthine corridors are signposted by someone with a sense of humour.

hindi: चाकर — बिना सवाल हुक्म बजाने वाला
definition: a servant, or anyone who obeys a powerful master servilely and without question
example: Every villain in the boardroom drama has a lackey holding the laser pointer.

hindi: अल्पभाषी — बहुत कम शब्दों में बात कहने वाला
definition: using remarkably little speech, brief and plain words that state only what matters
example: Her laconic reply to the forty-message thread was simply 'No.'

hindi: वस्तुओं के आँसू — मानव जीवन और क्षति में निहित करुणा
definition: the tears of things; the sorrow woven into human life, loss and passing time
example: Clearing out his grandmother's kitchen drawer, he felt the lacrimae rerum in a stack of old ration cards.

hindi: रिक्त स्थान — पाठ में छूटा या नष्ट हुआ अंश
definition: a missing portion or blank space in a manuscript, where words were lost, damaged or never written
example: The meeting minutes have a curious lacuna right where the budget overrun was discussed.

hindi: सरोवरीय — झील से संबंधित या झील में रहने वाला
definition: relating to lakes, or living, growing and forming in or beside still lake water
example: The estate agent's 'lacustrine setting' was a pond with ambitions.

hindi: दिखावटी दानी — जो उदारता का प्रदर्शन करे और एहसान जताए
definition: woman who makes a showy, condescending public display of her generous charity
example: She played Lady Bountiful at the office, handing out leftover conference tote bags.

hindi: पिछड़ा हुआ — जो सबसे पीछे रहे और देर से पहुँचे
definition: someone who falls behind the rest of the group, always slow to arrive, finish or respond
example: The laggard of the team still hasn't updated his phone since the previous decade.

hindi: सामान्य जन — पादरी नहीं, साधारण धर्मानुयायी लोग
definition: ordinary church members who are not ordained clergy; hence people standing outside any particular profession
example: The engineers argued about tabs versus spaces while the laity in marketing simply waited for lunch.

hindi: थिरकती ज्योति वाला — दीपशिखा सी कोमल, लहराती चमक
definition: flickering softly and playing lightly over a surface, like gentle candle flame
example: Lambent candlelight made the budget spreadsheet look almost romantic.

hindi: व्यंग्य-रचना — किसी व्यक्ति का तीखा मज़ाक उड़ाने वाला लेख
definition: a piece of satirical writing that mocks and ridicules a particular person or institution
example: The intern's farewell slideshow was a gentle lampoon of every manager in the building.

hindi: निद्रा-लोक — नींद की अवस्था (मूलतः निर्वासन का देश)
definition: sleep, playfully; originally the biblical country of exile east of Eden
example: Two paragraphs into the terms and conditions, I was off to the land of Nod.

hindi: तट-दर्शन — लंबी समुद्री यात्रा के बाद पहली बार भूमि पर पहुँचना
definition: the first sighting of land, or arrival ashore, after a long voyage
example: After six hours in meetings, the lunch break felt like landfall.

hindi: थलचर — समुद्री जीवन से अनजान, ज़मीन पर रहने वाला
definition: a person unfamiliar with ships and sailing, clumsy and seasick when aboard any vessel
example: One gentle wave on the harbour cruise exposed every landlubber in the marketing team.

hindi: म्लान होना — उपेक्षा में ठहरकर कमज़ोर पड़ते जाना
definition: to weaken or remain stuck in neglected inactivity, unable to progress or move forward
example: The proposal languished in someone's drafts folder for eighteen months.

hindi: लेखनी-स्खलन — लिखते समय हुई चूक
definition: a small writing error made through haste rather than ignorance, literally a slip of the quill
example: Signing the wedding card from Accounts rather than from Us was a lapsus calami, she insisted.

hindi: जिह्वा-स्खलन — बोलते समय अनजाने में हुई भूल
definition: a slip of the tongue, an accidental spoken mistake uttered without intending or noticing it
example: Calling the client by his rival's name was a lapsus linguae that cost the deal.

hindi: चोरी — किसी की संपत्ति अवैध रूप से ले लेना
definition: crime of unlawfully taking another person's property with intent to keep it
example: Taking the last charging cable from the meeting room is larceny in all but statute.

hindi: भंडार — खाने-पीने की चीज़ें रखने की ठंडी कोठरी
definition: a cool room or large cupboard in a house where food supplies are stored and kept fresh
example: My larder is three tins of beans, a jar of pickle and a strong sense of optimism.

hindi: गृहदेवता — घर की प्रिय और आत्मीय वस्तुएँ
definition: treasured household possessions, originally the guardian gods of the Roman home
example: She packed her lares and penates: a kettle, two plants and a cat with opinions.

hindi: दानशीलता — धन या उपहारों का उदार वितरण
definition: generous giving of money or gifts, freely bestowed by someone wealthy upon grateful others
example: The CEO's largesse extended to a pizza party and a memo about belt-tightening.

hindi: डिंभावस्था का — इल्ली जैसी अविकसित प्रारंभिक अवस्था में
definition: belonging to the early wormlike stage of insects; figuratively, immature and undeveloped
example: The app was still larval, but the pitch deck described it as fully winged.

hindi: विषयासक्त — खुलेआम कामुक
definition: feeling or showing open, offensive sexual desire; lewd and lustful
example: His lascivious wink at the barista earned him decaf for life.

hindi: श्रांति — थकान से भरी सुस्ती और शिथिलता
definition: weary physical or mental tiredness that leaves someone sluggish and lacking energy
example: A deep August lassitude settled over the office, where even the printer seemed to nap.

hindi: सराहना करना — किसी की प्रशंसा करना, विशेषकर सार्वजनिक रूप से
definition: to praise someone or something highly, especially in public writing or speech
example: Critics lauded the film's restraint, which is a polite way of saying nothing explodes.

hindi: श्लाघ्य — प्रशंसा के योग्य
definition: deserving praise and admiration for good intentions, even when the result falls short
example: His laudable plan to wake at five survived precisely one morning.

hindi: अफ़ीम-आसव — अफ़ीम का मद्यसार घोल
definition: a tincture of opium dissolved in alcohol, once freely sold as a soothing household medicine
example: Victorian poets took laudanum for inspiration; we take a third espresso and hope.

hindi: अतीत-प्रशंसक — बीते ज़माने का गुणगान करने वाला
definition: a person who constantly praises bygone times and complains about present days
example: Every family has a laudator temporis acti who insists music died in 1979.

hindi: प्रशंसात्मक — प्रशंसा और सराहना से भरा हुआ
definition: expressing warm praise and admiration, especially in formal speeches, written tributes or reviews
example: The reviews were so laudatory that the author suspected her mother of writing them.

hindi: कीर्ति — पूर्व उपलब्धियों से अर्जित सम्मान
definition: honours earned by past achievement and enjoyed ever since
example: Two hits in a decade, and he has been resting on his laurels for nine years of it.

hindi: निठल्ला — जो काम करने के बजाय पड़ा रहता है
definition: a lazy person who avoids work and spends days lounging about doing nothing
example: The layabout insisted he was 'between opportunities', mostly between cushions.

hindi: संगरोधालय — रोगियों को अलग रखने का भवन
definition: a hospital or quarantine building for people with plague, leprosy or infectious disease
example: The team's one sick coder was banished to the meeting room, now nicknamed the lazaretto.

hindi: पुनर्जीवित — जो विनाश या मृत्यु से वापस लौट आए
definition: someone or something restored to life or success after seeming finished
example: The discontinued sneaker made a Lazarus comeback and sold out in eleven minutes.

hindi: चरागाह — घास से भरा खुला खेत
definition: literary: an open grassy field or meadow, often used for grazing cattle and sheep
example: The poet's lea is today's overflow car park for the garden centre.

hindi: कामुक व्यक्ति — जो स्त्रियों पर भद्दी कामना रखता है
definition: a lustful fellow who shows excessive, openly offensive sexual desire toward women
example: HR's new policy was written, clause by clause, around one particular lecher.

hindi: वाचन-पीठ — खड़े होकर पढ़ने की ढलवाँ मेज़
definition: a tall stand with a sloping surface that holds a book for reading aloud
example: The best man gripped the lectern like a lifeboat and read his toast off a phone at full brightness.

hindi: अनुवात — हवा से आड़ वाली ओर
definition: facing away from the wind, on the sheltered, protected side of a ship or island
example: She parked her laptop on the leeward side of the café, safe from the air conditioner.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि-दूत — पोप या शासक का आधिकारिक प्रतिनिधि
definition: official envoy sent abroad to represent the Pope or a ruler in formal negotiations
example: The head office sent a legate to our branch, armed with slides and a lanyard.

hindi: प्रवाही-स्वर — स्वरों को बिना टूटे जोड़कर बजाया गया
definition: with musical notes played smoothly and connected, flowing together without breaks between them
example: The pilot's legato announcement glided over the turbulence as though nothing were shaking.

hindi: हाथ की सफ़ाई — चालाकी भरी जादूगरी या धोखा
definition: skilful sleight of hand, or clever deceptive trickery that fools watching people
example: By some accounting legerdemain, the project was both over budget and under it.

hindi: अपार — इतना अधिक कि गिनती कठिन हो
