definition: very large in number; countless, like a whole marching army
example: His excuses for missing the gym are legion and impressively creative.

hindi: मूल-धुन — बार-बार लौटने वाला पहचान-स्वर या विषय
definition: a recurring musical phrase linked to a character, idea or theme, returning throughout
example: Complaints about the office thermostat are the leitmotif of every staff survey.

hindi: सिंहसदृश — शेर जैसा रोबदार, घने केशों वाला और निडर
definition: like lions; majestic, proud, bold and often crowned with thick flowing hair
example: The conductor tossed his leonine mane before the final crescendo.

hindi: कहीं ऐसा न हो कि — इस डर से कि
definition: formal conjunction meaning for fear that, or to prevent something unwelcome happening
example: Save your document every minute, lest the laptop decide today is the day it quits.

hindi: शिथिल — सुस्त, ऊर्जाहीन और निष्क्रिय
definition: sluggish and drowsy, lacking energy, enthusiasm or the strength to take action
example: The lethargic Wi-Fi loaded each email like it was being delivered by hand.

hindi: विस्मृतिकारी — सब कुछ भुला देने वाला
definition: causing forgetfulness or oblivion, like the underworld river whose water erased memory
example: The Lethean effect of a long weekend wiped every password from her head.

hindi: शिक्षित — पुस्तकों और साहित्य का जानकार
definition: educated and knowledgeable through wide reading of books, poetry and literature
example: He was lettered enough to quote Milton and still misspell 'definitely'.

hindi: प्रातः दर्शन — सुबह का राजसी स्वागत-समारोह
definition: a formal morning reception held by a monarch or dignitary, originally upon rising from sleep
example: Her morning video calls from bed, tousled and holding court, amount to a modern levee.

hindi: महाकाय — अपार आकार और शक्ति वाली कोई चीज़ या संस्था
definition: something of enormous size and overwhelming power, such as a vast state or company
example: The permit office is a leviathan that swallows forms whole and returns only queue numbers.

hindi: प्रतिकार का नियम — जैसा अपराध वैसा दंड, आँख के बदले आँख
definition: ancient principle that punishment should exactly mirror the crime, repaying each injury with identical injury
example: The siblings settled the stolen fries by lex talionis, fry for fry.

hindi: कोशकार — शब्दकोश रचने वाला विद्वान
definition: a scholar who compiles dictionaries, recording the meanings, origins and usage of words
example: A lexicographer's quiet revenge is deciding, each year, which of your slang is finally respectable.

hindi: गुप्त संबंध — अवैध या छिपा प्रेम-संबंध
definition: a secret romantic or sexual relationship, especially one conducted outside marriage and kept hidden
example: The liaison stayed hidden until both lovers liked the same beach photo.

hindi: तर्पण — देवता को अर्पित पेय; कोई भी मदिरा-पेय
definition: wine or other liquid poured out as a religious offering to gods; hence, playfully, any alcoholic drink
example: After the launch the team retired to the pub for well-earned libations.

hindi: उदारता — खुले हाथ से देने का स्वभाव
definition: quality of giving freely and generously; open-handed, bountiful generosity
example: Her liberality with office supplies made her the most popular person on the floor.

hindi: स्वच्छंद भोगी — नैतिक बंधन न मानने वाला विलासी
definition: a person who freely pursues sensual pleasure, ignoring moral and religious restraint
example: He styles himself a libertine, though his wildest habit is ordering dessert first.

hindi: कामातुर — प्रबल यौन इच्छा से भरा
definition: showing strong sexual desire; full of lustful appetite that seeks constant pleasure
example: The novel's libidinous duke was cut from the film to secure a family rating.

hindi: गीत-नाट्य पाठ — ओपेरा या संगीत-नाटक के शब्द
definition: the written words and story of an opera or musical, as opposed to the music itself
example: The libretto of the office musical rhymed "deliverable" with "unbelievable" twice.

hindi: स्वेच्छाचारी — कामुक और मर्यादाहीन
definition: disregarding moral rules, especially sexual ones; lustful, unrestrained and openly scornful of decency
example: The Victorian reviewer called the novel licentious, which guaranteed it sold out.

hindi: तलवे चाटने वाला — आत्मसम्मान छोड़कर चापलूसी करने वाला
definition: a contemptible, grovelling person who flatters powerful people without any self-respect
example: The minister's lickspittles applauded the budget before reading the first page.

hindi: स्वामी — राजा, जिसके प्रति निष्ठा हो
definition: archaic: a lord or sovereign owed loyalty and service by followers; also such a loyal subject
example: The cat surveyed the sofa like a liege surveying his serfs.

hindi: हाथ का साफ़ — चुपके से चीज़ें उठा लेने का आदी
definition: given to petty stealing, quick to pocket things that belong to others
example: The office has one light-fingered colleague, and every missing stapler points to the same desk.

hindi: बौना-सा — अत्यंत छोटा या तुच्छ
definition: extremely small or tiny, or petty and trivial in outlook, importance or ambition
example: The hotel's Lilliputian bathroom required showering sideways.

hindi: डरपोक — जिसमें ज़रा भी हिम्मत न हो
definition: cowardly and weak, lacking courage and easily afraid of danger or trouble
example: Only the lily-livered skipped the office's first group spin class.

hindi: पंचपदी हास्य-कविता — पाँच पंक्तियों की चुटीली तुकबंदी
definition: a humorous five-line comic verse with a bouncing rhythm and rhymes, often absurd or cheeky
example: He resigned by limerick, and the last line rhymed 'Nantucket' with something unprintable.

hindi: निर्मल — एकदम साफ़ और पारदर्शी
definition: perfectly clear and transparent, like still water easily seen through to the bottom
example: The spa pool was limpid enough to reveal every coin, hairpin and regret at the bottom.

hindi: मालिश-तेल — दर्द में मलने वाला द्रव
definition: a medicated liquid rubbed into skin to ease aching muscles and stiff joints
example: After his first spin class he smelled of liniment and regret.

hindi: सिंहहृदय — शेर जैसा निर्भीक
definition: exceptionally brave, showing the fearless courage of a lion when facing danger
example: The lionhearted barista told the queue that the card machine was down.

hindi: सिर-आँखों पर बिठाना — किसी को प्रसिद्ध हस्ती की तरह सम्मान देना
definition: to treat someone as a celebrity, praising them with great public attention and admiring fuss
example: The town lionized the local baker after one viral video about sourdough.

hindi: लचीला-छरहरा — पतला और सहज गति वाला
definition: slim, supple and graceful in figure and movement, bending with easy elegance
example: The lissom dancer made the office conga line look like choreography.

hindi: स्तोत्रमाला — प्रार्थनाओं की लंबी दोहराई सूची; शिकायतों की लंबी झड़ी
definition: a long repeated series of prayers or appeals; hence any tediously long recital
example: The landlord listened to a litany of complaints, then fixed exactly one of them.

hindi: साहित्यकार वर्ग — पढ़े-लिखे विद्वानों का समूह
definition: the educated literary class; writers, critics and scholars who shape literary taste and opinion
example: The literati gathered at the launch party and spent an hour discussing everything except the book.

hindi: मुकदमेबाज़ — बात-बात पर अदालत जाने को तत्पर
definition: quick to argue through lawyers, eager to settle every quarrel with a lawsuit
example: Our litigious neighbour sent a formal notice about a hedge that is, generously, eleven centimetres over.

hindi: निषेधोक्ति — उलटे का नकार करके बात को संयमित ढंग से कहना
definition: understatement that affirms something by denying its opposite, as in calling disaster 'not ideal'
example: Losing the entire database was, the engineer conceded in pure litotes, "not our finest hour."

hindi: साहित्यसेवी — साहित्य रचने और परखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person devoted to literature, especially a professional writer of literary works
example: Every café in the neighbourhood now hosts one laptop litterateur per table.

hindi: समुद्रतटीय — समुद्र या झील के किनारे से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the shore of an ocean or lake, the coastal strip beside water
example: Our littoral holiday mostly involved guarding sandwiches from seagulls.

hindi: धर्मविधि — सार्वजनिक पूजा का निर्धारित क्रम और पाठ
definition: the fixed, formal order of words and actions used in public church worship
example: The Monday stand-up has become a liturgy: yesterday, today, blockers, and a collective sigh.

hindi: वर्दी — किसी घराने या संस्था के सेवकों की विशेष पोशाक
definition: distinctive uniform worn by servants or employees, marking them as belonging to a household or company
example: The delivery riders zip past in company livery, walking billboards on two wheels.

hindi: देखो — ध्यान से देखो, आश्चर्य
definition: archaic: look, behold, watch closely; used to announce something surprising that suddenly appears
example: I said the tests would pass, and lo, they failed on a missing comma.

hindi: चमत्कारी बहुलता — थोड़ी सामग्री से बहुतों की ज़रूरत पूरी करना
definition: a small supply that miraculously stretches to feed or serve a great many people
example: One lasagne fed twelve guests, a loaves and fishes moment nobody can explain.

hindi: रमणीय स्थल — छाया, जल और घास वाला आदर्श मनोहर स्थान
definition: an idealised pleasant place of shade, water and grass, a stock setting of pastoral poetry
example: The park bench by the fountain is the whole team's locus amoenus, weather permitting.

hindi: वाद-अधिकार — मामला उठाने का कानूनी हक़
definition: the legal right to bring a case, because the matter affects you directly
example: The neighbour's cat has no locus standi in our balcony dispute, yet sits there daily.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा — दिशा दिखाने वाला तारा; मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत
definition: a star, usually Polaris, that guides navigators at night; hence any guiding principle or example
example: Customer delight is the company's lodestar, at least on the slide deck.

hindi: डेरा — किराये का रहने का कमरा
definition: rented rooms where someone lives, usually inside another person's house, a temporary dwelling
example: His lodgings for the conference were a sofa bed and a cat with firm opinions about sofa beds.

hindi: झरोखेदार दालान — एक ओर से खुली, ऊपरी मंज़िल की छतदार दीर्घा
definition: a roofed gallery open along one side, usually on an upper floor, overlooking a garden or square
example: The villa's loggia was designed for sunset aperitifs, though ours mostly hosts the drying laundry.

hindi: शब्दप्रेमी — शब्दों पर मुग्ध रहने वाला
definition: a devoted lover of words who delights in their meanings, origins and curious spellings
example: The logophile lost the office spelling bee on purpose, then corrected the winner's acceptance speech.

hindi: अतिवाचालता — शब्दों की रुकने न वाली बाढ़
definition: excessive, uncontrollable talking or writing that pours words out with little real content
example: The CEO's all-hands logorrhea ran ninety minutes and contained one actual announcement.

hindi: पसरना — ढीले-ढाले ढंग से आराम से पड़े रहना
definition: to lounge, sprawl or recline lazily in a relaxed, loose and careless posture
example: The teenagers lolled across the sofa like spilled laundry.

hindi: चिरसहिष्णु — लंबे समय तक चुपचाप कष्ट सहने वाला
definition: patiently enduring annoyance, trouble or hardship for a very long time without complaint
example: Her long-suffering flatmate has heard the same playlist every morning since March.

hindi: वाचाल — बहुत अधिक और लगातार बोलने वाला
definition: talking a great deal, easily and constantly, often more than listeners would like
example: The loquacious driver covered his divorce, his diet and three conspiracy theories before the second traffic light.

hindi: प्रेम-छलिया — स्त्रियों को बहकाने वाला रसिक
definition: a charming seducer of women who makes romantic conquests without any lasting commitment
example: The office Lothario had a separate playlist for every floor of the building.

hindi: विलासी आलसी — सुख में डूबा, कर्तव्य भूला व्यक्ति
definition: someone living in dreamy, pleasant indolence, forgetting duties and ambitions entirely
example: Three months into the sabbatical, he had become a contented lotus-eater with a hammock.

hindi: संदिग्ध — कुछ बदनाम और अविश्वसनीय-सा
definition: disreputable and shady in a slightly seedy, suspicious and improper manner that invites distrust
example: The crypto conference had a louche charm, like a casino that also sold motivational books.

hindi: साधारण कुल का — आम घराने में जन्मा
definition: born into a humble family of common people rather than wealth or rank
example: The lowborn hero of every biopic somehow owns a very good leather jacket.

hindi: कामोत्तेजक — लंपट और अश्लीलता की ओर झुका
definition: lewd and lustful; slyly suggestive of sexual desire in a slippery, knowing manner
example: The critic called the perfume advert lubricious, which only doubled its sales.

hindi: स्पष्ट — साफ़ समझ आने वाला, या सजग और होश में
definition: expressed clearly and simply enough to understand easily, or thinking with a sharp, alert mind
example: He is most lucid between the second coffee and the first meeting.

hindi: स्पष्टता — विचार या भाषा की निर्मलता
definition: clearness of thought or expression that makes ideas simple to follow and understand
example: The intern's two-line email had a lucidity the entire strategy deck lacked.

hindi: लाभप्रद — बहुत पैसा या मुनाफ़ा देने वाला
definition: producing plenty of money or profit; highly rewarding in financial terms
example: Selling shovels turned out more lucrative than digging for the gold.

hindi: लोभ का धन — अनुचित ढंग से या लालच में कमाया पैसा
definition: money or profit, especially when gained dishonestly or valued too greedily above honour
example: He called the crypto scheme a passion project, but it ran entirely on lucre.

hindi: रात्रि-साधना — देर रात तक किया गया कठिन अध्ययन
definition: laborious study or writing done late into the night, often producing learned, heavy prose
example: His lucubrations, fuelled by cold brew, produced a thesis nobody finished reading.

hindi: राजसी — अत्यंत भव्य और विलासपूर्ण (भोज)
definition: lavish and luxurious, especially of a feast, after the wealthy Roman general Lucullus
example: The startup's Lucullan launch dinner cost more than its first year of revenue.

hindi: प्रौद्योगिकी-विरोधी — नई मशीनों और तकनीक का विरोधी
definition: someone opposing modern technology or machines, preferring older methods and familiar tools
example: Grandma, a proud Luddite, answers every text with a handwritten letter.

hindi: शोकाकुल-सा — अतिरंजित रूप से उदास और मातमी
definition: exaggeratedly gloomy and mournful in look or sound, often in a slightly comic manner
example: The basset hound gave me a lugubrious look when the walk was cut short.

hindi: दिग्गज — अपने क्षेत्र में प्रकाश-स्तंभ जैसा प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose learning and achievement make them famous, admired and inspiring within their field
example: The conference booked three luminaries and one projector that worked.

hindi: वृकवत्‌ — भेड़िये जैसा भूखा, हिंसक और झुंड में शिकार करने वाला
definition: like wolves; hungry, fierce, predatory and hunting together with the pack
example: Lupine investors circled the struggling startup, waiting politely for the down round.

hindi: चमकीला — चिकनी सतह की गहरी दमक वाला
definition: having a smooth, soft shimmering gleam that reflects light richly
example: The shampoo advert promised lustrous hair; it delivered a lustrous bathroom floor.

hindi: प्रकृति-कौतुक — प्रकृति की विचित्र, असामान्य रचना
definition: a freak of nature, a strange living thing departing wildly from its usual form
example: The two-headed tomato from her allotment was hailed as a lusus naturae and promptly photographed for Instagram.

hindi: सघन — भरपूर और तेज़ी से फैलती हरियाली वाला
definition: growing thickly, richly and abundantly, like dense green plants spreading everywhere
example: The office ficus grew luxuriant the moment everyone started working from home.

hindi: सुख में डूबना — आराम का भरपूर आनंद लेना
definition: to take great, lingering pleasure in comfort or luxury, enjoying every moment
example: She luxuriated in the hotel bathrobe until checkout became a negotiation.

hindi: मानव-भेड़िया — भेड़िये में बदल जाने वाला मनुष्य
definition: a werewolf; a person believed able to change into a wolf by magic or curse
example: Deprive him of coffee before nine and the mild accountant turns lycanthrope.

hindi: विद्यापीठ — व्याख्यान और शिक्षा का केंद्र
definition: a hall, school or institution for public lectures, learned discussion and instruction
example: The neighbourhood library became a lyceum on Thursdays, with lectures and suspiciously good biscuits.

hindi: तीक्ष्णदृष्टि — बाज़ जैसी पैनी नज़र वाला
definition: having extremely sharp sight, able to spot tiny details that others overlook
example: A lynx-eyed proofreader found the typo in the company's own name.

hindi: राजापमान — शासक की गरिमा का अपमान या अनादर
definition: the offence of insulting a monarch or ruler; loosely, disrespect toward anyone self-important
example: Correcting the professor's grammar in front of the class was treated as outright lèse-majesté.

hindi: वीभत्स — मृत्यु और भयावहता से जुड़ा, डरावना
definition: grim and disturbing because it dwells on death, corpses, graves or gruesome horror
example: The children built a macabre scarecrow from their father's worst ties.

hindi: कुटिल नीतिज्ञ — स्वार्थ के लिए छल-कपट से चालें चलने वाला
definition: cunning and scheming, using deceit and manipulation to gain or keep power
example: The Machiavellian intern booked every meeting room and then graciously offered to share.

hindi: मर्दानगी का दंभ — कठोरता और ताक़त पर अतिरंजित गर्व
definition: exaggerated, aggressive masculine pride in toughness, physical strength and dominance
example: Refusing to ask for directions is machismo; the satnav sighing at him is justice.

hindi: खिलंदड़ा — बेतहाशा, लापरवाह और मनमौजी
definition: wildly reckless and impulsive, rushing into foolish, crazy schemes with amusing daring
example: Their madcap plan to cycle to the wedding ended at a railway station.

hindi: कला-संरक्षक — कलाकारों को उदारता से धन देने वाला
definition: a generous patron funding artists and writers, named after a wealthy Roman statesman
example: Every indie game studio dreams of a Maecenas; most get a Kickstarter and a prayer.

hindi: भँवर — विनाशकारी उथल-पुथल का तेज़ चक्रवात
definition: a powerful violent whirlpool, or a situation of churning turmoil that drags everyone inside
example: The launch week was a maelstrom of bug reports, reviews and caffeine.

hindi: उन्मत्त स्त्री — आवेश में बेकाबू और उग्र नारी
definition: a frenzied woman wild with passion, like the raving female followers of Dionysus
example: At the clearance sale, three maenads fought over the last discounted handbag.

hindi: संगीताचार्य — महान संगीतकार या संचालक; किसी कला का उस्ताद
definition: a distinguished conductor or composer of music; hence any acknowledged master of a craft
example: The barista is a maestro of foam, and he knows it.

hindi: उच्च सम्मान सहित — विशिष्ट योग्यता के साथ उत्तीर्ण
definition: with great honour, marking a university degree earned with high distinction
example: She graduated magna cum laude and still cannot fold a fitted sheet.

hindi: उदारमनस्कता — विरोधी के प्रति भी दिखाया गया बड़प्पन
definition: generosity of spirit, especially toward a rival or a beaten foe
example: His magnanimity in defeat won him more supporters than the campaign ever had.

hindi: उद्योगपति — किसी क्षेत्र का धनाढ्य दिग्गज
definition: a wealthy and powerful person dominating a particular industry or business sector
example: The shipping magnate owns forty ports and still contests the parking ticket.

hindi: महिमा गाना — ईश्वर या किसी महान की स्तुति करना
definition: archaic: to praise and glorify someone, especially the Almighty, in solemn worship, prayer or song
example: Our choir magnifies the Lord every Sunday and the coffee urn every Sunday afterwards.

hindi: अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण वक्ता — भव्य और दिखावटी भाषा में बोलने वाला
definition: speaking or writing in lofty, grand, pompous language meant to impress listeners
example: The magniloquent wine review praised "notes of forgotten orchards" in an eight-dollar bottle.

hindi: कृति-शिरोमणि — जीवन भर का सबसे बड़ा और श्रेष्ठ काम
definition: the greatest work of an artist's or writer's life
example: Forty years of notes finally became a magnum opus nobody could lift.

hindi: मायावी मुनि — प्राचीन ज्ञानी जादूगर या ज्योतिषी
definition: a member of an ancient Persian priestly caste of learned sages; a sorcerer or skilled magician
example: The spreadsheet magus in finance can make any number balance, which worries the auditors.

hindi: मंत्रणा-सभा — विचार-विमर्श हेतु बैठक या परिषद
definition: a council or gathering in Arab and Persian cultures where people meet to discuss matters
example: The family's weekend majlis on WhatsApp settled the wedding menu before anyone asked the couple.

hindi: गृह-प्रबंधक — बड़े घर के नौकरों का मुखिया
definition: the chief steward who manages the household affairs and servants of a great noble house
example: The smart speaker has become the household majordomo, and it still cannot find the remote.

hindi: दीर्घाक्षर — पांडुलिपि के बड़े अक्षर
definition: a large letter, capital or uncial, used in manuscripts before small letters developed
example: Her texts arrive entirely in majuscule, so every grocery reminder reads like a royal decree.

hindi: दुर्भावना — बेईमान इरादे से किया गया काम
definition: literally 'with evil faith': acting with dishonest intent to deceive while pretending honesty
example: Agreeing to the meeting and then muting yourself for an hour is negotiation in mala fides.

hindi: अकुशल — भद्दे ढंग से काम बिगाड़ने वाला
definition: clumsy and tactless in handling people or situations, lacking skill and grace
example: The maladroit press release apologised for the leak while leaking something else.

hindi: व्याधि — रोग, बीमारी
definition: a disease or illness of the body or mind, often a serious, stubborn or lasting one
example: Doomscrolling is the malady of the age, and the cure sits in the settings menu.

hindi: शब्द-भ्रम — मिलते-जुलते शब्द का हास्यास्पद ग़लत प्रयोग
definition: the comic mistaken choice of a similar-sounding word instead of the intended correct word
example: Calling the project 'a real escape goat' was his finest malapropism yet.

hindi: अभिशाप — किसी के अनिष्ट की कामना
definition: a solemn curse, or spoken words wishing misfortune and harm upon someone
example: The malediction she muttered at the self-checkout machine would have impressed a medieval witch.

hindi: दुष्कर्मी — अपराध या बुरा काम करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: person who commits crimes or does serious wrong, especially against others
example: The office malefactor who microwaves fish at noon remains, officially, unidentified.

hindi: पदीय दुराचार — सरकारी या अधिकृत पद पर रहते हुए गैरकानूनी काम
definition: wrongful or unlawful action by someone holding public office or trusted authority
example: The audit found no malfeasance, just a treasurer who thought receipts were optional.

hindi: पूर्वनियोजित द्वेष — पहले से सोचा-समझा हानि पहुँचाने का इरादा
definition: intention to cause serious harm formed before acting, which legally marks a killing as murder
example: He scheduled the meeting for Friday at five with obvious malice aforethought.

hindi: बदनाम करना — किसी के बारे में बुरा-भला कहना
definition: speak harmful, usually false things about another person to damage their good reputation unfairly
example: Pineapple on pizza has been maligned for decades by people who have never tried it.

hindi: बीमारी का बहाना करना — काम से बचने को ढोंग करना
definition: to pretend or exaggerate illness deceitfully in order to avoid work, school or duty
example: He malingered through Monday and made a miraculous recovery for Friday drinks.

hindi: बहानेबाज़ — काम से बचने को बीमारी का ढोंग करने वाला
definition: a person who pretends sickness or exaggerates minor complaints in order to avoid work or duty
example: The malingerer's sick day ended abruptly when he appeared on the stadium big screen.

hindi: दुर्गंधित — बुरी गंध वाला
definition: having an unpleasant, offensive smell that makes nearby people wrinkle their noses and step back
example: The malodorous microwave fish sparked the longest thread in company chat history.

hindi: धनदेवता — लालच और भौतिक धन की पूजा
definition: wealth worshipped as an evil idol, the greedy pursuit of riches above everything
example: The festival sold its soul to Mammon one sponsored tent at a time.

hindi: साहित्य-मनीषी — लेखक और विद्वान
definition: a scholarly writer or learned person whose whole life is devoted to literature, books and ideas
example: A true man of letters, he answers texts with three-paragraph essays.

hindi: रणपोत — तोपों से सुसज्जित बड़ा युद्धपोत
definition: a heavily armed sailing warship belonging to a nation's fighting fleet
example: She walked into the budget meeting with the quiet menace of a man-of-war.

hindi: उच्च अधिकारी — प्रभावशाली, नौकरशाह वर्ग का सदस्य
definition: a powerful senior official, especially a bureaucrat thought remote and self-important
example: The ministry mandarins read the minister's bold plan and gently returned it with seventeen questions.

hindi: उन्माद — जुनूनी सनक या उत्तेजना
definition: an obsessive enthusiasm that takes hold of a person or a crowd
example: The office caught a brief mania for standing desks, then quietly sat back down.

hindi: संकेत-हस्त — हाशिये में बना इशारा करता हाथ
definition: a small drawn hand with pointing finger in a margin, directing readers toward an important passage
example: Medieval readers drew manicules beside the good bits; we screenshot them and never look again.

hindi: विविध — अनेक प्रकार का, कई रूपों वाला
definition: many and varied; existing in numerous different kinds, forms or aspects at once
example: The benefits of a nap are manifold, and I intend to list them after one.

hindi: दैवी वरदान — अचानक और अप्रत्याशित रूप से मिली राहत या सहायता
definition: an unexpected, welcome supply of help or nourishment that arrives as though from heaven
example: The leftover conference sandwiches were manna to the starving interns.

hindi: सलीक़ेदार — अच्छे तौर-तरीक़े वाला
definition: showing good manners, polite behaviour and respectful courtesy toward others
example: The mannerly toddler said please before demanding a third biscuit.

hindi: असफल-साधक — जो बनना था पर बन न सका
definition: having failed to become the artist or professional that one's talent or calling once promised
example: Every standup meeting has a novelist manqué who narrates the sprint like a Russian tragedy.

hindi: पुरोहित-भवन — चर्च द्वारा पादरी को दिया गया निवास
definition: the house a Scottish or Presbyterian church provides for its minister and family to live in
example: The old manse is now an Airbnb, and the guest book reads like a confession box.

hindi: लघु प्रतिरूप — मूर्ति या भवन का छोटा प्रारंभिक नमूना
definition: a small preliminary model of a sculpture or building made before the full work
example: The architect's maquette showed a sunny plaza; the finished building delivered a wind tunnel.

hindi: लंबी थकाऊ दौड़ — सहनशक्ति की परीक्षा
definition: an endurance test of exhausting length
example: The budget session became a marathon: nineteen hours and one working microphone.

hindi: लुटेरा — लूटमार करता घूमने वाला आक्रमणकारी
definition: armed raider who roams about attacking villages and plundering whatever valuables they find
example: A marauder in pyjamas raided the leftover pizza at three in the morning.

hindi: हाशिया-टिप्पणियाँ — किताब के किनारों पर लिखे नोट
definition: handwritten notes, comments and doodles that readers leave in the margins of a book's pages
example: The library copy's marginalia were funnier than the novel itself.

hindi: सुविधा का विवाह — प्रेम नहीं, लाभ के लिए किया गया संबंध
definition: a marriage or partnership formed for practical advantage, money or status rather than love
example: The merger of the two rival apps was a mariage de convenance with separate servers.

hindi: नाविक — समुद्र में जहाज़ चलाने वाला
definition: a sailor, especially one who navigates ships and steers voyages across open oceans
example: After one weekend kayaking, he started calling himself a seasoned mariner.

hindi: सामुद्रिक — समुद्र, जहाज़रानी और तटीय व्यापार से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the ocean, seagoing ships, coastal trade and naval commerce
example: The new office calls its break room a maritime lounge because someone hung a single oar on the wall.

hindi: कलंक-चिह्न — किसी अपराध या पाप का स्थायी दाग
definition: a lasting, visible sign of disgrace or guilt that brands someone a shunned outcast
example: That single bad review follows the restaurant around like the mark of Cain.

hindi: निर्जन में छोड़ना — किसी को सुनसान द्वीप पर अकेला छोड़ देना
definition: to abandon someone alone on a deserted island or remote, isolated place without rescue
example: The cancelled train marooned forty commuters at a station with one vending machine.

hindi: रणसंबंधी — युद्ध या सैनिक से जुड़ा
definition: having to do with war, or befitting a soldier
example: The parade ended with martial drums and a very civilian queue for tea.

hindi: कठोर अनुशासनप्रिय — नियमों का सख़्ती से पालन कराने वाला
definition: a strict, severe disciplinarian who demands rigid obedience to every rule and procedure
example: The new manager, a martinet, timed bathroom breaks with a stopwatch.

hindi: दरबारी नृत्य-नाटिका — मुखौटों, संगीत और भव्य दृश्यों वाला मंचन
definition: a lavish courtly entertainment of the seventeenth century combining masked dancers, music, poetry and spectacle
example: The company gala felt like a Jacobean masque, only with lanyards instead of masks.

hindi: लाजवाब — जिसका कोई जोड़ न हो
definition: without equal or rival; better than every other example of its kind anywhere
example: Grandma's biryani is matchless, a fact she mentions at every wedding.

hindi: कुलमाता — परिवार की स्त्री मुखिया
definition: the female head of a household or family, holding traditional authority over all its members
example: As materfamilias she approves every holiday plan, usually after quietly rewriting it.

hindi: औषधकोश — दवाओं के गुणों का ज्ञान
definition: the whole body of knowledge about medicinal substances, their sources, preparation and practical uses
example: Her bathroom cabinet has grown into a full materia medica of expired antihistamines.

hindi: प्रातःकालीन — सुबह-सवेरे का
definition: relating to morning; happening or active early, during the first hours after dawn
example: His matutinal cheerfulness is admirable in theory and unbearable before coffee.

hindi: भटकती बातें करना — बेतरतीब, बेमक़सद बोलते जाना
definition: talk in a rambling, aimless and incoherent manner, wandering between topics
example: He maundered through his wedding speech until the DJ mercifully started the music.

hindi: मक़बरा — भव्य समाधि-भवन
definition: a grand building raised to house a tomb
example: The empty mall has the hush of a mausoleum with escalators.

hindi: बुरी घड़ी — थोड़ी देर का अप्रिय, शर्मनाक अनुभव
definition: a brief but thoroughly unpleasant or embarrassing experience that must simply be endured
example: The quarterly review with the auditor was a mauvais quart d'heure, stretched somehow to ninety minutes.

hindi: पारखी — जानकार विशेषज्ञ जो ख़ुशी से ज्ञान बाँटे
definition: a trusted expert who eagerly gathers knowledge in a field and happily shares it
example: The office keyboard maven has opinions about switches that nobody asked for and everybody now holds.

hindi: शायद — हो सकता है, कदाचित
definition: archaic: perhaps, possibly, conceivably; something might happen by chance, though nobody promises it
example: Mayhap the bus will arrive on time, and mayhap pigs will commute.

hindi: कल देखेंगे — ढीले-ढाले ढंग से काम को किसी और दिन पर टालना
definition: Spanish for tomorrow, used for a relaxed habit of putting things off indefinitely
example: Filing taxes follows a strict mañana policy until the reminder email turns red.

hindi: मेरी भूल — अपनी गलती की खुली स्वीकारोक्ति
definition: an open admission that the fault was your own
example: The apology began as a mea culpa and ended up blaming the vendor.

hindi: घास का मैदान — फूलों और घास से भरा खुला खेत
definition: archaic: a meadow, an open grassy field scattered with wild flowers
example: The festival sold 'mead' in the mead, and nobody could tell which one the sign meant.

hindi: अल्प — कम और अपर्याप्त, दरिद्र-सा
definition: lacking in quantity or quality; small, thin, scanty and barely sufficient for needs
example: The hotel called it a continental breakfast; it was a meagre croissant and hope.

hindi: बल खाते बहना — घुमावदार, बिना सीधी दिशा के चलना
definition: follow a winding, wandering course like a slow river; named after the twisting Maeander river
example: The meeting meandered from budgets to biscuits and never found its way back.

hindi: ध्यान-चिंतन — गंभीर विषय पर गहरा विचार
definition: long serious thinking about a weighty subject, or a written reflection exploring such thoughts
example: His essay was billed as a meditation on solitude and was mostly about losing his headphones.

hindi: अधकपारी — आधे सिर का तेज़ दर्द
definition: archaic: a severe one-sided headache, the older English name for migraine
example: Three hours of spreadsheet reconciliation brought on a megrim worthy of a Brontë heroine.

hindi: सुमधुर — शहद-सी मीठी, बहती हुई आवाज़ वाला
definition: sounding sweet and smooth, pleasant and gentle to hear, flowing like honey
example: The podcast host's mellifluous voice could make a terms-of-service update sound like a bedtime story.

hindi: सुरीला — मधुर धुन से भरा, सुनने में सुखद
definition: having a pleasant, tuneful sound, sweet and musical to hear, full of melody
example: The kettle's melodious whistle was the only cheerful voice in the house before coffee.

hindi: अति-नाटक — अतिरंजित भावनाओं वाला सनसनीखेज़ नाटक
definition: a sensational drama with exaggerated characters and extravagant plot twists designed to stir strong reactions
example: Losing the TV remote became a full melodrama in three acts and one accusation.

hindi: मृत्यु-स्मारक — मरणशीलता की याद दिलाने वाली वस्तु
definition: a reminder that you will die, kept deliberately in view
example: The cracked phone screen served as a small daily memento mori.

hindi: पशुशाला — जंगली जानवरों का संग्रह; तरह-तरह के लोगों का जमघट
definition: a collection of wild animals kept for show; figuratively, a strange assortment of people
example: The shared house was a menagerie of night-shift nurses, drummers and one silent philosopher.

hindi: मिथ्यावादी — आदतन झूठ बोलने वाला
definition: habitually telling lies, or containing deliberate lies meant to deceive
example: The mendacious status report listed the feature as shipped, which came as news to the feature.

hindi: मिथ्यावादिता — झूठ बोलने की पक्की आदत
definition: the habit of lying; untruthfulness as a settled trait
example: The inquiry exposed a mendacity running through every quarterly report.

hindi: भिक्षुक — भिक्षा पर जीने वाला
definition: person living by begging, sometimes a member of a religious order sworn to poverty
example: Every third fundraising email turns the charity into a digital mendicant.

hindi: तुच्छ — छोटा, नीरस काम जो सेवकों के ज़िम्मे हो
definition: lowly, unskilled and tedious, suited to household servants rather than persons of standing
example: No task is too menial for the intern, including explaining the printer to the partners.

hindi: आपराधिक आशय — अपराध करने का दोषपूर्ण इरादा
definition: guilty mind; the criminal intention or knowledge needed before conduct counts as crime
example: The cat knocked the glass off the table with clear mens rea and zero remorse.

hindi: स्वस्थ शरीर में स्वस्थ मन — तन-मन दोनों का आरोग्य
definition: a healthy mind in a healthy body, the classical ideal of balanced physical and mental wellbeing
example: The gym's slogan says mens sana in corpore sano, which explains the smoothie bar and not the parking fees.

hindi: मानसिक क्रिया — मन की सोचने-समझने की गतिविधि
definition: mental activity of every kind, the ongoing working of thought within the mind
example: Monday morning mentation runs at half speed until the second coffee arrives.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक — अनुभवी और विश्वस्त सलाहकार
definition: a trusted, experienced adviser who guides and teaches a younger or less experienced person
example: Her mentor's best advice was never to schedule a meeting that could be an email.

hindi: शैतानी चतुर — ठंडी चालाकी से ललचाने वाला
definition: devilishly cunning and tempting, offering dazzling rewards with a sinister hidden price
example: The Mephistophelean free trial asked only for a card number and your soul.

hindi: विषैली दुर्गंध वाला — सड़ांध भरी, दम घोंटने वाली गंध का
definition: foul-smelling and poisonous, like noxious fumes rising from rotting ground, sewers or stagnant swamps
example: A mephitic cloud rose from the drain the moment the landlord said everything was fine.

hindi: चंचल स्वभाव — पल-पल बदलता मिज़ाज
definition: quick to change in mood or manner, and hard to predict
example: A mercurial editor: lavish praise on Monday, silence for the rest of the week.

hindi: ताल — उथली शांत झील या पोखर
definition: literary: a still lake or broad shallow pond of standing water
example: The mere looked perfect for a sunset photo until the geese filed a complaint.

hindi: छलपूर्ण आकर्षक — ऊपर से लुभावना, भीतर से खोखला
definition: attractive in a showy, superficial manner though lacking real value, substance or sincerity
example: The app's meretricious animations hid the fact that it did nothing at all.

hindi: मध्याह्न — जीवन या वैभव का उत्कर्ष काल
definition: the highest point of a person's power, glory or worldly success, as at noonday
example: At the meridian of the dot-com boom, pet food had its own IPO.

hindi: प्रशंसनीय — पुरस्कार या सराहना के योग्य
definition: deserving praise, reward or honour for being morally good or excellent
example: The award for meritorious service went to the woman who finally fixed the lift.

hindi: सम्मोहित करना — ध्यान पूरी तरह बाँध लेना
definition: to hold someone's attention completely, as though they were under hypnotic spell
example: The toddler was mesmerized by the washing machine's spin cycle.

hindi: कायापलट — रूप या स्वभाव का पूरा बदल जाना
definition: a complete change of form, nature or character, turning something into another thing entirely different
example: The garage band's metamorphosis into a wedding covers act took just one mortgage.

hindi: हृदय-परिवर्तन — सोच और जीवन की दिशा का गहरा बदलाव
definition: a profound change of mind or heart that turns your whole life around
example: After his third missed deadline, a metanoia struck, and he bought a paper diary.

hindi: छंद — पद्य में ज़ोरदार और हल्के अक्षरों की नियमित लय
definition: the regular pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables that gives verse its rhythm
example: Her toast had rhyme but no meter, so it limped across the reception.

hindi: मुझे लगता है — मेरे विचार में
definition: archaic: it seems to me, in my opinion; often used playfully to hint gentle doubt about something
example: Methinks the gentleman who swears he never checks his phone doth check it rather often.

hindi: दीर्घायु — अत्यंत लंबी आयु वाला व्यक्ति या वस्तु
definition: a person or thing of extraordinary lifespan, named after the longest-lived patriarch in the Bible
example: My laptop is the Methuselah of the office, eleven years old and still wheezing through spreadsheets.

hindi: लक्षणा — किसी वस्तु के स्थान पर उससे जुड़ी चीज़ का नाम लेना
definition: naming something by referring to a closely associated thing, as 'Downing Street' for the British government
example: "The suits want it by Friday" is metonymy, and also, apparently, a deadline.

hindi: जीवट — कठिनाई में परखा गया साहस
definition: inner courage, spirit and toughness, shown when someone is tested by difficulty
example: The first night alone with twins put the new parents' mettle to the test.

hindi: विषाक्त वातावरण — दूषित हवा या अशुभ प्रभाव
definition: a heavy, poisonous atmosphere or unpleasant influence hanging over a place
example: A miasma of burnt popcorn and passive aggression hung over the shared kitchen.

hindi: आशावादी फक्कड़ — तंगी में भी 'कुछ न कुछ हो जाएगा' मानने वाला
definition: cheerfully improvident person always certain that money will somehow arrive soon
example: A true Micawber, he listed the lottery under projected income.

hindi: उम्मीद-भरोसे — बिना योजना के किसी चमत्कार की आस में
definition: cheerfully hopeful that some lucky chance will surely arrive, without making any plans
example: Her Micawberish budget assumed a tax refund would arrive exactly when rent did.

hindi: सोना बना देने वाला हाथ — हर काम मुनाफ़े में बदलने की क्षमता
definition: a knack for turning everything one handles into profit
example: Three hits in a row and the press decided she had the Midas touch.

hindi: भाव-भंगिमा — चेहरे और चाल-ढाल से झलकता रूप
definition: a person's look, bearing or manner, revealing character or mood through appearance
example: The new manager's solemn mien lasted until the first office birthday cake.

hindi: प्रवासी — नियमित रूप से स्थान बदलने वाला
definition: moving regularly from one region to another, especially birds and animals following the changing seasons
example: The office's migratory desk-sharers follow the afternoon sunlight like geese.

hindi: डींगमार सिपाही — कायर शेखीबाज़
definition: a boastful soldier who brags about courage but proves cowardly in danger, from Roman comedy
example: The office miles gloriosus bragged about fixing the outage, then vanished during it.

hindi: परिवेश — वह सामाजिक वातावरण जिसमें कोई रहता है
definition: the social surroundings, circle and setting in which a person lives, works and moves
example: In the milieu of early-stage founders, nobody admits to sleeping more than five hours.

hindi: उग्रवादी — लक्ष्य के लिए आक्रामक संघर्ष को तत्पर
definition: aggressively combative in support of a cause, willing to fight rather than negotiate
example: He is militant about oat milk and will fight anyone holding a carton of dairy.

hindi: नाज़ुक डरपोक — कमज़ोर और दब्बू व्यक्ति
definition: a feeble, timid person lacking courage, spirit or toughness of any kind
example: He called his brother a milksop for refusing the extra-spicy wings, then cried at his own.

hindi: टोपी-साज़ — महिलाओं की टोपियाँ बनाने-बेचने वाला
definition: a person who designs, makes and sells women's hats and fine headwear
example: Royal wedding season is the milliner's quarterly earnings call.

hindi: मीनार — मस्जिद की पतली ऊँची मीनार जहाँ से अज़ान दी जाती है
definition: a slender tower attached to a mosque, from whose balcony the call to prayer is given
example: Our walking tour had one navigation rule: keep the minaret on your left and follow the smell of fresh bread.

hindi: मनश्चक्षु — कल्पना में देखने की शक्ति
definition: the mental ability to picture things imagined or remembered inside the mind
example: In her mind's eye the renovation looked elegant; in reality it looked like a dentist's waiting room.

hindi: चाकर — शक्तिशाली स्वामी के आदेश बजाने वाला दास
definition: a servile follower or underling who meekly carries out a powerful master's orders without question
example: The director sent a minion to ask why the slide deck was not in the brand font.

hindi: प्रेमगीतकार — जर्मन मध्यकाल का दरबारी प्रेम-गायक कवि
definition: a medieval German poet-singer who composed lyric songs of courtly love for noble courts
example: He serenaded her through the dorm window like a minnesinger, until campus security requested an encore elsewhere.

hindi: चारण — गीत-संगीत से मनोरंजन करने वाला मध्यकालीन गायक
definition: a medieval singer and musician who entertained noble courts with songs and poems
example: Every office party needs one minstrel with a guitar and no sense of when the room has emptied.

hindi: अत्यल्प — बेहद छोटा
definition: extremely small in size or amount; tiny, slight and hardly noticeable at first glance
example: The terms and conditions arrive in minuscule print for a reason.

hindi: आश्चर्यजनक — कहते हुए भी अचरज होता है
definition: wonderful to relate, marking something surprising that the speaker can barely believe
example: The train, mirabile dictu, arrived on time.

hindi: विविध-संग्रह — अलग-अलग विषयों की रचनाओं का संकलन
definition: a varied collection of different writings, items or topics bound together
example: Her blog is a miscellany of travel notes, sourdough failures and tax advice.

hindi: बदमाश — नियम तोड़ने वाला दुष्ट व्यक्ति
definition: person who behaves badly or breaks the rules, often in petty criminal ways
example: Some miscreant has renamed every meeting room after a cheese.

hindi: पूर्व-तैयारी — पकाने से पहले सारी सामग्री सजाकर रखना
definition: a cook's preparation of every ingredient and tool before cooking begins
example: His mise en place for Monday is laptop charged, coffee brewed and inbox ignored.

hindi: मंच-सज्जा — दृश्य में हर चीज़ की सोची-समझी व्यवस्था
definition: the arrangement of scenery, actors, lighting and props within a stage or film scene
example: Her dinner party's mise en scène included candles, jazz and a strategically placed cookbook.

hindi: कंजूस — धन जोड़ने वाला, खर्च से डरने वाला
definition: hoarding money greedily and hating to spend even small amounts on anyone
example: His miserly tipping made the waiter reconsider the whole concept of hospitality.

hindi: अनुचित निर्वहन — वैध काम को गलत या हानिकारक ढंग से करना
definition: carrying out a lawful official duty in a wrongful, careless or harmful manner
example: Approving your own expense claim may be allowed, but approving it twice is misfeasance.

hindi: बेडौल — बिगड़े या टेढ़े आकार वाला
definition: having an ugly, distorted, abnormal shape, twisted away from its natural form
example: The misshapen vegetables box costs half as much and tastes exactly the same.

hindi: विषघ्न — विषों के विरुद्ध प्राचीन मिश्रण
definition: archaic: a compound remedy believed to protect against poisons, named after King Mithridates
example: Reading every terms-of-service page is his mithridate against corporate poison.

hindi: स्मृति-सूत्र — याद रखने में मदद करने वाली युक्ति
definition: a device such as a rhyme or pattern that helps learners remember facts, names or sequences
example: His password mnemonic was so elaborate that he needed a second mnemonic to remember it.

hindi: छद्म-वीर — तुच्छ विषय को वीर-काव्य की शैली में उड़ाने वाला
definition: imitating the grand style of epic poetry to mock a trivial subject with comic exaggeration
example: He narrated his trip to the recycling bins in mock-heroic tones worthy of Troy.

hindi: लेशमात्र — थोड़ी-सी मात्रा
definition: a small, modest amount or quantity of something, especially of something good or desirable
example: With a modicum of planning, the trip would not have begun at the wrong airport.

hindi: कार्यप्रणाली — काम करने का चिर-परिचित तरीका
definition: a person's characteristic way of doing something
example: Charm first, invoice later, vanish by spring: that was his modus operandi.

hindi: जीने का ढंग — मतभेद रहते हुए साथ रहने का व्यावहारिक समझौता
definition: practical arrangement that lets rival parties live together peacefully despite unresolved differences
example: Their modus vivendi is simple: he never mentions her playlist, she never mentions his cooking.

hindi: अर्धांश — आधा हिस्सा
definition: archaic: a half share, or either of the paired portions into which something divides
example: After the divorce each claimed a moiety of the record collection and all of the dog.

hindi: बलिभक्षी सत्ता — जो भारी बलिदान माँगे
definition: a cruel power or cause demanding terrible sacrifice, originally a pagan idol receiving sacrificed children
example: The quarterly growth target became a Moloch that devoured weekends.

hindi: धनवान — बहुत पैसे वाला, संपन्न
definition: having plenty of money; wealthy, prosperous, comfortably affluent and well provided
example: The moneyed guests arrived late, having assumed the party would wait.

hindi: एकालाप — किसी एक व्यक्ति का लंबा अबाध भाषण
definition: a long speech by one character on stage, or anyone talking at length without letting others speak
example: He calls it a team meeting, but it is really a forty-minute monologue with slides.

hindi: एकाक्षरी उत्तर देने वाला — केवल हाँ-ना में बोलने वाला
definition: speaking only in very short words, brief replies that avoid real conversation
example: Ask a teenager about school and receive a monosyllabic 'fine' every single time.

hindi: बावला — ख़यालों में खोया, भोंदू और मूढ़ व्यक्ति
definition: archaic: a foolish, absent-minded person who gapes and daydreams, wandering about mooning
example: The mooncalf at the bus stop missed three buses writing a poem about buses.

hindi: पंचसभा — प्राचीन काल की सामुदायिक सभा
definition: archaic: an assembly of freemen gathered to discuss community affairs and settle local disputes
example: The residents' association meeting is essentially a moot, with parking replacing cattle as the main grievance.

hindi: नीति-नाटक — अच्छाई-बुराई के प्रतीक पात्रों वाला उपदेशक नाटक
definition: a medieval drama teaching a moral lesson through characters personifying virtues and vices
example: The team retro turned into a morality play, with Scope Creep cast as the villain.

hindi: दलदल — ऐसी उलझन जिससे निकलना कठिन हो
definition: a boggy swamp, or a complicated tangled situation that traps anyone entering it
example: The reimbursement process is a morass of forms, approvals and lost receipts.

hindi: विराम-अवधि — किसी गतिविधि पर अस्थायी रोक
definition: an official temporary suspension or halt of some activity until further notice
example: We declared a moratorium on buying houseplants until the current ones stop dying.

hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त — साथ ही
definition: formal word adding further information that strengthens what has already been stated
example: The plan is late and over budget; moreover, nobody can remember what it was for.

hindi: असमान-विवाह — जिसमें निम्न-कुल जीवनसाथी को पद न मिले
definition: describing royal marriage where the lower-ranking spouse and children gain neither titles nor inheritance
example: Theirs was a morganatic marriage: she got the prince, not the parking space at the palace.

hindi: मरणासन्न — अंत के निकट, दम तोड़ता हुआ
definition: close to death or ending, having lost its vitality and slowly fading away
example: The group chat has been moribund since the wedding, stirring only for birthday GIFs.

hindi: मरने वाले तुम्हें सलाम करते हैं — निश्चित संकट से पहले कड़वा अभिवादन
definition: those about to die salute you; a grim, wry greeting before facing certain death or doom
example: The interns filed into the quarterly review with a whispered morituri te salutant.

hindi: आगामी दिन — अगला दिन, कल
definition: archaic: the following morning or tomorrow; good morrow was once a greeting meaning good morning
example: I vowed to deal with the leftovers on the morrow, as I had vowed all week.

hindi: सटीक शब्द — ठीक वही शब्द जो बात को पूरी तरह कहे
definition: the exact, perfectly fitting word that expresses a thought most precisely
example: After ten minutes hunting the mot juste, she settled on 'meh'.

hindi: सहज बुद्धि — जन्मजात समझदारी, जो पढ़ाई से नहीं आती
definition: natural common sense that comes from birth rather than from schooling or books
example: No manual covers a toddler with a permanent marker, so parents run on mother wit and coffee.

hindi: विदूषक-वेश — दरबारी मसख़रे की रंग-बिरंगी पोशाक; बेमेल मिश्रण
definition: the multicoloured patchwork costume of a court jester; also any varied, incongruous mixture of things
example: The all-hands was a motley of dress codes, from three-piece suits to somebody's bathrobe.

hindi: मजमेबाज़ — ठग दवा-विक्रेता, झूठे दावे करने वाला
definition: a fraud who deceives crowds with showy false claims, once selling fake medicines
example: The webinar's mountebank promised passive income and sold only the webinar.

hindi: नैतिकता की ठेकेदार — दूसरों के आचरण पर नाक-भौं सिकोड़ने वाली
definition: a narrow-minded, prudish person who fiercely polices other people's manners and morals
example: The group chat's Mrs Grundy flagged a winking emoji as inappropriate.

hindi: सादे कपड़े — वर्दीधारी का असैनिक पहनावा
definition: plain civilian clothes worn by someone who usually wears a military or official uniform
example: Spotting the general manager in mufti at the supermarket felt like seeing a teacher at the cinema.

hindi: अर्थदंड देना — जुर्माना लगाना या धन ऐंठना
definition: punish someone with a fine, or unfairly extract money from them through trickery or pressure
example: The airline mulcted him forty dollars for a bag two centimetres too wide.

hindi: अश्वतरवत्‌ हठी — खच्चर की तरह अड़ियल और ज़िद्दी
definition: like mules; stubborn, obstinate, headstrong, balky and refusing to budge
example: He stayed mulish about the sat-nav and drove straight into the reservoir car park.

hindi: बहुविध — अनेक प्रकार और रूपों वाला
definition: having many varied kinds, parts or forms; greatly diverse in number
example: His multifarious side projects share one feature: none of them is finished.

hindi: बहुलता — बहुत अधिक संख्या या विविधता
definition: a very large number or great variety of different things, kinds or parts
example: A multiplicity of chargers, and still not one fits my phone.

hindi: बहुसंख्यक — बहुत बड़ी संख्या में, भीड़ जैसा
definition: very large in number; made of countless many separate parts or people
example: Her multitudinous browser tabs each promised she would read them later.

hindi: थोड़े में बहुत — छोटे आकार में भरपूर सार
definition: much meaning packed into small space, great content within brief form
example: A good commit message is multum in parvo: seven words that explain three days.

hindi: उदारता — दान देने में असाधारण दरियादिली
definition: great generosity in giving
example: The new library exists entirely because of one alumna's munificence.

hindi: महादानी — बहुत बड़े दिल से भरपूर देने वाला
definition: extremely generous, giving money and gifts freely and lavishly with great liberality
example: The munificent founder donated a library, named after himself in very large letters.

hindi: विचारमग्न होना — धीमे से सोचते रहना
definition: to think quietly and absorbedly about something, or remark thoughtfully while pondering aloud
example: 'Perhaps we never needed the meeting,' she mused, as the meeting entered its second hour.

hindi: चिंतन-मनन — धीमा, विचारमग्न सोच-विचार
definition: quiet absorbed thinking, drifting gently over some subject without hurry
example: His late-night musings on the meaning of work somehow always ended at the snack drawer.

hindi: परिवर्तनशीलता — बदलते रहने का स्वभाव
definition: the constant tendency of things to change, shift and alter rather than remain settled or permanent
example: The mutability of airline schedules is the only truly reliable thing about them.

hindi: परिवर्तनशील — जो बदला जा सके या बदलता रहे
definition: liable or able to change easily; not fixed, settled, permanent or certain in form
example: The seating plan was mutable right up until the caterer arrived.

hindi: यथावश्यक परिवर्तन सहित — ज़रूरी बदलाव करके, बाकी ज्यों का त्यों
definition: with the necessary changes made and everything else left as it was
example: The same clause applies to the Delhi office, mutatis mutandis.

hindi: विद्रोह — जहाज़ के नाविकों का कप्तान के विरुद्ध बगावत
definition: open rebellion by sailors against their captain, or any revolt against authority
example: When the coffee machine was replaced with herbal tea, the office came close to mutiny.

hindi: संकीर्णदृष्टि — केवल तात्कालिक लाभ देखने वाला
definition: unable to think beyond the present, ignoring long-term consequences; also, literally short-sighted
example: Cutting the testing team to hit this quarter's number is myopic, and next quarter will say so.

hindi: असंख्य — गिनती से परे, अनगिनत
definition: countless; existing in a very large number, too many things to count
example: The app offers myriad settings, and nobody has opened a single one.

hindi: आज्ञाकारी अनुचर — बिना प्रश्न आदेश मानने वाला
definition: a loyal follower or hired hand who carries out orders without question or scruple
example: The influencer arrived with a squad of myrmidons carrying ring lights.

hindi: मिथक-संसार — किसी संस्कृति की कथाएँ और विश्वास
definition: the body of stories and beliefs that shape a culture's sense of itself
example: The company mythos insists the founders started in a garage; it was a rented studio.

hindi: सम्मिश्रण — अलग-अलग तत्वों का मिला-जुला संग्रह
definition: a varied mixture or collection of different elements, flavours or styles blended together into one whole
example: The café menu is a mélange of Korean, Mexican and whatever the chef dreamt about.

hindi: गृहस्थी — एक छत के नीचे रहने वाला परिवार
definition: a household, the members of a family or group living together under one roof
example: Our ménage is two adults, one toddler, a dog and a sourdough starter with seniority.

hindi: त्रिकोणीय गृहस्थी — तीन लोगों का साझा प्रेम-संबंध
definition: a romantic household arrangement shared by three people living together in partnership
example: Our flat's arrangement with the landlord and his cat felt less like a lease and more like a ménage à trois.

hindi: असमान विवाह — निम्न सामाजिक स्तर के व्यक्ति से संबंध
definition: a marriage with someone considered socially inferior or unsuitable in rank
example: Her aunt called the engagement a mésalliance because the groom owns a food truck.

hindi: व्यवसाय-कौशल — वह काम जिसमें कोई सहज रूप से निपुण हो
definition: a person's trade, profession or calling, especially the work where their natural skill shines
example: Spreadsheets were never her métier, but give her a room of angry stakeholders and she is sublime.

hindi: हाथापाई — भीड़ में उलझी हुई मारपीट
definition: a confused brawl or fight involving a whole crowd of people struggling together at once
example: The Black Friday doors opened and the aisle became a mêlée over discounted televisions.

hindi: धनकुबेर — बेहिसाब दौलत वाला ठाठदार रईस
definition: a person of conspicuous wealth and importance, originally someone enriched in colonial India
example: The crypto nabob arrived at the picnic by helicopter and asked where the valet was.

hindi: मुक्ताभ — सीप के भीतर जैसी रंग बदलती मोती-सी चमक
definition: shimmering with pearly, softly shifting colours like the smooth lining found inside seashells
example: The nacreous finish on the new laptop mostly shows fingerprints beautifully.

hindi: अधोबिंदु — सबसे नीचा, सबसे बुरा दौर
definition: the lowest point of anything, the moment when fortunes sink deepest
example: The nadir of the offsite was the trust fall nobody caught.

hindi: मेज़पोश-वस्त्र — घर की मेज़ की सूती-लिनन चीज़ें
definition: household table linen, such as tablecloths and napkins, kept for dining
example: The wedding list asked for napery, which baffled every guest under the age of fifty.

hindi: आत्ममोह — स्वयं पर अत्यधिक मुग्धता
definition: excessive absorption in oneself and one's own image
example: The memoir's narcissism is total: even the earthquake is about him.

hindi: पूर्व-मंडप — गिरजाघर के मुख्य भाग से पहले का प्रवेश-कक्ष
definition: the entrance hall or lobby inside the western door of a church, before the main nave
example: Latecomers to the christening lingered in the narthex, admiring the stonework and checking the cricket score.

hindi: शून्य — कुछ भी नहीं, व्यर्थ
definition: archaic: nothing whatsoever, zero; to come to naught means an effort fails completely and entirely
example: Six months of planning came to naught when the venue double-booked.

hindi: नौवहन-संबंधी — जहाज़ों, नाविकों और समुद्री यात्रा से जुड़ा
definition: relating to ships, sailors, navigation and seagoing voyages across the ocean
example: He owns one striped shirt and now describes his whole wardrobe as nautical.

hindi: मध्य-भाग — गिरजे का प्रवेश से वेदी तक का लंबा केंद्रीय कक्ष
definition: the long central hall of a church, running from the entrance toward the altar
example: The bride insisted on a cathedral wedding, then spent the reception complaining about the length of the nave.

hindi: नहीं — बल्कि, इससे भी अधिक
definition: archaic: meaning 'rather', correcting a statement by adding something stronger; also plain denial
example: The new espresso machine is good, nay, life-changing, according to accounting.

hindi: भोलापन — दुनिया के अनुभव की कमी से उपजा सरल विश्वास
definition: innocent simplicity and trusting openness that comes from lacking worldly experience
example: It was sheer naïveté to believe the 'five-minute' setup guide.

hindi: पराकाष्ठा — किसी चीज़ का सर्वोत्तम या चरम रूप
definition: the highest point of perfection, the very finest possible example of something, beyond which nothing better exists
example: To my father, a folding chair with a cup holder is the ne plus ultra of engineering.

hindi: अति सर्वत्र वर्जयेत् — किसी भी चीज़ की अधिकता नहीं
definition: nothing in excess; a classical motto urging moderation and restraint in everything
example: Ne quid nimis, she reminded herself, and closed the tab with the fifth pair of trainers.

hindi: निकम्मा — कभी कुछ ठीक न करने वाला आलसी
definition: a lazy, irresponsible person who never manages to achieve anything worthwhile in life
example: The family ne'er-do-well turned up at the reunion with a podcast pitch.

hindi: धुँधला — अस्पष्ट, बादल-सा आकारहीन
definition: hazy and vague like a cloudy nebula, lacking clear form, outline or detail
example: The project's nebulous goals meant every meeting ended by scheduling another meeting.

hindi: प्रेत-विद्या — मृतात्माओं से संपर्क कर भविष्य जानने का जादू
definition: magic that claims to summon the spirits of the dead to foretell future events; black magic generally
example: Reviving a ten-year-old Perl script for one last report felt uncomfortably like necromancy.

hindi: मृतक-नगर — विशाल प्राचीन क़ब्रिस्तान
definition: a large ancient cemetery, often filled with elaborate tombs, like a city of the dead
example: After the mall closed, the car park became a necropolis of abandoned trolleys.

hindi: कुटिल — दुष्ट और आपराधिक इरादों वाला
definition: wicked, villainous and criminal, usually carried out through deliberate, scheming plots
example: His nefarious plan was to microwave fish in the shared kitchen at exactly noon.

hindi: अपरिहार्य प्रतिद्वंद्वी — जिससे बचा न जा सके
definition: an opponent or downfall that cannot be escaped
example: Spreadsheets were his nemesis long before the audit made it official.

hindi: कोई अपने मामले का न्यायाधीश नहीं — निष्पक्षता का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle of natural justice that nobody should judge a case involving their own interest
example: Letting the founder grade his own quarterly performance breached nemo judex in causa sua rather spectacularly.

hindi: कोई मुझे छेड़कर बच नहीं सकता — हर आक्रमण का प्रतिशोध होगा
definition: nobody provokes me unpunished; a warning that every attack will meet swift retaliation
example: Her cat's expression, after the bath, read plainly: nemo me impune lacessit.

hindi: नवदीक्षित — नया धर्मान्तरित; किसी क्षेत्र का नौसिखिया
definition: a newly converted religious believer; hence a beginner or novice in any field, craft or activity
example: The neophyte cyclist bought the carbon frame before learning to clip in.

hindi: विस्मृति-औषधि — दुःख भुलाने वाला पेय या वस्तु
definition: a drink, drug or pleasure that brings welcome forgetfulness of sorrow, grief and pain
example: For some, a long bath is nepenthe; for others, it is rewatching the same sitcom again.

hindi: भाई-भतीजावाद — पद देने में अपनों का पक्षपात
definition: favouring relatives or friends with posts, contracts and power, regardless of their merit or ability
example: The startup's nepotism was obvious: the CEO's nephew became Chief Vibes Officer.

hindi: वयोवृद्ध मार्गदर्शक — अनुभवी, बुद्धिमान बुज़ुर्ग सलाहकार
definition: Homer's elderly Greek counsellor, hence a wise senior adviser respected for long experience
example: The Nestor of the newsroom has survived nine redesigns and still writes the best headlines.

hindi: स्नायुदौर्बल्य — नसों की थकान और कमज़ोरी
definition: a vague disorder of fatigue, weak nerves and headaches, much diagnosed in the nineteenth century
example: Burnout is what they call neurasthenia now that it comes with a meditation subscription.

hindi: तथापि — इसके बावजूद भी
definition: despite everything just said, still true regardless, even though obstacles might suggest otherwise
example: The printer jammed twice; nevertheless, the quarterly report reached the board with seconds to spare.

hindi: सूम — देने में अत्यंत संकीर्ण
definition: stingy and grudging, giving or spending only the smallest possible amount of money
example: The niggardly bonus arrived as a gift card worth exactly one coffee.

hindi: निकट — पास, लगभग
definition: archaic: near, close by in place or time; also nearly or almost, as in well nigh impossible
example: The deadline draws nigh, and the document remains a title and a coffee stain.

hindi: कोई आपत्ति नहीं — धर्माधिकारी की प्रकाशन-स्वीकृति
definition: nothing hinders; a Church censor's declaration that a book contains nothing objectionable
example: Legal granted the campaign its nihil obstat after removing every joke.

hindi: निर्विस्मय भाव — किसी भी बात से अचंभित न होना
definition: wondering at nothing; the composed attitude of never being overly impressed or excited
example: He met the product launch with nil admirari, having seen three identical launches since breakfast.

hindi: कभी निराश न हो — संघर्ष कितना भी कठिन हो, आशा बनाए रखो
definition: never despair; keep hope alive however hard the struggle becomes
example: Down two goals at half-time, the coach scrawled nil desperandum on the whiteboard.

hindi: वर्षामेघ — बारिश लाने वाला घना बादल, या प्रभामंडल
definition: dark rain-bearing cloud; also luminous halo surrounding sacred figures in paintings
example: A grey nimbus parked itself over the stadium exactly at kick-off.

hindi: महान शिकारी — कुशल आखेटक; अमेरिकी बोलचाल में मूर्ख व्यक्ति
definition: a mighty, skilful hunter; in modern American slang, a clumsy foolish person
example: He styles himself a Nimrod of the wilds and still cannot find the tent pegs.

hindi: कुलीन का कर्तव्य — ऊँचे पद के साथ उदार होने की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: the duty of privileged people to behave generously and honourably towards others
example: Out of noblesse oblige, the senior engineer took the on-call shift over Diwali.

hindi: अनिच्छया — चाहे या न चाहे, मजबूरी में
definition: whether willing or unwilling, happening regardless of anyone's personal wishes or consent
example: The whole family, nolens volens, joined the group chat about the wedding.

hindi: मुझे मत छुओ — हस्तक्षेप के विरुद्ध चेतावनी, या मसीह और मरियम का चित्र
definition: touch me not; a warning against interference, or a painting of Christ and Mary Magdalene
example: The vintage guitar sat in its case with a noli me tangere sticky note for visiting nephews.

hindi: आरोप का विरोध नहीं — बिना दोष स्वीकारे दंड मान लेना
definition: plea accepting conviction and punishment without formally admitting guilt for the charge
example: Asked who ate the last slice, he entered a plea of nolo contendere and did the dishes.

hindi: छद्मनाम — संघर्ष या काम के लिए अपनाया गया नाम
definition: an assumed name adopted by someone fighting, campaigning or working under cover
example: His gaming handle became such a nom de guerre that even his manager calls him ShadowFax.

hindi: उपनाम — लेखक का साहित्यिक छद्म नाम
definition: a false name, or pseudonym, that an author publishes under instead of their real name
example: Her food-blog nom de plume fools everyone except her mother.

hindi: यायावर — बिना स्थायी घर के घूमता रहने वाला
definition: living without a fixed home, moving from place to place with the seasons or work
example: Digital nomads call their lifestyle nomadic; their landlords call it three-month leases.

hindi: विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त अभिजात — सत्ता के अहम पदों पर बैठा अफ़सर-वर्ग
definition: the privileged elite of officials holding every important post in a party-controlled system
example: The company's nomenklatura all had corner offices and, somehow, all of the parking spaces.

hindi: विक्षिप्तचित्त — मानसिक रूप से अपने होश में नहीं
definition: lacking a sound mind, and therefore unable to manage personal affairs or make sensible decisions
example: Anyone who replies-all to the whole company at midnight is, briefly, non compos mentis.

hindi: मैं पूरा नहीं मरूँगा — मेरी रचना शरीर के बाद भी जीवित रहेगी
definition: a proud belief, borrowed from Horace, that one's creative work will outlive the mortal body after death
example: He open-sourced the library with a non omnis moriar in the README, which felt a little much for a date parser.

hindi: असंगत कथन — पिछली बात से न जुड़ने वाली टिप्पणी
definition: a statement that does not follow from what came before
example: He answered a question about rent with a non sequitur about his childhood dog.

hindi: नब्बे वर्षीय — नब्बे से निन्यानवे वर्ष की आयु का व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose years of life fall between ninety and ninety-nine inclusive
example: Our nonagenarian neighbour has a better social calendar than anyone under thirty.

hindi: बेफ़िक्री — शांत, सहज और उदासीन ढंग
definition: a calm, relaxed and casually unconcerned manner that seems wholly effortless to onlookers
example: She merged the risky pull request with a nonchalance that made the whole team sweat.

hindi: फिर भी — सब कुछ होते हुए भी
definition: despite what was just said, still true regardless, even though obstacles suggest otherwise
example: The demo crashed in front of investors; they wired the money nonetheless, which worried everyone more.

hindi: बेजोड़ — जिसकी कोई बराबरी न कर सके
definition: a person or thing without any equal, finer than every other example of its kind
example: As a procrastinator he is a nonpareil, and he will prove it next week.

hindi: गुलदस्ता — सुगंधित फूलों का छोटा गुच्छा
definition: a small fragrant bunch of flowers, carried or worn, once meant to sweeten foul smells
example: He brought a nosegay from the petrol station and called it spontaneous romance.

hindi: घर-वापसी — लंबी यात्रा के बाद स्वदेश लौटना
definition: a hero's long, hard journey home after years of wandering and trials
example: After three layovers and a lost suitcase, her nostos ended in her mother's kitchen.

hindi: नीम-हकीमी दवा — झूठे दावों से बेची जाने वाली जादुई औषधि
definition: a quack medicine or remedy sold with inflated claims of curing illness
example: The wellness influencer's newest nostrum is lemon water at nineteen dollars a bottle.

hindi: ध्यातव्य — विशेष ध्यान देने योग्य बात
definition: note well, drawing the reader's attention to something especially important or easily missed
example: Nota bene: the microwave fish ban applies to managers too.

hindi: बदनाम — किसी बुराई के लिए सबमें जाना-पहचाना
definition: widely known and talked about for some quality or deed that is shameful or unwelcome
example: The notorious corner seat by the window leaks every monsoon without fail.

hindi: तथापि — इसके बावजूद, फिर भी
definition: despite something that might have prevented it, still holding true regardless of that obstacle
example: The forecast notwithstanding, the team barbecue went ahead under three umbrellas and one heroic tarp.

hindi: नवधनाढ्य — हाल में अमीर बना, दिखावे का शौक़ीन
definition: people who have recently gained great wealth and display it showily, lacking established social polish
example: The nouveau riche neighbour installed a fountain, a second fountain, and a gold doorbell.

hindi: नवीन पाकशैली — हल्का, सुंदर सजा, कम मात्रा वाला भोजन
definition: a light, modern cooking style serving small, beautifully arranged portions of food
example: After the nouvelle cuisine tasting menu, they stopped for pizza on the drive home.

hindi: लघु उपन्यास — कहानी से लंबी, उपन्यास से छोटी कृति
definition: a prose story longer than a short story, though shorter and tighter than a full novel
example: He meant to write a quick apology email and produced a novella with footnotes.

hindi: प्रशिक्षु अवधि — किसी कार्य में शुरुआती सीखने का समय
definition: the probationary period of being a beginner or novice learning a craft, religious order or profession
example: His novitiate in the kitchen lasted until he set the risotto alarmingly on fire.

hindi: कदापि नहीं — किसी भी प्रकार नहीं
definition: archaic: meaning absolutely never, through not any manner, degree or possible means whatsoever
example: The intern was nowise prepared for the meeting that turned out to be his own review.

hindi: विषैला — स्वास्थ्य के लिए घातक या हानिकारक
definition: harmful or poisonous to health, especially through fumes, smells or substances
example: The printer emits a noxious smell whenever anyone prints more than three pages.

hindi: कोई दिन बिना एक रेखा के नहीं — रोज़ थोड़ा-थोड़ा काम
definition: no day without a line; steady daily work, however small, builds great results over time
example: He writes two hundred words every morning, nulla dies sine linea, even on holiday.

hindi: विधि बिना दंड नहीं — पूर्व क़ानून के बिना सज़ा नहीं
definition: the principle that nobody should face punishment except under a clear statute already existing when the deed occurred
example: Fining staff for a dress code announced afterwards violates nulla poena sine lege and common decency.

hindi: अब पीने का समय है — कठिन संघर्ष के बाद उत्सव मनाओ
definition: now is the moment to drink and celebrate, because a hard struggle is finally over
example: The release went live without a single bug report; nunc est bibendum.

hindi: पूर्वप्रभावी — अब किया गया पर पहले से लागू
definition: done at present but taking legal effect from an earlier date, correcting a past omission
example: The paperwork was filed nunc pro tunc, which is lawyer for pretending we did it in March.

hindi: पोप का राजदूत — किसी देश में पोप का स्थायी प्रतिनिधि
definition: permanent ambassador representing the Pope at the court or capital of a foreign government
example: He treats his weekly call to the landlord with the gravity of a papal nuncio.

hindi: वैवाहिक — विवाह या विवाह-संस्कार से संबंधित
definition: relating to marriage, weddings or the wedding ceremony and festive celebrations surrounding them
example: The nuptial budget was approved only after the drone photographer was cut.

hindi: हाय ज़माना — बिगड़ते समय और आचार पर खेद
definition: what times, what customs, a weary lament over the decline of present manners and public morals
example: 'Phones at the dinner table, o tempora, o mores,' said the man scrolling beside them.

hindi: हठधर्मिता — टस से मस न होने वाली जिद
definition: stubborn refusal to be moved, softened, or persuaded
example: The negotiations died on the obduracy of a single shareholder.

hindi: प्रणाम — गहरा सम्मान दिखाने के लिए झुककर अभिवादन
definition: a deep bowing gesture showing humble respect, deference and honour to someone important
example: Every morning the whole team makes obeisance to the coffee machine.

hindi: संदेह-चिह्न — संदिग्ध अंश के पास लगाया गया चिह्न
definition: a printed mark, a dash or dagger, placed beside a doubtful or spurious passage in manuscripts
example: The editor's obelus beside my favourite paragraph was a polite way of calling it fiction.

hindi: धुंधलाना — बात को जान-बूझकर उलझा देना
definition: to make something deliberately unclear, muddled or confusing so that people struggle to understand it
example: The apology obfuscated so skilfully that nobody could tell what had happened.

hindi: प्रसंगवश कथन — फ़ैसले में कही गई गैर-बाध्यकारी टिप्पणी
definition: a judge's passing remark in a court decision, offered along the way and never binding later cases
example: The manager's comment about 'unlimited leave' was pure obiter dictum, as HR swiftly clarified.

hindi: कलावस्तु — सजावट के लिए रखी छोटी कलात्मक वस्तु
definition: a small decorative object valued for its artistic craftsmanship, rarity and beauty
example: The unused smart speaker has been promoted to objet d'art on the bookshelf.

hindi: नैवेद्य — देवता को अर्पित पवित्र भेंट
definition: a sacred offering, such as bread, wine or incense, presented to a deity during religious worship
example: A box of samosas left on the reception desk is the traditional oblation to the office manager.

hindi: विस्मृति — पूरी तरह भुला दिए जाने की अवस्था
definition: the state of being completely forgotten by everyone, or of forgetting everything happening around
example: Last year's viral dance has already faded into oblivion, along with the people who filmed it.

hindi: स्वप्निल अकर्मण्यता — सोफ़े पर पड़े-पड़े सपने देखने वाला भाग्यवादी आलस्य
definition: a dreamy, fatalistic laziness, named after Goncharov's hero who barely leaves his couch
example: His Oblomovism peaked when he spent a weekend planning a run and never found his trainers.

hindi: सार्वजनिक निंदा — लोगों द्वारा की गई तीखी भर्त्सना और अपमान
definition: strong public condemnation and abusive criticism that disgraces someone's reputation
example: After the leaked group chat, the senator endured a week of obloquy online.

hindi: अंत्येष्टि-संस्कार — मृतक के लिए किए जाने वाले विधिवत अंतिम कर्म
definition: the formal funeral rites and solemn ceremonies performed when burying someone who has died
example: The office held solemn obsequies for the old fax machine, complete with a eulogy from IT.

hindi: चाटुकार — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा झुककर खुश करने वाला
definition: too eager to please and obey powerful people, in a servile, flattering manner
example: The obsequious intern laughed at the CEO's joke before the punchline arrived.

hindi: अप्रचलन — धीरे-धीरे अनुपयोगी होते जाने की अवस्था
definition: the process of becoming outdated and useless as newer things replace them
example: Planned obsolescence means your phone starts sulking the day the next model launches.

hindi: अप्रचलित — जिसका चलन या उपयोग समाप्त हो गया
definition: no longer used or needed, replaced by something newer and more useful
example: The fax machine is obsolete, yet it survives every office move like a cockroach.

hindi: उपद्रवी — शोरगुल भरा और बेकाबू
definition: noisy, unruly and difficult to control, loudly and stubbornly resisting order and discipline
example: An obstreperous toddler at the next table rearranged everyone's brunch plans.

hindi: मंदबुद्धि — धीमी समझ वाला, बात न पकड़ने वाला
definition: slow to understand or perceive, sometimes deliberately stupid about something perfectly obvious
example: He was being obtuse about the dishes, as if the sink were someone else's.

hindi: टाल देना — आवश्यकता ही समाप्त कर देना
definition: to remove the need for something before it can arise
example: A single sentence in the contract would have obviated the entire lawsuit.

hindi: गुह्य — अलौकिक और रहस्यमय विद्याओं से जुड़ा
definition: relating to magic, astrology and supernatural powers; hidden from ordinary understanding
example: The tax code has an occult logic that only accountants and the damned can read.

hindi: भीड़तंत्र — उन्मादी भीड़ का शासन
definition: government by the crowd or rabble, where public passion overrules order
example: The comment section descended into ochlocracy within four minutes of the review going live.

hindi: अष्टपत्री — आठ पन्नों में मोड़े कागज़ से बनी पुस्तक
definition: a book size made by folding each printed sheet three times to form eight leaves
example: The octavo edition fits neatly in a coat pocket, which is how it got left behind on the 8:15 train.

hindi: अस्सी वर्षीय — अस्सी से नवासी वर्ष की आयु का व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose years of life fall between eighty and eighty-nine inclusive
example: The octogenarian in row three asked the sharpest question of the entire product launch.

hindi: स्तुतिगीत — किसी विषय की प्रशंसा में लिखी भावपूर्ण कविता
