definition: a formal lyric poem addressed to and praising a person, object or idea
example: Her review of the new espresso machine read less like feedback and more like an ode.

hindi: मैं घृणा भी करता हूँ, प्रेम भी — एक ही व्यक्ति के प्रति द्वंद्व
definition: hatred and love together; the torment of loving and hating the same person at once, as Catullus confessed
example: My relationship with my smartwatch is odi et amo: it nags me, and I cannot take it off.

hindi: घृणा और तिरस्कार — किसी के प्रति सामूहिक नफ़रत
definition: general public hatred and disgust directed at someone because of their conduct
example: Raising the office coffee price by a rupee brought the odium of the entire floor.

hindi: गंधयुक्त — तेज़ महक छोड़ने वाला
definition: giving forth a strong smell, whether pleasant or unpleasant, that people notice from across the room
example: His odoriferous gym bag announced his arrival two desks before he did.

hindi: लंबी घटनापूर्ण यात्रा — कठिनाइयों से भरी
definition: a long, eventful journey full of trials
example: Getting the visa turned into a nine-month odyssey through four consulates.

hindi: मातृ-आसक्त — पिता से होड़ और माँ से गहरा लगाव
definition: relating to a child's unconscious rivalry with the same-sex parent and longing for the other parent
example: Their Oedipal feud over who carves the turkey resurfaces every December.

hindi: कृतित्व — किसी रचनाकार की समस्त रचनाओं का संग्रह
definition: the complete body of work produced by an artist, writer or composer across a whole career
example: His oeuvre consists of forty half-finished side projects and one very polished README.

hindi: प्रायः — अक्सर, बार-बार
definition: archaic: often, frequently, many times; survives in phrases like oft-quoted
example: The oft-promised software update arrived, bringing three new bugs.

hindi: अक्सर — बहुधा, बार-बार
definition: literary word meaning frequently, happening many times, repeatedly and often
example: Oftentimes the quickest route to a working printer is simply switching it off and walking away.

hindi: प्राचीन — पुराने ज़माने का, बीते दिनों का
definition: belonging to times long past, used fondly in the phrase olden days
example: In the olden days, you had to wait a whole week for the next episode.

hindi: तेल-सा चिकना — बनावटी, चापलूसी भरी मधुरता वाला
definition: oily in manner; smoothly flattering and ingratiating in a false, greasy, insincere style
example: His oleaginous thank-you email praised the client's vision, taste and, somehow, spreadsheet fonts.

hindi: घ्राण-संबंधी — सूँघने की इंद्रिय से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the sense of smell and the organs and nerves involved in detecting scents
example: The new flatmate's curry was an olfactory event the whole building attended.

hindi: अल्पतंत्र — मुट्ठीभर लोगों के हाथ में शासन
definition: government where power rests with a small group of people, often wealthy or well connected
example: The residents' committee claims to be a democracy but runs as an oligarchy of three retired uncles.

hindi: उच्चासीन और निर्लिप्त — सामान्य चिंताओं से ऊपर
definition: lofty and detached, as though above ordinary concerns
example: He dismissed the complaint with Olympian calm and never read the second page.

hindi: मौन-व्रत — बाहरी लोगों से भेद न खोलने की कसम
definition: a code of silence forbidding members from revealing secrets to outsiders
example: The office omertà about who broke the coffee machine held for three whole weeks.

hindi: प्रेम सब पर विजय पाता है — सच्चे प्रेम के आगे कोई बाधा नहीं टिकती
definition: love conquers everything; no obstacle can stand against true, determined love
example: Omnia vincit amor: they kept dating across six time zones and one terrible Wi-Fi connection.

hindi: समग्र खंड — कई रचनाएँ एक ही जिल्द में
definition: a single volume collecting several works previously published separately
example: He bought the trilogy omnibus, which now props open the balcony door.

hindi: सर्वज्ञ — सब कुछ जानने वाला
definition: knowing absolutely everything, or seeming to, like a deity or the all-seeing narrator of novels
example: Every family group chat assumes Mum is omniscient, and she usually is.

hindi: सब-कुछ का संग्रह — हर तरह की चीज़ों का बेतरतीब जमावड़ा
definition: a varied collection of different things or people gathered from everywhere
example: The junk drawer is an omnium-gatherum of cables for devices nobody owns anymore.

hindi: सर्वभक्षी — सब कुछ खाने वाला; हर विषय में रुचि लेने वाला
definition: eating both plants and meat; figuratively, taking everything available with hungry interest
example: Her omnivorous reading ran from Gibbon to shampoo labels during long showers.

hindi: केंद्र-बिंदु — किसी संसार की नाभि या केंद्र
definition: the central point or navel of something, around which everything revolves
example: For the whole family, grandmother's dining table is the omphalos of every festival.

hindi: स्वप्न-शकुन — सपनों से भविष्य का अर्थ निकालना
definition: foretelling future events by reading hidden meaning and signs in dreams
example: Dreaming of the deploy failing and then rolling back twice is not oneiromancy, just Thursday.

hindi: प्रचंड आक्रमण — ज़ोरदार और लगातार हमला
definition: fierce, overwhelming attack delivered with great force and continuing pressure
example: Monday morning brought the usual onslaught of emails marked urgent.

hindi: प्रमाण-भार — अपना दावा सिद्ध करने का दायित्व
definition: the burden of proving a claim, resting on whoever asserts the contested fact
example: Whoever claims the meeting could have been an email bears the onus probandi, and usually wins.

hindi: पूर्वोद्धृत — पहले उद्धृत की गई रचना में
definition: in the work already cited earlier, named again only by its author in a later citation
example: The thesis cites Smith, op. cit., so often that Smith deserves co-authorship.

hindi: दूधिया इंद्रधनुषी — ओपल जैसी रंग बदलती चमक वाला
definition: shimmering with milky, softly shifting rainbow colours, like the glowing surface of an opal gemstone
example: Her opalescent nail polish changed colour every time she pointed at someone.

hindi: सर्पवत्‌ — साँप जैसा फिसलनदार, कुंडली मारता और विषैला
definition: like snakes or serpents; sinuous, slithering, coiling, cold and venomous
example: The lobbyist's ophidian charm slid past every question about who was paying him.

hindi: उपयुक्त समय पर — ठीक मौक़े पर होने वाला
definition: happening at exactly the right time, well suited and convenient for the moment
example: The fire alarm rang at the most opportune moment, just as my presentation began.

hindi: अपमानसूचक — तिरस्कार और लांछन से भरा
definition: expressing scornful blame and abuse, or bringing shameful public disgrace
example: The comments section grew so opprobrious that the recipe blog disabled it.

hindi: लोकनिंदा — किसी शर्मनाक काम पर समाज की कठोर भर्त्सना
definition: harsh public criticism and scorn heaped upon someone for shameful conduct
example: The airline that charged for water drew opprobrium from every timeline at once.

hindi: वैभवशाली — भव्य और बहुमूल्य ठाठ-बाट से भरा
definition: richly luxurious and costly, displaying wealth through splendid lavish expense
example: The hotel lobby was so opulent that the vending machine looked embarrassed.

hindi: कृति — किसी रचनाकार की एक गिनी हुई रचना
definition: a single artistic work, especially a numbered musical composition by one composer
example: The group presentation was billed as a team opus; one person wrote it.

hindi: प्रार्थना करो और काम करो — भक्ति और परिश्रम का संतुलन
definition: pray and work; a monastic rule balancing daily devotion with steady, humble labour
example: Her routine is ora et labora: meditation at six, spreadsheets by seven.

hindi: दैववाणी-सा — गंभीर, रहस्यमय और आधिकारिक
definition: solemnly wise and mysterious, delivered with authority like pronouncements from a sacred prophet
example: The senior engineer's oracular code review read simply: 'No.'

hindi: नारंगीघर — संतरे के पेड़ों के लिए बना काँचदार भवन
definition: a grand glass-windowed garden building for growing orange trees and tender plants through winter
example: The wedding venue's orangery holds two lemon trees and four hundred chairs.

hindi: वक्ता — प्रभावशाली सार्वजनिक भाषण देने वाला
definition: a skilled public speaker known for powerful, eloquent speeches that move audiences
example: A born orator, she turned the building's recycling meeting into a call to arms.

hindi: वक्तृत्व कला — जनसभा में प्रभावशाली भाषण देने की कला
definition: the skilful craft of public speaking, moving audiences with formal, powerful speeches
example: His oratory could rouse a stadium, though it struggled to rouse his teenage son.

hindi: दीक्षित करना — पादरी पद पर विधिवत नियुक्त करना; आदेश देना
definition: to formally make someone a priest or minister through ritual; also to decree something with authority
example: The school board ordained that no phones would enter the classroom, and the phones disagreed.

hindi: उन्मत्त — बेकाबू भोग-विलास और मस्ती से भरा
definition: marked by wild, unrestrained indulgence and revelry, like a frenzied party
example: The Black Friday queue reached an orgiastic pitch at 6:01 a.m.

hindi: रणध्वज — युद्ध में आगे चलने वाला प्रेरक झंडा
definition: the sacred scarlet banner of medieval French kings, and any rallying banner or symbol for a cause
example: The founder's viral memo became the oriflamme of the four-day-week movement overnight.

hindi: ओजस्वी स्वर वाला — भरी, गोल और प्रभावशाली, कभी आडंबरी आवाज़
definition: full, rich and resonant in voice, often sounding grand or pompous
example: The mayor read the parking bylaw in orotund tones worthy of a coronation.

hindi: मोहक-रहस्यमय — संगीत-सा मंत्रमुग्ध करने वाला
definition: mystically entrancing and enchanting, like the magical music of the legendary poet-singer
example: The pianist's Orphic encore made even the ushers stop checking their phones.

hindi: ग्रह-यंत्र — सौरमंडल का यांत्रिक नमूना
definition: a clockwork model showing the planets circling the solar centre in their true relative motions
example: The CFO's spreadsheet of interlocking budgets ran like an orrery, beautiful and entirely theoretical.

hindi: सर्वनियंत्रक — निगरानी और भ्रामक सरकारी भाषा से जनता को दबाने वाला
definition: describing controlling state surveillance and twisted official language that disguises harsh truths
example: Calling the layoffs a 'talent liberation event' was pure Orwellian doublespeak.

hindi: जड़ीभूत — समय के साथ कठोर और अपरिवर्तनीय बना
definition: hardened over time into rigid habits, unable to adapt or change
example: The ossified approval process now requires four signatures to order more staplers.

hindi: अस्थि-कक्ष — मृतकों की हड्डियाँ रखने का पात्र या स्थान
definition: a container, chamber or building where the bones of the dead are gathered and stored
example: His junk drawer is an ossuary of dead batteries and snapped chargers.

hindi: दिखावटी — जो कारण कहा गया हो, पर असली न हो
definition: stated as the reason, though probably not the real one
example: The ostensible purpose of the meeting was planning; the real one was blame.

hindi: आडंबरपूर्ण — धन और वैभव का भड़कीला दिखावा करने वाला
definition: designed to impress others through showy, flashy and vulgar display of costly wealth
example: His ostentatious watch told the time in three cities, and nobody cared in any of them.

hindi: आवर्ती धुन — बार-बार दोहराया जाने वाला संगीत-खंड
definition: a short musical phrase repeated persistently throughout a piece, often beneath changing melodies
example: The neighbour's drill has become the ostinato beneath every video call I take.

hindi: बहिष्कार करना — किसी को समूह से बाहर कर देना
definition: exclude someone from a group or society, refusing every form of contact with them
example: The book club ostracised him for reading the ending first.

hindi: अन्यलोकी — किसी और ही लोक का-सा
definition: seeming to belong to another world beyond earthly things, dreamy and remote
example: The minimalist gallery had an otherworldly calm, right until the gift shop opened.

hindi: निरर्थक — निष्क्रिय, बेकार या अनावश्यक
definition: serving no practical purpose, idle, useless or simply unnecessary and better left out
example: The third reminder about the reminder email was, by any measure, otiose.

hindi: सम्मानजनक अवकाश — गरिमा के साथ विश्राम
definition: leisure with dignity; honourable retirement or restful ease earned after long, useful work
example: After forty years of spreadsheets, Dad has embraced otium cum dignitate and a very large garden.

hindi: अष्टपदी छंद — आठ पंक्तियों का तुकांत इतालवी छंद
definition: an Italian stanza of eight lines rhyming abababcc, used by Byron for comic verse
example: He summarised the quarterly numbers in ottava rima, and the board did not laugh at the couplet.

hindi: चलन-बाहर — फ़ैशन या उपयोग से बाहर हो चुका
definition: outdated and no longer fashionable or accepted, left behind by changing times
example: He defended his outmoded flip phone as a lifestyle rather than an oversight.

hindi: मर्यादा से परे — असामान्य और चौंकाने वाला
definition: unusual, shocking and going well beyond the bounds of what polite society considers proper
example: His outré suggestion of karaoke at the board meeting was, surprisingly, approved.

hindi: करतल ध्वनि — खड़े होकर की गई तालियों की लंबी गूँज
definition: a sustained burst of applause from a crowd on its feet
example: She got a standing ovation, which is the lesser honour and still the louder one.

hindi: उपक्रम-वाद्य — ओपेरा से पहले का आरंभिक संगीत; पहल का प्रस्ताव
definition: an orchestral opening piece introducing an opera; also a first friendly approach toward agreement
example: A plate of homemade cookies was the new neighbour's overture, and the parking dispute softened overnight.

hindi: मेषवत्‌ — भेड़ जैसा, बिना सोचे झुंड के पीछे चलने वाला
definition: like sheep; meek, docile and following the flock without thought
example: The ovine rush to buy whatever the influencer held up emptied the shelf by noon.

hindi: विरोधाभासी युग्म — दो परस्पर विरोधी शब्दों को एक साथ रखना
definition: pairing words with contradictory meanings side by side, such as 'deafening silence' or 'bittersweet'
example: "Mandatory fun" is an oxymoron, and so, the team suspects, is "quick sync."

hindi: सविनय असहमति — उनका सम्मान करते हुए
definition: borrowed Latin word meaning with polite respect to someone whose opinion the speaker then contradicts
example: Pace my dentist, a second coffee is not a lifestyle choice but a structural requirement.

hindi: स्थूलचर्मी — मोटी खाल वाला विशाल पशु; आलोचना से बेअसर व्यक्ति
definition: a large thick-skinned animal such as an elephant; figuratively, someone untouched by criticism
example: After twenty years in politics he was a pachyderm, and the angry replies slid right off.

hindi: शांति-स्थापना — अशांत क्षेत्र या व्यक्ति को शांत करना
definition: process of bringing peace and order to a troubled region, sometimes through military force
example: The pacification of the office thermostat war required a locked plastic cover.

hindi: संधियाँ निभानी होती हैं — समझौते का पालन अनिवार्य
definition: principle that agreements and treaties must be faithfully kept by those who signed them
example: You agreed to help me move house, and pacta sunt servanda, pizza or no pizza.

hindi: जयगान — किसी की महिमा में उल्लास भरा प्रशंसा-गीत
definition: a song or piece of writing full of joyful praise and triumphant thanks
example: Her review of the new espresso machine read like a paean from a woman who had finally slept.

hindi: धर्मवीर — किसी ध्येय का वीर योद्धा
definition: a heroic knight or brave champion who fights boldly for a noble cause
example: She became the paladin of the office thermostat, defending seventy-one degrees against all comers.

hindi: प्राचीन लिपिशास्त्र — पुरानी लिखावट पढ़ने की विद्या
definition: the study of ancient and medieval handwriting, used for reading and dating historic manuscripts
example: Deciphering the doctor's prescription called for skills bordering on palaeography.

hindi: रुचिकर — खाने या मानने योग्य
definition: pleasant enough to taste or swallow; also acceptable enough that people willingly agree with it
example: Pizza made the four-hour budget meeting almost palatable.

hindi: रुचि — जीभ का स्वाद-बोध, स्वाद की परख
definition: the sense of taste, or a person's ability to judge flavours finely and tell them apart
example: Years of vending-machine coffee had ruined his palate for anything decent.

hindi: महल-सा — राजमहल जैसा विशाल और वैभवपूर्ण
definition: resembling a palace: large, splendid, luxurious, grandly furnished and extremely costly
example: The startup's palatial office had a nap pod for every unpaid invoice.

hindi: बेकार की लंबी बातचीत — फ़िज़ूल का झंझट
definition: prolonged, idle talk or fuss, especially tedious discussion that achieves little
example: After an hour of palaver about the office fridge, nobody had thrown out the yoghurt.

hindi: सवारी घोड़ा — सहज चाल वाला हल्का सवारी का घोड़ा
definition: archaic: a gentle riding horse with smooth gait, used for travel rather than battle
example: The hotel's golf cart served as a palfrey, carrying guests gently between the spa and the bar.

hindi: पुनर्लिखित पांडुलिपि — मिटाकर दोबारा लिखा गया पत्र, जिसमें पुरानी परतें झलकें
definition: a manuscript page scraped and written over, with earlier writing still faintly visible
example: The office whiteboard is a palimpsest of three abandoned strategies.

hindi: पल्लादियो-शैली का — सममित, स्तंभ-सज्जित शास्त्रीय वास्तु-शैली वाला
definition: built in the classical manner of Andrea Palladio: balanced, symmetrical and adorned with temple fronts
example: The new suburb promises Palladian living, which means two plastic columns glued beside the garage.

hindi: उपशामक — रोग नहीं, केवल पीड़ा घटाने वाला
definition: relieving the pain or symptoms of illness, easing suffering without curing its underlying cause
example: Restarting the app is palliative; the bug will be back by Thursday.

hindi: पांडुवर्ण — फीका, पीला-सा रंग
definition: pale and lacking healthy colour in the face, often suggesting illness or weariness
example: The pallid auditors emerged from the windowless room blinking at the sunlight.

hindi: स्पष्ट अनुभवगम्य — इतना प्रबल कि मानो छुआ जा सके
definition: able to be touched or felt; so intense or obvious that it seems almost physical
example: The tension in the room was palpable when someone replied-all to the salary spreadsheet.

hindi: पक्षाघात — अंगों का लकवा या कंपन
definition: paralysis or uncontrollable trembling of the limbs, often with weakness of muscles and loss of feeling
example: Waiting for the exam results, his hands shook with a palsy no amount of chamomile could steady.

hindi: रामबाण — हर मर्ज़ का एक ही इलाज
definition: a single cure imagined to fix every ailment
example: Standups are not a panacea; a broken plan stays broken at nine in the morning.

hindi: ठसक — साहसी शान और आत्मविश्वासी अंदाज़
definition: bold, confident flair and style shown in doing something daring
example: She lost the chess match with such panache that everyone thought she had won.

hindi: हाहाकार — भारी शोर और पूरी अफ़रा-तफ़री
definition: wild noisy uproar and complete confusion, named after Milton's capital city of hell
example: Pandemonium broke out when the office announced free pizza in the lobby.

hindi: तुष्टिकरण करना — दूसरों की कमज़ोर इच्छाओं को भुनाना
definition: to cater shamelessly to people's lowest desires, tastes or prejudices, usually for personal profit or popularity
example: The headline pandered shamelessly to anyone who hates Mondays, which is everyone.

hindi: स्तुतिगान — सार्वजनिक रूप से किया गया भव्य गुणगान
definition: a formal public speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something lavishly
example: The launch keynote was less a product demo than a forty-minute panegyric to the founder.

hindi: रोटी और तमाशा — जनता को सस्ते भोजन व मनोरंजन से बहलाए रखना
definition: bread and circuses; cheap food and entertainment offered to keep the public quiet and distracted
example: Free snacks and a ping-pong table instead of raises: panem et circenses, office edition.

hindi: अति-आशावादी — हर हाल को सर्वोत्तम मानने वाला
definition: blindly hopeful, insisting everything happens for the best despite plain evidence otherwise
example: His Panglossian forecast survived three missed quarters and one missing CFO.

hindi: स्वयंभू महाप्रभु — खुद को बहुत बड़ा अधिकारी समझने वाला
definition: a person who holds, or pompously claims, great authority and importance over lesser people
example: The society secretary, a panjandrum with a laminated badge, fined us for laughing in the lift.

hindi: समूची श्रृंखला — प्रभावशाली पूरा साज़-सामान
definition: a full and impressive array of things
example: She boarded with a panoply of chargers for a two-hour flight.

hindi: देवमंडल — किसी क्षेत्र के सर्वोच्च नाम
definition: the set of figures a field honours above all others
example: Her second album put her in the pantheon of artists we argue about at weddings.

hindi: मूकाभिनय — बिना शब्दों के हाव-भाव से अभिनय; दिखावा
definition: a dumb show acting out a story through gesture without words; also a festive comic stage show
example: Across the noisy restaurant they conducted an entire argument in pantomime.

hindi: सर्वोत्तम रूप में — अपनी श्रेणी का सबसे उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण
definition: better than every other thing of its kind; the very finest, most typical example there is
example: She is the group-chat lurker par excellence: always reading, never typing.

hindi: दृष्टांत-कथा — नैतिक शिक्षा देने वाली छोटी कहानी
definition: a short, simple story told to teach a moral or spiritual lesson
example: His parable about the tortoise and the deadline convinced nobody to start early.

hindi: प्रतिमान — सोच और कार्य का ढाँचा
definition: the pattern of assumptions a field works inside
example: Remote work broke the old paradigm and nobody has finished writing the new one.

hindi: आदर्श प्रतिमान — किसी गुण का सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण
definition: a perfect example or model of some quality, especially moral excellence
example: The neighbour's son, a paragon of punctuality, has ruined every other child's excuses.

hindi: उपेक्षा-कथन — किसी बात को छोड़ने का दिखावा करके उसी पर ज़ोर देना
definition: drawing attention to something by pretending to pass over it, mentioning while claiming silence
example: "Let's not even discuss last quarter's numbers," the CFO began, then spent twenty minutes of paralipsis on them.

hindi: समानांतरता — मिलते-जुलते विचारों को एक जैसी व्याकरणिक बनावट में रखना
definition: using matching grammatical structure across related phrases or clauses, giving them balance and rhythm
example: The wedding speech leaned on parallelism — "she laughs at my jokes, she forgives my cooking" — and nobody minded.

hindi: सर्वोपरि — सबसे ऊपर, सबसे ज़रूरी
definition: more important than anything else; ranking highest above every other concern
example: Security is paramount, says the team whose password is still 'admin'.

hindi: गुप्त प्रेमी — विवाहित व्यक्ति का छिपा प्रेम-साथी
definition: a secret lover, especially one kept hidden outside a marriage by someone already married
example: The senator's paramour turned out to be the one leaking his calendar.

hindi: मुंडेर — छत या पुल के किनारे की नीची रक्षा-दीवार
definition: a protective wall rising along the edge of a roof, bridge, terrace or balcony
example: Pigeons, smokers and one philosophical intern share the office parapet at four every afternoon.

hindi: तामझाम — किसी काम से जुड़ा ढेर सारा सामान
definition: the miscellaneous equipment, accessories, gadgets and belongings that accompany a particular hobby or activity
example: Moving desks meant hauling the full paraphernalia of remote work: ring light, mic arm and three dongles.

hindi: समाज-बहिष्कृत — जिसे सब अपने से दूर रखें
definition: person shunned, rejected and avoided by society or a group because of some disgrace
example: Bring durian to the office fridge once and you become a pariah by lunch.

hindi: वार्ता — शत्रुओं के बीच शर्तों पर बातचीत
definition: face-to-face discussion between enemies, especially held to agree the terms of a truce
example: A parley was called on the staircase to decide whose turn it was to take the bins.

hindi: काव्यलोकीय — कविता और कवियों के संसार से जुड़ा
definition: relating to poetry and poets, taking its name from the mountain sacred to the muses
example: The café's open-mic night has Parnassian aspirations and a broken microphone.

hindi: काव्यलोक — कवियों और साहित्य की ऊँचाई
definition: the mountain home of poetry and the arts, standing for literary excellence and poetic fame
example: Thanks to one viral poem, she had briefly ascended Parnassus by way of Instagram.

hindi: श्लेष — मिलती-जुलती ध्वनि वाले शब्दों से अर्थ का खेल करना
definition: wordplay on words that sound alike but differ in meaning; the formal name for punning
example: The bakery's sign read "Knead to know basis," paronomasia that sold surprisingly many loaves.

hindi: स्पष्टवादिता — सत्ता के सामने निर्भीक सच कहना
definition: frank, fearless speech that tells powerful people the truth despite personal risk
example: Telling the founder his idea had been tried five times was pure parrhesia, and brief employment.

hindi: कृपण — पैसा खर्च करने में बेहद कंजूस
definition: extremely unwilling to spend money, stingy even with small everyday amounts
example: The parsimonious landlord fixed the boiler with duct tape and a prayer.

hindi: कृपणता — खर्च करने में अति कंजूसी
definition: extreme unwillingness to spend money
example: The department's parsimony extended to rationing the printer paper.

hindi: पादरी-गृह — पल्ली पुरोहित का घर
definition: the house a church provides for its parish priest or minister and household to live in
example: The Brontës grew up in a parsonage and still out-wrote every writing retreat with a juice bar.

hindi: क्यारीबाग़ — सजावटी नक्शे में बनी क्यारियों का बाग़
definition: a formal garden of flower beds laid out in ornamental geometric patterns
example: From the drone shot the parterre looked immaculate; up close, the pigeons had opinions.

hindi: पूर्वाग्रह — पहले से तय किया हुआ मत
definition: a position decided before hearing the argument, which then colours everything judged afterward
example: The panel arrived with a parti pris against tabs, so the spaces advocate never stood a chance.

hindi: अपराध-सहभागी — अपराध में साझेदार
definition: a partner in crime; an accomplice who knowingly shares in planning or committing an unlawful offence
example: My sister, particeps criminis in every midnight snack raid, never once confessed.

hindi: पक्षधर — एक दल या मत का अंधा समर्थक
definition: strongly and unfairly favouring one side, party or cause over every other
example: The family group chat turned partisan the moment someone asked whose turn it was to host Diwali.

hindi: कल का अमीर — जो अचानक ऊँचे वर्ग में पहुँच गया
definition: a person who has recently risen to wealth or social rank but is not accepted there
example: The old members treated him as a parvenu, even after he paid for the new clubhouse roof.

hindi: सार्वजनिक व्यंग्य-पर्चा — किसी हस्ती पर चिपकाया गया उपहास-लेख
definition: a satirical lampoon mocking a public figure, originally posted anonymously in a public place
example: Someone taped a pasquinade about the new parking policy to the lift, and nobody admits typing it.

hindi: संध्या-भ्रमण — शाम को सबके साथ इत्मीनान से टहलना
definition: the Italian custom of a leisurely evening stroll through town, seeing neighbours and being seen
example: Our office passeggiata is a slow lap to the coffee machine at four.

hindi: यत्र-तत्र — पूरी पुस्तक में जगह-जगह
definition: here and there throughout a book, marking a topic mentioned in many scattered places
example: In my memoir's index, the entry for coffee simply reads passim.

hindi: गुज़रा हुआ — जिसका दौर बीत चुका
definition: no longer fashionable or current, its brief moment of popularity having already passed
example: Avocado toast is passé, declared the café that now charges double for it on sourdough.

hindi: अनुकरण-रचना — दूसरों की शैली की नक़ल से बनी कृति
definition: an artwork imitating or blending the styles of earlier artists, periods or famous works
example: The new café is a pastiche of every café on Instagram, down to the neon quote.

hindi: चरागाही — गाँव, चरागाह और गड़रियों के शांत जीवन से जुड़ा
definition: showing countryside and shepherd life as simple, peaceful and charming, distant from busy towns
example: The bank's advert was so pastoral you'd think mortgages grazed in meadows.

hindi: कुलपति — परिवार का पुरुष मुखिया
definition: the male head of a household or family, holding traditional authority over all its members
example: He carves the Sunday roast with the grave ceremony of a Roman paterfamilias and a blunt knife.

hindi: करुण भाव — दया और दुःख जगाने वाला गुण
definition: the quality in something that stirs pity or sorrow
example: The ad reaches for pathos with a dog, a suitcase, and one piano chord.

hindi: कुलपति — परिवार या समुदाय का सबसे बुज़ुर्ग मुखिया
definition: the eldest male head of a family or community, respected for long years and authority
example: The family patriarch still controls the thermostat, and nobody has ever seen the password.

hindi: कुलीन — पुराने अभिजात वर्ग के ढंग और संस्कार वाला
definition: having the manner or breeding of a long-established upper class
example: His patrician drawl has survived four decades in a party that claims to hate it.

hindi: न्यूनता — बहुत कम मात्रा या संख्या
definition: scarcity; the presence of something in only small, insufficient amount or number
example: The paucity of evidence did not stop the comment section from reaching a verdict.

hindi: कंगाल — जिसके पास कुछ भी न हो
definition: very poor person, especially one depending on public charity to live
example: One look at the rent statement and she felt a pauper in her own flat.

hindi: रोमन शांति — प्रबल शक्ति द्वारा थोपी गई लंबी शांति
definition: long peace imposed across a region by a single dominant power, named after Rome's empire
example: Since Grandma took charge of the group chat, the family has enjoyed a Pax Romana.

hindi: शांति तुम्हारे साथ हो — आशीर्वाद भरा अभिवादन
definition: peace be with you; a Church blessing, sometimes used as a solemn greeting or farewell
example: He left the heated budget meeting with a cheerful pax vobiscum.

hindi: शांतिप्रिय — स्वभाव से झगड़े से बचने वाला
definition: inclined to avoid quarrels and live quietly without conflict or hostility
example: A peaceable man, he settled the group-chat war by muting it.

hindi: किसान वर्ग — ज़मीन जोतने वाले ग्रामीण श्रमिक
definition: the class of poor rural farm workers and smallholders, ranking lowest in traditional society
example: The lord of the manor now calls the peasantry his community stakeholders.

hindi: छोटी भूल — मामूली दोष या अपराध
definition: a small, trivial fault or moral lapse, easily excused and quickly forgiven
example: Stealing chips off a friend's plate is a peccadillo; the whole basket is a felony.

hindi: पाखंडी सदाचारी — ऊपर से धर्मात्मा, भीतर स्वार्थी
definition: hypocritically preaching virtue and morality while quietly serving selfish interests
example: His Pecksniffian speech on work-life balance was sent at two in the morning.

hindi: गबन — सौंपे गए सार्वजनिक धन का निजी उपयोग
definition: stealing public money or funds held in trust by an official for private gain
example: The club treasurer's new kayak raised quiet questions about peculation.

hindi: आर्थिक — धन या पैसों से संबंधित
definition: relating to money, covering payments, debts, fines, costs and other financial matters
example: Our friendship survived everything except a pecuniary dispute over splitting the pizza.

hindi: शिक्षक — पढ़ाने वाला, प्रायः उपदेशात्मक
definition: a teacher or schoolmaster, especially a strict, pedantic one fond of instructing others
example: The pedagogue at the dinner party turned a simple question about wine into a forty-minute lecture.

hindi: शिक्षाशास्त्र — पढ़ाने की कला और उसका विधान
definition: the method, craft and theory of teaching, including which approaches help students learn best
example: His pedagogy consisted of reading the slides aloud, slowly, with feeling.

hindi: पंडिताऊ व्यक्ति — छोटे-छोटे नियमों पर अड़ने वाला ज्ञानी
definition: someone who fusses over small rules and details of learning to flaunt their knowledge
example: The pedant in the group chat corrected 'less' to 'fewer' during a fire alarm.

hindi: पंडिताऊ — छोटी बारीकियों पर अनावश्यक ज़ोर देने वाला
definition: fussing excessively over small rules and details of learning, often to flaunt knowledge
example: His pedantic code review flagged forty commas and missed the security hole.

hindi: पांडित्य-प्रदर्शन — बारीक नियमों पर दिखावटी अड़ियलपन
definition: excessive fuss over small rules and details of learning, used to flaunt knowledge
example: Pedantry is explaining that a tomato is a fruit while the salad goes cold.

hindi: वंशावली — कुलीन वंश-परंपरा की प्रतिष्ठा
definition: a recorded line of distinguished ancestors, or the social prestige that comes from noble lineage
example: The dog's pedigree is longer than mine and, frankly, better documented.

hindi: त्रिकोणिका — स्तंभों के ऊपर भवन के मुख का त्रिकोण शीर्ष
definition: the triangular gable crowning the front of a classical building, just above its columns
example: The bank's pediment proclaims permanence in marble, while its app crashes every payday.

hindi: सामंत-पद — उपाधिधारी अभिजात कुलीनों की श्रेणी
definition: the rank of titled nobles, or the whole body of peers holding such titles
example: One generous donation later, the peerage welcomed a baron of discount furniture.

hindi: अद्वितीय — जिसके बराबर कोई न हो
definition: without any equal anywhere; better than every other person or thing of the same kind
example: Her spreadsheet formulas are peerless and utterly unreadable.

hindi: अपमानसूचक — किसी शब्द में तिरस्कार का भाव
definition: expressing contempt or disapproval; used especially of insulting words, names and labels given to people
example: In some offices, 'visionary' has quietly become a pejorative.

hindi: महासागरीय — तट से दूर खुले समुद्र से संबंधित
definition: relating to the open ocean, distant from coast or shore, away from land
example: The cruise sold itself as a pelagic adventure and delivered an all-day buffet.

hindi: माल — धन-दौलत, विशेषकर बेईमानी से जुटाई हुई
definition: money or riches, usually gained dishonestly and mentioned with scornful contempt for greedy wealth
example: The influencer's pelf came from selling courses on how to sell courses.

hindi: अंधाधुंध — हड़बड़ाते हुए और बेतरतीब ढंग से
definition: in reckless disorderly haste, with everything rushing together in confusion
example: Shoppers poured pell-mell through the doors when the sale began.

hindi: स्वच्छ — पारदर्शी और चमकता हुआ साफ़
definition: clear and transparent, letting light pass cleanly through, like pure water
example: The mountain stream was pellucid, the trail map considerably less so.

hindi: वादकालीन — मुक़दमा चलते रहने के दौरान
definition: while the lawsuit remains pending, during the period before the court reaches judgment
example: The dog's custody was settled pendente lite: weekdays with her, weekends with him, treats with nobody.

hindi: पताका — भाले पर लगी लंबी तिकोनी झंडी
definition: a long narrow triangular flag carried on a knight's lance as his personal banner
example: The cyclists rode out with little orange pennons on poles, a peloton of very polite knights.

hindi: पैसा-पंक्ति लेखक — भाड़े का सस्ता लेखक
definition: archaic: a hack writer paid by the line, producing cheap, padded prose for newspapers
example: Paid per word, the content farm's penny-a-liners never met an adjective they would not use twice.

hindi: पंचचरणी छंद — हर पंक्ति में पाँच चरण
definition: a line of verse built from five metrical feet, most famously iambic pentameter in English poetry
example: He wrote his resignation email in iambic pentameter, which HR found both moving and unnecessary.

hindi: पुनर्दृश्य रेखा — चित्र के नीचे से झाँकती पुरानी, बदली हुई आकृति
definition: an earlier painted image showing faintly through later paint, revealing the artist's changes
example: Under the fresh coat of office paint, a pentimento of the old logo still haunted the lobby.

hindi: उपच्छाया — पूर्ण छाया के चारों ओर की हल्की छाया
definition: the partly shadowed fringe around a dark shadow, where light is only partly blocked
example: He sat in the penumbra of the meeting, visible enough to count, dim enough to scroll.

hindi: निर्धन और कृपण — अत्यंत ग़रीब या हद से कंजूस
definition: extremely poor, or else so stingy that someone lives as though completely penniless
example: The penurious poet sold his couch to fund a chapbook nobody bought.

hindi: दरिद्रता — भयंकर ग़रीबी और अभाव
definition: extreme poverty, lacking money even for the most basic daily needs
example: Three unpaid internships brought him to the brink of penury and a LinkedIn post about grit.

hindi: प्रतिवर्ष — हर साल के हिसाब से
definition: for each year, used when stating yearly rates, salaries, costs or interest
example: The gym costs a modest sum per annum and a much larger sum in guilt.

hindi: कठिनाइयों से होकर तारों तक — संघर्ष के मार्ग से ऊँचाई की ओर
definition: through hard struggle and hardship to the stars; a motto of striving upward against difficulty
example: Per ardua ad astra: the startup reached profitability after two pivots and one very long winter.

hindi: कठोर राहों से सितारों तक — कष्ट सहकर ही सफलता मिलती है
definition: through rough hardship to the stars; success reached only by enduring struggle and difficulty
example: Per aspera ad astra, she told herself, on the fourth rejected draft of her thesis.

hindi: प्रति व्यक्ति — हर एक व्यक्ति के हिसाब से
definition: for each person, used when dividing a total figure evenly across a whole population
example: Our office leads the city in coffee consumption per capita, and in nothing else.

hindi: इसके विपरीत — दूसरी ओर
definition: formal phrase meaning conversely, contrasting this side against the opposing point
example: Remote work saves commuting; per contra, it turns the kitchen into a permanent office.

hindi: न्यायालय द्वारा — किसी एक न्यायाधीश के नाम के बिना
definition: a judgment issued by the whole court collectively, without naming any single author
example: The ruling came down per curiam, leaving law students no single judge to blame in their essays.

hindi: स्वयं में — अपने आप में, अन्य संदर्भ हटाकर
definition: in itself, considered apart from anything connected to it
example: The app isn't slow per se; the network it trusts is.

hindi: कदाचित — संयोगवश, शायद ऐसा हो
definition: archaic: perhaps, possibly, by chance; also doubt or uncertainty about something happening
example: If, peradventure, the Wi-Fi works today, we shall hold the call on video.

hindi: विचरण करना — इत्मीनान से पैदल घूमना
definition: walk around a place at leisure, strolling without hurry or fixed purpose
example: We perambulated the farmers' market for an hour and bought exactly one lemon.

hindi: संभवतः — शायद, किसी संयोग से
definition: archaic: perhaps, possibly, maybe; by some lucky chance it could happen or turn out true
example: Is there, perchance, a charger hiding in anybody's bag?

hindi: सुग्राहिता — सूक्ष्म बातों को समझने की संवेदनशील क्षमता
definition: the rare quality of noticing and understanding things with quick, sensitive insight
example: With uncanny percipience, the dog hid before anyone said the word bath.

hindi: सुग्राही — बारीकियों को गहराई से महसूस करने और समझने वाला
definition: unusually perceptive, noticing and understanding things with quick, sensitive insight
example: A percipient waiter brought the bill the moment one diner started checking the time.

hindi: देशाटन — दूर देशों की लंबी, भटकती यात्रा
definition: a long, wandering journey, especially one through many distant foreign places
example: His gap-year peregrination through twelve countries produced four thousand photos and one clean shirt.

hindi: विश्वासघाती — भरोसा तोड़कर धोखा देने वाला
definition: deceitfully betraying the trust, loyalty and faith that someone had placed in them
example: The perfidious cat accepted breakfast from both neighbours and loyalty to neither.

hindi: विश्वासघात — भरोसे या वचन को जानबूझकर तोड़ना
definition: deliberate betrayal of trust or of a promise given
example: Selling the client list to a rival was perfidy, not ambition.

hindi: विवशतावश — लाचारी में, आवश्यकता से
definition: archaic: by necessity, unavoidably, because circumstances force it whether anyone likes it or not
example: The lift broke, so we perforce climbed nine floors carrying the sofa.

hindi: लता-मंडप — बेलों से ढका खंभेदार बाग़ीचा-पथ
definition: a garden walkway framed by columns and crossbeams, along which climbing vines grow trained overhead
example: Every summer the pergola promises dappled shade, and every summer the wisteria declines to participate.

hindi: उपसौर — कक्षा का सूर्य के सबसे निकट बिंदु
definition: the point in a planet's or comet's orbit where it swings nearest to the blazing solar centre
example: Our holiday budget reaches perihelion in December, burning hottest just before it swings away.

hindi: घुमंतू — काम या रहने के लिए एक जगह से दूसरी जगह घूमता हुआ
definition: travelling from place to place, especially for work, never settling anywhere for long
example: Her peripatetic consulting career means her suitcase knows more cities than her houseplants do.

hindi: भाग्य-विपर्यय — कथा में अचानक उलटा मोड़
definition: a sudden reversal of fortune or circumstances, especially within a tragic story
example: The peripeteia came when the villain of the meeting turned out to be the new manager.

hindi: पर्यायोक्ति — एक शब्द की जगह लंबा घुमावदार कथन
definition: roundabout expression using several words where one plain word would serve directly
example: "Negative patient care outcome" is periphrasis the hospital lawyers were paid to invent.

hindi: परिस्तंभ — आँगन को चारों ओर से घेरती खंभों की क़तार
definition: a line of columns surrounding a courtyard or running around a building on every side
example: The hotel's peristyle courtyard is perfect for wedding photos and terrible for finding the exit.

hindi: झूठी गवाही — शपथ लेकर जानबूझकर झूठ बोलना
definition: crime of deliberately telling lies after swearing under oath to tell truth
example: Swearing you 'loved the book' at book club is not technically perjury, but it is close.

hindi: उपसंहार करना — भाषण को ओजस्वी समापन देना
definition: to finish a speech with a grand summing up, or to speak at great length
example: The best man perorated for so long that the cake began to lean.

hindi: उपसंहार — भाषण का प्रभावशाली समापन अंश
definition: the grand closing part of a speech, designed to stir and persuade listeners
example: His peroration on teamwork would have landed better had he not left before the cleanup.

hindi: विचारना — ध्यान से तौलना-सोचना
definition: archaic: to weigh something carefully in thought and consider its merits attentively
example: Perpend, dear reader, whether that fourth subscription service is truly necessary.

hindi: उपहास-विनोद — हल्का, व्यंग्यपूर्ण मज़ाक
definition: light, mocking banter that teases gently and treats serious matters with playful irony
example: The retirement speech was pure persiflage, roasting forty years of missed deadlines with genuine affection.

hindi: अवांछित व्यक्ति — जिसका आना अब स्वीकार्य नहीं
definition: someone no longer welcome in a place or group
example: One leaked memo made her persona non grata at head office.

hindi: मानवीकरण — निर्जीव वस्तु या भाव को मनुष्य जैसे गुण देना
definition: giving human qualities, feelings or actions to a lifeless object, animal or abstract idea
example: "The Wi-Fi is sulking again" is personification, and also a fair description of the router.

hindi: सूक्ष्मदर्शी — जो छिपी बातें भी झट भाँप ले
definition: quick to notice and understand things that other people miss, especially hidden motives
example: A perspicacious reviewer asked why the demo only ever worked on the founder's laptop.

hindi: सूक्ष्मदृष्टि — छिपी बात को तुरंत पकड़ लेने की क्षमता
definition: the sharp ability to notice and quickly understand things that other people miss
example: Her perspicacity was not magic; she simply read the terms and conditions.

hindi: सुस्पष्ट — इतना साफ़ कि तुरंत समझ आ जाए
definition: plainly written or expressed so clearly that every reader understands its meaning immediately
example: The one perspicuous page in the manual was, naturally, the warranty exclusions.

hindi: महामारी — घातक, तेज़ी से फैलने वाला रोग
definition: a deadly epidemic disease spreading rapidly through a population, such as plague
example: The pestilence of reply-all emails swept the company before lunch.

hindi: निम्न-मध्यवर्गीय — छोटे मालिकों वाली संकीर्ण सोच
definition: belonging to the lower middle class of shopkeepers and small owners, often implying narrow conventional attitudes
example: Complaining about the neighbour's bins is gloriously petit bourgeois, and he knows it.

hindi: सोंधी गंध — पहली बारिश में उठती मिट्टी की महक
definition: pleasant, earthy smell rising from warm, dry ground after first rainfall
example: The petrichor after the storm was lovely, until the drains added their own notes.

hindi: तुच्छतावादी — महत्वहीन बारीकियों में उलझा रहने वाला
definition: fussing and arguing over petty, trivial details as though they really mattered greatly
example: The pettifogging clause about stapler ownership ran to three pages of the tenancy agreement.

hindi: मायाभास — मन या भूत-प्रेत से उपजी भ्रामक छवि
definition: a ghostly figure or illusion, a thing seen that exists only in the mind or spirit world
example: The promised four-day work week remains a phantasm of the quarterly town hall.

hindi: पाखंडी — नियमों के बाहरी पालन पर गर्व, भीतर से खोखला
definition: self-righteously obsessed with outward religious rules while lacking real inner virtue
example: The HOA's pharisaical fuss over lawn height ignored the burst pipe next door.

hindi: पाखंडी धर्मात्मा — जो दिखावटी पवित्रता से दूसरों को नीचा दिखाए
definition: a hypocritical person who parades strict outward virtue while judging everyone else
example: The Pharisee of the book club lectures us on spoilers and reads the last page first.

hindi: इश्कबाज़ी करना — कई स्त्रियों से हल्के प्रेम-संबंध रखना
definition: to chase many women casually, one flirtation after another, without serious romantic commitment
example: He philandered across three dating apps and still claimed he was too busy for love.

hindi: लोकोपकार — जनकल्याण के लिए उदार धन-दान
definition: generous giving of money and effort to promote the welfare and happiness of others
example: His philanthropy came with a naming right, a press release and a tax receipt.

hindi: आक्रोश-भाषण — किसी व्यक्ति पर तीखा सार्वजनिक आक्रमण
definition: a bitter, fiery speech denouncing a particular person, after Demosthenes attacking Philip of Macedon
example: The council meeting ended with a philippic against the man who approved the roundabout.

hindi: कलाहीन व्यक्ति — कला और संस्कृति से उदासीन या उसका तिरस्कार करने वाला
definition: someone indifferent or openly hostile to culture, beauty, the arts and serious learning
example: Only a philistine would use a first-edition novel to level the table, he said, levelling the table.

hindi: भाषाशास्त्री — भाषा और प्राचीन ग्रंथों का विद्वान
definition: a scholar who studies language history and ancient literary texts, tracing words and meanings
example: The philologist spent the wedding explaining where the word 'bride' came from, to the bride.

hindi: विद्याप्रेमी — ज्ञान और सीखने का रसिया
definition: a devoted lover of learning who studies many subjects purely for the pleasure of knowing
example: A true philomath, he finished the free online course and then emailed the professor three follow-up questions.

hindi: वशीकरण-रस — प्रेम जगाने वाला जादुई पेय
definition: a magical potion or drink believed to make someone fall helplessly in romantic love
example: A double espresso is the nearest thing this office has to a love philtre.

hindi: शिरावेध — नस काटकर रक्त निकालना
definition: the medical practice of opening a vein to draw blood, once used to cure disease
example: Old doctors trusted phlebotomy for everything; the annual health check still wants three vials.

hindi: भीति — कारण से कहीं बड़ा डर
definition: a fear far out of proportion to the thing feared
example: His phobia of public speaking survives every workshop the company pays for.

hindi: पुनर्जीवित — राख से फिर उठ खड़ा होने वाला
definition: something that rises restored from its own destruction
example: The mill closed in 1998 and reopened as a phoenix of glass and coffee shops.

hindi: स्फुरदीप्त — अंधेरे में धीमी चमक देने वाला
definition: glowing faintly in darkness without heat or flame, long after light fades
example: The phosphorescent stars on his ceiling have outlasted three landlords.

hindi: यक्ष्मा — फेफड़ों का क्षय
definition: archaic: a wasting disease of the lungs, the older medical name for tuberculosis
example: The costume drama's doctor diagnosed phthisis with more confidence than the scriptwriter had research.

hindi: रक्षा-मंजूषा — मंत्र या पवित्र लेख रखी छोटी डिबिया
definition: a small case holding sacred texts or written charms, worn as protection or religious observance
example: The founder keeps the first customer's cheque in his wallet like a phylactery.

hindi: औषध — दवा और चिकित्सा की विद्या
definition: archaic: medicine or a remedy for sickness, and also the healing profession practised by physicians
example: The group chat prescribes one physic for every ailment: drink water and log off.

hindi: मुखलक्षण — चेहरे की बनावट और नैन-नक्श
definition: the shape and features of a person's face, sometimes read as clues to their character
example: The portrait artist studied his physiognomy for an hour, then drew him as a potato.

hindi: अति मंद स्वर में — बहुत धीरे और कोमलता से
definition: played or sung very softly and gently, at the quietest, most delicate musical volume
example: He opened the snack wrapper pianissimo, but the whole cinema still turned around.

hindi: आवारा-नायक शैली का — किसी चालाक घुमक्कड़ के क़िस्सों वाली कथा
definition: describing a novel that follows a roguish, likeable wanderer through a loose string of episodic adventures
example: His gap year was pure picaresque: three countries, two lost passports and one borrowed moped.

hindi: छोटा जलदस्यु — ठग, लुटेरा या उसका जहाज़
definition: a rogue or petty pirate, or a small ship used for plunder and raiding
example: The picaroon in accounts keeps raiding everyone's stash of good pens.

hindi: लाक्षणिक — विशेष, गैर-शाब्दिक अर्थ में कहा गया
definition: meant in a special, harmless sense rather than literally, softening an apparent insult
example: When she called him an idiot, she insisted it was in a purely Pickwickian sense.

hindi: नगर-निवास — शहर में रखा छोटा दूसरा घर
definition: a small second home or flat kept in a city for occasional stays
example: She calls the one-bedroom above the bakery her pied-à-terre, which sounds better than overflow storage.

hindi: काव्य-प्रेरक — कला और ज्ञान के स्रोत से जुड़ा
definition: relating to poetic inspiration and learning, from the sacred spring of the muses
example: Two coffees in, she finally drank from the Pierian spring and the essay began.

hindi: भित्ति-स्तंभ — दीवार से थोड़ा उभरा सजावटी चपटा खंभा
definition: a flat rectangular column projecting slightly from a wall, mostly for decoration rather than support
example: Like a pilaster, the deputy manager looks structural but is holding up nothing at all.

hindi: अनुच्छेद-चिह्न — नए अनुच्छेद को दर्शाने वाला चिह्न
definition: the printed paragraph mark ¶, shaped like a reversed capital letter, showing where a new paragraph begins
example: Turning on formatting marks fills the screen with pilcrows, tiny flags over every accidental line break.

hindi: उठाईगीरी करना — थोड़ा-थोड़ा करके छोटी चीज़ें चुराना
definition: steal small things, often repeatedly and in small amounts, from somewhere
example: Hotel guests pilfer the tiny shampoos with the serene conscience of saints.

hindi: तीर्थयात्रा — श्रद्धा से किसी पवित्र या प्रिय स्थान की यात्रा
definition: a long journey to a sacred or deeply meaningful place, made out of devotion
example: Fans make the pilgrimage to the original bakery, queue for two hours and photograph a croissant.

hindi: लूटना — युद्ध में बलपूर्वक लूटपाट करना
definition: violently plunder a place, stealing goods during warfare or conquest
example: The teenagers pillaged the fridge and left only condiments standing.

hindi: नमक का खंभा — भय या आश्चर्य से जड़ हो जाना
definition: someone frozen motionless by shock, fear or amazement, like Lot's wife
example: Seeing her boss at the karaoke bar, she turned into a pillar of salt mid-chorus.

hindi: सार्वजनिक निंदा करना — खुलेआम उपहास और अपमान करना
definition: attack or ridicule someone publicly; originally, punish them in wooden stocks
example: The internet pilloried the brand for a tweet that took nine people to approve.

hindi: शिखर — उपलब्धि की सबसे ऊँची चोटी
definition: the highest point of success or achievement, like a slender mountain peak
example: He reached the pinnacle of his profession and found only a slightly better chair.

hindi: चटपटा — तीखा, रोचक स्वाद वाला
definition: having a pleasantly sharp, spicy taste; also lively, stimulating and interesting to the mind
example: The piquant chutney rescued an otherwise forgettable office buffet.

hindi: मत्स्याखेटीय — मछली पकड़ने और मछुआरों से संबंधित
definition: concerning fishing, anglers, rods and the patient pastime of catching fish
example: His piscatorial weekends involved one trout, nine sandwiches and total silence.

hindi: मत्स्यवत्‌ — मछली जैसा, ठंडा, चिकना और गोल आँखों वाला
definition: like fish; cold, slippery, scaly, wide eyed and gaping
example: His piscine handshake left everyone reaching discreetly for the sanitiser.

hindi: सारगर्भित और चुटीला — छोटा पर गहरा
definition: brief speech full of meaning, clever words that pack much sense into little space
example: His pithy toast lasted nine seconds and got the loudest laugh of the wedding.

hindi: नगण्य राशि — बहुत थोड़ा, अपर्याप्त पैसा
definition: very small, inadequate amount of money paid or received for work
example: Streaming pays musicians a pittance per play and a fortune in exposure.

hindi: तार-चुटकी — धनुष की जगह उँगली से तार छेड़कर बजाया गया
definition: played by plucking the strings of a violin or cello with the fingers rather than drawing horsehair across them
example: Rain fell on the tin roof in a pizzicato patter that made the whole cabin sound like an orchestra tuning up.

hindi: सर्वोत्कृष्ट कृति — संग्रह या भोज की सबसे शानदार चीज़
definition: the most impressive item or showpiece in a collection, meal or artistic work, saved for last
example: The starters were fine, but the pièce de résistance was a biryani that silenced the table.

hindi: शांतिकारी — गुस्सा ठंडा करने के उद्देश्य से
definition: intended to calm anger and make an offended person less hostile
example: The airline's placatory voucher covered roughly one sandwich.

hindi: कृपापात्र पदधारी — संरक्षक की कृपा से मिले पद पर बैठा व्यक्ति
definition: a person appointed to a position as political reward, expected to serve their patron's interests
example: The new director is widely seen as a placeman who will nod through whatever the chairman wants.

hindi: साहित्यिक चोरी करना — दूसरे के लेखन को अपना बताना
definition: to copy another person's writing, words or ideas and present them dishonestly as your original work
example: He plagiarized the wedding speech from a film, and the bride had seen it.

hindi: खरा व्यवहार — छल-कपट रहित, सीधा-सच्चा लेन-देन
definition: honest, straightforward conduct in dealings with others, free from trickery or hidden motives
example: The seller's plain dealing, listing every scratch in the photos, earned him five stars.

hindi: सीधा-सच्चा वक्ता — सरल, खरी भाषा में बात कहने वाला
definition: speaking plainly and honestly in simple words, without fancy phrasing or flattery
example: The plainspoken mechanic said the car was fine and the driver was the problem.

hindi: करुण स्वर वाला — ऊँची, गूँजती और उदास ध्वनि वाला
definition: loud, deep and resonant in sound, carrying a mournful, plaintive, lamenting quality
example: A plangent cello line drifted from the flat upstairs every time the landlord raised the rent.

hindi: अकाम — शारीरिक आकर्षण रहित आत्मीय प्रेम
definition: describing intimate, affectionate friendship without romantic or sexual desire
example: They insisted it was purely platonic, right up to the joint mortgage.

hindi: वाहवाही — किसी काम पर मिली तालियाँ और सराहना
definition: praise and applause given enthusiastically by admirers for something done especially well
example: The intern won plaudits for a slide deck that, crucially, had only five slides.

hindi: गूँथना — डालियाँ आपस में बुनकर बाड़ बनाना
definition: to interweave living branches of trees or hedges together into a dense screen or arch
example: The neighbours pleached their limes into a green wall, which is how you say fence politely.

hindi: जनसाधारण का — आम लोगों जैसा, अपरिष्कृत
definition: belonging to or suited to ordinary people; lacking refinement
example: He apologised for his plebeian taste in films, then defended it for a full hour.

hindi: कृत्तिका-मंडल — प्रतिभाशाली जनों की चमकती टोली
definition: a brilliant group of seven or so gifted people, named after the Pleiades star cluster
example: The founding engineers were hailed as a Pleiad, though two of them still couldn't fix the printer.

hindi: खुले आकाश तले — बाहर प्रकृति में बैठकर चित्र बनाना
definition: painting done outdoors, directly from nature rather than inside a studio
example: Her plein air landscapes involve two hours of painting and forty minutes of swatting mosquitoes.

hindi: सर्वसदस्यीय — जिसमें सभा के सभी सदस्य उपस्थित हों
definition: attended by every member of an assembly, conference or council rather than smaller committees
example: The plenary session was where everyone learned what the breakout groups had already quietly decided.

hindi: पूर्णाधिकारी राजदूत — संधि करने का पूरा अधिकार रखने वाला
definition: diplomat given full power to negotiate and sign agreements for a government
example: She went to the car dealership as the family plenipotentiary, empowered to walk out.

hindi: परिपूर्णता — पूरी भरपूरता, प्रचुरता
definition: fullness and abundance; a plentiful, complete supply or quantity of something wanted
example: The buffet offered a plenitude of dishes and exactly one free chair.

hindi: पुनरुक्ति दोष — अनावश्यक दोहराव वाले शब्द
definition: using more words than needed, especially words that repeat meaning already expressed
example: "Free gift" is a pleonasm, but marketing has never met a redundancy it wouldn't print.

hindi: बहुतायत — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा भरमार
definition: an amount so large it becomes a problem of its own
example: There is a plethora of dashboards and not one answer to the actual question.

hindi: चबूतरा — मूर्ति या खंभे के नीचे का ठोस आधार
definition: the heavy square base or solid block on which a column, statue or building rests
example: The city removed the general's statue and left an empty plinth that skateboarders now adore.

hindi: पंखावली — पक्षी के सारे पंख; भड़कीली सजावट
definition: the feathers covering a bird; figuratively, showy colourful clothing and finery
example: The wedding guests arrived in full plumage, outshining the actual peacocks on the lawn.

hindi: जितना बदलता है, उतना ही वैसा रहता है — बदलाव ऊपरी है
definition: a French saying: the more things change, the more they remain essentially the same underneath all surface novelty
example: A new app for booking meetings, and still nobody reads the agenda; plus ça change.

hindi: धनिकतंत्र — धनवानों का शासन
definition: government where power rests with the wealthy, whose money buys influence
example: The school board became a quiet plutocracy once the biggest donors started choosing the syllabus.

hindi: धनिकतंत्री — धन के बल पर सत्ता चलाने वाला अमीर
definition: person whose power and influence come from great personal wealth and money
example: The plutocrat insisted he was self-made, starting with only a modest inheritance.

hindi: वर्षाजन्य — वर्षा से भरपूर या उससे बना
definition: relating to rain; marked by heavy, abundant rainfall over long seasons
example: Our pluvial city owns more umbrellas than residents, and loses most of them on trains.

hindi: राजकवि — राष्ट्र या संस्था द्वारा सम्मानित आधिकारिक कवि
definition: a poet officially appointed to write verse for national or ceremonial occasions
example: She is the unofficial poet laureate of the family group chat, with a rhyme for every birthday.

hindi: कवि जन्म लेता है, बनाया नहीं जाता — सच्ची प्रतिभा जन्मजात होती है
definition: poets are born, not made; true artistic talent is inborn and cannot simply be taught
example: After a twelve-week songwriting course produced three jingles, he conceded poeta nascitur, non fit.

hindi: तुक्कड़ कवि — घटिया कविता लिखने वाला
definition: a writer of poor, trivial verse who wrongly believes they are a real poet
example: The poetaster at open mic rhymed "love" with "above" four times and bowed each time.

hindi: विवाद-लेख — किसी मत पर प्रबल, आक्रामक खंडन
definition: a forceful written or spoken attack denouncing an opinion, doctrine or opponent
example: His polemic against pineapple on pizza has been cited in three family arguments.

hindi: ध्रुव — दिशा देने वाला अटल तारा
definition: the North Star, fixed guiding point for navigation; hence, a steady guiding principle
example: For the night-shift nurses, the vending machine glowed like a polestar down the corridor.

hindi: शिष्टता — औपचारिक, रस्मी विनम्रता
definition: formal politeness and courtesy, especially when shown as polished social ritual
example: Behind the email's politesse lay a clear message: fix this by Friday.

hindi: अंधा आशावादी — हर बुराई में भी भलाई देखने वाला
definition: someone so relentlessly, stubbornly hopeful that they ignore obvious trouble and plain reality
example: Only a Pollyanna would call the server outage a lovely chance to rest.

hindi: कायर — पूरा का पूरा डरपोक व्यक्ति
definition: an utter coward, a person completely lacking courage when facing danger
example: Only a poltroon would cancel the team dinner by leaving a sticky note on the fridge.

hindi: बहुभाषी — अनेक भाषाएँ जानने वाला
definition: a person who speaks, reads and writes several languages with genuine fluency and ease
example: The polyglot ordered dinner in Italian, argued the bill in French and tipped in pure silence.

hindi: बहुश्रुत — अनेक विषयों का ज्ञाता
definition: a scholar of wide and varied learning who masters knowledge across many different fields
example: The podcast billed its guest as a polyhistor, which meant he had opinions on everything.

hindi: बहुश्रुत — अनेक विषयों का गहरा ज्ञाता
definition: a person with deep learning and expertise across many different subjects
example: The polymath on our team fixed the server, the lyrics and the sourdough starter.

hindi: रूपांतर आवृत्ति — एक ही मूल शब्द के अलग-अलग रूप दोहराना
definition: repeating words derived from the same root in different grammatical forms within a sentence
example: "Please don't judge the judges' judgement," the talent show host begged, leaning hard on polyptoton.

hindi: संयोजक-बाहुल्य — हर शब्द के बीच बार-बार 'और' लगाना
definition: deliberately using many conjunctions such as 'and' between words or clauses, making the list feel heavy
example: The toddler wanted juice and crackers and the blue cup and the other blue cup, polysyndeton in a high chair.

hindi: उपदेश झाड़ना — अधिकार जताते हुए राय देना
definition: express opinions pompously and at length, as though they were unquestionable truths
example: He loves to pontificate about fitness while holding his third doughnut.

hindi: सर्वपदधारी — अनेक पदों वाला दंभी अधिकारी
definition: a pompous official holding many titles and offices at once, often self-importantly
example: The club's Pooh-Bah is president, treasurer and sole judge of the chili contest.

hindi: बनठना बड़बोला — भड़कीले कपड़ों में इतराता, बकबक करता व्यक्ति
definition: a vain, showily dressed person who chatters conceitedly; originally an archaic word for parrot
example: The moderator, a popinjay in velvet loafers, spoke longer than all four panellists combined.

hindi: शूकरवत्‌ — सूअर जैसा मोटा, गुलाबी या भोजन-लोलुप
definition: like swine or hogs; plump, pinkish, greedy and fond of eating
example: He surveyed the hotel buffet with porcine delight and a plate the size of a hubcap.

hindi: लोह-कपाट — किले के द्वार पर गिराया जाने वाला भारी जालीदार फाटक
definition: a heavy iron grating lowered through grooves to seal a castle gateway against attack
example: At closing time the landlord drops the pub's shutter like a portcullis, and no pleading will raise it.

hindi: वाहन-ड्योढ़ी — गाड़ियों के आर-पार निकलने योग्य ढका प्रवेश-द्वार
definition: a covered entrance porch large enough for carriages or cars to drive through and unload
example: The hotel's porte-cochère was built for horse-drawn carriages and now shelters a queue of ride-share drivers.

hindi: अपशकुन — किसी बड़ी, प्रायः अशुभ घटना का पूर्व-संकेत
definition: a sign or omen warning that some momentous, often calamitous event is about to happen soon
example: The CFO booking the big conference room for a whole afternoon was a portent nobody enjoyed.

hindi: अशुभसूचक — किसी गंभीर घटना का संकेत देने वाला; आडंबरपूर्ण
definition: ominously warning that something momentous is coming; also pompously solemn and self-important
example: The all-hands invite arrived with a portentous subject line and no agenda.

hindi: ड्योढ़ी-मंडप — स्तंभों पर टिका भव्य प्रवेश-बरामदा
definition: a grand porch whose roof rests on columns, standing before the entrance of a building
example: The new co-working space has a marble portico and, inside, exactly one working coffee machine.

hindi: तोंदिल — भरा-पूरा, गोल-मटोल शरीर
definition: somewhat stout and round in body, especially describing a dignified older person
example: The portly uncle claimed the recliner as a hereditary right.

hindi: दिखावेबाज़ — जो वह होने का ढोंग करे जो वह नहीं
definition: a person who affects attitudes or talents they lack, simply to impress others
example: The poseur at the party quoted Proust confidently, having read only the Wikipedia summary.

hindi: अति शीघ्र — पूरी तेज़ी से, बिना पल गँवाए
definition: with great speed, as quickly as possible, rushing onward without any delay or pause
example: When the boss said 'quick chat', three people updated their résumés posthaste.

hindi: मरणोपरांत — किसी की मृत्यु के बाद होने वाला
definition: happening, published, born or awarded only after the death of the person concerned
example: The posthumous album sold more copies than everything he released while alive.

hindi: भोजनोपरांत — खाने के बाद का
definition: happening after a meal, especially the drowsy period following a large dinner or lunch
example: The postprandial meeting at two o'clock is where good ideas go to nap.

hindi: पुष्पगुच्छ — छोटा, सादा फूलों का गुच्छा
definition: a small simple bunch of flowers, often picked by hand and given as a gift
example: The toddler's posy was three dandelions and a stick, and it outshone the florist's order.

hindi: पेय — पीने योग्य (पानी)
definition: safe and suitable for drinking, especially water that is clean and free from harmful germs
example: The hotel's tap water was declared potable by a sign that looked hand-written.

hindi: शाकवाटिका — सजावटी ढंग से लगी सब्ज़ियों की बाड़ी
definition: an ornamental kitchen garden where vegetables, herbs and flowers grow together in patterned beds
example: Three pots of herbs on a fire escape become a potager the moment they reach Instagram.

hindi: पान — पीने की क्रिया या पेय
definition: a drink, or the drinking of one, especially alcoholic drinks taken freely and often
example: His potations at the reunion explained the forty voice notes sent at midnight.

hindi: रोटी-कमाऊ रचना — केवल पैसे के लिए जल्दबाज़ी में लिखी गई कृति
definition: a quickly written, formulaic book or film produced mainly to earn money rather than achieve artistic merit
example: The thriller is a shameless potboiler, which is exactly why I finished it in one flight.

hindi: अधिपति — अपार शक्ति वाला शासक या महाप्रभु
definition: a monarch or ruler holding great power, often absolute and grandly displayed
example: The billionaire received the journalists like a potentate granting an audience from his yacht.

hindi: विविध संग्रह — भांति-भांति की चीज़ों का मेल
definition: a varied collection of different items or pieces gathered into one mixture
example: The newsletter was a potpourri of office updates, recipes and a mysterious fridge warning.

hindi: लेप — गरम पुल्टिस जो सूजन पर बाँधी जाए
definition: a warm moist mass of herbs or bread spread on cloth and applied to soothe swelling
example: Grandma still swears a mustard poultice beats anything the pharmacy sells.

hindi: दूसरों को सबक — दूसरों को डराने के लिए दिया गया दंड
definition: punishing one person harshly chiefly as a warning example to everyone else
example: The manager revoked one intern's parking badge pour encourager les autres, and suddenly timesheets arrived early.

hindi: प्रारंभिक वार्ता — औपचारिक बातचीत से पहले की अनौपचारिक चर्चा
definition: informal preliminary discussion held between parties before formal negotiations properly begin
example: Months of pourparlers over coffee preceded the actual merger talks.

hindi: अंगरक्षक-वर्गीय — नेता की रक्षा और नियंत्रण करने वाले विशिष्ट दल का
definition: belonging to an elite guard that protects a leader and often controls him
example: A praetorian ring of aides decides who ever reaches the chief executive.

hindi: बड़बड़ाना — मूर्खतापूर्ण या बेमतलब बहुत बोलना
definition: talk foolishly, tediously and at length about things of little importance
example: He prated about crypto all through the wedding reception, and the bride still has not forgiven him.

hindi: बक-बक करना — बच्चों-सी बेसिर-पैर की बातें
definition: talk at length in a foolish, childish or inconsequential way about trivial things
example: The podcast hosts prattled about their lunch for twenty minutes before reaching the guest.

hindi: अनिश्चित और अस्थिर — किसी भी क्षण ढह जाने योग्य
definition: unsteady and liable to collapse or fail at any moment
example: The coalition is precarious: three spare votes, two large egos, one bad news cycle.

hindi: पूर्वाधिकार — पद के अनुसार आगे रहने का हक़
definition: the right to come first, especially the order of rank observed at formal ceremonies
example: Seating the wedding tables by precedence took longer than planning the honeymoon.

hindi: गुरु — मार्गदर्शक शिक्षक
definition: a teacher or instructor who guides students in principles, rules and correct conduct
example: His preceptor in chess taught him one lesson above all: never resign before your opponent's phone buzzes.

hindi: उतावला — बिना सोचे, अत्यधिक जल्दबाज़ी में किया गया
definition: done suddenly and hastily, acting without careful thought or proper timing, rushed into
example: Quitting by text was precipitate, and the rent reminded him within the week.

hindi: परभक्षी — शिकार करके जीने वाला; दूसरों का शोषण करने वाला
definition: hunting and killing other animals for food; figuratively, exploiting weaker people for gain
example: The payday lender's predatory interest rate was hidden in a font only ants could read.

hindi: अग्रगण्य — अपने क्षेत्र में सबसे आगे और प्रतिष्ठित
definition: surpassing all others; the most distinguished and important figure within a field
example: The preeminent expert on the codebase left in 2019 and took the comments with him.

hindi: धर्माध्यक्ष — बिशप जैसा ऊँचे पद का पादरी
definition: a high-ranking church official of great dignity, such as a bishop, archbishop or cardinal
example: The senior partner moved through the office like a prelate, blessing spreadsheets with a nod.

hindi: पूर्वरंग — किसी बड़े काम या रचना से पहले का आरंभिक अंश
definition: an introductory piece of music, or any event serving as the opening before something larger
example: Rain on the windscreen was only the prelude; the real storm arrived with the in-laws.

hindi: प्रथम प्रदर्शन — नाटक या फ़िल्म का पहला सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन
definition: the first public performance of a play, opera or film, usually a glamorous occasion
example: The première of Dad's new barbecue sauce drew a nervous crowd and two brave volunteers.

hindi: तल्लीनता — किसी बात में मन का उलझे रहना
definition: the state of being so absorbed in some thought that everything else around goes unnoticed
example: His preoccupation with the fantasy football draft explained the blank slides in his presentation.

hindi: प्राधान्य — संख्या या मात्रा में अधिकता
definition: the state of outweighing the rest; being greater in number, amount, weight or importance
example: A preponderance of the reviews praise the pizza; the rest are about the parking.

hindi: आकर्षक — पहली नज़र में ही अच्छा प्रभाव डालने वाला
definition: attractive in appearance, making a favourable first impression upon people at once
example: The startup's founders were prepossessing; its balance sheet, less so.

hindi: भोजन-पूर्व — खाने से पहले का
definition: happening before a meal, especially drinks or talk before dinner
example: Our preprandial chat about dieting ended the moment the biryani arrived.

hindi: विशेषाधिकार — किसी पद या व्यक्ति का अनन्य अधिकार
definition: an exclusive right or privilege belonging to a particular office, rank or person
example: Choosing the playlist on a road trip is traditionally the driver's prerogative, however questionable his taste.

hindi: पूर्वाभास — होने वाली बात को पहले से जान लेना
definition: the power of correctly sensing future events before they happen, as though knowing them in advance
example: With eerie prescience, she saved the file seconds before the laptop died.

hindi: दूरदर्शी — होने वाली बात पहले ही भाँप लेने वाला
definition: correctly sensing future events before they happen, as though knowing them in advance
example: Packing a spare charger proved prescient somewhere over the Atlantic.

hindi: हस्तलाघव — हाथ की सफ़ाई से जादू
definition: conjuring tricks performed with quick skilful hand movements that deceive watchers
example: The waiter's prestidigitation made the bill appear before anyone asked.

hindi: दावेदार — सिंहासन पर विवादित दावा करने वाला
definition: someone claiming a throne or title that another person currently holds
example: Every season a fresh pretender to the league title appears, then quietly collapses by December.

hindi: असाधारण — प्रकृति के सामान्य नियमों से परे लगने वाला
definition: beyond what is normal or natural, seeming almost supernatural in strength or skill
example: The toddler has a preternatural ability to wake the moment the laptop opens.

hindi: बहाना — असली कारण छिपाने वाला झूठा कारण
definition: a false reason given to hide the real motive behind some action
example: He visited the kitchen on the pretext of refilling water, and left with the cake.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — गोलमोल बातें कर सच से बचना
definition: to avoid telling the plain truth by speaking evasively, vaguely or deliberately misleadingly
example: Asked when the build would be ready, the contractor prevaricated about supply chains.

hindi: नखरेबाज़ — ख़ास बर्ताव चाहने वाला अहंकारी व्यक्ति
definition: a vain, temperamental person who expects special treatment and sulks when crossed
example: The star striker is a prima donna who refuses to play unless the kit is ironed twice.

hindi: प्रथम दृष्टया — पहली नज़र में सही जान पड़ने वाला
definition: true or sufficient on first impression, unless later disproved
example: The court found a prima facie case and let the trial go ahead.

hindi: आदिम — सबसे प्राचीन, पहले युग का
definition: belonging to the earliest ancient ages of the world, untouched since the beginning
example: Our shared drive has a primeval folder called New Folder (7) that nobody dares open.

hindi: ज्येष्ठाधिकार — पूरी विरासत सबसे बड़ी संतान को
definition: the custom giving the entire family estate and title to the firstborn child, traditionally male
example: By primogeniture the eldest got the house; the rest of us got the group chat.

hindi: आदिकालीन — सृष्टि के आरंभ से मौजूद
definition: existing from the very beginning of time, the most ancient and original source of things
example: Somewhere in the fridge, a primordial tub of hummus is evolving toward consciousness.

hindi: प्रथम गतिदाता — सब गतियों का मूल स्रोत
definition: the outermost heavenly sphere turning all others; hence, the prime source of motion
example: Coffee is the primum mobile of the editorial floor; nothing moves until the pot does.

hindi: समकक्षों में प्रथम — बराबरी वालों में अगुआ
definition: first among equals; a leader holding formal rank among peers of equal standing
example: The senior partner insists she is merely primus inter pares, then picks the restaurant for all of us.

hindi: कृपया — मैं तुमसे विनती करता हूँ
definition: archaic: please, pray thee; a polite plea that asks someone for a favour
example: Prithee, whoever took the last oat milk, replace the carton.

hindi: राजाज्ञा-दस्यु — शासन की अनुमति से शत्रु जहाज़ लूटने वाला
definition: a privately owned armed ship licensed by government to plunder enemy merchant vessels
example: The recruiter operated like a privateer, legally raiding rival companies for engineers.

hindi: निश्चित मूल्य भोजन — तय दाम पर तय व्यंजनों वाला मेन्यू
definition: a restaurant meal of several fixed courses offered at one fixed price
example: The prix fixe lunch tempted us with three courses and delivered three very small ones.

hindi: नि:शुल्क — जनहित में, बिना फीस लिए किया गया
definition: done professionally without charge, usually for the public good
example: She takes two pro bono cases a year and loses sleep over both.

hindi: औपचारिक — केवल रस्म निभाने के लिए, दिखावे भर का
definition: done merely as a formality, following the expected form without real meaning or intent
example: The feedback survey was pro forma; the decision had been made on Tuesday.

hindi: स्वपक्षी — बिना वकील के स्वयं पैरवी करता हुआ
definition: representing oneself in court without a lawyer, pleading one's own case personally
example: He argued his parking appeal pro se, armed with a printed street view and unshakable confidence.

hindi: कार्यवाहक — अस्थायी रूप से, कुछ समय के लिए
definition: for the time being, holding a role temporarily until someone permanent is appointed
example: I am treasurer pro tempore, which means I guard the biscuit tin.

hindi: सत्यनिष्ठा — पूरी ईमानदारी, विशेषकर पैसे और पद के मामलों में
definition: complete honesty and uprightness, especially where money or power is involved
example: Thirty years on the bench and not one question about his probity.

hindi: पूर्व-खंडन — विरोधी की आपत्ति उठने से पहले ही उसका उत्तर दे देना
definition: anticipating an opponent's likely objection and answering it before they have a chance to raise it
example: "Now, you may think four cats is too many," she began, procatalepsis rehearsed for her landlord.

hindi: प्रांतपाल — दूरस्थ प्रांत का शक्तिशाली प्रशासक
definition: a Roman provincial governor; now any powerful administrator governing a distant province on behalf of a remote capital
example: The consultant arrived from London as a kind of proconsul, armed with slides and absolute certainty.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — ज़रूरी काम को बार-बार आगे खिसकाना
definition: keep putting off a necessary task until later, delaying without good reason
example: I procrastinate so skilfully that the deadline now arrives with its own apology.

hindi: जबरन ढाँचे में कसने वाला — नुक़सान की परवाह किए बिना
definition: forcing things to fit a fixed scheme, whatever the damage
example: Grading on a strict curve is procrustean: someone must fail so the shape holds.
