hindi: अपव्ययी — धन को बेपरवाही से लुटाने वाला
definition: spending money or resources wastefully and freely, with reckless extravagance and little thought
example: The prodigal subscriber pays for four gyms and visits none.

hindi: विपुल — आश्चर्यजनक रूप से विशाल
definition: remarkably great in size, amount or degree; impressive, enormous and quite astonishing
example: Her prodigious memory holds every birthday and every grudge.

hindi: उपोद्घात — कविता या ग्रंथ की आरंभिक भूमिका
definition: a short introduction or preface placed at the very start of a poem, speech or book
example: The wedding toast had a proem, a middle, and no discernible ending.

hindi: अपवित्रीकरण — पवित्र वस्तु का अनादरपूर्ण प्रयोग
definition: treating something holy or sacred with disrespect, spoiling its sanctity
example: Using the wedding cake knife to open Amazon boxes struck Grandma as pure profanation.

hindi: अधार्मिक — पवित्र के प्रति अनादरपूर्ण; लौकिक, सांसारिक
definition: showing disrespect toward sacred things; also worldly rather than religious
example: His profane muttering at the printer could have peeled paint from a cathedral.

hindi: प्राध्यापकीय — प्रोफ़ेसर जैसा विद्वत्तापूर्ण
definition: like a university professor; learned, lecturing and scholarly in manner, speech or appearance
example: He grew a beard and bought tweed, and his professorial look lasted until his first bug report.

hindi: अपव्यय-उच्छृंखलता — बेतहाशा फिजूलखर्ची या निर्लज्ज दुराचार
definition: reckless extravagance with money
example: A decade of profligacy left the club with trophies and no money.

hindi: अत्यधिक — बहुत मात्रा में उमड़ता हुआ
definition: plentiful and abundant; pouring freely out in a large, generous or excessive amount
example: His profuse apologies lasted longer than the delay itself.

hindi: बाहुल्य — बहुत बड़ी मात्रा, भरमार
definition: a plentiful, abundant amount of something; a large quantity spilling freely over
example: The garden centre sells a profusion of plants, most destined to die on my windowsill.

hindi: प्रस्तावना — किसी ग्रंथ से पहले का विद्वत्तापूर्ण परिचय
definition: a lengthy scholarly introduction or preface placed before a longer written work, explaining its method
example: His email opened with a prolegomenon before finally asking for the stapler.

hindi: पूर्वाभास — किसी बाद की घटना या आपत्ति को पहले ही बता देना
definition: treating a future event as though already accomplished, or describing someone by what they will later become
example: "You're a dead man," the tech lead told whoever deployed on Friday, prolepsis that the Monday postmortem duly confirmed.

hindi: अतिविस्तृत — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा लंबा और उबाऊ
definition: using far too many words, so that writing or speech becomes long and tedious
example: His prolix email needed a summary, and the summary needed a summary.

hindi: प्रस्तावना — नाटक या रचना से पहले का परिचयात्मक भाग
definition: an opening section introducing a play, poem or story before the main action begins
example: The recruiter's small talk was merely a prologue to the question about salary expectations.

hindi: सैर-पथ — टहलने की चौड़ी राह, या स्वयं इत्मीनान की सैर
definition: a leisurely public stroll, or a broad seaside walkway built for such walking
example: The Sunday promenade along the seafront is mostly people photographing their ice cream.

hindi: साहसी सर्जक — निषेध तोड़कर नया देने वाला
definition: boldly original, and willing to defy authority to bring something new
example: The lab's Promethean streak gave the world a cure and a decade of lawsuits.

hindi: स्वप्न-लोक — वह आदर्श स्थान या अवस्था जिसकी लंबे समय से प्रतीक्षा हो
definition: a longed-for place or condition where hopes of happiness and plenty will finally come true
example: For every commuter, a four-day week is the promised land glimpsed from the train window.

hindi: भविष्यवाणी करना — आने वाले समय की बात पहले से कहना
definition: to foretell future events as though speaking with divine or supernatural knowledge
example: She prophesied the printer would jam before the board meeting, and the printer obliged.

hindi: प्रसन्न करना — क्रुद्ध देवता या व्यक्ति को भेंट देकर शांत करना
definition: to appease an angry deity or powerful person by offering gifts, sacrifice or flattering attention
example: We propitiated the IT department with doughnuts before asking for admin rights.

hindi: प्रसादक — रुष्ट को मनाने के लिए दिया गया
definition: offered to calm anger and regain favour from someone offended or powerful
example: He arrived home late bearing a propitiatory bouquet and a very long explanation.

hindi: शुभ — अनुकूल, सफलता का संकेत देने वाला
definition: favourable, likely to bring success, offering good signs that the timing suits
example: A sunny Monday and working coffee machine seemed propitious for launching anything.

hindi: औचित्य — जो उचित और मर्यादित माना जाए, वैसा व्यवहार
definition: the quality of behaving in ways that society considers correct, proper and respectable
example: He questioned the propriety of reviewing his own pull request, then approved it anyway.

hindi: सत्रावसान करना — सभा की बैठकें बिना भंग किए रोक देना
definition: formally suspend the meetings of a parliament or assembly for a while without dissolving
example: The group chat was prorogued after the fourth argument about pineapple on pizza.

hindi: रंगमुख — मंच का सामने वाला भाग जो परदे और दर्शकों के बीच होता है
definition: the front part of a theatre stage, framed by an arch, standing between curtain and audience
example: He delivers every quarterly update as if framed by a proscenium, pausing for applause that never comes.

hindi: नव-दीक्षित — हाल ही में किसी धर्म या मत को अपनाने वाला
definition: a recent convert to a religion, cause or belief, often an eager, preaching one
example: A proselyte of cold showers, he now brings it up at every dinner.

hindi: धर्मांतरण कराना — दूसरों को अपने मत में लाने का प्रयास करना
definition: to convert people, or zealously attempt converting them, to one's religion, cause or personal belief
example: Ever since his first marathon he proselytizes about running at every dinner party.

hindi: छंदशास्त्र — पद्य की लय, छंद और ध्वनि का अध्ययन
definition: the study of rhythm, meter, stress and sound patterns in verse and spoken language
example: Karaoke night is where good taste in prosody goes to die.

hindi: वाणी-आरोपण — निर्जीव वस्तु या अनुपस्थित व्यक्ति के मुँह से बात कहलवाना
definition: giving voice to a lifeless object, abstract idea or absent person, making them speak as though human
example: "If this sofa could talk, it would demand therapy," she said, prosopopoeia for a very used couch.

hindi: नायक — कथा या घटना का मुख्य पात्र
definition: the leading character in a drama or story; hence the chief figure driving any cause or contest
example: Every group chat believes it is the protagonist of the weekend plan.

hindi: बहुरूपी — अनेक रूप धारण करने वाला
definition: endlessly changeable; able to take many forms or roles
example: A protean actor who plays the villain, the priest, and the dog in one season.

hindi: शिष्य — किसी प्रभावशाली गुरु द्वारा संरक्षित और प्रशिक्षित व्यक्ति
definition: a younger person guided, taught and promoted in their career by an influential, experienced mentor
example: The chef's protégé now runs a rival restaurant across the street.

hindi: स्मृति-जागरक — किसी गंध या स्वाद से अचानक जागी गहरी याद
definition: describing vivid memories suddenly triggered by a taste, smell or small sensation
example: The smell of school glue sent her into a Proustian reverie about fourth grade.

hindi: रसद-सामग्री — भोजन और चारे की आपूर्ति
definition: food supplies or provisions, originally fodder gathered for horses and cattle
example: The camping trip's provender was mostly instant noodles and optimism.

hindi: दूरदर्शी — भविष्य के लिए पहले से बचत करने वाला
definition: careful to save money and provide for future needs rather than spending everything immediately
example: The provident one in the family keeps a spare charger in every single bag.

hindi: शर्त — किसी सहमति के साथ जुड़ी अनिवार्य बात
definition: a condition attached to an agreement
example: She agreed, with the proviso that she would never be asked to travel on weekends.

hindi: विवेक — सोच-समझकर और सावधानी से काम करना
definition: wise and careful judgement in practical matters, sensibly avoiding needless risks
example: Prudence suggested backing up the laptop; hope suggested otherwise.

hindi: कामुक-जिज्ञासु — यौन बातों में अनुचित रुचि रखने वाला
definition: having an excessive, unhealthy interest in sexual matters, scandal and other people's private lives
example: The tabloid's prurient coverage of the divorce outsold the actual election results.

hindi: नख़रेबाज़ विदुषी — बनावटी परिष्कार वाली साहित्यिक स्त्री
definition: a literary woman with affectedly refined speech and manners, overly fastidious about elegant language
example: She played the précieuse at brunch, refusing to call anything a 'vibe' when 'ambience' was available.

hindi: सार-संक्षेप — किसी लेख का छोटा सारांश
definition: a brief summary giving only the essential points of longer writing
example: The board read the one-page précis and not a single word of the report.

hindi: तैयार परिधान — बने-बनाए, दुकान से ख़रीदे जाने वाले कपड़े
definition: designer clothing made in standard sizes and sold ready to wear
example: The runway gown costs a car; the prêt-à-porter version merely costs a scooter.

hindi: हुँह — तिरस्कार भरी उपेक्षा
definition: archaic: exclamation of scorn, impatience or disapproval, brushing some claim or suggestion aside
example: Pshaw, said the uncle, who has never once read the terms and conditions.

hindi: भूकेंद्रवादी — पृथ्वी को ब्रह्मांड का केंद्र मानने वाला
definition: following Ptolemy's ancient system placing Earth at the centre, with heavens circling around it
example: The CEO held a Ptolemaic theory of the company, with every department circling his desk.

hindi: बालिश — बचकाना, बच्चों जैसा मूर्खतापूर्ण
definition: childishly silly and immature, showing foolish behaviour unsuited to adults
example: The comment thread descended into puerile jokes about the CEO's surname.

hindi: झगड़ालू — हर बात पर भिड़ने को तैयार
definition: eager to argue and quick to fight, always ready for another quarrel
example: Her pugnacious code reviews start with 'Interesting choice' and end with a rewrite.

hindi: बलशाली — शक्तिमान, प्रभावशाली
definition: archaic: powerful, mighty, having great strength, authority or influence over others
example: The puissant office printer decides whose documents shall live.

hindi: पक्का, खरा — असली, सही और उत्तम
definition: genuine, proper and thoroughly authentic; the real thing itself rather than some cheap imitation
example: That is a pukka biryani, not the rice-with-opinions the canteen serves.

hindi: सौंदर्य — शारीरिक रूप की असाधारण सुंदरता
definition: great physical beauty, especially of a face or figure, admired openly by others
example: The dating app bio promised pulchritude; the video call delivered a ceiling fan.

hindi: सूक्ष्म शिष्टाचार — आचरण का बारीक नियम
definition: a fine point of formal etiquette, or strict attention to such small details
example: He observed every punctilio of the video call: camera on, muted mic, background tastefully blurred.

hindi: सूक्ष्मनिष्ठ — नियम और शिष्टाचार की हर बारीकी का ध्यान रखने वाला
definition: extremely careful about correct conduct, duty and every small detail of honour
example: He is so punctilious about returning books that the library sends him thank-you cards.

hindi: विशेषज्ञ टिप्पणीकार — जनता के सामने नियमित राय देने वाला जानकार
definition: an expert who regularly gives opinions publicly, especially through newspapers or television
example: Every pundit predicted the result with total confidence, just after it happened.

hindi: तीखा — नाक में चुभने वाली तेज़ गंध या स्वाद वाला
definition: having a sharply strong smell or taste that hits the senses immediately and lingers afterwards
example: The pungent cheese was banished from the shared fridge by unanimous vote.

hindi: दंडात्मक — दंड देने के उद्देश्य से
definition: intended as punishment, often harsh enough to seem more severe than needed
example: The gym's cancellation fee is so punitive that staying a member works out cheaper than leaving.

hindi: विरेचक — पेट साफ़ करने वाली दवा
definition: a strong medicine that empties the bowels, once given for almost every complaint
example: Georgian doctors handed out purgatives the way apps hand out push notifications.

hindi: चुराना — चुपके से किसी की वस्तु उठा लेना
definition: steal something, especially quietly or cunningly, from another person's keeping
example: Someone purloined my labelled yoghurt and left the lid as a taunt.

hindi: भीरुता — साहस और दृढ़ता का अभाव
definition: cowardly timidity, lacking courage or resolve to face danger or difficulty
example: The board's pusillanimity turned a bold rebrand into a slightly different shade of blue.

hindi: भीरु — छोटे मन वाला, साहसहीन
definition: cowardly and timid, lacking the courage or resolve to face danger or difficulty
example: The pusillanimous committee postponed the decision until everyone had forgotten it.

hindi: कथित — जो माना जाता हो पर सिद्ध न हो
definition: generally supposed to be so, without having been proved
example: The putative author of the leak turned out to be on leave that entire week.

hindi: विद्रोही तख़्तापलट — सत्ता हथियाने का अचानक प्रयास
definition: a sudden attempt by a small group to seize government power by force
example: The weekend putsch in the book club ended with the thrillers faction seizing control of the reading list.

hindi: गढ़नहार — किसी को अपने आदर्श पर ढालकर उस पर मोहित होने वाला
definition: someone who shapes another person into an ideal, then becomes enchanted by the creation
example: The coach played Pygmalion, turning a gawky teenager into a champion and taking the credit.

hindi: चिता — शव जलाने के लिए लकड़ियों का ढेर
definition: a large heap of wood built for burning a dead body during funeral rites
example: The bonfire of old tax papers blazed like a Viking pyre.

hindi: आत्मघाती विजय-सा — हार जैसी महँगी जीत
definition: won at a cost so ruinous the victory is hardly worth having
example: They won the case and lost the company: a Pyrrhic victory in three volumes.

hindi: देखिए — उस शब्द या प्रविष्टि का संदर्भ लें
definition: meaning 'which see'; directs the reader toward another entry within the same written reference work
example: For the full saga, see 'printer jam', q.v., in the office wiki.

hindi: के रूप में — उस हैसियत से
definition: borrowed Latin word meaning considered strictly in that particular capacity or character
example: The manager qua manager approved the leave; the manager qua friend asked for postcards.

hindi: दलदल — फँसा देने वाली कठिन स्थिति
definition: soft boggy ground, or a tangled awkward situation very hard to escape
example: The quick database migration became a six-month quagmire with its own group chat.

hindi: यथोचित पारिश्रमिक — किए गए काम के अनुसार उचित भुगतान
definition: a fair payment claimed for work actually done when a price was never agreed in writing
example: The freelancer had no contract, only a quantum meruit claim and four hundred Slack messages proving the work.

hindi: चतुष्पत्री — चार पन्नों में मोड़े कागज़ से बनी पुस्तक
definition: a book size made by folding each printed sheet twice to form four leaves
example: Shakespeare's plays first appeared as flimsy quartos, the airport paperbacks of Elizabethan London.

hindi: चतुष्पदी — चार पंक्तियों का छंद
definition: a stanza or group of four lines of verse, often with alternating rhymes
example: The greeting card's quatrain rhymed "birthday" with "worth day" and hoped nobody would check.

hindi: दमन करना — विद्रोह या अशांति को कुचलना
definition: forcibly suppress a rebellion, riot or violent disturbance and swiftly restore public order
example: The teacher quelled the classroom mutiny with a single raised eyebrow.

hindi: बाल की खाल निकालना — मामूली बात पर बहस करना
definition: to argue or object about a small, unimportant point instead of the real matter
example: We spent the whole meeting quibbling over the name of the project that was then cancelled.

hindi: लेन-देन — बदले में कुछ मिलने की शर्त पर किया गया उपकार
definition: a favour given on the understanding that something comes back
example: The email made the quid pro quo explicit, which is why it became evidence.

hindi: प्रशांत — शांत, स्थिर और अभी निष्क्रिय
definition: quiet, still and inactive for the moment, though capable of stirring again
example: The volcano stayed quiescent, much like the group chat before someone mentions dinner plans.

hindi: मुक्ति — मृत्यु; जीवन या किसी झंझट का अंतिम अंत
definition: death seen as a final release from life, or anything that finishes something off for good
example: The third cup of coffee proved the quietus of my plan to sleep early.

hindi: गलशोथ — गले में पीपयुक्त सूजन
definition: a painful abscess and swelling of the throat around the tonsils, making swallowing hard
example: Singing karaoke for four hours gave him a throat that felt like quinsy.

hindi: सार-तत्त्व — किसी चीज़ का शुद्धतम रूप
definition: the purest and most perfect example of something, holding its essential core
example: The quintessence of Monday is a meeting that could have been an email.

hindi: ठेठ — किसी गुण या वर्ग का सबसे सटीक, विशुद्ध नमूना
definition: being the purest, most perfect and typical example of a quality or class
example: Rain on the one day you washed the car is quintessential British luck.

hindi: पन्नों की तह — मोड़कर सिले गए कागज़ों का एक खंड
definition: a gathering of folded sheets stitched together, forming a single section of a manuscript or book
example: The printer jammed halfway through the thesis and swallowed an entire quire of chapter three.

hindi: रक्षकों की रक्षा कौन करेगा — शक्तिशाली निगरानीकर्ताओं की जवाबदेही का प्रश्न
definition: who will guard the guards themselves; asking who holds powerful overseers accountable
example: The compliance team audits itself, which raises the old question: quis custodiet ipsos custodes?

hindi: देशद्रोही — आक्रांता शत्रु से मिल जाने वाला ग़द्दार
definition: a traitor who collaborates with an occupying enemy, after Norway's Vidkun Quisling
example: The flatmate who told the landlord about the cat is the house quisling.

hindi: आदर्शोन्मत्त — ऊँचे पर अव्यावहारिक सपनों के पीछे भागने वाला
definition: noble but wildly impractical, chasing lofty ideals that ignore hard reality
example: Rewriting the whole codebase over a long weekend was a quixotic quest, and Tuesday proved it.

hindi: कहाँ जा रहे हो? — दिशा और लक्ष्य पर उठा गंभीर प्रश्न
definition: whither are you going, a solemn question asking where a person, nation or venture is heading
example: The board's slide deck held eleven roadmaps and no answer to quo vadis.

hindi: जो सिद्ध करना था — प्रमाण या तर्क की विजयी समाप्ति
definition: which was to be proved; words that mark the triumphant finish of a mathematical proof or careful argument
example: She showed him the electricity bill after he left the heater on, and said nothing more: quod erat demonstrandum.

hindi: पूर्ववर्ती — किसी समय का, भूतपूर्व
definition: former, having once held a role or position that has since passed
example: The quondam unicorn now rents half its office to a yoga studio.

hindi: बोला — कहा (केवल भूतकाल में)
definition: archaic: said, spoke; used only in past form before the speaker's name
example: Nevermore, quoth the raven, and the same, quoth my bank, about overdraft fees.

hindi: उच्छृंखल भीड़ — बेक़ाबू, तिरस्कृत जनसमूह
definition: a disorderly crowd of common people, regarded with contempt by those of higher rank
example: The chief executive called the reply-all thread a rabble, then joined it with three emojis.

hindi: भदेस विनोदी — मोटे हास्य और भोग-विलास से भरपूर
definition: marked by coarse, earthy humour and exuberant indulgence, after the writer Rabelais
example: Grandpa's Rabelaisian wedding speech made the vicar reconsider his career.

hindi: धंधेबाज़ अपराधी — धमकी और ज़बरन वसूली से कमाने वाला
definition: a criminal who profits from extortion, fraud, bribery and illegal schemes organised by gangs
example: The parking firm's fines are so relentless they feel like the work of a racketeer.

hindi: कथावाचक — मज़ेदार किस्से चतुराई से सुनाने वाला
definition: a person who tells stories and anecdotes with skill and witty charm
example: Every wedding has one raconteur uncle whose stories grow longer with each retelling.

hindi: ठिठोली — मैत्रीपूर्ण चिढ़ाने वाला मज़ाक
definition: good-natured teasing or joking ridicule exchanged among friends without real malice
example: The team's raillery about his standing desk ended the day it cured his back pain.

hindi: परिधान — वस्त्र, विशेषकर सुंदर या औपचारिक पोशाक
definition: clothing and garments, especially fine or formal dress, named in elevated or poetic language
example: He arrived at casual Friday in full raiment, three-piece suit and pocket square, and the hoodies fell silent.

hindi: अस्तित्व का कारण — वह मूल प्रयोजन जिसके लिए कोई चीज़ बनी
definition: the most important reason or purpose for which someone or something exists
example: The office coffee machine's raison d'être is to break down every Monday at nine.

hindi: ऐयाश — शराब, जुए और रंगरलियों में डूबा पुरुष
definition: a fashionable gentleman given to heavy drinking, reckless gambling and chasing sensual pleasure
example: Every Regency romance needs a rake, and every rake needs a reformed final chapter.

hindi: लंपट — शराब, जुए और व्यसन में डूबा उच्छृंखल
definition: archaic: a thoroughly dissolute, reckless libertine given to drinking, gambling and vice
example: He was a rakehell at twenty-five and is now very serious about sourdough.

hindi: प्राचीर — किले या नगर को घेरती रक्षा-दीवार
definition: a broad defensive wall or embankment of earth and stone surrounding a fort or city
example: My spam filter is a rampart that admits every phishing email and repels my own mother.

hindi: लुटेरी लालसा — निर्ममता से हड़प लेने की वृत्ति
definition: predatory greed that takes without scruple
example: The rapacity of the asset strippers left nothing behind but the brand name.

hindi: लूटपाट — बलपूर्वक संपत्ति छीनना
definition: violent seizure and plunder of property by force, especially during warfare, invasion and conquest
example: Ten minutes after the buffet opened, the dessert table looked like the scene of rapine.

hindi: तालमेल — आपसी समझ और सहज मैत्रीपूर्ण संबंध
definition: friendly understanding between people that lets them communicate easily and trust each other
example: The new manager built instant rapport by admitting she also hated the old intranet.

hindi: मेल-मिलाप — बिगड़े संबंधों में फिर से निकटता
definition: renewal of friendly relations between rival nations or estranged parties after a long quarrel
example: After a year of passive-aggressive memos, Sales and Engineering reached a rapprochement over free pizza.

hindi: नटखट बदमाश — दुष्ट कम, शरारती अधिक
definition: a mischievous rascal or rogue whose pranks and misdeeds are playfully cheeky rather than truly wicked
example: The rapscallion in accounting renamed every meeting room after a cheese.

hindi: दुर्लभ व्यक्ति — असाधारण, विरल व्यक्ति या वस्तु
definition: a rare bird, meaning a person or thing that is exceptionally unusual and seldom encountered
example: A builder who finishes early is a rara avis worth a framed photo.

hindi: तर्कणा — क्रमबद्ध तर्क से निष्कर्ष तक पहुँचना
definition: the process of exact logical reasoning, working step by step towards a conclusion
example: By sheer ratiocination he deduced who ate his lunch: the only colleague with a new salad bowl.

hindi: कर्णकटु — भोंडी, ऊँची और बेतरतीब आवाज़ वाला
definition: harsh, loud and rowdy sounding, disturbing everyone nearby with noisy, jarring disorder
example: The raucous office quiz ended only when facilities cut the microphone.

hindi: विध्वंस करना — भयंकर तबाही मचाना
definition: cause severe destruction and plunder across a place, leaving ruins behind
example: The birthday party ravaged the living room like a small invading army.

hindi: क्षुधातुर — तेज़ भूख से व्याकुल
definition: extremely hungry, with a fierce, eager appetite that demands food immediately
example: After one spin class he was ravenous enough to negotiate with the vending machine.

hindi: यथार्थवादी राजनीति — आदर्श नहीं, व्यावहारिक हितों पर आधारित नीति
definition: politics driven by practical power interests rather than moral principles or ideals
example: Inviting the neighbour you dislike because he owns a projector is pure housewarming realpolitik.

hindi: झिड़कना — किसी को उसकी ग़लती पर तीखे शब्दों में डाँटना
definition: sharply and openly criticise someone aloud for their behaviour, words or actions
example: The judge rebuked the lawyer whose phone played a ringtone mid-verdict.

hindi: खंडित करना — प्रमाण देकर आरोप या तर्क काटना
definition: to argue that a claim or accusation is false by offering solid evidence or counter-argument
example: She rebutted every accusation of sock theft with a laminated inventory.

hindi: मुकरना — पहले कहे विश्वास या कथन को सार्वजनिक रूप से वापस लेना
definition: to publicly withdraw a belief or statement once held, especially under pressure
example: After one bite of the pineapple pizza, the critic was forced to recant.

hindi: पाठ-संशोधन — पांडुलिपियों की तुलना से तैयार पाठ
definition: a revised version of a text produced by critically comparing surviving manuscripts and their variant readings
example: The team's onboarding doc exists in three recensions, and nobody agrees which one is canon.

hindi: दुर्लभ और परिष्कृत — अत्यंत चुनिंदा, कभी-कभी दिखावटी
definition: rare, exotic and carefully chosen, sometimes affectedly obscure or pretentious
example: His playlist is so recherché that nobody at the party recognised a single song.

hindi: आदतन अपराधी — सज़ा के बाद भी बार-बार अपराध करने वाला
definition: person who keeps returning to crime or wrongdoing even after being punished for it
example: A recidivist of the snooze button, he has been late every Monday since March.

hindi: गायन-संवाद — ओपेरा में बोलचाल जैसी लय में गाया गया संवाद
definition: a style of sung dialogue in opera that follows natural speech rhythm, carrying the plot forward
example: The waiter recited the specials in a solemn recitative, and nobody dared interrupt the truffle part.

hindi: स्मरण — किसी बीती बात को मन में फिर से लाना
definition: the action of calling a past event back into memory, or the memory recalled
example: His recollection of the meeting differed sharply from the recording, which was awkward.

hindi: भगोड़ा — कायर और विश्वासघाती
definition: archaic: a coward who deserts a cause or betrays a duty through fear
example: The recreant who promised to help with the move switched his phone off on Saturday.

hindi: प्रत्यारोप — एक-दूसरे पर दोष मढ़ने का सिलसिला
definition: bitter mutual accusation in which each side blames the other for failure
example: The postmortem dissolved into recrimination over who had actually pressed deploy.

hindi: पुनःप्रकोप — ठीक होने के बाद रोग का फिर भड़क उठना
definition: the breaking out again of a disease or illness after a quiet period of apparent recovery
example: Every autumn brings a recrudescence of the office cold and the pumpkin latte.

hindi: नैतिक सत्यता — आचरण की सीधाई, सही राह पर अडिग रहना
definition: strict adherence to what is right in judgment and conduct
example: She ran the charity with a rectitude that made the auditors almost redundant.

hindi: दक्षिण पृष्ठ — खुली पुस्तक का दाहिना पन्ना
definition: the right-hand page of an open book, which is the front side of a printed leaf
example: The designer insisted every chapter open on a recto, so the whole print run gained a blank page.

hindi: पुरोहित-आवास — पल्ली के पादरी को मिला घर
definition: the house a church provides for its rector, the parish priest, and family to live in
example: Every village mystery on television begins with a vicar, a rectory and a suspicious scone.

hindi: शयित — लेटा हुआ या आराम से टेक लगाए
definition: lying down or reclining comfortably, resting rather than standing or working
example: He watched the entire cricket match recumbent, rising only for the wickets.

hindi: स्वस्थ होना — बीमारी या थकान के बाद फिर ताक़त पाना
definition: to recover health and bodily strength slowly after an illness, injury or period of exhaustion
example: She took a long weekend to recuperate from the quarterly planning cycle.

hindi: संपादित कर छिपाना — दस्तावेज़ से संवेदनशील अंश काला करना
definition: to edit a document by removing, blacking out or hiding sensitive words, names or passages
example: The released report was so redacted it read like a crossword puzzle.

hindi: सुवासित — गंध से भरा, किसी बात की याद दिलाता
definition: strongly smelling of something pleasant, or powerfully bringing back memories of another place or time
example: The office kitchen was redolent of burnt toast and broken promises about cleaning the fridge.

hindi: ग्रामाधिकारी — जागीर का काम देखने वाला स्थानीय कारिंदा
definition: a medieval manor officer who supervised peasants' labour and managed estate duties for the lord
example: The office manager patrols the kitchen like a reeve, counting mugs and noting who never washes theirs.

hindi: जलपान — थकान मिटाने वाला हल्का भोजन
definition: a light meal taken for refreshment and renewed strength after hard work or long travel
example: A samosa at the platform stall was all the refection the late train allowed.

hindi: प्रभास्वर — चमक से दमकता हुआ
definition: shining brilliantly with radiant, glowing light that dazzles anyone watching, gleaming with splendour
example: The refulgent chandelier cost more than the wedding it was hung for.

hindi: खंडन करना — प्रमाण से गलत सिद्ध करना
definition: to prove a claim wrong by evidence or argument
example: One clean counterexample refuted a theory that had stood for a decade.

hindi: खातिरदारी करना — भरपूर भोजन या कहानियों से प्रसन्न करना
definition: to entertain someone lavishly with generous food, drink or amusing stories told at length
example: She regaled the guests with biryani and the story of how she burnt the first one.

hindi: राजचिह्न — राजसी या पदसूचक वस्त्र और प्रतीक
definition: ceremonial emblems, robes and insignia of royalty or high office, worn on formal occasions
example: The graduates filed past in full academic regalia, sweating under polyester gowns in the June heat.

hindi: राज-प्रतिशासक — राजा के नाबालिग या अनुपस्थित होने पर शासन करने वाला
definition: a person ruling a kingdom while the monarch is a child, absent or unfit
example: With the parents on holiday, the eldest sibling ruled the household as a stern regent of the fridge.

hindi: राजहत्या — राजा की हत्या या उसका हत्यारा
definition: the deliberate killing of a reigning king, or the person who carries out such killing
example: Removing the founder's beloved beanbag from the lobby was received internally as something close to regicide.

hindi: धावक लुटेरा — सीमा पर मवेशी लूटने वाला हमलावर
definition: archaic: a mounted raider or plunderer, especially the cattle thieves who raided across the Anglo-Scottish border
example: The neighbour's cat, a practised reiver, crosses the fence nightly for our fish.

hindi: प्रत्युत्तर — किसी बात का तुरंत दिया गया जवाब
definition: a sharp or clever reply, especially one answering an objection, criticism or accusation directly
example: His rejoinder arrived three days late, in the shower, fully polished.

hindi: विधवा — मृत पति के पीछे बची पत्नी (पुराना प्रयोग)
definition: archaic: the widow left behind when her husband has died, named in records as his surviving wife
example: Grandma bristled when the genealogy site listed her only as the relict of Harold.

hindi: अस्थि-मंजूषा — संत के पवित्र अवशेष रखने का पात्र
definition: a container, often ornate, holding the sacred bones or belongings of a saint
example: Her jewellery box doubles as a reliquary for concert wristbands from 2009.

hindi: संस्मरण — बीती बातों को स्नेह से याद करना
definition: the fond remembering of past experiences, often recounted aloud as stories shared among friends
example: The reunion dissolved into reminiscence about a printer that jammed for four straight years.

hindi: प्रमादी — लापरवाह, कर्तव्य में ढील करने वाला
definition: lazy or careless in performing a duty, failing someone through plain neglect or inattention
example: I would be remiss not to mention that the free pizza was cold.

hindi: प्रतिवाद करना — किसी ग़लत बात का ज़ोरदार विरोध जताना
definition: protest forcefully to someone, pointing to their fault and firmly demanding correction
example: Residents remonstrated with the landlord about a lift that had been 'coming soon' since spring.

hindi: प्रतिफलदायी — अच्छी कमाई या पारिश्रमिक देने वाला
definition: paying well for work done; bringing good financial reward or profit
example: Her hobby of fixing relatives' laptops is endless and not remotely remunerative.

hindi: बहुमुखी प्रतिभासंपन्न — अनेक क्षेत्रों में निपुण व्यक्ति
definition: a person with deep learning and talent across many different subjects and skills
example: He calls himself a Renaissance man because he owns a ukulele and a telescope.

hindi: मिलन-स्थल — तय समय पर तय जगह मिलना
definition: an arranged meeting between people at a particular agreed time and place
example: Their weekly rendezvous at the chai stall has survived three job changes and one breakup.

hindi: धर्मत्यागी विद्रोही — अपने दल या मत को छोड़ने वाला बाग़ी
definition: a rebel who abandons the faith, principles or loyalty expected of them and defiantly strikes out alone
example: The renegade vegan at the barbecue was spotted near the sausages.

hindi: त्याग — किसी सुख, दावे या अधिकार को विधिवत छोड़ देना
definition: formally giving up a pleasure, claim, habit or right through self-denial
example: His renunciation of sugar lasted until the birthday cake arrived at four.

hindi: क्षतिपूर्ति — युद्ध या अन्याय के बाद हर्जाना
definition: compensation money paid by a defeated nation or wrongdoer for damage and suffering caused
example: After borrowing his car, she paid reparations in the form of a full tank and a wash.

hindi: हाज़िरजवाबी — तुरंत दिया गया चतुर उत्तर
definition: conversation full of quick, clever replies and witty comebacks traded back and forth
example: Her repartee on the panel was so quick that the moderator simply gave up and listened.

hindi: भोजन — एक बार का खाना
definition: a meal, especially a substantial one eaten at a particular sitting, occasion or regular time
example: Our Sunday repast lasted three hours because nobody wanted to start the dishes.

hindi: प्रदर्शन-भंडार — कलाकार की तैयार प्रस्तुतियों का संग्रह
definition: the complete stock of plays, songs or pieces a performer is prepared to present
example: Grandpa's repertoire contains exactly four jokes, each performed with fresh conviction.

hindi: परिपूर्ण — भरपेट खाया हुआ, भरा हुआ
definition: filled to capacity with food after eating, or generously well supplied with something
example: Replete after the thali, he pretended to read the dessert menu out of courtesy.

hindi: परितृप्ति — पूरी तरह भर जाने की अवस्था
definition: the state of being completely full of food, stuffed well beyond comfort
example: Thanksgiving ends not in conversation but in repletion and a silent group nap.

hindi: विश्राम — शांत आराम और निश्चलता
definition: a state of rest, calm stillness and quiet ease, especially after work or effort
example: The dog achieved perfect repose on the freshly made bed within seconds.

hindi: निंदनीय — जिसकी कड़ी निंदा होनी चाहिए
definition: deserving strong criticism and blame for being morally wrong or shameful
example: Taking the last parking spot with two wheels across the line is reprehensible.

hindi: दंड-स्थगन — सज़ा या संकट से अस्थायी राहत
definition: cancellation or delay of a punishment, or brief welcome relief from something unpleasant or dreaded
example: The server outage gave the whole team a reprieve from the quarterly review.

hindi: फटकार — अधिकारी द्वारा दी गई औपचारिक डाँट
definition: formal expression of sharp disapproval given by someone holding authority
example: His reprimand arrived as a calendar invite titled 'quick chat'.

hindi: उलाहना देना — निराशा के साथ किसी की ग़लती जताना
definition: express disappointment and disapproval toward someone about their fault, failing or careless conduct
example: Her houseplants reproach her silently every time she forgets to water them.

hindi: दुराचारी — बेशर्म और सुधार से परे व्यक्ति
definition: an unprincipled, shameless person whose wicked habits seem beyond any moral reform
example: My uncle, a charming reprobate, taught me poker and how to leave a wedding early.

hindi: घोर अस्वीकृति — किसी आचरण की कठोर निंदा
definition: severe disapproval and stern condemnation of someone's conduct as morally wrong
example: Clapping when the plane lands earned him the silent reprobation of the entire cabin.

hindi: टोकना — किसी की ग़लती पर शांत ढंग से फटकारना
definition: gently yet firmly criticise someone for a fault or wrong behaviour they showed
example: The librarian reproved him with one raised eyebrow and not a single word.

hindi: सरीसृपवत्‌ — रेंगने वाले जीव जैसा ठंडा, भावहीन और हिसाबी
definition: like lizards and other reptiles; cold blooded, unfeeling, calculating and scaly
example: The negotiator's reptilian stillness unsettled everyone waiting for her to blink.

hindi: मृतात्मा-प्रार्थना — दिवंगत की आत्मा की शांति हेतु गाई जाने वाली प्रार्थना-रचना
definition: a Mass or solemn musical composition sung for the peaceful rest of the souls of those who have died
example: The team played a mournful requiem on kazoos for the deleted spreadsheet.

hindi: उनकी आत्मा को शांति मिले — दिवंगत के लिए शांति की कामना
definition: may they rest in peace, a short prayer carved on graves and tombs for the dead
example: Requiescat in pace, old phone: your battery gave everything it had.

hindi: प्रतिदान — किए गए काम का बदला, दंड या पुरस्कार के रूप में
definition: repayment for something done, either as deserved punishment or deserved reward
example: A cold shoulder was the only requital for eating her leftovers.

hindi: घटना-प्रसंग — घटना के साथ घटित तथ्य और कथन
definition: the facts and spontaneous statements forming part of an event, admissible as evidence
example: The doorbell camera captured the res gestae: one courier, one parcel, one confident toss over the gate.

hindi: स्वयंसिद्ध — घटना स्वयं लापरवाही बताती है
definition: the thing speaks for itself; a legal rule letting obvious facts prove carelessness
example: A burnt pan, a shrieking smoke alarm and you holding the spatula: res ipsa loquitur.

hindi: पूर्व-न्याय — अदालत द्वारा अंतिम रूप से निपटाया मामला
definition: a legal matter already decided finally by a court, which the same parties cannot reopen
example: Who ate the last samosa is res judicata; the family court ruled against you in March.

hindi: दृढ़निश्चयी — अपने निर्णय पर अटल
definition: firmly determined and unwavering in purpose, refusing to give way under pressure
example: She stayed resolute about no meetings on Friday, even when the CEO sent a calendar invite.

hindi: अनुनादी — गहरी और देर तक गूँजने वाली ध्वनि वाला
definition: deep, full and rich in sound, continuing to echo and vibrate long after it starts
example: His resonant laugh carried through three floors of the open-plan office, including the quiet room.

hindi: विश्राम — कठिनाई या श्रम से थोड़ी देर की राहत
definition: a short period of rest or delay, offering relief from something difficult
example: The toddler's nap offered a respite just long enough to drink one lukewarm coffee.

hindi: शोभायमान — भव्य चमक से भरा हुआ
definition: shining brilliantly and looking splendid, richly radiant and impressive to behold
example: He arrived resplendent in a gold jacket to what turned out to be a video call.

hindi: पुनर्बलकारी — खोई ताक़त और सेहत लौटाने वाला
definition: having the power to bring back health, strength and good spirits after weakness
example: Nothing is more restorative than a nap that the calendar did not approve.

hindi: धारणाशील — बातों को देर तक याद रखने वाला
definition: able to hold facts firmly in memory and remember them accurately for many years
example: A retentive mind is a blessing until it remembers every embarrassing thing you said in 2014.

hindi: संकोची — अपने मन की बात छिपाए रखने वाला
definition: reluctant to speak openly or share thoughts, keeping feelings and facts private
example: The usually reticent CFO became chatty only when the numbers were good.

hindi: कटौती करना — खर्च और ख़र्चीले काम घटाना
definition: reduce spending sharply, cutting back costs when money becomes tight
example: The company retrenched by cancelling the offsite about morale.

hindi: प्रतिशोधात्मक दंड — किए गए बुरे काम का उचित दंड
definition: punishment given in return for wrongdoing, repaying harm with deserved harm
example: He took retribution for the reply-all by replying all with a spreadsheet.

hindi: वक्री — उलटी दिशा में चलता प्रतीत होने वाला
definition: moving backwards; of a planet, seeming to travel backwards across the heavens
example: She blamed Mercury going retrograde for the email she had sent to the wrong Priya.

hindi: आमोद-प्रमोद — शोर-शराबे से भरा जीवंत उत्सव
definition: lively, noisy celebration with dancing, drinking, music and loud merriment lasting late into night
example: The revelry next door ended at dawn, precisely when my alarm began its own.

hindi: लौटा हुआ प्रेत — मृत्यु या लंबी अनुपस्थिति के बाद लौटने वाला
definition: a person or ghost returning from death, or someone reappearing after a long absence
example: The bug we closed in March came back in June, a revenant with a new stack trace.

hindi: मूल विषय पर लौटें — भटकी बातचीत को वापस लाना
definition: a call to return to the actual subject under discussion after a long wandering digression
example: After twenty minutes on weekend hiking trips, the chair sighed, 'Revenons à nos moutons, the budget.'

hindi: प्रतिध्वनित होना — आवाज़ का बार-बार गूँजते रहना
definition: to echo repeatedly, a loud sound bouncing back from walls and continuing to ring
example: The dropped baking tray reverberated through the silent exam hall for a full minute.

hindi: दिवास्वप्न — जागती आँखों का सपनीला भटकाव
definition: a pleasant dreamy state of drifting thoughts, lost in daydream while awake
example: She slipped into a reverie during the budget call and surfaced only when someone said her name twice.

hindi: धिक्कारना — घृणा से किसी की निंदा करना
definition: criticise another person in abusive, angry and contemptuous language, condemning them with open hatred
example: The new parking policy was reviled by staff and quietly admired by the finance team.

hindi: भाव-विभोर होकर बखान करना — उत्साह से गुणगान
definition: speak or write about something with extravagant, gushing enthusiasm and lavish praise
example: He rhapsodized about his new air fryer as though it had personally saved his marriage.

hindi: वाग्मिता — प्रभावित करने की भाषा-कला, कभी खोखली
definition: the craft of persuasive speaking or writing, sometimes meaning impressive language lacking sincerity
example: The rhetoric promised a greener future; the budget promised a bigger car park.

hindi: अलंकारिक प्रश्न — उत्तर पाने के लिए नहीं, ज़ोर देने के लिए पूछा गया प्रश्न
definition: a question asked purely for effect or emphasis, with nobody expected to answer
example: "Who leaves an empty milk carton in the fridge?" was a rhetorical question, since everyone knew it was Rohan.

hindi: श्लेष्मा — आँख-नाक से बहने वाला स्राव
definition: archaic: watery discharge from eyes or nose, as during a cold or catarrh
example: Pollen season turns the whole commute into a carriage of sneezing and rheum.

hindi: निम्न तबक़ा — तुच्छ और अवांछित समझे जाने वाले लोग
definition: people regarded as disreputable, worthless or socially undesirable by those considering themselves superior
example: The club raised its fees to keep out the riffraff and promptly lost half its members.

hindi: धर्मनिष्ठ — न्यायप्रिय और नैतिक रूप से सही
definition: morally right and just, behaving according to strong principles of goodness
example: Her righteous crusade against people who recline airline seats is legendary.

hindi: झंझट — लंबी, उलझी और बेकार प्रक्रिया
definition: a long tangled complicated procedure, or rambling confused talk that wanders without reaching any point
example: Renewing a passport involves a rigmarole of photographs, forms and queues.

hindi: मृत्यु-कठोरता — मरने के कुछ घंटों बाद देह का अकड़ जाना
definition: the stiffening of the body some hours after death
example: Rigor mortis gave the pathologist a rough window for the time of death.

hindi: सोता — पानी की बहुत छोटी पतली धारा
definition: a very small narrow stream of flowing water, trickling gently across open ground
example: A rill of spilled coffee made its way steadily toward the keyboard.

hindi: तुषार — पेड़ों पर जमी सफ़ेद बर्फ़ीली परत
definition: white icy coating formed when freezing fog settles onto branches, grass, wires
example: Rime coated every branch in the park, and every jogger stopped to photograph it.

hindi: बेलगाम विलासी — उच्छृंखल मौज-मस्ती वाला
definition: wild and unrestrained, especially of living given over to noisy pleasure
example: The prodigal son's riotous living would today be documented hourly on Instagram.

hindi: कालभ्रमित व्यक्ति — जो बदलते समय से पूरी तरह बेख़बर हो
definition: someone hopelessly behind the times, after Irving's sleeper who napped twenty years
example: Back from a month offline, he blinked at the new logo like Rip Van Winkle.

hindi: तटीय — नदी के किनारे से संबंधित या वहाँ स्थित
definition: relating to the banks of a river or stream and the strip of land lying beside them
example: The riverside flat advertised riparian views, meaning you could hear the ducks arguing.

hindi: चुटीला पलटवार — तीखा और चतुर जवाबी उत्तर
definition: a quick, clever reply that turns someone's criticism back against them
example: Her riposte to "you're always late" was a calendar invite for the previous Tuesday.

hindi: अमर्यादित-सा — शालीनता की सीमा छूता हुआ
definition: slightly improper or indecent, bordering on shocking polite company with suggestive content
example: The best man's toast grew risqué enough that the grandmother finally reached for her hearing aid.

hindi: जलधारा — छोटी पतली नदी या बहता सोता
definition: a small narrow stream or trickle of flowing water, like a tiny river
example: Rivulets of rain ran down the tent, confirming the 'waterproof' label was aspirational.

hindi: अति-सज्जित — हल्की, बारीक और अत्यधिक सजावट वाला
definition: excessively elaborate in light, delicate decoration of curls, scrolls and pastel flourishes
example: Her email signature, with its three fonts and a glittering quote, had gone fully rococo.

hindi: गर्वोक्ति — बड़बोली और खोखली डींग
definition: boastful, bragging talk about personal courage and deeds, inflated and empty
example: After two coffees, his rodomontade about quarterly targets filled the whole standup.

hindi: धूर्त — बेईमान पर मोहक, जिसकी चालबाज़ी माफ़ हो जाए
definition: a dishonest, unprincipled rascal, often charming enough that people forgive his trickery and cheating
example: The estate agent was a rogue, but such a cheerful one that we nearly signed anyway.

hindi: धूर्तता — बेईमानी और चालबाज़ी भरा आचरण
definition: dishonest, roguish conduct; playful mischief or outright trickery and cheating
example: Hiding the office's last oat milk behind the kale was pure roguery.

hindi: मथना — गंदला करना या उथल-पुथल मचाना
definition: to stir water until muddy, or to throw something into churning turmoil
example: News of the merger roiled the markets before anyone had finished their coffee.

hindi: हुड़दंग मचाना — शोरगुल भरी मस्ती करना
definition: to celebrate noisily and boisterously in company, usually with plenty of drinking and shouting
example: The fantasy-football league roistered through the draft as though money were at stake.

hindi: कुंजी-उपन्यास — असली लोगों को नक़ली नामों में छिपाने वाला उपन्यास
definition: a novel portraying real people and actual events thinly disguised behind invented names
example: The ex-employee's debut novel is a roman à clef, and the whole office has already matched the villain to the CFO.

hindi: नदी-उपन्यास — कई खंडों में फैली एक परिवार या समाज की लंबी गाथा
definition: a very long novel sequence, spread across many volumes, following a single family or society through generations
example: The family group chat has become a roman-fleuve, now in its ninth volume of cousins' weddings.

hindi: आवर्ती गीत — दो तुकों और लौटती टेक वाली फ़्रांसीसी कविता
definition: a French verse form using two rhymes, with its opening words returning as a refrain
example: Her voicemail greeting circles back to its first line like a rondeau with a dial tone.

hindi: गुलाबी आभा वाला — गुलाबी रंगत; अति आशावादी
definition: rosy pinkish in colour like dawn light; also overly hopeful and optimistic
example: The roseate sunset matched the roseate sales forecast nobody believed.

hindi: व्याख्यान-मंच — वक्ता या संचालक का ऊँचा चबूतरा
definition: a raised platform for a speaker or a conductor
example: She stepped up to the rostrum, once a stage decked with the beaks of captured ships.

hindi: अरुणिम उँगलियों वाली — होमर की भोर का विशेषण
definition: Homer's epithet for dawn, whose first pink rays spread across the eastern horizon like fingers
example: Rosy-fingered dawn crept over the skyline just as the all-nighter's final slide deck crashed.

hindi: गोलमटोल — गोल और भरे-पूरे शरीर वाला
definition: round and plump in body, pleasantly heavy and full in shape, carrying comfortable extra flesh
example: The rotund pug waddled through the park as if he owned the lease.

hindi: गोलमंडप — गुंबद से ढका गोलाकार भवन या कक्ष
definition: a round building or hall, especially one crowned with a dome and circled by columns
example: The museum's rotunda has perfect acoustics, as every toddler inside it discovers within seconds.

hindi: पराजय-भगदड़ — सेना की करारी हार और अव्यवस्थित पलायन
definition: crushing defeat that sends beaten troops fleeing in total disorder
example: The quiz night was a rout: our team scored four points and left before dessert.

hindi: रसिक लम्पट — ढलती उम्र का विलासी पुरुष
definition: a debauched gentleman, often older and elegant, devoted entirely to sensual pleasure
example: The ageing roué at the bar still orders champagne as though the eighties never ended.

hindi: लय-स्वातंत्र्य — भाव के लिए गति को थोड़ा खींचना-घटाना
definition: expressive freedom in musical tempo, briefly slowing and quickening without losing the overall beat
example: He tells a joke with generous rubato, pausing so long before the punchline that people check their phones.

hindi: भरी-पूरी सुंदरता — मांसल, सुडौल रूप
definition: plump, full-bodied and beautiful, like the women painted by Peter Paul Rubens
example: Her Rubenesque self-portrait got more likes than any of the gym selfies around it.

hindi: निर्णायक सीमा — जिसे पार करने पर लौटना असंभव
definition: a boundary that, once crossed, allows no going back
example: Sending that resignation email was his Rubicon, and the server sent it twice.

hindi: अरुणाभ — स्वस्थ लालिमा लिए चेहरा
definition: having a healthy, reddish, rosy complexion, often from outdoor life or drink
example: The rubicund farmer at the market insists his secret is fresh air and ghee.

hindi: शीर्षलेख — लाल स्याही में लिखा शीर्षक या निर्देश
definition: a heading or instruction written in crimson letters in a manuscript, hence any governing rule
example: The teacher's grading rubric runs four pages, which is longer than the essay it grades.

hindi: लाल अंकन करना — पांडुलिपि के शीर्षक लाल रंग से लिखना
definition: to mark headings, initials or instructions in crimson letters in a manuscript or book
example: She rubricates her planner with a red gel pen, so every dentist appointment looks like scripture.

hindi: गुंडा — बेलगाम, हिंसक और निर्लज्ज बदमाश
definition: a violent, lawless brute who bullies, threatens or attacks others without scruple or shame
example: The ruffian in seat 14B reclined fully the moment the meal trays came out.

hindi: रोमंथन करना — जुगाली करना; किसी बात पर देर तक मनन करना
definition: to chew again like grazing cattle; figuratively, to think deeply and slowly over something
example: She ruminated on the job offer for three weeks and then asked for one more.

hindi: मनन — किसी बात को बार-बार मन में घुमाना
definition: long careful thinking that turns one subject over and over, slowly chewing through every angle
example: After a week of rumination over two job offers, he chose the one with the better coffee machine.

hindi: नाटकीय-राजसी — षड्यंत्रों और आडंबर भरे छोटे काल्पनिक राज्य जैसा
definition: like a small, romantic imaginary kingdom full of court intrigue and pompous ceremony
example: The housing association's Ruritanian politics included sashes, factions and a disputed throne.

hindi: नगर में ग्राम — शहर के बीच गाँव जैसी शांति
definition: the illusion of countryside within a city, a green rural retreat amid urban streets
example: A community garden between two car parks is rus in urbe with a parking ticket.

hindi: चाल — धोखा देने की युक्ति
definition: a cunning trick or plan designed to deceive someone into believing falsehood
example: The 'quick sync' was a ruse to get everyone into the surprise farewell.

hindi: देहाती — गाँव जैसा सादा, खुरदुरा और बिना सजावट का
definition: simple, rough and homely in the plain style of rural countryside cottages and farms
example: The restaurant's rustic charm included wobbly benches and a fourteen-pound sourdough.

hindi: ग्रामवास करना — गाँव जाकर सरल जीवन बिताना
definition: to retire into the countryside and live a simple rural life away from cities
example: After the exit, the founder rusticated in Vermont, posting daily about chickens and seed rounds.

hindi: श्याम — गहरा काला, शोकाकुल काला
definition: deep black in colour, dark like midnight or the heavy cloth worn for mourning
example: The sable coffee arrived looking stronger than the entire team's morale.

hindi: अति-मधुर — चाशनी जैसा मीठा, बनावटी भावुकता से भरा
definition: excessively sweet in taste, or sickly sentimental in a false, sugary, unconvincing manner
example: The saccharine farewell card was signed by forty people who never spoke to her.

hindi: पौरोहित्य-संबंधी — पुरोहितों और उनके पवित्र पद से जुड़ा
definition: relating to priests and their sacred office, duties, rituals and spiritual authority within a church
example: The barista poured the flat white with sacerdotal solemnity, as though the oat milk had been blessed.

hindi: धार्मिक-अनुष्ठानिक — पवित्र संस्कारों या रीति से जुड़ा
definition: relating to sacred rites and holy ceremony rather than everyday life
example: The office coffee ritual has taken on an almost sacral solemnity, with its own order of service.

hindi: धर्म-अपमान — पवित्र वस्तु या स्थान का अनादर
definition: disrespectful treatment of something sacred, holy or otherwise held deeply worthy of reverence and protection
example: Putting ketchup on the chef's wagyu was, in his kitchen, pure sacrilege.

hindi: अपवित्रकारी — पवित्र वस्तु का अनादर करने वाला
definition: treating something sacred, holy or deeply revered with gross, shocking and deliberate disrespect
example: Microwaving fish in the shared office kitchen is sacrilegious in any faith.

hindi: परम पवित्र — इतना पवित्र कि उसे छुआ या बदला न जाए
definition: regarded as untouchable: so sacred or important that nobody may question, alter or tamper with it
example: In this household the last slice of pizza is sacrosanct and belongs to whoever ordered it.

hindi: प्रज्ञावान — गहरी समझ और विवेक से सही निर्णय लेने वाला
definition: having deep wisdom and sound judgement, especially earned through long experience
example: The sagacious senior engineer's entire code review was one word: why?

hindi: प्रज्ञा — व्यावहारिक बुद्धि और गहरी सूझबूझ
definition: keen practical wisdom and sound judgment
example: Her sagacity in a crisis was worth more than the whole strategy deck.

hindi: ऋषि — अनुभव और ज्ञान से परिपूर्ण बुद्धिमान
definition: a person revered for profound wisdom gained through long learning and experience
example: The office sage's advice was always the same: turn it off and on again.

hindi: नौसादर-गंध — मूर्च्छा में सुँघाया जाने वाला लवण
definition: smelling salts of ammonia, waved under noses to revive people from fainting
example: After seeing the cloud bill, the finance team needed sal volatile rather than coffee.

hindi: अश्लील-चटपटा — यौन बातों से भरा, उत्तेजक
definition: dwelling on sexual matters in a lustful, sensational manner meant to titillate readers
example: The memoir's salacious chapter was the only one anyone discussed at book club.

hindi: वेतन — नियमित काम के बदले तयशुदा नियत आय
definition: fixed pay for regular work, quoted by the year and drawn by the month
example: The salary looked generous until he divided it by the hours actually worked.

hindi: प्रमुख — जो सबसे उभरकर ध्यान खींचे
definition: standing out as the most noticeable or important part
example: Skip the history and give me the salient points before the client calls.

hindi: पीत-वर्ण — पीलापन लिए अस्वस्थ त्वचा
definition: having yellowish, unhealthy-looking skin, pale and sickly in colour
example: Months of fluorescent lighting had given the whole finance floor a sallow glow.

hindi: धावा बोलना — घेरे से साहसपूर्वक बाहर निकल पड़ना
definition: rush or venture boldly outward, like soldiers charging from a besieged fortress
example: Fortified with espresso, we sallied forth into the Black Friday crowds.

hindi: गोष्ठी-कक्ष — विद्वानों और कलाकारों की घरेलू बैठक
definition: a regular gathering of writers, artists and thinkers hosted in a private home for lively conversation
example: Her Sunday brunch has quietly become a salon, where the avocado toast is secondary to the arguments about novels.

hindi: सभा-संचालिका — विद्वानों की गोष्ठी सजाने वाली मेज़बान
definition: a hostess who gathers writers, artists and thinkers in her home for regular elegant conversation
example: A modern salonnière, she runs a group chat where poets argue about sourdough.

hindi: स्वास्थ्यप्रद — शरीर और सेहत के लिए हितकर
definition: healthy and wholesome, good for the body and promoting sound health, especially of climate or places
example: He moved to the hills for the salubrious air and spent the first week complaining about the stairs.

hindi: हितकारी — कड़वा होकर भी भलाई करने वाला
definition: producing good effects on health or wellbeing, often through something unpleasant but beneficial
example: Losing the fantasy league was a salutary lesson in reading the injury reports.

hindi: मलहम — घाव भरने वाला लेप
definition: a soothing ointment spread on wounds, burns or sore skin to help healing
example: A kind reply to a bad review works like salve on a small burn.

hindi: गुप्त प्रकाशन — प्रतिबंधित लेखन को चुपचाप छापकर बाँटना
definition: banned writing secretly copied and passed from reader to reader behind the government's back
example: The leaked style guide circulated like samizdat, forwarded from one private inbox to the next.

hindi: महाबली — असाधारण शारीरिक शक्ति वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person of extraordinary physical strength, often hiding a single secret weakness
example: The gym's resident Samson deadlifts twice his weight and faints at the sight of a needle.

hindi: पवित्र भोलापन — किसी की निरी भोली मूर्खता पर व्यंग्य
definition: holy simplicity: said with irony of someone's innocent, trusting and foolish ignorance
example: He asked whether the email from the stranded prince was genuine, and the whole office sighed sancta simplicitas.

hindi: पवित्र करना — पावन बनाना; धार्मिक स्वीकृति देना
definition: to make something holy or sacred; also to give something religious approval, blessing or respectable sanction
example: Tradition has sanctified the office birthday cake, however dry it turns out.

hindi: ढोंगी-धर्मात्मा — दूसरों से अधिक पवित्र होने का दिखावा करने वाला
definition: making a smug, showy display of being morally superior or more righteous than everyone else
example: His sanctimonious posts about digital detox were, naturally, written at two in the morning.

hindi: पवित्रता — किसी चीज़ का पावन और अलंघनीय होना
definition: the quality of being holy and sacred, deserving deep reverence and protection from harm
example: He guards the sanctity of his Sunday lie-in the way monks guard a relic.

hindi: पवित्र कक्ष; एकांत — मंदिर का पवित्र स्थान; निजी कमरा
definition: a holy place inside a temple; hence a private room where no one may intrude
example: The garage is Dad's sanctum, and entering without knocking voids your allowance.

hindi: गर्भगृह — सबसे पवित्र और निजी स्थान
definition: the holy of holies, a deeply private room or retreat where hardly anyone else may enter
example: His garage is a sanctum sanctorum of unfinished bikes and forbidden snacks.

hindi: अविचल धैर्य — संकट में भी ठंडा दिमाग
definition: cool, steady nerve that stays unshaken during danger or sudden crisis
example: She restarted the production server mid-demo with the sangfroid of someone ordering coffee.

hindi: फक्कड़ — जेब में एक पैसा भी नहीं
definition: without a single penny to spend; completely broke, usually just temporarily
example: Sans le sou until payday, he discovered the joys of free museum Fridays.

hindi: निर्भय और निष्कलंक — वीर भी, बेदाग भी
definition: without fear and without blame, the old ideal of the perfect honourable knight
example: She fixed the production outage at 3 a.m. and wrote the post-mortem, sans peur et sans reproche.

hindi: क्रांतिकारी जनसाधारण — फ़्रांसीसी क्रांति के उग्र ग़रीब नागरिक
definition: the radical working-class revolutionaries of Paris during the French Revolution, or militant radicals generally
example: The junior staff marched on the boardroom like sans-culottes demanding a better coffee bean.

hindi: जानने का साहस करो — स्वयं सोचने की हिम्मत रखो
definition: dare to know; have the courage to think for yourself instead of trusting authority
example: Sapere aude, the professor said, which in practice meant reading the terms and conditions.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — गहन बुद्धिमत्ता और विवेक
definition: deep wisdom and thoughtful intelligence, often mentioned with gentle irony
example: In a rare burst of sapience, the committee voted to meet less often.

hindi: प्राज्ञ — बुद्धिमान और ज्ञानी
definition: wise, thoughtful and deeply intelligent, often said with gentle irony
example: The sapient cat watched us assemble the bookcase and declined to comment.

hindi: पाषाण-शवपेटी — नक़्क़ाशीदार पत्थर का प्राचीन ताबूत
definition: a stone coffin, often carved and richly decorated, used in ancient burials of kings and nobles
example: The server rack in the corner looked like a sarcophagus and hummed like one too.

hindi: वेशभूषा-संबंधी — कपड़ों और पहनावे की शैली से जुड़ा
definition: relating to tailoring, clothes or style of dress, especially skilled or elegant dressing
example: His one sartorial decision each morning is which grey T-shirt is cleanest.

hindi: तृप्त करना — भूख या इच्छा को पूरी तरह शांत करना
definition: to satisfy an appetite or desire completely, sometimes pushing well past comfort into excess
example: No quantity of cat videos has ever sated the internet.

hindi: तृप्ति — इतना मिल जाना कि और की इच्छा न रहे
definition: the condition of being fully satisfied, with hunger and appetite completely gone
example: Satiety arrives exactly twenty minutes after the second dessert.

hindi: क्षत्रप — दूर बैठे सम्राट का प्रांतीय शासक
definition: a provincial governor ruling a distant region on behalf of an emperor, often grown proud and self-serving
example: The branch manager rules the Pune office like a Persian satrap who has not heard from the capital in years.

hindi: उन्मुक्त उत्सव — नियम भूलकर मनाई गई रंगरलियाँ
definition: a period of wild, unrestrained revelry and feasting, after the Roman winter festival
example: The last day of exams turns the dorm into a saturnalia of pizza boxes and bad decisions.

hindi: उदास और गंभीर — रूखा, मंद स्वभाव
definition: gloomy and grave in temper, slow to warm
example: He had a saturnine face that made even his compliments sound like warnings.

hindi: टहलना — धीमे, बेफ़िक्र क़दमों से चलना
definition: walk in a slow, relaxed, unhurried manner, as though time hardly matters
example: He sauntered into the standup twelve minutes late, coffee first, apology never.

hindi: भगदड़ — हर कोई अपनी जान बचाए, ऐसी अफ़रातफ़री
definition: a panicked general rout where everyone scrambles desperately to save only themselves
example: When the layoff rumours hit, the office became a polite sauve qui peut of updated LinkedIn profiles.

hindi: मनीषी — असाधारण गहन ज्ञान वाला विद्वान
definition: a learned person with profound, remarkable knowledge of some field, admired for scholarly brilliance
example: The spreadsheet savant can make a pivot table weep.

hindi: व्यवहार-कुशलता — हर स्थिति में सही करना जानने की सहजता
definition: the polished social skill of knowing exactly which words and behaviour suit any delicate situation
example: With real savoir-faire, she turned the awkward silence after the layoffs into a question about lunch.

hindi: जीवन-कला — शिष्ट समाज में सलीक़े से रहना जानना
definition: knowledge of polite social customs and the graceful skill of living well
example: Her savoir-vivre extends to knowing which fork to use and when to leave the party.

hindi: खुरदुरा; अश्लील — रूखी सतह वाला, भद्दा
definition: rough and scaly to touch; also indecent, scandalous or shockingly crude in content
example: The scabrous memoir sold millions, mainly to people claiming they read it ironically.

hindi: शरारती नटखट — जिसकी करतूतें अपराध कम, शैतानी अधिक
definition: a cheeky young scamp or good-for-nothing whose naughtiness amuses more than it harms
example: The little scallywag ordered forty pizzas on his mother's unlocked phone.

hindi: छंद-विश्लेषण — पंक्ति में चरण और बलाघात चिह्नित करना
definition: the marking and analysis of stressed syllables and metrical feet within lines of verse
example: Her scansion of the birthday card revealed that Uncle Raj had forced three syllables into one.

hindi: न्यून — बहुत कम, लगभग नहीं के बराबर
definition: barely sufficient; present in only a small, scarce amount, less than truly needed
example: He paid scant attention to the safety briefing and full attention to the snacks.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — जिस पर दूसरों के दोष डाल दिए जाएँ
definition: someone unfairly blamed and punished for the mistakes, failures or crimes of other people
example: The intern became the scapegoat for a server outage that happened before he was hired.

hindi: उद्दंड — सदा मुसीबत मोल लेने वाला शरारती
definition: a mischievous, reckless rascal who is always getting into trouble and shrugging off every scolding
example: Every family has a scapegrace cousin who turns up at weddings with a new business idea and no suit.

hindi: फूट डालने वाला — धर्मसंघ या समूह में विभाजन करने वाला
definition: causing or favouring division within a church or group, splitting members into rival hostile factions
example: The schismatic debate over dark mode split the design team into two lunch tables.

hindi: टीकाकार — प्राचीन ग्रंथों पर हाशिये की टिप्पणियाँ लिखने वाला विद्वान
definition: an ancient scholar who wrote explanatory notes in the margins of classical Greek or Latin texts
example: Every group chat has a scholiast who answers each forwarded article with three paragraphs of footnotes.

hindi: टीका-टिप्पणी — प्राचीन ग्रंथ के हाशिये पर लिखी व्याख्या
definition: an explanatory note written in the margin of an ancient Greek or Latin text by an early scholar
example: The most useful line in the whole policy PDF is a scholium some intern left in the comments.

hindi: अध्यापिका — सख़्त, नियमपसंद शिक्षिका
definition: a strict, prim schoolteacher, especially a woman fussy about rules, manners and correct behaviour
example: She went full schoolmarm in the standup, asking who had left the build broken overnight.

hindi: कण — अंश मात्र, एक चिंगारी भर
definition: a tiny trace or spark; the smallest possible amount or quantity of something
example: There is not a scintilla of proof that the printer works when you need it.

hindi: स्फुरित होना — चिनगारी सी चमकना, टिमटिमाना
definition: to sparkle and flicker with quick flashes of light, often figuratively brilliant
example: The fairy lights scintillated faithfully until someone plugged in the kettle.

hindi: अल्पज्ञ — अधूरे ज्ञान से विद्वान होने का दिखावा करने वाला
definition: a person who pretends to deep learning while having only shallow, superficial knowledge
example: One article in, the sciolist was already lecturing epidemiologists online.

hindi: वंशज — प्रतिष्ठित घराने का उत्तराधिकारी
definition: a young descendant or heir of a notable, wealthy or powerful family, expected to inherit
example: The scion of a pasta dynasty launched a keto brand, to deafening family silence.

hindi: कानून-अवज्ञाकारी — छोटे नियमों को खुलेआम ठुकराने वाला
definition: person who openly ignores laws, especially minor ones like parking or littering rules
example: The neighbourhood scofflaw parks across three spaces and waves at the traffic warden.

hindi: दुष्ट — बेईमान और धोखेबाज़ व्यक्ति
definition: a dishonest, unprincipled person who cheats and betrays others without feeling shame
example: That scoundrel promised to 'circle back' and then left the company.

hindi: लंबा आक्रोश-लेख — भड़ास भरा उबाऊ लेखन
definition: a long, tedious piece of writing or speech, usually an angry rant
example: He replied to a two-word text with a screed about respect and read receipts.

hindi: क़लमघसीट — हल्का-फुल्का लिखने वाला
definition: a writer of hasty, careless prose or mediocre literary work, often said with contempt
example: The critic dismissed him as a scribbler, then quoted him in three consecutive columns.

hindi: लेखनशाला — मठ का वह कक्ष जहाँ पांडुलिपियाँ लिखी जाती थीं
definition: a room in a medieval monastery where monks copied, lettered and illustrated handwritten manuscripts
example: The shared office went silent as a scriptorium once the deadline email landed.

hindi: लेखक-मुंशी — दस्तावेज़ों की नक़ल करने वाला पेशेवर लिपिक
definition: archaic: a professional clerk who copies documents and writes letters for others
example: He spent the afternoon as office scrivener, retyping a scanned spreadsheet.

hindi: गंडमाला — गले की ग्रंथियों की सूजन
definition: a form of tuberculosis causing swollen glands and sores along the neck
example: Old parish records list scrofula so often you start eyeing your own lymph nodes.

hindi: कृपण बूढ़ा — उत्सव में भी खर्च से चिढ़ने वाला
definition: Dickens's miserly character; hence any stingy person who resents spending, especially during festive seasons
example: The office Scrooge vetoed the pizza and suggested a motivational email instead.

hindi: नैतिक संकोच — ग़लत काम से रोकने वाली अंतरात्मा की आवाज़
definition: a moral hesitation that stops someone from doing something they feel is wrong
example: He had no scruple about eating the office cake, only about taking the last slice.

hindi: दर्पण-दर्शन — बिल्लौर या जल में झाँककर भविष्य देखना
definition: gazing into a crystal ball, mirror or still water to glimpse future events or distant secrets
example: Staring at the loading spinner long enough starts to feel like scrying.

hindi: धोवन-कक्ष — बर्तन माँजने की पिछली कोठरी
definition: a small back room beside a kitchen where dishes are washed and rough chores done
example: Our open-plan kitchen has no scullery, so the dinner-party dishes simply live on the counter.

hindi: रसोई-चाकर — बर्तन माँजने वाला नौकर
definition: archaic: a lowly kitchen servant who washes dishes and does rough household chores
example: At every family gathering the youngest cousin is appointed scullion and handed the roasting tin.

hindi: अश्लील निंदापूर्ण — गंदी, झूठी बदनामी करने वाला
definition: making coarse, abusive and insulting claims intended to damage someone's reputation
example: The scurrilous blog post had more exclamation marks than verifiable facts.

hindi: डुबोना — अपने ही जहाज़ में छेद कर डुबो देना; योजना नष्ट करना
definition: to sink one's own ship deliberately, or to wreck a plan or scheme on purpose
example: One reply-all from the intern scuttled three weeks of careful negotiation.

hindi: दो पाटों के बीच — दो समान ख़तरों के बीच फँसना
definition: two equally dangerous alternatives, where avoiding one threat drives you toward the other
example: Between the Scylla of layoffs and the Charybdis of bankruptcy, the board chose lunch.

hindi: समुद्रयात्री — जीवन भर समुद्र पर यात्रा करने वाला
definition: a sailor or traveller whose working life is spent voyaging across oceans
example: A true seafarer, Grandpa still sways gently whenever he stands in a queue.

hindi: सामयिक — अपने उचित समय या मौसम के अनुरूप
definition: suitable for the time of year or season, or arriving at a fitting, welcome moment
example: A seasonable reminder about flu jabs arrived, followed instantly by a sneeze.

hindi: सांप्रदायिक — किसी एक पंथ या गुट से कट्टरता से बँधा
definition: narrowly devoted to one religious sect or faction, often intolerant of and hostile toward others
example: The podcast's sectarian feud over sourdough starters has now lasted four seasons.

hindi: गंभीर व शांत — धीमा, संयत और मर्यादित
definition: calm, unhurried and dignified in manner, never loud, hasty or excitable in company
example: The office party remained sedate until someone discovered the karaoke machine.

hindi: बैठकर रहने वाला — गतिहीन, अधिकतर बैठे रहने वाला
definition: spending much time seated and taking little physical exercise or movement
example: His sedentary job means the step counter treats a walk to the fridge as cardio.

hindi: शोभनीय — जो उचित और भला लगे
definition: proper and fitting according to accepted standards of good behaviour and taste
example: It hardly seemed seemly to post the wedding cake before the bride had cut it.

hindi: सामंत स्वामी — जागीर का मालिक और प्रजा का स्वामी
definition: a feudal lord of a manor, holding land, rights and authority over the peasants living there
example: Our landlord inspects the building like a seigneur surveying his peasants, then ignores the boiler.

hindi: आत्मानुशासन — अपने आचरण पर दृढ़ नियंत्रण
definition: steady control over your own feelings, impulses and conduct, especially when provoked or tempted
example: It took real self-command not to reply-all with the word 'obviously'.

hindi: आत्मत्याग — अपनी इच्छाएँ स्वयं छोड़ देना
definition: refusing yourself pleasures or comforts, often for discipline or others' sake
example: January brings a brief festival of self-denial, followed by February's festival of forgetting.

hindi: संकोची — अपनी उपलब्धियों को पीछे रखने वाला
definition: modestly keeping yourself and your achievements in the background, avoiding attention
example: The self-effacing founder credits everything to the team, and the team credits the coffee.

hindi: आत्मसंयम — अपने ऊपर पूरा शांत नियंत्रण
definition: calm, confident control over yourself that stays steady during stress or pressure
example: The intern showed more self-possession in the outage call than the three directors combined.

hindi: सदा निष्ठावान — हर हाल में वफ़ादार
definition: always faithful, a motto promising loyalty that never lapses under any circumstance
example: His phone has changed five times, but his ringtone remains semper fidelis to 2009.

hindi: जरावस्था — बुढ़ापे की ओर ढलने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the gradual process of ageing and declining in strength over many years
example: My sourdough starter has entered senescence, bubbling only out of politeness.

hindi: जराग्रस्त — बुढ़ाता हुआ, ढलती अवस्था में
definition: growing aged and gradually declining in vigour through the passing years
example: The senescent houseplant has one leaf left and a great deal of attitude.

hindi: प्रधान-कारिंदा — राजसी घर का मुख्य प्रबंधक
definition: archaic: the steward in charge of managing the household, lands and servants of a noble lord
example: Every office manager is a seneschal at heart, guarding the stationery cupboard like a castle keep.

hindi: व्यापक अर्थ में — ढीली, विस्तृत परिभाषा के अनुसार
definition: in the broad, loose sense of a term, stretching beyond its precise technical definition
example: Sensu lato, anything eaten standing over the sink counts as dinner.

hindi: संकुचित अर्थ में — सख़्त, सीमित परिभाषा के अनुसार
definition: in the strict, narrow sense of a term, following its precise technical definition
example: A tomato is a fruit sensu stricto, a fact best not raised at a salad bar.

hindi: उपदेशात्मक — छोटी नैतिक सूक्तियों से भरा, अक्सर उबाऊ
definition: given to brief moral sayings, often preachy and pompous in their wisdom
example: The sententious manager closed every standup with a maxim about grit.

hindi: सत्तर वर्षीय — सत्तर से उनासी वर्ष की आयु का व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose years of life fall between seventy and seventy-nine inclusive
example: The septuagenarian on our street runs faster five-kilometre times than the entire engineering team.

hindi: समाधि-सा — क़ब्र की तरह उदास, गहरा और खोखला
definition: gloomy, hollow and deep, like something belonging to a tomb or grave of the dead
example: The accountant announced the quarterly figures in a sepulchral voice.

hindi: समाधि — पत्थर में काटी गई या बनाई गई क़ब्र
definition: a tomb carved from solid rock or built from stone for burying the dead
example: The basement storage room had become a sepulchre for forgotten gym equipment.

hindi: देवदूत-सा — स्वर्गिक, निर्मल और दीप्त
definition: like the seraphs, the highest angels of heaven: pure, radiant and serenely blissful
example: The toddler wore a seraphic smile, right beside the wall he had crayoned.

hindi: शुष्क — सूखा और मुरझाया, पतझड़ जैसा
definition: dried, withered and faded, like autumn leaves or grass after long summer heat
example: By August the office plant was sere, a quiet memorial to everyone assuming someone else watered it.

hindi: भूदास — ज़मीन से बँधा मज़दूर
definition: a medieval labourer bound to work a lord's land, unable to leave without permission
example: Unpaid overtime makes serfs of us all, only with ergonomic chairs.

hindi: दासवत — ग़ुलाम जैसी अधीनता दिखाने वाला
definition: excessively willing to obey and please others, like a slave serving a master
example: The chatbot's servile apologies somehow made the refund delay more annoying.

hindi: परिचारक — सेवा करने वाला नौकर
definition: archaic: a servant or attendant who waits upon a master and performs duties within a household
example: The hotel's robot servitor delivers towels flawlessly and then blocks the corridor for twenty minutes.

hindi: लंबे-लंबे शब्दों वाला — भारी शब्द पसंद करने वाला
definition: using long, polysyllabic words, often showily, where shorter plain words would serve
example: His sesquipedalian cover letter used "perspicacious" twice and misspelled the company name.

hindi: षट्पदी — छह पंक्तियों का छंद, विशेषकर चतुर्दशपदी का अंतिम भाग
definition: a group of six lines of verse, especially the closing six lines that finish a sonnet
example: The breakup text had a gentle octave and a brutal sestet.

hindi: षट्शब्दावर्ती कविता — छह अंत-शब्दों को क्रम बदल-बदलकर दोहराने वाली कविता
definition: a poem of six stanzas that rotates the same six line-ending words in a fixed pattern
example: Our standup has the shape of a sestina: the same six words, rearranged daily.

hindi: गिरजाघर का सेवक — घंटा बजाने और क़ब्रें खोदने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: a church officer who looks after the building, rings bells and digs graves
example: Like a patient sexton, the office manager buried every failed initiative without comment.

hindi: धूमिल छटा — रंगों का धुएँ-सा कोमल घुलना, बिना तीखी रेखा
definition: the soft blending of colours and shadow in painting, letting edges dissolve gently like smoke
example: The beauty filter applied such generous sfumato that his jawline simply left the meeting.
