hindi: फटेहाल कुलीन — ग़रीबी में भी शिष्टता का दिखावा
definition: keeping the manners and appearance of gentility despite being quite poor
example: The shabby-genteel club still serves sherry, now poured from a box.

hindi: शांति — हिब्रू अभिवादन, मिलने-बिछड़ने पर
definition: Hebrew greeting meaning peace, used when meeting or parting with someone
example: He ended every email with shalom, even the ones disputing an invoice.

hindi: कल्पित स्वर्ग — दुनिया से दूर शांत और सुखी स्थान
definition: a remote imagined paradise, hidden away from the world, where life is peaceful and happy
example: Every burnt-out founder dreams of a Shangri-La with no Slack and a very slow postal service.

hindi: जुआ-ठग — ताश या पासों में धोखा देने वाला
definition: archaic: a cheat or swindler, especially one who fleeces victims by cheating at cards, dice or gambling
example: The friendly stranger at the poker app's table was a sharper with three accounts.

hindi: पहचान-चिह्न — ऐसा शब्द या रिवाज जो अपने और पराए को अलग कर दे
definition: a custom, word or belief that marks insiders and shuts outsiders from a group
example: Pronouncing it 'jif' is the shibboleth that sorts the office into two warring camps.

hindi: निकम्मा — बिना उद्यम या महत्त्वाकांक्षा वाला
definition: lazy and lacking ambition, making no effort to work or improve their circumstances
example: The shiftless roommate's grand plan for the dishes was to wait for them to become vintage.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — फ़ैसले में हिचकिचाते रहना
definition: to waver indecisively and keep delaying, hesitating endlessly, unable to settle upon any choice
example: Stop shilly-shallying over the paint colour; the walls have been grey primer since March.

hindi: शांति चाहो तो युद्ध की तैयारी रखो — सैन्य तत्परता ही सुरक्षा
definition: wishing for peace means preparing for warfare; visible military strength deters enemies from attacking
example: She keeps a spare charger in every bag: si vis pacem, para bellum.

hindi: सीत्कारी — सिसकारी जैसी 'स' वाली ध्वनि करता
definition: making or full of hissing sounds, like a whispered string of esses or a snake's warning
example: The sibilant whisper of the espresso machine is the library's only permitted conversation.

hindi: भविष्यवादिनी — दैवी प्रेरणा से भविष्य बताने वाली स्त्री
definition: a woman in ancient Greece or Rome believed to utter prophecy about future events under divine inspiration
example: The office manager, sibyl of the calendar, knew the offsite would be cancelled weeks before anyone else.

hindi: भविष्यवाणी-सा रहस्यमय — गूढ़ और भविष्यसूचक
definition: prophetic and mysterious, uttered like a riddling prediction whose meaning remains obscure
example: The economist's sibylline forecast could be read as boom, bust or both.

hindi: यथावत् — मूल में ठीक ऐसा ही लिखा है
definition: thus, placed in brackets to show a quoted mistake appears exactly in the original
example: The memo praised our 'excellant [sic] attention to detail'.

hindi: अत्याचारियों का यही हश्र — हर तानाशाह का हिंसक पतन निश्चित
definition: thus always to tyrants; a defiant vow that every tyrant will meet a violent downfall
example: When the micromanaging manager's calendar invite finally got declined by everyone, someone typed sic semper tyrannis.

hindi: सांसारिक वैभव क्षणभंगुर है — यश ऐसे ही बीत जाता है
definition: thus passes worldly glory, meaning fame and power fade with passing time
example: Last year's viral dance is now a cringe compilation; sic transit gloria mundi.

hindi: नाक्षत्र — तारों से जुड़ा या उनसे मापा गया
definition: relating to stars, or measured against distant fixed stars rather than sun
example: By sidereal time the meeting overran slightly; by human time it lasted a geological era.

hindi: रेशमी — रेशम जैसा चिकना और मुलायम
definition: smooth, soft and glossy to touch, like fine silk fabric; also gentle and elegant
example: Her silken voice made even the parking-ticket announcement sound like poetry.

hindi: मधुरभाषी — मीठी बातों से मना लेने वाला
definition: persuasive and charming in speech, able to talk people into almost anything
example: The silver-tongued salesman sold her the extended warranty on a pair of socks.

hindi: वानरवत्‌ — बंदर या वनमानुष जैसा, लंबी भुजाओं और उछल-कूद वाला
definition: like monkeys or great apes in looks, limbs, movement or behaviour
example: He swung from the pull-up bar with simian ease and absolutely no shame about grunting.

hindi: खरा-असली — पूर्णतः प्रामाणिक, मिलावट से रहित
definition: completely genuine and authentic, the real person or thing rather than any impostor
example: The vintage jacket turned out to be simon-pure, label, moths and all.

hindi: धर्म-व्यापार — धार्मिक पद या कृपा को बेचना-खरीदना
definition: the buying or selling of church offices, pardons or sacred favours for money
example: Paying extra to skip the temple queue is simony with a QR code.

hindi: भोला-भाला मूर्ख — सीधा-सादा और कम समझ वाला
definition: a foolish, gullible person of little intelligence, easily confused or deceived
example: The scam email plainly assumed its reader was a simpleton, and one replied.

hindi: अनिश्चित काल के लिए — बिना अगली तारीख तय किए
definition: with no future date fixed for resuming
example: The House was adjourned sine die after ninety minutes of shouting.

hindi: अनिवार्य शर्त — जिसके बिना काम असंभव हो
definition: something absolutely essential, without which the thing cannot exist
example: Trust is the sine qua non of a partnership that survives its first bad quarter.

hindi: बिना श्रम का पद — नाम का पद, काम कुछ नहीं
definition: a paid position requiring little or no actual work, effort or responsibility from its holder
example: His title was Head of Synergy, a sinecure whose main duty was attending lunches.

hindi: अनिष्टसूचक — जिसमें छिपा हुआ अहित जान पड़े
definition: giving the impression that something harmful is quietly at work
example: Nothing about the offer looked sinister until the second page, on the left.

hindi: मोहक विनाशिका — लुभाकर संकट में डालने वाली
definition: something alluring that draws you toward ruin
example: Cheap credit was the siren that sank three of his shops.

hindi: लू — गरम, धूल भरी झुलसाने वाली हवा
definition: scorching, dusty wind blowing from North African deserts across Mediterranean shores
example: The hair-dryer on full blast felt like a personal sirocco aimed at my face.

hindi: अरे तू — छोटे या नीचे व्यक्ति को तिरस्कार भरा संबोधन
definition: archaic: a contemptuous form of address used toward a male person thought lower in rank or younger
example: Fetch me the remote, sirrah, commanded the grandfather, to a grandson of forty.

hindi: निष्फल परिश्रम-भरा — जो कभी पूरा ही न हो
definition: endlessly laborious and doomed to yield nothing
example: Clearing that inbox is Sisyphean; by lunch it has filled again.

hindi: मक्खीचूस — अत्यंत कंजूस आदमी
definition: extremely stingy person who hates spending money on anything or anyone
example: The skinflint brought a discount coupon to his own birthday dinner.

hindi: मुठभेड़ — छोटी और अनियोजित झड़प
definition: brief, minor fight between small groups of soldiers, apart from main battle
example: The siblings fought a brief skirmish over the front seat before breakfast.

hindi: धोखाधड़ी — गुप्त बेईमान चालबाज़ी
definition: underhand scheming trickery and dishonest dealings carried out behind people's backs
example: A little skulduggery with the office thermostat started the great winter feud.

hindi: बदनामी — किसी के बारे में फैलाई गई झूठी, हानिकारक बात
definition: false spoken statements that damage another person's good reputation and public standing unfairly
example: Calling my sourdough 'basically bread' is slander, and I have witnesses.

hindi: अपूर्ण तुक — लगभग मिलती-जुलती ध्वनि वाली तुक
definition: an imperfect rhyme where words share similar but not identical sounds, like 'soul' and 'all'
example: Rhyming "orange" with "door hinge" is a slant rhyme and a cry for attention.

hindi: आलस्य — कर्तव्य से जी चुराने का दोष
definition: sinful laziness; unwillingness to work or exert yourself, a deadly vice
example: Sloth is a strong word for staying on the sofa through three 'next episode' prompts.

hindi: आलस्यपूर्ण — सुस्त और निष्क्रिय, मेहनत से कतराने वाला
definition: deeply lazy and unwilling to work, stir or make any real effort
example: After a slothful Sunday, the only thing he had finished was the snacks.

hindi: देर तक सोने वाला — बिस्तर न छोड़ने वाला आलसी
definition: archaic: a lazy person who keeps sleeping under the covers long after everyone else rises
example: The slugabed claimed he was 'working from bed', which his snoring disputed.

hindi: आलसी व्यक्ति — सुस्त, काम से जी चुराने वाला
definition: a habitually lazy, slow person who avoids work, effort and early mornings
example: The Proverbs tell the sluggard to consider the ant; he considered snoozing the alarm instead.

hindi: थोड़ा-बहुत ज्ञान — किसी विषय की सतही जानकारी
definition: a slight, superficial knowledge of a subject or language, gained from scattered bits of study
example: A smattering of French got him to the café and not one word further.

hindi: प्रहार करना — ज़ोर से मारना
definition: archaic: to strike with a heavy blow, or affect someone suddenly, strongly and deeply
example: One rolled-up magazine smote the wasp, and the picnic resumed in triumph.

hindi: उपनाम — किसी को दिया गया चिढ़ाने या प्यार भरा नाम
definition: a nickname, often humorous or affectionate, given to someone by friends, colleagues or rivals
example: The server earned the sobriquet 'Old Faithful' by crashing at exactly the same hour every day.

hindi: पाप-नगरी — घोर व्यभिचार और भ्रष्टता का स्थान
definition: any place notorious for wickedness, depravity, vice and corruption, deserving divine punishment
example: The hostel's reviews warned of a Sodom and Gomorrah, which turned out to mean karaoke till two.

hindi: सुसज्जित — बेहद सलीके से सँवारा, परिष्कृत
definition: elegantly groomed and polished in appearance, dressed with sophisticated care; French
example: Her soigné look survived a delayed flight, which frankly seems like witchcraft.

hindi: संध्या-गोष्ठी — शाम की सुरुचिपूर्ण सभा या दावत
definition: an elegant evening party or social gathering held in a private home
example: Her book-club soirée featured excellent wine and absolutely no discussion of the book.

hindi: प्रवास — घर से दूर कहीं कुछ समय का ठहराव
definition: a temporary stay somewhere away from home, lasting days, weeks or months
example: Her week-long sojourn at her sister's flat quietly became a four-month residency.

hindi: विधिवत संपन्न करना — किसी अवसर को औपचारिक समारोह से मनाना
definition: to celebrate an important occasion, especially a wedding, with a formal and dignified ceremony
example: They solemnized their vows at the town hall and their friendship at the kebab shop.

hindi: एकजुटता — साझे हित के लिए परस्पर समर्थन
definition: unity and mutual support among people who share interests, aims or struggles
example: In a show of solidarity, the whole team also forgot to submit their timesheets.

hindi: स्वगत भाषण — मंच पर अकेले पात्र का अपने मन की बात बोलना
definition: a speech in a play where a character alone on stage voices private thoughts aloud to the audience
example: Stuck in traffic, she delivered a full soliloquy on the moral failings of the left lane.

hindi: सुलेमानी — अत्यंत बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण और न्यायसंगत (निर्णय)
definition: showing wise, fair judgement in settling hard disputes, like biblical King Solomon
example: Her Solomonic ruling gave one twin the window seat going and the other returning.

hindi: अयनांत — वर्ष का सबसे लंबा या छोटा दिन
definition: either yearly moment when the sun reaches its highest or lowest point, giving the longest or shortest daylight
example: On the winter solstice the sun clocked out at four, and frankly so did I.

hindi: अयनांत-संबंधी — सबसे लंबे या छोटे दिन से जुड़ा
definition: relating to the solstice, those yearly points of longest or shortest daylight when the sun turns
example: The solstitial sunset at Stonehenge draws druids, tourists and one man livestreaming it badly.

hindi: चलकर हल होता है — समस्या टहलने या करके देखने से सुलझती है
definition: a problem gets solved by walking, meaning practical action settles what arguing cannot
example: Stuck on the bug, she invoked solvitur ambulando and found the fix halfway round the block.

hindi: मदिरा-विशेषज्ञ — रेस्तराँ में वाइन सलाहकार
definition: a trained wine expert in a restaurant who advises guests and serves wine
example: The sommelier suggested a pairing; our budget suggested the house red.

hindi: निद्राचारी — नींद में चलने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone who rises and walks around while still deeply asleep; a sleepwalker
example: The somnambulist in flat three reorganised the fridge magnets again last night.

hindi: निद्रालु — उनींदा, नींद से भरा हुआ
definition: sleepy and drowsy, or causing drowsiness, heavy eyelids and a strong urge to doze
example: The somnolent lecture hall gently snored through the professor's third footnote.

hindi: चतुर्दशपदी — चौदह पंक्तियों की नियमबद्ध कविता
definition: a poem of fourteen rhymed lines following a strict pattern, often about love
example: He wrote her a sonnet; she replied with a thumbs-up emoji.

hindi: गंभीर स्वर वाला — गहरी, भरी हुई और गूँजती ध्वनि वाला
definition: having a deep, full, resonant sound that rings richly and fills a large room
example: The sonorous voice of the station announcer made a platform change sound like scripture.

hindi: सत्य — सच्चाई (पुराना प्रयोग)
definition: archaic: truth; the plain reality of matters, surviving mostly in poetic or playful phrases
example: In sooth, nobody has read the terms and conditions.

hindi: भविष्यवक्ता — आने वाली घटनाएँ बताने का दावा करने वाला
definition: a person claiming to foretell coming events, in the manner of an ancient prophet or fortune teller
example: Every market crash produces a fresh crop of soothsayers who saw it coming, in hindsight.

hindi: मुँह बंद करने की घूस — विरोधी को शांत करने का छोटा उपहार
definition: small bribe or concession offered to quiet a troublesome guard or critic
example: The extra vacation day was a sop to Cerberus before announcing the return-to-office policy.

hindi: अधकचरा — अपरिपक्व होकर भी ज्ञानी होने का दिखावा
definition: immature and overconfident, pretending to knowledge while showing childish, shallow judgment
example: His sophomoric essay solved free will in four paragraphs and a meme.

hindi: निद्राकारी — नींद लाने वाला, उबाऊ
definition: tending to bring on sleep, heavy drowsiness or such deep boredom that listeners start nodding
example: The minister's soporific speech outperformed every sleep app on the market.

hindi: धावा — घिरी सेना का शत्रु पर अचानक आक्रमण
definition: sudden attack made by troops rushing outward from a besieged position
example: She made a brave sortie from her desk to raid the office snack drawer.

hindi: पर्ची-शकुन — चिट्ठी या पासे डालकर भविष्य जानना
definition: foretelling future events by drawing lots or casting dice and reading the signs they give
example: Picking the sprint's bug fixes by pulling tickets from a hat is sortilege with extra steps.

hindi: धीमे स्वर में — दबी आवाज़ में, ताकि सब न सुनें
definition: spoken quietly under one's breath, softly so that others barely hear
example: 'This could have been an email,' she muttered sotto voce, just loud enough.

hindi: सरसराना — हवा का पेड़ों में धीमी आह-सी आवाज़ करना
definition: of wind, to make a soft, moaning, rustling sound through trees
example: Wind soughed through the pines while the campers argued about who packed the matches.

hindi: पुट — ज़रा-सा स्पर्श, हल्का-सा अंश
definition: a very small quantity; a slight trace, touch or hint of some flavour or quality
example: The email was polite with just a soupçon of passive aggression.

hindi: सादा और कठोर — सुख-सुविधा से रहित
definition: plain, bare, and stripped of all comfort
example: His flat was spartan: a bed, a lamp, and forty books stacked on the floor.

hindi: भ्रामक — ऊपर से ठीक दिखने वाला पर वस्तुतः गलत
definition: looking sound at first glance but false underneath
example: It is a specious argument: every step is clean except the one that matters.

hindi: फुहार — लहरों से उड़ती महीन जल-बौछार
definition: fine spray blown from crests of waves by strong ocean winds
example: Spindrift from the ferry's bow ruined his hair before the first photo.

hindi: कुंज — पेड़-झाड़ियों का छोटा घना टुकड़ा
definition: a small thick patch of trees and bushes standing among open fields
example: The drone vanished into the spinney, and so did our Saturday afternoon.

hindi: गुरु-गुरु चरण — लगातार दो ज़ोरदार अक्षर
definition: a metrical foot of verse with two stressed syllables placed side by side
example: "Stop. Now." is a spondee, and every toddler parent has mastered it.

hindi: सहज निपुणता — कठिन कौशल को अनायास जैसा दिखाने की कला
definition: studied carelessness; making difficult skill look effortless, natural and unrehearsed
example: Her keynote had real sprezzatura, the kind that takes forty rehearsals to look unrehearsed.

hindi: फेन — लहरों पर उठता झाग
definition: white foam or froth gathered upon breaking waves, blown about by ocean winds
example: A spume of milk foam crowned her latte, and she photographed it like a seascape.

hindi: मिथ्या — नकली, या झूठे संबंध वाला
definition: not genuine, or not really connected to what it claims
example: The correlation is spurious; both lines are just following the weather.

hindi: अंधड़ — अचानक उठा तेज़ झोंका और बौछार
definition: sudden, violent gust of wind, often bringing brief heavy rain or snow
example: A squall flipped every umbrella on the bridge in one synchronised display of betrayal.

hindi: व्यंग्य-चुटकी — छोटा, चुभता हुआ हास्य-लेख
definition: a short, witty piece of satirical writing that mocks someone with quick ridicule
example: Her two-line squib in the newsletter did more damage than the entire quarterly review.

hindi: ज़मींदार साहब — गाँव का प्रमुख भूस्वामी
definition: the chief landowner of an English country district, respected as its local gentleman
example: The village squire now runs a glamping business and describes the sheep as 'content'.

hindi: ज़मींदार तबक़ा — भूस्वामी भद्रजनों का प्रभुत्व
definition: landowning country gentlemen considered as a class, especially holding local political power
example: The parish council remains a squirearchy, only now with a Facebook page.

hindi: खंडित-स्वर — छोटे, अलग-अलग कटे हुए स्वरों वाला
definition: with each musical note played short, sharp and detached from the next; hence abrupt and clipped
example: Her staccato replies — 'Fine.' 'Noted.' 'Sure.' — told him the anniversary had not gone unnoticed.

hindi: संजीदा — सधा हुआ, पुराने ढर्रे का और कुछ नीरस
definition: serious, settled and respectable in habits, avoiding anything lively or daring
example: The staid accounting firm's idea of wild fun is a second biscuit at the Friday meeting.

hindi: अथक श्रमवीर — असाधारण रूप से कठोर परिश्रम करने वाला कर्मी
definition: an exceptionally hardworking, productive worker who greatly exceeds normal output targets
example: The Stakhanovite on our team answered tickets during his own farewell lunch.

hindi: कर्मठ — मज़बूत, भरोसेमंद और निष्ठावान साथी
definition: loyal, reliable and hardworking, firmly supporting a cause through difficult times
example: The stalwart volunteers kept the book club alive long after anyone read the books.

hindi: छंद-खंड — कविता की पंक्तियों का समूह
definition: a grouped set of lines forming one unit within a poem, like a paragraph in prose
example: Every stanza of the team anthem was written by a different committee, and it shows.

hindi: गुप्त न्यायालय — मनमाने, गुप्त और कठोर न्याय वाली संस्था
definition: secretive, harsh court or committee judging people arbitrarily, named after a notorious Tudor English court
example: The promotion panel met behind closed doors like a Star Chamber with pastries.

hindi: अभागे प्रेमी — जिनके प्रेम को नियति ने ठुकराया
definition: thwarted by fate, especially said of lovers whose romance seems doomed from the start
example: The star-crossed couple met on a dating app the week one of them moved to Tasmania.

hindi: पूर्व-निर्णय पालन — पिछले फ़ैसलों पर टिके रहना
definition: the legal principle that courts follow earlier decisions when deciding similar later cases
example: The group chat runs on stare decisis: whoever booked last time books again.

hindi: गतिरोध — ठहराव या आंतरिक कलह की स्थिति
definition: a state of stillness where nothing moves, progresses or changes, often through deadlock or internal strife
example: The project sat in stasis for months, awaiting sign-off from a committee that never met.

hindi: सामाजिक दर्जा — जीवन में किसी का स्थान
definition: a person's social rank or position in society, especially as fixed by birth or fortune
example: Having married above her station, she now pretends to understand polo.

hindi: मूर्तिवत् — ऊँचा, सुडौल और गरिमामय
definition: tall, graceful and dignified in figure, like a beautiful classical statue
example: The statuesque model made the airport security queue look like a runway.

hindi: यथास्थिति — जो व्यवस्था इस समय चली आ रही है
definition: the existing state of affairs, especially when someone wants it kept
example: Every committee says it wants change and then votes for the status quo.

hindi: युद्ध-पूर्व स्थिति — झगड़े से पहले वाली दशा में लौटना
definition: peace terms returning both sides to exactly the position held before the fighting
example: After two hours arguing over the thermostat, it was restored to twenty-one degrees: status quo ante bellum.

hindi: पक्का — दृढ़, वफ़ादार और भरोसेमंद समर्थक
definition: firmly loyal and dependable in supporting a person, cause or belief through every challenge
example: A staunch defender of tabs over spaces, he has left three teams over it.

hindi: अडिग — दृढ़ और अटल रूप से निष्ठावान
definition: firmly loyal and unwavering, refusing to change course or abandon a commitment
example: He remained steadfast in his support for the club through eleven relegation seasons.

hindi: पांडुलिपि-वंशवृक्ष — प्रतियों के आपसी संबंध का चित्र
definition: a family-tree diagram tracing the descent of surviving manuscript copies of a text from one another
example: Tracing which cousin started the family rumour required a stemma worthy of a classics department.

hindi: गरजदार — अत्यंत ऊँची और भारी आवाज़ वाला
definition: extremely loud and powerful in voice
example: A stentorian 'order!' from the chair ended the shouting instantly.

hindi: खरा — उत्कृष्ट और पूरी तरह भरोसेमंद
definition: excellent and thoroughly reliable in character or quality, like genuine silver
example: She did sterling work reconciling the expenses nobody else would touch.

hindi: यथावत रहे — संपादन में हटाया अंश वापस रखें
definition: an editor's instruction meaning leave it standing, restoring text previously marked for deletion
example: The author scrawled stet beside every cut, and the editor quietly reached for more coffee.

hindi: प्रश्नोत्तर-संवाद — एक-एक पंक्ति में तीखा अदल-बदल वाला संवाद
definition: rapid dialogue in Greek drama where characters trade single alternating lines, often in sharp argument
example: The landlord negotiation became pure stichomythia: 'No.' 'Why?' 'Policy.' 'Whose?' 'Mine.'

hindi: कलंक — किसी बात से चिपकी बदनामी
definition: a mark of disgrace attached to a condition or a choice
example: The stigma around therapy fades a little each time someone admits they go.

hindi: आसव-कक्ष — अचार, मुरब्बे और अर्क बनाने का कमरा
definition: a room in a large house where preserves, cordials and home remedies are made and stored
example: Her pantry of homemade kombucha has quietly turned the spare room into a still-room.

hindi: कमी करना — बहुत कम मात्रा में देना या खर्च करना
definition: supply or spend only a meagre amount, holding back from needed generosity
example: The caterer did not stint on the garlic, and the meeting was mercifully brief.

hindi: स्तंभ-वीथी — प्राचीन यूनान का ढका खंभेदार गलियारा
definition: in ancient Greece, a long covered line of columns where citizens walked, traded and argued in public
example: The office kitchen has become our stoa: every product debate happens there, beside the kettle.

hindi: सहनशील — कष्ट को बिना शिकायत सहने वाला
definition: enduring pain, loss or hardship calmly and patiently, without complaining or showing distress
example: He took the news that the flight was delayed six hours with stoical silence and a third coffee.

hindi: दृढ़हृदय — अडिग और साहसी मन वाला
definition: brave and resolute in spirit, keeping courage firm through danger and hardship
example: The stout-hearted hikers pressed on after the trail map blew off the cliff.

hindi: तुरंत — उसी क्षण, बिना रुके
definition: archaic: immediately, without delay, at once, straight after something happens, without pausing
example: The toddler saw the puddle and straightway jumped in, new shoes and all.

hindi: तंगहाल — आर्थिक तंगी से घिरा
definition: restricted by shortage of money, living with less than everyday life requires
example: In straitened times, the family downgraded from takeout to toast.

hindi: कूटनीति — किसी को छलने की सोची-समझी योजना
definition: a cunning plan or trick designed to deceive opponents and gain advantage
example: Her stratagem for winning the thermostat war involved a very convincing fake sensor.

hindi: चेतना-प्रवाह — विचारों का बेरोकटोक बहाव
definition: a literary method presenting the continuous unbroken flow of a character's passing thoughts
example: His voice notes are pure stream of consciousness, starting at groceries and ending at the Roman Empire.

hindi: कटु आलोचना — किसी बात पर लगाया गया कड़ा दोष
definition: severe criticism or censure pointing to faults in someone's work or conduct
example: Her strictures on the slide deck ran longer than the slide deck itself.

hindi: कर्कश — तीखी, कानों को चुभने वाली और आग्रही आवाज़
definition: loud, harsh and grating in sound, often forcefully insistent in tone
example: A strident car alarm harangued the whole street at three in the morning.

hindi: अध्ययनशील — मन लगाकर पढ़ने वाला
definition: spending much time in careful reading and study, devoted to learning knowledge
example: The studious flatmate highlights library books, then apologises to them.

hindi: जड़ बनाना — बुद्धि कुंठित करना या मूर्ख सिद्ध करना
definition: to make someone seem foolish, or dull the mind through tedious, pointless routine
example: Four hours of compliance training stultified even the keenest new hire.

hindi: उथल-पुथल — तीव्र भावावेग और विद्रोह का दौर
definition: a period of turbulent passion, rebellion and upheaval, named after a German literary movement
example: After weeks of Sturm und Drang over the logo, the committee chose the original blue circle.

hindi: घोर अंधकारमय — भयावह काला
definition: utterly dark, and gloomy with it
example: The tunnel lights failed and left us in Stygian dark for twenty minutes.

hindi: अनुनय — दबाव नहीं, समझाकर राज़ी करने की कला
definition: persuasion through reasoning and appeal rather than through force or threats
example: Moral suasion got the flatmates to wash their mugs where a rota had failed.

hindi: सौम्य — मोहक, सहज और शालीन
definition: charming, confident and elegantly polite in manner, often with smooth sophistication
example: His suave apology for the outage almost made customers grateful for it.

hindi: विचाराधीन — अदालत में लंबित, इसलिए सार्वजनिक चर्चा वर्जित
definition: still before a court, and so not to be discussed publicly
example: The anchor kept saying the matter was sub judice, and kept discussing it.

hindi: गुप्त रूप से — चुपचाप, बिना किसी को बताए
definition: in secret, and understood by everyone present to stay that way
example: The merger talks ran sub rosa for four months before anyone leaked them.

hindi: मौन रूप से — बिना कहे, चुपचाप मान लिया गया
definition: passed over silently, done or accepted without any spoken mention
example: The policy was dropped sub silentio, vanishing from the handbook without a memo.

hindi: अधीन करना — बलपूर्वक वश में करना
definition: bring people or lands under complete control through force and conquest
example: The toddler has subjugated the entire household and now issues snack decrees.

hindi: पार्थिव — चंद्रमा के नीचे का, परिवर्तनशील संसार का
definition: literary: belonging to this changing earthly world beneath the moon, where nothing lasts
example: Even the finest sourdough starter is subject to sublunary decay when you forget it for a week.

hindi: बहकाना — किसी को रिश्वत देकर झूठी गवाही या अपराध के लिए उकसाना
definition: bribe or persuade someone into committing perjury or another unlawful deed
example: He tried to suborn the referee with a pizza, which was both illegal and insufficient.

hindi: सम्मन — अदालत में हाज़िर होने का आदेश
definition: a written court order requiring someone to appear as witness or produce documents
example: Getting him to the family reunion took something close to a subpoena.

hindi: अंतर्भूत करना — बड़े वर्ग के भीतर समेट लेना
definition: to include something within a larger category or principle
example: The smaller complaints were subsumed under one heading and quietly forgotten.

hindi: छलावा — बच निकलने की गुप्त चाल
definition: deceitful trickery used to hide something, escape blame or achieve a goal
example: Moving the vegetables under the rice was subterfuge no parent has ever missed.

hindi: सारगर्भित — थोड़े शब्दों में साफ़ और पूरी बात
definition: expressed clearly using minimal words, brief speech that still covers everything
example: The intern's succinct summary replaced a forty-slide deck, and nobody missed the slides.

hindi: रसीला — रस से भरा, कोमल और स्वादिष्ट
definition: tender, juicy and full of flavour, especially describing meat, ripe fruit or fleshy plants
example: The succulent mango dripped straight onto his interview shirt.

hindi: सराहना भरी विफलता — प्रशंसा मिली पर कमाई नहीं
definition: a work praised by critics and experts but with little popular or commercial success
example: The indie app was a succès d'estime: five-star reviews, forty downloads.

hindi: कुख्याति से मिली सफलता — विवाद से लोकप्रिय हुई कृति
definition: a work that becomes popular largely because it causes public scandal and outrage
example: The memoir was a succès de scandale: everyone condemned it, and everyone bought it.

hindi: स्वेदक — पसीना लाने वाली दवा
definition: a medicine that causes heavy sweating, once given to drive fever from the body
example: The office radiator has become a sudorific that nobody prescribed.

hindi: सहनशीलता — अनिच्छा से सहन करना, चुप अनुमति
definition: patient, grudging toleration of something unwelcome, permitted without any real approval or welcome
example: His standing-desk treadmill remains in the office on sufferance, and on nobody's wishlist.

hindi: अपने ढंग का अकेला — जिसकी कोई श्रेणी ही न बने
definition: in a class of its own, resembling nothing else
example: The building is sui generis, and the neighbours have opinions about it.

hindi: स्वाधिकारी — अपने कानूनी अधिकार स्वयं रखने वाला
definition: legally independent and of full capacity, able to manage one's own affairs without guardian
example: Turning eighteen made him sui juris, which mostly meant signing his own phone contract and regretting it.

hindi: प्रणय-प्रार्थी — विवाह या प्रेम हेतु किसी को मनाने वाला
definition: a gentleman seeking a woman's romantic affection, usually hoping she will agree to marriage
example: Her suitors were screened more thoroughly than any job applicant at her firm.

hindi: मलिन करना — किसी के अच्छे नाम को दूषित करना
definition: stain or spoil the purity, honour or good reputation of someone or something
example: One sponsored post was enough to sully years of honest reviews.

hindi: उमसभरा — गरम, भारी और चिपचिपा (मौसम)
definition: oppressively heavy, humid heat; still, sticky summer weather before thunder breaks
example: It was so sultry on the train that strangers bonded purely through shared suffering.

hindi: सर्वोच्च सम्मान सहित — सबसे ऊँची विशिष्टता के साथ उपाधि
definition: with highest honour, marking a university degree earned with the very greatest distinction
example: He graduated summa cum laude, which he mentions roughly once per conversation.

hindi: विलासिता-निषेधक — पद के अनुसार ख़र्च और पहनावे पर रोक
definition: regulating personal spending and dress, especially laws restricting luxury according to social rank
example: The office dress code is sumptuary: only directors may wear trainers.

hindi: शाही — ठाठदार, बहुत महँगा और भरपूर वैभव वाला
definition: splendidly luxurious and costly, like a lavish royal feast or richly decorated grand furnishings
example: The wedding buffet was sumptuous; the Wi-Fi password was the only thing rationed.

hindi: विविध — कई तरह के, फुटकर
definition: various; several different items of mixed kinds, not worth naming separately
example: The kitchen drawer holds batteries, rubber bands and sundry cables for devices long gone.

hindi: अतिप्रचुरता — बहुतायत से भी अधिक
definition: a very great or excessive amount, much more than plentiful or ever needed
example: The garden produced a superabundance of courgettes, and the neighbours stopped answering the door.

hindi: जराजीर्ण — उम्र के कारण सेवा से हटाया गया, पुराना पड़ चुका
definition: retired or discarded because of advanced years, considered much outdated and unfit for further service
example: A superannuated server hums in the closet, hosting a website nobody remembers launching.

hindi: अतिशयता — ज़रूरत से फ़ालतू मात्रा
definition: an excessive amount beyond what is needed; something unnecessary and surplus
example: The superfluity of charging cables in one drawer could power a small town.

hindi: सर्वोत्कृष्ट — अपनी श्रेणी में सबसे उत्तम
definition: of the very highest quality or degree, better than every other of its kind
example: The coffee was superlative; the Wi-Fi, sadly, was merely present.

hindi: दिव्य — स्वर्गिक, ऊपरी लोकों से संबंधित
definition: belonging to the heavens or a higher spiritual realm; celestial, divine and more than earthly
example: The first sip of coffee after a red-eye flight has a supernal quality.

hindi: उत्तान — पीठ के बल लेटा हुआ; निष्क्रिय और अनुगामी
definition: lying flat facing upward; also passive, weak and failing to resist or take action
example: The committee's supine response to the budget cuts was to schedule another committee.

hindi: परिकल्पना — मान ली गई पर अप्रमाणित बात
definition: something assumed true without proof, a guess used as a working basis
example: The whole plan rested on the supposition that the client would read the attachment.

hindi: सर्वोच्च — पद, शक्ति या गुण में सबसे ऊपर
definition: highest in rank, power or quality, above everything else of its kind
example: With supreme confidence he hit reply-all to the entire company.

hindi: अतिरेक — ज़रूरत से कहीं अधिक मात्रा
definition: an excessive amount of something, especially food or drink, leaving people sickened
example: A surfeit of streaming services means an evening spent choosing and none spent watching.

hindi: अनुमान — अधूरे प्रमाण पर लगाया गया अंदाज़ा
definition: a guess about something true, formed without enough evidence to be certain
example: My surmise that the parcel was stolen collapsed when the neighbour waved it at me.

hindi: पोषण — जीवित रखने वाला भोजन
definition: food and drink regarded as the source of strength that keeps someone alive
example: During exam week, cold coffee was his only sustenance and his only personality.

hindi: मर्मर — पत्तों या फुसफुसाहट की धीमी सरसराहट
definition: a soft, gentle whispering or rustling sound, like leaves or voices quietly murmuring
example: A susurrus of gossip moved through the pews as the groom's ex took her seat.

hindi: अधिराज — अधीन राज्यों पर प्रभुत्व रखने वाला सर्वोच्च स्वामी
definition: a feudal overlord, or a state controlling another's foreign affairs while allowing local rule
example: The parent company plays suzerain, letting the startup keep its beanbags but vetoing every hire.

hindi: अधिराजत्व — अधीन राज्य पर ऊपरी प्रभुत्व, भीतरी शासन छोड़कर
definition: overlordship of a dominant state that controls another state's foreign affairs while leaving it internal self-rule
example: The parent company claims mere suzerainty over the startup, yet somehow approves every logo change.

hindi: छरहरा — पतला, सुडौल और सलीकेदार
definition: slender and elegant in figure, graceful, sleek and well proportioned in shape
example: The svelte new laptop weighs less than the charger it ships with.

hindi: वशीकर्ता — दूसरे के मन पर हावी होकर उसे नचाने वाला
definition: someone who controls and manipulates another person, often shaping their talent or career
example: The band's manager played Svengali, choosing their haircuts, lyrics and girlfriends.

hindi: प्रेमी युवक — प्रेयसी का अनुरागी, विशेषकर ग्रामीण
definition: a young male lover or suitor, especially a country youth courting
example: A lovesick swain waited outside the gym with a protein shake as tribute.

hindi: दूब — घनी छोटी घास से ढकी ज़मीन
definition: an expanse of short, thick grass covering open ground like a lawn or meadow
example: The groundskeeper guards that sward like it holds the nation's gold reserves.

hindi: साँवला — गहरे, धूप-सँवलाए रंग वाला
definition: having a dark, sunburnt or naturally deep complexion and darker general colouring
example: The swarthy sailor in the old novel is always hiding either treasure or a secret.

hindi: दिलेर — तलवारबाज़ नायकों जैसा रंगीला और साहसी
definition: bold, dashing and adventurous, like the daring swordsmen of classic pirate stories
example: The swashbuckling founder promised Mars by Thursday and a demo by never.

hindi: सुखभोगी — आराम और विलास का आदी
definition: a person devoted to luxury and pleasure, named after the pampered citizens of ancient Sybaris
example: The sybarite in seat 2A asked whether the lie-flat bed came in memory foam.

hindi: विलासी — सुख-भोग और ऐश-आराम में डूबा हुआ
definition: devoted to luxury and sensual pleasure, self-indulgent in comfort and ease
example: His sybaritic Sunday involved three pillows, a heated blanket and no intention of answering email.

hindi: चापलूस — स्वार्थ के लिए बड़ों की झूठी तारीफ़ करने वाला
definition: a person who flatters powerful people to gain favour or personal advantage
example: Every startup founder eventually discovers which advisors are mentors and which are sycophants.

hindi: परी-सी छरहरी — बेहद पतली और हल्की
definition: slender, light and graceful, like an airy spirit of classical legend
example: Her sylphlike figure somehow survived a fortnight of wedding buffets.

hindi: वन्य — वन से जुड़ा, पेड़ों से भरा और छायादार
definition: belonging to woods and forest, full of trees and leafy shade, pleasantly wooded
example: The listing promised a sylvan retreat, which turned out to mean one birch and zero phone signal.

hindi: गोष्ठी-सहभागी — भोज-सभा में चर्चा करने वाला
definition: a guest taking part in a symposium, drinking and conversing with fellow thinkers
example: By midnight every symposiast at the dinner had a theory about why the startup failed.

hindi: संगोष्ठी — विशेषज्ञों की चर्चा-सभा
definition: a meeting where specialists present and discuss their work
example: The symposium ran late because two professors disagreed politely for an hour.

hindi: अंशांशी लक्षणा — अंश से पूरे का या पूरे से अंश का बोध कराना
definition: naming a single part of something to stand for the whole thing, or the whole thing standing for one part
example: "Nice wheels," the neighbour said, a synecdoche covering the whole car and its forty monthly payments.

hindi: धर्मसभा — चर्च के अधिकारियों की औपचारिक परिषद
definition: a formal assembly of church leaders gathered to decide matters of doctrine and discipline
example: The style-guide review had the gravity of a synod, with three hours spent on the serial comma.

hindi: सारांश — कथा या ग्रंथ का संक्षिप्त विवरण
definition: a brief written summary giving the main points, plot or ideas of a longer text or story
example: The streaming synopsis somehow gave away the ending in twelve words.

hindi: युति-रेखा — तीन आकाशीय पिंडों का एक सीध में आना
definition: the alignment of three heavenly bodies, such as Earth, moon and the solar disc, along one straight line
example: Getting the designer, developer and client free at the same hour was a rare syzygy.

hindi: पवित्र तंबू — ईश्वर-आराधना का पवित्र स्थान या पात्र
definition: a sacred tent or ornate shrine where worshippers believe a holy presence dwells
example: The glass-walled boardroom has become a tabernacle where the quarterly numbers are unveiled.

hindi: निश्चित भोज — तय कीमत पर तय व्यंजन
definition: a restaurant meal of several fixed courses offered at a fixed price
example: The table d'hôte spared us the menu debate and gave us soup we never chose.

hindi: भोजन-चर्चा — खाने की मेज़ पर होने वाली बातचीत
definition: informal conversation around a dining table, especially the remembered sayings of famous people
example: The best ideas at the retreat came from table talk, not from the slides that preceded dinner.

hindi: दृश्य-चित्र — ठहरा हुआ, चित्र जैसा सजा दृश्य
definition: a striking scene, arranged or accidental, that looks like a painted picture
example: Six engineers frozen around one red dashboard made a tableau worthy of a museum wall.

hindi: सजीव झाँकी — जीवित लोगों द्वारा स्थिर होकर रचा चित्र
definition: a silent scene in which costumed people pose motionless to recreate a famous painting
example: The family photo became an accidental tableau vivant of The Last Supper, minus the goodwill.

hindi: कोरी स्लेट — जिस पर अभी कुछ लिखा न गया हो
definition: a blank state carrying nothing written on it yet
example: A new team is never a tabula rasa; everyone arrives with an old grudge.

hindi: मौन — बिना कहे समझा और स्वीकार किया गया
definition: understood and accepted without ever being said aloud
example: There was a tacit agreement that nobody would mention the failed launch.

hindi: मितभाषी — स्वभाव से चुप रहने वाला, कम बोलने वाला
definition: habitually silent and reserved, rarely speaking and saying very little
example: The taciturn contractor spoke four words all week, and three were 'that's gonna cost'.

hindi: व्यवहार-चातुर्य — बिना ठेस पहुँचाए बात कहने की कला
definition: skill in handling delicate situations and speaking without giving offence to others
example: It took tact to tell the founder that the logo looked like a sneezing penguin.

hindi: स्पर्शी — छूने से संबंधित, स्पर्श द्वारा अनुभव होने वाला
definition: relating to the sense of touch, or pleasant and interesting to handle, stroke and feel
example: The tactile keyboard clicked so satisfyingly that he began writing emails nobody needed.

hindi: मूर्त — छूने योग्य, ठोस और वास्तविक
definition: able to be touched and physically felt; real, solid, definite and clearly measurable
example: After six months of strategy decks, the team finally had something tangible to show.

hindi: ललचाना — पास दिखाकर पहुँच से दूर रखना
definition: to tease by keeping something wanted just out of reach
example: The menu tantalized us for an hour before the kitchen admitted it had closed.

hindi: विलंबित — समय से पीछे, देर से आने वाला
definition: arriving or acting later than expected, slow and behind the proper time
example: A tardy thank-you note is still better than the silent one sitting in your drafts.

hindi: पर्वतीय ताल — पहाड़ों के बीच छोटी गहरी झील
definition: a small deep mountain lake, often cold and lying in a rocky hollow
example: Only one of us actually swam in the tarn, and he has not stopped mentioning it.

hindi: ठहरना — रुकना, देर करना, विलंब से जाना
definition: to delay leaving, linger or remain somewhere longer than intended or needed
example: Guests tarried at the door for forty minutes, saying goodbye in instalments.

hindi: पाताल जैसा — नरक के सबसे गहरे अंधकार वाला
definition: belonging to Tartarus, the deepest and darkest chasm of the underworld where eternal punishment waits
example: The server room had a Tartarean heat that no air-conditioning ticket could reach.

hindi: ढोंगी भक्त — धर्म का आडंबर ओढ़े धूर्त
definition: a hypocrite who makes a showy display of religious piety to deceive others
example: The influencer played Tartuffe, preaching minimalism while selling forty-dollar candles.

hindi: फटेहाल — चीथड़ों में लिपटा व्यक्ति
definition: a person dressed in ragged, tattered clothing, shabby and dilapidated in appearance
example: By the end of launch week the whole team looked like tatterdemalions back from a music festival.

hindi: सस्ता-दिखावटी — चमकदार पर घटिया और तुच्छ
definition: showy and glittering, though cheap and poor in quality, taste or moral worth
example: The tawdry gift shop sold the cathedral in snow globes and fridge magnets.

hindi: ईश्वर-स्तुति गान — विजय पर गाया जाने वाला धन्यवाद भजन
definition: an ancient Church hymn praising the Lord, sung to celebrate victory or deliverance
example: When the landlord fixed the heating, the flat sang a small Te Deum.

hindi: तकनीकीतंत्र — विशेषज्ञों और तकनीकविदों का शासन
definition: government by technical experts, chosen for specialist knowledge rather than popular election
example: The apartment society slid into technocracy the moment the engineer figured out the booster pump.

hindi: मद्यत्यागी — शराब से पूर्ण परहेज़ करने वाला
definition: never drinking alcohol at all, keeping total abstinence from liquor as a settled personal rule
example: Being teetotal made her the permanent designated driver and the only reliable witness.

hindi: तार-शैली का — अनावश्यक शब्द हटाकर बेहद संक्षिप्त
definition: extremely brief speech that drops small connecting words, like telegrams once priced word by word
example: Dad's telegraphic texts, 'Arrived. Cold. Food bad.', are a genre of their own.

hindi: दुस्साहस — जोखिम और मर्यादा की परवाह किए बिना की गई ढिठाई
definition: reckless boldness; nerve that ignores the risk or the offence
example: He had the temerity to ask for a raise the week after the outage.

hindi: संयम — भोग और इच्छाओं में आत्म-नियंत्रण
definition: moderation and self-restraint, especially in appetite
example: His idea of temperance was one dessert instead of three.

hindi: संयमी — हर बात में मर्यादित और संतुलित
definition: showing moderation and self-control, avoiding excess in behaviour, speech or appetite
example: Her temperate reply to the angry email was twelve words long and entirely devastating.

hindi: झंझावात — प्रचंड तूफ़ान
definition: violent, raging storm with fierce winds, often bringing heavy rain, hail or thunder
example: A tempest in a teacup, the manager called it, as the teacup emailed the entire company.

hindi: समय बदलता है — और हम भी उसके साथ बदलते हैं
definition: times change, and people change along with them, their habits shifting over passing years
example: Tempora mutantur: the rebel who mocked spreadsheets now colour-codes his holiday itinerary.

hindi: समय टालना — निर्णय से बचने के लिए बात को लटकाए रखना
definition: delay making a decision by stalling and talking, hoping to gain more time
example: The minister temporized for forty minutes and answered nothing, which was itself an answer.

hindi: समय भागता है — काल तेज़ी से बीतता जाता है
definition: time flies, meaning the passing hours and years slip quickly away
example: Tempus fugit: I opened the laptop for one email and it is somehow dusk.

hindi: समर्थनीय — जिसका बचाव किया जा सके
definition: able to be defended against objection
example: After the third contradiction, his position was no longer tenable.

hindi: पक्षपातपूर्ण — एक विशेष मत को चुपके से आगे बढ़ाने वाला
definition: written or argued to promote one particular side, rather than weighing evidence fairly
example: The survey's tendentious questions somehow all ended with "don't you agree the rebrand is brilliant?"

hindi: तमसाच्छन्न — घने अंधकार से भरा
definition: dark, shadowy and gloomy, filled with deep murky darkness where little light reaches
example: The tenebrous basement bar charged extra for the privilege of not seeing the menu.

hindi: त्रिपदी — तीन पंक्तियों का छंद
definition: a stanza or group of three lines of verse, often sharing one rhyme
example: Her haiku-style out-of-office reply was technically a tercet and emotionally a door slam.

hindi: पलटी मारना — बार-बार पक्ष बदलकर बात से मुकरना
definition: to evade clear statements by repeatedly changing sides or shifting your position
example: The candidate tergiversated on the parking policy until both camps felt betrayed.

hindi: कलहप्रिया — चिल्लाने वाली झगड़ालू स्त्री
definition: a quarrelsome, overbearing woman given to loud scolding and constant nagging
example: The sitcom's termagant landlady got all the best lines and none of the sympathy.

hindi: उत्तर-सीमा — जिससे पहले कुछ अवश्य घटित हुआ हो
definition: the latest possible date for an event, document or object under historical study
example: The pottery's terminus ante quem was the volcano, which rarely leaves room for revisions.

hindi: पूर्व-सीमा — जिसके बाद ही कुछ घटित हुआ हो
definition: the earliest possible date for an event, document or object under historical study
example: The receipt in the coat pocket gave a terminus post quem for its last outing: Tuesday's burrito.

hindi: नृत्य-संबंधी — नाचने की कला से जुड़ा
definition: relating to dancing, named after the muse who presided over dance
example: His terpsichorean ambitions at the wedding outpaced his knees.

hindi: ठोस भूमि — पैरों तले की पक्की ज़मीन
definition: solid ground, felt as a relief after sea or air
example: After nine hours of turbulence, terra firma felt like a personal favour.

hindi: अज्ञात क्षेत्र — अनजाना, अनछुआ विषय या इलाका
definition: unknown territory, a place or subject that nobody has yet explored, charted or properly understood
example: For most of the team, the billing code is terra incognita guarded by one retired engineer.

hindi: निर्जन भूमि — किसी की भी न मानी गई धरती
definition: land legally regarded as belonging to nobody and therefore open to claim
example: The last slice of office pizza is terra nullius, and colonisation is swift and merciless.

hindi: भूमि-स्वाद — मिट्टी और जलवायु से उपजा विशिष्ट स्वाद
definition: the particular soil, climate and setting that give wine or food its character
example: The café insists its coffee's terroir tastes of hillside mist; mostly it tastes of coffee.

hindi: संक्षिप्त और रूखा — छोटे, कटे-कटे शब्दों वाला
definition: brief and abrupt speech using minimal words, which often feels slightly unfriendly
example: The landlord's terse text read 'Rent. Today.' and somehow managed to glare.

hindi: त्रिपदी श्रृंखला — एक-दूसरे में गुँथे तुकांत त्रिपद
definition: an Italian verse form of linked three-line stanzas whose rhymes chain forward, used by Dante
example: The reply-all chain grew like terza rima, each message dragging the next one onward.

hindi: चतुश्चरणी छंद — हर पंक्ति में चार चरण
definition: a line of verse built from four metrical feet, common in ballads and nursery rhymes
example: The jingle for the mattress sale bounces along in cheerful tetrameter.

hindi: सागरीय — समुद्रों और खुले महासागर से जुड़ा
definition: relating to seas and open oceans, especially smaller inland waters and gulfs
example: Her thalassic screensaver of rolling waves is the closest the quarterly offsite gets to a beach.

hindi: समुद्राधिपत्य — समुद्र पर प्रभुत्व से चलने वाला राज्य
definition: a state whose power rests on command of seas and naval trade routes
example: With four offshore warehouses, the online bookshop now fancies itself a thalassocracy.

hindi: मृत्यु-प्रवृत्ति — विनाश और मृत्यु की ओर खिंचाव
definition: the instinct or urge toward death, destruction and self-undoing, lurking beneath ordinary behaviour
example: Only some deep thanatos explains checking your work email at midnight on holiday.

hindi: चमत्कार-विद्या — अलौकिक करामात दिखाने की कला
definition: the working of wonders or miracles; magic that seems to bend the ordinary laws of nature
example: Getting the whole family onto one video call without a mute mishap is minor thaumaturgy.

hindi: वहाँ से — उस स्थान या कारण से आगे
definition: archaic: from that place, from there onward; also following from that cause, reason or starting point
example: We flew to Delhi, and thence took a train that was only four hours late.

hindi: तत्पश्चात — उस समय से आगे, तब से
definition: archaic: from that time onward, thereafter; starting at that moment and continuing ever after
example: He burned his tongue on the office coffee and thenceforth brought a flask.

hindi: धर्मतंत्र — धर्मगुरुओं के हाथ में शासन
definition: government by priests or religious authority, claiming divine sanction for its laws
example: The yoga studio has become a small theocracy where questioning the instructor's diet counts as heresy.

hindi: देव-दर्शन — ईश्वर का प्रत्यक्ष प्रकट होना
definition: a visible appearance of a divine being before human eyes, witnessed by ordinary mortals
example: When the elusive CEO walked into the canteen, the interns reacted as if to a theophany.

hindi: तदनंतर — उसके बाद से
definition: after that particular moment, continuing from then onward into later time
example: She fixed the build once, and thereafter was summoned to every broken pipeline in the building.

hindi: उसके द्वारा — इस प्रकार
definition: formal word meaning through that action, and producing that result as consequence
example: She automated the timesheets, thereby saving four hours a week and one fragile friendship.

hindi: उसमें — उसी के भीतर
definition: formal word meaning inside that particular thing, place or matter just mentioned
example: The tax form was simple, and therein lay the suspicion that something was badly wrong.

hindi: उसका — उसी के संबंध में
definition: formal word meaning belonging to, concerning or coming from that thing just mentioned
example: The office promised free snacks, or at least the rumour thereof, which kept morale oddly high.

hindi: तत्पश्चात — उसके तुरंत बाद
definition: immediately after that happened, and often directly because of that very event, remark or decision
example: The CEO praised remote work, and thereupon announced a mandatory five-day office return.

hindi: विषहर महौषध — सब विषों की प्राचीन दवा
definition: an ancient compound medicine of many ingredients, prized as a remedy against poisons and disease
example: His morning smoothie has forty ingredients and the ambitions of a Renaissance theriac.

hindi: अभिनेता — रंगमंच का कलाकार
definition: an actor, especially one on the stage; named after Thespis, the first Greek actor
example: The office has one resident thespian who reads the fire safety notice as if auditioning for Macbeth.

hindi: उधर — उस स्थान की ओर
definition: archaic: to that place, there, away from the speaker; heading towards another distant spot
example: The delivery rider ran hither and thither, following a map pin in the ocean.

hindi: आमूलचूल — हर पहलू में पूरा
definition: carried through completely in every detail; total, thorough, uncompromising and absolute
example: The audit was thoroughgoing enough to find a 2014 expense claim for one stapler.

hindi: दास — किसी के पूर्ण वश में रहने वाला बंधक
definition: a slave or bonded servant in early medieval society; also the condition of being wholly controlled
example: Three episodes in, the whole household was in thrall to a Korean cooking drama.

hindi: विलाप-गीत — मृतक के लिए गाया गया शोक-गीत
definition: a song or poem of mourning, lamenting someone dead with grave, sorrowful words
example: The fans sang a threnody for the relegated club, then booked tickets for next season.

hindi: इस प्रकार — इसलिए, अतः
definition: formal word meaning therefore, as a result, or in this particular manner being described
example: He skipped every standup, thus earning the title of most mysterious team member.

hindi: चाय-नृत्य — दोपहर की चाय के साथ नाच की सभा
definition: a fashionable afternoon gathering combining teatime refreshments with ballroom dancing, popular in earlier decades
example: Grandma insists the community centre's Sunday thé dansant has better music than any club downtown.

hindi: जुताई — जोती हुई मिट्टी और उसकी उपजाऊ दशा
definition: the crumbly cultivated condition of tilled soil, and the labour of ploughing farm land
example: The gardening forum argues about tilth with the passion other forums reserve for politics.

hindi: कालसिद्ध — लंबे समय से आदर के साथ चली आ रही
definition: respected and followed because it has been practised for a very long time
example: We kept the time-honoured tradition of blaming the intern for the broken build.

hindi: उपहार लाते शत्रु से डरो — विरोधी की उदारता पर भरोसा न करो
definition: beware enemies bearing gifts; distrust sudden generosity from rivals who wish you harm
example: When the competitor offered to share their API for free, the CTO simply said timeo Danaos et dona ferentes.

hindi: भयशील — आसानी से डरने वाला, संकोची
definition: nervous and lacking courage, easily frightened and timid about taking risks or facing danger
example: A timorous knock announced the intern who had deleted the shared drive.

hindi: आसव — जड़ी-बूटी का मद्यसार में घोल
definition: a medicine made by dissolving herbs or drugs in alcohol, taken in careful drops
example: She bought a forty-dollar tincture for calm and was stressed about the price by lunch.

hindi: घंटी-नाद — घंटियों की लगातार टनटनाहट
definition: the ringing, tinkling, jingling sound of many bells chiming together, again and again
example: The tintinnabulation of forty bike bells announced that the charity ride had reached the café.

hindi: प्रिय पेय — अक्सर पी जाने वाली शराब
definition: a person's favourite alcoholic drink, usually taken in modest amounts
example: Grandma's tipple is one small sherry, poured with the ceremony of a coronation.

hindi: मद्यसेवी — नियमित रूप से थोड़ी-थोड़ी पीने वाला
definition: a person who habitually drinks alcohol, usually steadily rather than wildly
example: A discreet tippler, she keeps the gin in a bottle labelled 'kombucha'.

hindi: धाराप्रवाह फटकार — क्रोध से भरा लंबा भाषण
definition: a long, angry speech full of harsh criticism and denunciation, delivered without pausing
example: The tirade about the Wi-Fi ended abruptly when the router came back on.

hindi: विराट — आकार, शक्ति या महत्वाकांक्षा में विशाल
definition: enormous in size, force, or ambition
example: It took a titanic effort to get the bridge open before the monsoon.

hindi: दशांश — आय का दसवाँ भाग जो धर्मसंस्था को दिया जाए
definition: one tenth of yearly income or farm produce, given regularly to support the church and its clergy
example: The streaming services now collect a monthly tithe that no one remembers agreeing to.

hindi: बिंदु मात्र — सबसे छोटा अंश
definition: archaic: the smallest particle or amount; a tiny written mark or minor detail
example: The lawyers argued over every jot and tittle of the lease, including the comma.

hindi: जी-हुज़ूरिया — हर बात में हाँ मिलाने वाला चमचा
definition: a servile person who flatters and obeys powerful people to gain favour
example: He was promoted twice for being the manager's toady and once, briefly, for competence.

hindi: संकट-घंटा — ख़तरे की चेतावनी देती घंटी
definition: an alarm bell rung loudly and urgently as a warning signal of approaching danger
example: The smoke detector sounded its tocsin over nothing more sinister than toast.

hindi: शृंगार — सजने-सँवरने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the process of dressing, grooming and arranging one's hair and appearance; also a costume
example: Her morning toilette runs forty minutes, which is why she joins standup with the camera off.

hindi: मसख़री — बेतुकी शरारत और हुड़दंग
definition: foolish, silly behaviour and playful nonsense, especially pranks lacking sense
example: The office tomfoolery peaked with a stapler set in lime jelly.

hindi: ज़ायकेदार — स्वादिष्ट, मन ललचाने वाला
definition: temptingly tasty and pleasant to chew; also, less often, attractive and appealing to look upon
example: The toothsome brownies at the bake sale disappeared before anyone read the price tag.

hindi: पियक्कड़ — आदतन भारी शराब पीने वाला
definition: a person who habitually drinks alcohol heavily, often over many years
example: The old toper greets each new craft-beer bar as a missionary greets a village.

hindi: वृक्षशिल्प — झाड़ियों को काटकर आकृतियाँ बनाने की कला
definition: the craft of clipping shrubs and hedges into ornamental shapes, animals or geometric figures
example: The hotel's topiary peacock has survived four managers and one very ambitious leaf blower.

hindi: रूढ़ विषय — साहित्य में बार-बार आने वाला प्रसंग
definition: a traditional theme or stock motif that recurs throughout literature
example: The chosen one raised by relatives is a topos that fantasy writers never tire of.

hindi: उलटा-पुलटा — सिर के बल, पूरी तरह अस्त-व्यस्त
definition: turned upside down, or thrown into complete disorder and confusion where nothing sits properly
example: Daylight saving time leaves the whole household topsy-turvy for a week.

hindi: जड़ता — शारीरिक या मानसिक सुस्ती और शिथिलता
definition: a heavy state of sluggish inactivity, lacking energy for body or mind
example: Thanksgiving dinner ended, as tradition demands, in a collective torpor on the sofa.

hindi: सर्वसत्तावादी — जीवन के हर पहलू पर राज्य का नियंत्रण
definition: describing a centralised government demanding complete obedience and controlling every aspect of public and private life
example: The housing society's parking rules have grown frankly totalitarian, down to the colour of the bicycle covers.

hindi: मान गए — सामने वाले की चतुर बात की स्वीकृति
definition: used to admit that another person just made a clever, telling point against your argument
example: "You complain about meetings in a meeting you called." "Touché."

hindi: सिंहावलोकन — किसी विषय का व्यापक सर्वेक्षण
definition: a broad general survey or review of a subject covering every major point briefly
example: The keynote offered a tour d'horizon of the industry, pausing only to promote the company's own product.

hindi: अद्भुत कौशल-प्रदर्शन — असाधारण दक्षता की कृति
definition: a brilliant, masterly performance or piece of work showing exceptional skill
example: Her one-take closing argument was a tour de force; opposing counsel simply clapped.

hindi: बस इतना ही — बिना किसी जोड़ या विशेषण के
definition: stated simply and briefly, without adding further words, description, qualification or explanation
example: He isn't a great chef or a good chef; he is a chef, tout court, and microwaves count.

hindi: कलंकित करना — झूठ फैलाकर किसी का अपमान करना
definition: speak falsely and maliciously about another person, spreading lies to damage their good reputation
example: The anonymous account traduced the mayor daily, never once getting the facts right.

hindi: त्रासदी-अभिनेता — दुखांत नाटकों का अभिनेता या लेखक
definition: an actor who specialises in tragic roles, or a writer of tragic stage drama
example: My cat is a born tragedian, collapsing in anguish whenever breakfast arrives ninety seconds late.

hindi: दुखांत-सुखांत नाटक — दुख और हास्य का मिश्रित नाटक
definition: a drama blending tragic and comic elements, mixing serious suffering with humour
example: The house move was a tragicomedy: the sofa jammed in the stairwell and everyone laughed until it rained.

hindi: लोकोत्तर — सामान्य सीमाओं से परे
definition: going beyond ordinary limits; surpassing all normal experience or excellence
example: The first sip of coffee after a red-eye flight is a transcendent experience.

hindi: पार्श्व-भुजा — क्रूसाकार गिरजे की आड़ी भुजा
definition: either wing of a cross-shaped church, crossing the long central nave at right angles
example: We lost Grandma in the north transept and found her in the gift shop, as foretold.

hindi: उल्लंघन — नैतिक या कानूनी सीमा तोड़ना
definition: a breach of moral principles, duty or rules; a sinful wrongdoing against others
example: Replying to a work email on holiday is a transgression against the out-of-office.

hindi: ऋतु-प्रवास — मौसम के साथ पशुओं समेत चरागाह बदलना
definition: the seasonal movement of herders and livestock between summer mountain pastures and winter lowlands
example: Our snowbird neighbours practise transhumance: Florida in winter, the lake house in summer.

hindi: अस्थायी — थोड़ी देर ठहरकर चला जाने वाला
definition: staying only briefly in one place or state before passing onward, never settling permanently
example: The bug was transient, which is engineering for 'it vanished the moment someone watched'.

hindi: नश्वर — जो टिकता नहीं, बीत जाता है
definition: belonging to passing time, lasting briefly and never becoming permanent or settled in place
example: Viral fame is transitory; the embarrassing username is forever.

hindi: रूप बिगाड़कर बदलना — अजीब या मज़ाकिया ढंग से कायापलट करना
definition: to change something completely, often in a strange, grotesque or comic manner
example: The renovation transmogrified a cosy bungalow into a beige showroom nobody dares sit in.

hindi: रूपांतरण — एक वस्तु का दूसरी में बदल जाना
definition: the complete changing of one thing into another different substance, nature or form altogether
example: Through some strange transmutation, 'quick sync' became a ninety-minute meeting.

hindi: आडंबर-सामग्री — पद या सफलता के बाहरी चिह्न और साज़-सामान
definition: outward ornaments, dress and accessories that signal status, office or worldly success
example: He had all the trappings of a unicorn founder, the vest, the podcast and the standing desk, except revenue.

hindi: पार करना — किसी क्षेत्र के आर-पार यात्रा करना
definition: travel across or through a region, crossing its whole breadth from one side to the other
example: We traversed the entire airport terminal only to learn the gate had moved back.

hindi: विडंबन — गंभीर चीज़ की बेहूदा, विकृत नक़ल
definition: a grotesque imitation that mocks a serious work or subject by treating it absurdly
example: The office karaoke rendition of the national anthem was a travesty that HR is still reviewing.

hindi: शीरेदार — गाढ़ा चिपचिपा मीठा, अति-भावुक
definition: thickly sweet like syrup, or sentimental to such an excessive degree that it becomes sickly
example: The treacly anniversary post had more hashtags than genuine feeling.

hindi: तीक्ष्ण — धारदार, सीधे मर्म पर चोट करने वाला
definition: incisive and forceful criticism that cuts straight through vague or muddled thinking
example: One trenchant comment in code review killed a fortnight of scope creep.

hindi: भोजनवीर — जमकर खाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a hearty eater who clears every plate with steady, cheerful appetite
example: The office trencherman treats leftover catering as a sacred duty.

hindi: कपाल-छेदन करना — खोपड़ी में छेद करना
definition: to bore a small hole in the skull, an ancient surgery to relieve pressure
example: After the fourth all-hands meeting he wanted someone to trepan the headache out.

hindi: न्यायाधिकरण — विशेष मामलों पर निर्णय देने वाली अदालत या समिति
definition: court or official body appointed to judge particular disputes or claims
example: The family tribunal of grandmothers ruled that the wedding would have biryani.

hindi: त्रिपद रचना — तीन समान रूप वाले वाक्यांशों की श्रृंखला
definition: a series of three parallel words, phrases or clauses, often rising in force
example: "Faster, cheaper, better," promised the startup, a tricolon that quietly skipped "working."

hindi: तमाशबीन क्रांतिकारिणी — फाँसी देखते हुए बुनाई करने वाली
definition: a woman who knitted while watching executions during the French Revolution; a bloodthirsty spectator
example: She watched the performance review from the back row like a tricoteuse, needles clicking.

hindi: त्रिपट — तीन जुड़े फलकों वाली कलाकृति
definition: an artwork made of three hinged or matching panels displayed together side by side
example: His three monitors, all showing error logs, formed a triptych of modern despair.

hindi: विजयोत्सव — बड़ी जीत और उसका उल्लास
definition: a great victory, or the public elation that follows one
example: He called the merger a triumph and paraded it through three press conferences.

hindi: विजयोत्सवी — विजय के सम्मान और उत्सव से जुड़ा
definition: made or performed to celebrate a victory, like a grand parade, procession or stone arch
example: He made a triumphal entrance into the office carrying the fixed wifi router.

hindi: गुरु-लघु चरण — पहले ज़ोरदार, फिर हल्का अक्षर
definition: a metrical foot of verse with one stressed syllable followed by one unstressed syllable
example: "Monday" is a trochee: one heavy blow, then a long sigh.

hindi: अथक परिश्रमी — अदम्य साहस से जुटा रहने वाला
definition: a person of tireless energy, courage and endurance who works extremely hard
example: She worked like a Trojan all night to get the launch deck ready.

hindi: छद्म उपहार — भीतर छिपे आक्रमण वाला
definition: a gift or disguise that carries a hidden attack inside
example: The free plugin was a Trojan horse and shipped a keylogger with it.

hindi: दृष्टिभ्रम चित्र — ऐसा चित्र जो असली वस्तु होने का धोखा दे
definition: painting realistic enough to trick viewers into believing they perceive real, solid objects
example: The café's trompe l'oeil bookshelf has fooled three customers into reaching for a paperback.

hindi: वचन — निष्ठा की पक्की प्रतिज्ञा
definition: archaic: a faithful pledge of loyalty, especially the solemn promise made at marriage
example: They plighted their troth at the registry office, then argued about parking.

hindi: प्रेमगायक कवि — दरबारी प्रेम के गीत रचने-गाने वाला मध्यकालीन कवि
definition: a medieval poet-singer of southern France who composed lyric songs of courtly love
example: He arrived at the anniversary dinner with a ukulele, a troubadour armed with exactly three chords.

hindi: वधू-साज — विवाह हेतु दुल्हन के वस्त्र और घरेलू सामान
definition: the clothes, linen and household belongings a bride gathers before starting married life
example: Her trousseau was mostly hoodies, which she felt was honest about the marriage.

hindi: उत्तरी चारण — उत्तरी फ़्रांस का मध्यकालीन गीतकार कवि
definition: a medieval poet-singer of northern France who composed lyric songs and narrative poems
example: My uncle composes birthday verses for every relative, a suburban trouvère with a rhyming dictionary app.

hindi: घुटने टेकना — ताक़तवर के आगे दीनता से झुकना
definition: submit weakly and servilely to powerful people, abandoning your own judgement just to please them
example: The board truckled to the largest shareholder and called it strategic alignment.

hindi: उग्र — तीखे और लड़ाकू स्वभाव वाला
definition: aggressively defiant and eager to fight, with a surly, sullen and openly threatening manner
example: The truculent toddler negotiated bedtime like a union boss facing layoffs.

hindi: दिखावटी कचरा — चमकीला पर बेकार धोखा
definition: showy but worthless things or deceptive nonsense meant to impress and mislead
example: The launch party was all trumpery: confetti, a countdown, and no product.

hindi: गुप्त मिलन — प्रेमियों की तय की हुई मुलाक़ात
definition: a private romantic meeting arranged between lovers, often secretly
example: Their lunchtime tryst at the stationery cupboard was the worst-kept secret in accounts.

hindi: कोलाहल — भीड़ का शोर और उथल-पुथल
definition: loud noisy uproar and confusion, especially from a large excited crowd
example: The tumult in the stadium was so loud the referee resorted to interpretive dance.

hindi: समाधि-टीला — क़ब्र के ऊपर बना मिट्टी का प्राचीन टीला
definition: an ancient burial mound of earth and stones raised high over a grave or tomb
example: The pile of unread newspapers by the door had grown into a small tumulus.

hindi: गंदला — मैला, धुंधला और उलझा हुआ
definition: cloudy and muddy from stirred sediment, or confused and unclear in thought
example: The turbid prose of the terms and conditions guarantees nobody reads them.

hindi: बोझिल और फूला हुआ — भारी शब्दों से दबा लेखन
definition: swollen with pompous, complicated language that makes writing heavy and tedious
example: The turgid policy document used "operationalise" nine times on a single page.

hindi: दलबदलू — अपना पक्ष छोड़ विरोधी से जा मिलने वाला
definition: a person who deserts their party, cause or friends and switches over to join the opposing side
example: He moved from Android to iPhone and the family group chat branded him a turncoat.

hindi: नैतिक पतन — घोर अनैतिक और नीच आचरण
definition: depravity; conduct that is basely immoral
example: The visa was refused on grounds of moral turpitude.

hindi: भावगुच्छ — संदेश छिपाए फूलों का नन्हा गुच्छा
definition: a small posy of flowers and herbs chosen so each bloom carries a symbolic message
example: Her tussie-mussie said friendship; the attached text message said something far more complicated.

hindi: नौसिखिया — किसी काम को सीखने वाला अनाड़ी
definition: a beginner or novice just starting to learn a subject, craft or skill, still making clumsy mistakes
example: The tyro golfer hit a flawless drive, straight into the car park.

hindi: आमने-सामने की निजी बातचीत — दो लोगों की एकांत वार्ता
definition: a private, intimate conversation between a pair of people, away from everyone else
example: Their quick tête-à-tête by the printer somehow lasted through two print jobs and a lunch break.

hindi: वे कहाँ गए — बीते लोगों और दिनों पर शोक का काव्य-भाव
definition: literary: a lament asking where vanished people and glories have gone, mourning passing time
example: His speech at the reunion became an ubi sunt for dial-up modems and mixtapes.

hindi: फ़रमान — मनमाना, अधिकारपूर्ण आदेश
definition: originally a Russian imperial order; now any arbitrary command issued by authority
example: Head office issued a ukase that every slide must use the new font by Monday, no exceptions.

hindi: राजाओं का अंतिम तर्क — कूटनीति विफल होने पर सैन्य बल
definition: the final argument of kings; military force used when diplomacy and persuasion have failed
example: When the group chat failed to settle the holiday destination, Dad invoked ultima ratio regum and booked Goa.

hindi: सुदूरतम सीमा — ज्ञात संसार का आख़िरी छोर
definition: the farthest known place, a distant limit or remote goal beyond ordinary reach
example: Inbox zero remains my ultima Thule, glimpsed once in 2019.

hindi: अधिकार-क्षेत्र से बाहर — कानूनी शक्ति की सीमा लाँघकर किया गया
definition: beyond the legal power of the person or body acting
example: The court struck the order down as ultra vires the parent statute.

hindi: उलूध्वनि करना — जीभ हिलाकर ऊँची, लहराती आवाज़ निकालना
definition: to howl or wail with a long, high, trilling sound, grieving or celebrating
example: The aunties ululated when the couple finally cut the cake, drowning out the DJ.

hindi: छायादार — घने पेड़ों की छाया से भरा
definition: giving plenty of shade, darkened by spreading trees and leafy branches overhead
example: We picked the umbrageous table on the terrace, then complained we couldn't see the menu.

hindi: स्वाभाविक — दिखावे और बनावट से मुक्त
definition: natural and sincere in manner, free from pretence, vanity or artificial airs
example: Her unaffected laugh made the stiff networking event feel almost human.

hindi: विशुद्ध — बिना किसी मिलावट के
definition: complete, total and pure, never mixed with anything that would spoil or weaken it
example: Friday at five brings a pleasure unalloyed by any thought of Monday.

hindi: सर्वसम्मति — सबकी एक राय
definition: complete agreement among everyone involved, without a single dissenting voice or objection
example: There was rare unanimity in the office: the new coffee machine is terrible.

hindi: अभेद्य — जिस पर कोई आपत्ति या आक्रमण टिक न सके
definition: so strong and convincing that no argument, criticism or attack could possibly weaken it
example: Her spreadsheet made an unassailable case for pizza, and the salad faction quietly withdrew.

hindi: निरभिमानी — बिना दिखावे के, सरल और विनम्र
definition: modest and quiet, not showing off or claiming importance despite real ability
example: The unassuming man in the corner turned out to own the restaurant.

hindi: मन खोलना — अपने भीतर की बातें किसी से कह देना
definition: to disclose openly one's private thoughts, secrets or feelings to someone trusted
example: On the long train ride, he unbosomed his entire fantasy-football strategy.

hindi: गोलाक्षर लिपि — प्राचीन पांडुलिपियों के बड़े गोल अक्षर
definition: a rounded script of large capital letters used in Greek and Latin manuscripts of late antiquity
example: The craft brewery's label uses faux uncial lettering, so the pale ale looks as if monks brewed it.

hindi: कुरूप — देखने में भद्दा, असुंदर
definition: unattractive and unpleasant to look upon, plainly lacking grace or beauty of form
example: The uncomely concrete car park won an architecture prize, to everyone's confusion.

hindi: गँवार — असभ्य, अशिष्ट और भद्दा
definition: lacking good manners, refinement or polish, and therefore rough and impolite
example: Eating crisps loudly into the microphone struck the panel as uncouth.

hindi: चिकनी-चुपड़ी बातों वाला — बनावटी मिठास से भरा
definition: excessively smooth, flattering and ingratiating in manner, with false, oily charm toward people
example: The unctuous car salesman called everyone 'my friend' until the finance paperwork.

hindi: अविचलित — बाधा या खतरे से न घबराने वाला
definition: still brave and determined, not discouraged or frightened by danger, difficulty or failure
example: Undaunted by forty rejections, she sent her novel out a forty-first time.

hindi: पारलौकिक — जो इस धरती का न लगे
definition: seeming beyond earthly things, strange and heavenly or eerie in its otherness
example: An unearthly glow from the server room turned out to be one forgotten gaming laptop.

hindi: असंदिग्ध — एकदम स्पष्ट, जिसमें दो अर्थ न हों
definition: stated plainly and clearly, leaving absolutely no doubt or double meaning
example: The toddler's refusal of broccoli was unequivocal and airborne.

hindi: अकृत्रिम, सच्चा — जो दिखावटी न होकर हृदय से हो
definition: genuine and heartily sincere, never pretended, faked or merely performed for outward appearances
example: His delight at the free pizza was entirely unfeigned.

hindi: निडर — बिना हिचके या पीछे हटे
definition: facing danger or unpleasant truths firmly, without hesitating, shrinking or looking away
example: His unflinching look at the quarterly numbers lasted exactly until the second chart.

hindi: अधर्मी; असमय — ईश्वर-विरोधी; अत्यंत अनुचित समय
definition: sinful and wicked, defying religion; informally, outrageously unreasonable, especially of early hours
example: The flight left at an ungodly hour, which the airline described as convenient.

hindi: अनुलेपन — चिकना औषधीय मरहम
definition: a soft greasy ointment rubbed into skin to soothe, heal or perfume
example: The skincare brand calls its twelve-dollar lip balm an unguent and charges twenty-eight.

hindi: अपवित्र — जो पवित्र न किया गया हो; अधर्मी
definition: not made holy or consecrated; hence wicked, unholy or shockingly unreasonable
example: The unhallowed hour of 4 a.m. is when the smoke alarm chooses to chirp.

hindi: निर्विवाद — जिस पर संदेह या आरोप न लगाया जा सके
definition: so honest and reliable that nobody could reasonably doubt or accuse it
example: His sources were unimpeachable; his spelling, sadly, was not.

hindi: अस्त-व्यस्त — बिना सँवारे, बिखरे बालों वाला
definition: untidy and uncared for in appearance, especially hair left uncombed and messy
example: After the fourth all-nighter, the coder's unkempt hair had developed its own weather.

hindi: निरक्षर — पढ़ाई-लिखाई और पुस्तकीय ज्ञान से रहित
definition: lacking formal education and book learning, poorly read or unable to read well
example: He calls himself unlettered, yet quotes the terms of service from memory.

hindi: निरा — बिना किसी कमी के, पूरा का पूरा
definition: complete, total and absolute, without any softening, used mostly of something awful
example: The office potluck was an unmitigated disaster of seven pasta salads.

hindi: अरुचिकर — स्वाद या विचार में अप्रिय
definition: unpleasant to taste or swallow; also difficult for people to accept, believe or agree with
