example: The canteen soup was unpalatable, but not as unpalatable as the restructuring news.

hindi: अविक्षुब्ध — परेशानी से बेअसर और शांत
definition: staying calm and steady, not worried or shaken by trouble or alarming news
example: Unperturbed by the red dashboard, she finished her sandwich and then fixed the cache.

hindi: अनाकर्षक — पहली नज़र में फीका, साधारण
definition: plain or unattractive in appearance, making little good first impression upon anyone
example: The unprepossessing dhaba by the highway serves the best dal in the district.

hindi: अशोभनीय — अनुचित और भद्दा लगने वाला
definition: improper and unbecoming, behaving in ways that offend accepted standards of good taste
example: There was an unseemly scramble for the last slice when the office pizza landed.

hindi: भद्दा — आँखों को खटकने वाला
definition: ugly and unpleasant to look upon, spoiling an otherwise pleasing scene or view
example: The unsightly tangle of cables behind the television is the household's real load-bearing wall.

hindi: अकृत्रिम — बिना पूर्व-अभ्यास के, सहज रूप से स्वाभाविक
definition: natural and spontaneous rather than rehearsed, contrived or deliberately arranged for effect
example: His unstudied charm lasted until we found the pitch rehearsal on his phone.

hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठ — जिसे आज तक कोई पार न कर सका
definition: never bettered or exceeded by anyone; better than every other example recorded before
example: His record of unanswered emails remains unsurpassed.

hindi: असामयिक — समय से पहले या ग़लत घड़ी में
definition: happening early or at a poor, awkward time, arriving just when it is unwelcome
example: The untimely death of my laptop battery came mid-sentence in the job interview.

hindi: अशिक्षित — जिसे कभी विधिवत सिखाया न गया हो
definition: never taught or trained, lacking formal education and the knowledge that teaching brings
example: To my untutored palate, the fourteen-dollar coffee tastes like the four-dollar one.

hindi: निरलंकृत — बिना सजावट या लीपापोती के, जैसा है वैसा
definition: stated plainly and honestly, without polish or softening that would disguise hard truths
example: The unvarnished feedback: the logo looks like a sad potato.

hindi: कोसना — किसी को ऊँचे स्वर में खरी-खोटी सुनाना
definition: scold someone severely and at great length for their fault, neglect or wrongdoing
example: She upbraided the delivery driver, only to find the parcel behind her own plant pot.

hindi: सम्मान्य — समाज में ईमानदार और आदरणीय माना जाने वाला
definition: honest, respectable and decent, the kind of person whose principles neighbours openly trust
example: An upstanding member of the group chat, she never once muted the family thread.

hindi: अहंकारी नवोदित — अचानक ऊपर उठकर बड़ों को चुनौती देने वाला
definition: a person who has suddenly risen in status or importance and behaves arrogantly toward established superiors
example: The upstart app mocked the bank in its adverts, then asked the bank for a loan.

hindi: नागर — सुसंस्कृत, सहज और शिष्ट
definition: smoothly polite, cultured and confident, especially in elegant social company
example: The urbane host made even the argument about pineapple on pizza sound like a salon debate.

hindi: नगर और विश्व को — पोप का सर्वव्यापी संदेश
definition: to the city and the world; a solemn papal blessing addressed from Rome to everyone everywhere
example: He announced his promotion urbi et orbi, meaning every group chat he belongs to.

hindi: पाखंडी चाटुकार — झूठी विनम्रता में छिपा कुटिल षड्यंत्री
definition: Dickens's fawning, scheming clerk, hence a hypocrite whose false humility masks villainy
example: He calls himself 'just a humble servant of the team' with all the sincerity of Uriah Heep.

hindi: ऋक्षवत्‌ — भालू जैसा भारी-भरकम, बालों वाला और बलशाली
definition: like bears; large, shaggy, heavy, lumbering and gruffly powerful
example: Her ursine brother-in-law gives hugs that audibly rearrange your spine.

hindi: अनधिकार हड़पने वाला — ज़बरदस्ती सत्ता छीनने वाला
definition: someone who seizes a throne or power wrongfully, without legal right
example: The younger brother, a shameless usurper, claimed the window seat before anyone had even boarded.

hindi: अधिकतम — जितना हो सके उतना
definition: of the greatest possible degree, extent or amount; the furthest limit reachable
example: Treat this with the utmost urgency, wrote the man who had sat on it for a month.

hindi: निपट — पूरा, पूर्णतः
definition: complete and total, absolute in degree, without any limit or qualification whatsoever
example: The launch was utter chaos, which marketing described as buzz.

hindi: चरमतम — सबसे दूर, सबसे अंतिम छोर का
definition: the most distant or extreme, lying at the very furthest limit of possibility
example: The parcel reached the uttermost corner of the map, then marked itself 'attempted'.

hindi: पत्नी-भक्त — पत्नी पर अत्यधिक, दब्बू ढंग से समर्पित
definition: excessively fond of one's wife, often submissively devoted to her wishes
example: The uxorious CEO rescheduled the board meeting because his wife preferred Tuesdays.

hindi: दुविधा में झूलना — दो विकल्पों के बीच बार-बार डोलना
definition: to waver repeatedly between different opinions or actions, unable to decide
example: He vacillated between pizza and sushi for so long that the kitchen closed.

hindi: विचारशून्य — बुद्धि और भाव दोनों से खाली
definition: empty of thought, intelligence or meaning; showing a blank, mindless lack of ideas
example: The influencer delivered a vacuous monologue about living your truth to a ring light.

hindi: सहचर पुस्तिका — हमेशा साथ रखी जाने वाली मार्गदर्शिका
definition: a handbook carried everywhere, a ready guide consulted constantly for practical help
example: The recipe app is my vade mecum, though the smoke alarm disagrees.

hindi: पराजितों पर हाय — हारे हुए को विजेता की शर्तें माननी पड़ती हैं
definition: misery belongs to the conquered; defeated enemies must accept whatever harsh terms the victors demand
example: The losing fantasy-league team now buys everyone lunch for a year, vae victis.

hindi: खानाबदोश — बेफ़िक्र घुमक्कड़ जिसका कोई ठिकाना नहीं
definition: a carefree wanderer who drifts from place to place without home, plans or steady work
example: He calls himself a vagabond, though his vagabonding runs strictly on air miles and lounge access.

hindi: सनक — अप्रत्याशित और बेतुका बदलाव
definition: an unexpected, unpredictable change in situation, weather or behaviour, often strange and hard to explain
example: The vagaries of the printer mean every urgent document emerges only after a ritual reboot.

hindi: आवारा — बिना घर-बार के भटकने वाला
definition: a person without a settled home or regular work who wanders from place to place
example: The office cat, once a vagrant, now has a desk, a badge and a Slack handle.

hindi: मिथ्याभिमान — अपने कार्यों पर व्यर्थ घमंड
definition: excessive, boastful pride in your own achievements; empty vanity that craves applause
example: The vainglory of a LinkedIn post about 'humbly' winning an award is hard to top.

hindi: रोगभ्रमी — अपनी सेहत की हर छोटी बात पर सदा चिंतित रहने वाला
definition: a person constantly anxious about their health, always fussing over minor ailments and remedies
example: The office valetudinarian keeps three hand sanitisers, a humidifier and a strong opinion about the air conditioning.

hindi: वीरलोक — वीरों का स्वर्ग जहाँ सम्मान मिले
definition: a heavenly hall of honour where fallen heroes feast, or any place of glory
example: Retired arcade machines go to a Valhalla somewhere near the seaside pier.

hindi: पराक्रमी — संकट में साहस दिखाने वाला
definition: showing great courage and bravery when facing danger, especially in battle
example: The valorous intern volunteered to tell the CEO the demo was broken.

hindi: शौर्य — युद्ध या संकट में वीरता
definition: great courage and bravery shown when facing danger, especially in battle
example: Replying-all to correct the director's figures was an act of rare valour.

hindi: नश्वरता-चित्र — जीवन की क्षणभंगुरता याद दिलाने वाली चित्रकला
definition: a still-life painting showing skulls, candles or fading flowers as reminders that earthly life passes
example: Her fridge, with its wilting lettuce and expired yoghurt, had become an accidental vanitas.

hindi: व्यर्थों में व्यर्थ — सांसारिक दौड़ और वैभव सब नश्वर है
definition: vanity of vanities; all worldly striving, glory and possessions are empty and pass swiftly away
example: He polished his LinkedIn headline for an hour, then remembered vanitas vanitatum and closed the laptop.

hindi: पराजित करना — शत्रु को पूरी तरह परास्त करना
definition: defeat an enemy or rival thoroughly and decisively, leaving them beaten in battle or contest
example: She vanquished the flat-pack wardrobe with only two screws left over.

hindi: निस्सार — बेजान, फीका और खोखला
definition: flat and flavourless like a stale drink; hence dull, empty of ideas and lacking spirit
example: The vapid keynote, like the flat cola beside it, had lost all its fizz by noon.

hindi: उन्माद-दौरा — घबराहट और मूर्च्छा का दौरा
definition: archaic: a sudden attack of fainting, nervous weakness or hysteria once blamed on bodily fumes
example: When the server went down on launch day, the product manager had a fit of the vapours.

hindi: बहुवर्णी — अलग-अलग रंगों के धब्बों वाला
definition: marked with irregular patches, streaks or stripes of several different colours
example: His variegated tie drew more attention than his variegated excuses.

hindi: सटीक संस्करण — अनेक विद्वानों की टिप्पणियों सहित ग्रंथ
definition: an edition of a text printing the notes of many scholars and all variant readings
example: The group project's shared document has become a variorum of everybody's tracked changes and nobody's decisions.

hindi: दुष्ट सेवक — नीच, बदमाश व्यक्ति
definition: archaic: a dishonest, worthless rogue or scoundrel; originally meaning a servant, page or attendant
example: Some varlet has changed the office Wi-Fi password and told no one.

hindi: जागीरदार — बड़े स्वामी के अधीन, उसके प्रति निष्ठावान
definition: a person or state holding land under a stronger overlord, owing loyalty and service in return
example: Every regional office behaves like a loyal vassal the week before headquarters sets budgets.

hindi: भविष्यदर्शी — कवि या ऋषि जैसी भविष्यवाणी करने वाला
definition: prophetic and inspired, speaking like a seer or poet foretelling future events
example: After two espressos the intern turned vatic about the future of spreadsheets.

hindi: भविष्य बाँचना — भविष्यवक्ता की तरह गंभीर घोषणा करना
definition: to foretell future events in the solemn manner of a prophet, often with grand certainty
example: Pundits vaticinate about the election every night and quietly forget their forecasts every morning.

hindi: निष्क्रिय पड़े रहना — बिना उद्देश्य के सुस्त जीवन
definition: to live a dull, inactive life with little mental or physical activity or purpose
example: After exams, he plans to vegetate in front of three seasons of a cooking show.

hindi: चर्मपत्र — बछड़े की खाल से बना लेखन-पत्र
definition: fine parchment made from calfskin, used for manuscripts and important documents
example: The wedding invitations came on vellum, the RSVP by text message.

hindi: बिकाऊ — रिश्वत लेकर कुछ भी करने वाला
definition: willing to take bribes; corrupt and ready to sell loyalty or favour for money
example: The venal inspector found the kitchen spotless the moment an envelope appeared.

hindi: घूसखोरी — रिश्वत के लिए बिक जाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: willingness to be bribed; being for sale where one should not be
example: The venality of the licensing office was an open secret and a fixed price.

hindi: प्रतिशोध-वैर — पीढ़ियों तक चलने वाला बदले का झगड़ा
definition: a long bitter feud with repeated acts of revenge between families or groups
example: His vendetta against the self-checkout machine began with one unexpected item in the bagging area.

hindi: पूजनीय — आयु, ज्ञान या परंपरा के कारण आदरणीय
definition: deserving deep respect because of great years, wisdom or distinguished history
example: The venerable family recipe turns out to be printed on the back of a soup can.

hindi: आया, देखा, जीता — तुरंत और पूर्ण विजय का गर्व
definition: Caesar's boast, 'came, saw, conquered'; used to crow about a swift, complete and effortless victory
example: He fixed the printer in forty seconds and walked out muttering veni vidi vici.

hindi: क्षम्य — मामूली और माफ़ करने योग्य
definition: forgivable; describing a minor fault or wrongdoing, pardonable rather than grave or deadly
example: Forgetting to mute on a call is venial; forgetting to switch off the camera is not.

hindi: साहसिक — जोखिम उठाने को तत्पर
definition: willing to take risks and attempt daring, uncertain things with boldness
example: A venturesome diner ordered the chef's mystery special without asking a question.

hindi: सत्यनिष्ठ — सच बोलने वाला, सत्य पर आधारित
definition: habitually truthful and honest; speaking truth, or giving accurate, faithful accounts
example: A veracious witness admitted he was mostly watching his phone.

hindi: सत्यवादिता — सच बोलने की आदत, कथन की सच्चाई
definition: habitual truthfulness, or the accuracy of a statement
example: Nobody doubted his sincerity; the veracity of his numbers was another matter.

hindi: शब्दशः — ठीक उन्हीं शब्दों में, बिना बदलाव
definition: word for word, repeating exactly the original words spoken or written
example: She read his text aloud verbatim, typos and all.

hindi: शब्दाडंबर — अर्थहीन शब्दों का ढेर
definition: excessive words that add length but little meaning to writing or speech
example: Strip the verbiage from the mission statement and what remains is "we sell shoes".

hindi: शब्दबहुल — कम बात के लिए ढेर सारे शब्द
definition: using more words than needed, making writing or speech long and wordy
example: The verbose error message ran three paragraphs and never said what had broken.

hindi: समझदार को इशारा काफ़ी — ज़्यादा कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: brief hint meaning a word to the wise suffices, so further explanation seems unnecessary
example: Finance reviews expense reports on Monday, and the karaoke receipt is still in there; verbum sap.

hindi: हरा-भरा — घनी हरी घास और पौधों से ढका हुआ
definition: green with thick, healthy grass and plants growing richly everywhere
example: The verdant lawn in the brochure was, on arrival, verdant only in the brochure.

hindi: हरियाली — ताज़ी हरी घास-पत्तियों का फैलाव
definition: fresh green grass, plants and leaves growing richly across the land
example: After one rainy week the balcony pots burst into a verdure she takes full credit for.

hindi: यथार्थ — वास्तविकता से मेल खाता हुआ, सत्य
definition: truthful and accurate; corresponding faithfully to reality exactly as events actually happened
example: The dashcam gave a veridical account that contradicted both drivers.

hindi: सचमुच — निश्चय ही, सत्य कहता हूँ
definition: archaic: truly, certainly; used to insist solemnly that something stated is true
example: Verily, the office fridge holds a yoghurt older than the intern.

hindi: वास्तविक — सचमुच, पूरे अर्थ में वही
definition: truly deserving the name given; genuine, real and fully worthy of the description
example: The group chat became a veritable flood of cat photographs.

hindi: सत्य — कोई शाश्वत, मूलभूत सच्चाई
definition: truth, especially a fundamental and lasting truth that holds firm over time
example: It is an eternal verity that the printer jams the morning of the deadline.

hindi: क्षुद्र जंतु — चूहे-कीड़े जैसे हानिकारक जीव; घृणित लोग
definition: small harmful animals such as rats and lice; figuratively, loathsome despised people
example: The landlord treated tenants' complaints as vermin to be exterminated, not answered.

hindi: कृमिग्रस्त — कीड़े-चूहों से भरा; गंदा और घृणित
definition: infested with rats, lice or other vermin; filthy, loathsome and disgusting
example: The festival portaloos had reached a verminous state well before the headliner.

hindi: वासंतिक — वसंत ऋतु से जुड़ा, नई कोंपलों वाला
definition: belonging to spring, the fresh season when blossoms return and days lengthen
example: The first vernal sunshine and the whole office suddenly remembers the rooftop terrace exists.

hindi: कला-प्रदर्शनी उद्घाटन — प्रदर्शनी का निजी प्रारंभिक दर्शन
definition: a private viewing or opening reception held before an exhibition opens to the public
example: The vernissage served warm wine, tiny cheese and forty opinions per square metre.

hindi: पद्यकार — कविता गढ़ने वाला, पर प्रायः सामान्य कवि
definition: someone who turns ideas into rhyme and metre with skill but little genuine poetic inspiration
example: Every office has a versifier who turns the quarterly targets into rhyming couplets.

hindi: वाम पृष्ठ — खुली पुस्तक का बायाँ पन्ना
definition: the left-hand page of an open book, which is the back side of a printed leaf
example: Nobody reads the verso of a restaurant menu, which is exactly where the service charge hides.

hindi: ओज — बोलने या करने में जोश और जीवंतता
definition: lively energy, spirit and zest shown in speech, writing or performance
example: He delivered the quarterly numbers with such verve that nobody noticed they were down.

hindi: सायंकालीन — शाम के समय होने या खिलने वाला
definition: relating to evening; happening, appearing or blooming during the evening twilight hours
example: My vespertine burst of motivation arrives daily at nine, precisely when it is useless.

hindi: पवित्र-निष्कलंक — शुद्ध, सतीत्वमय और अछूता
definition: chaste, pure and virginal, like the priestesses who tended Rome's sacred flame
example: Her vestal white sneakers lasted exactly one monsoon afternoon.

hindi: प्रवेश-कक्ष — बाहरी द्वार और भीतरी भवन के बीच का छोटा कक्ष
definition: a small entrance hall or lobby between the outer door and the interior of a building
example: The listing calls the flat's vestibule a room; physics calls it a doormat.

hindi: अवशेष — बीती चीज़ का बचा हुआ छोटा निशान
definition: a small remaining trace or fragment of something that once existed but has faded
example: The single remaining fax cover sheet is a vestige of the firm's analogue past.

hindi: अवशेषी — पहले उपयोगी, अब बचा हुआ पर निष्क्रिय
definition: remaining as a small leftover trace of something once useful but purposeless today
example: The Save icon, a floppy disk, is a vestigial symbol nobody under twenty recognises.

hindi: धर्मवस्त्र — पूजा-अनुष्ठान में पुरोहितों के पहने औपचारिक वस्त्र
definition: ceremonial robes and garments worn by clergy or officials during religious services and rituals
example: The CEO wears the grey hoodie to every keynote like priestly vestments, and nobody dares suggest a blazer.

hindi: वसन — वस्त्र, आवरण
definition: archaic: clothing or garments; anything that covers and wraps something like dress
example: The new phone arrives in a vesture of three boxes, two sleeves and a sheet of tissue paper.

hindi: मध्यम मार्ग — दो अतियों के बीच का रास्ता
definition: a sensible middle path that avoids both extremes between two opposing positions
example: Hybrid work became the via media between those who love offices and those who love pyjamas.

hindi: व्यंजन — परोसे गए खाने के पदार्थ
definition: items of food, especially choice dishes served at a formal table
example: The wedding buffet promised rare viands and delivered paneer in three identical gravies.

hindi: पाथेय — यात्रा के लिए दी गई रसद या धन
definition: provisions, supplies or travel money given to someone setting out on a journey
example: Mum's viaticum for the road trip: forty sandwiches and a laminated map.

hindi: पादरी-आवास — गिरजे के पादरी का घर
definition: the house a church provides for its vicar, the parish priest, and family to live in
example: Our quiz team is called Murder at the Vicarage, and we have never once won anything.

hindi: और इसके उलट भी — दोनों पक्ष बदल कर भी वही बात
definition: with the two things just mentioned swapped around
example: Designers should sit with support for a week, and vice versa.

hindi: राजप्रतिनिधि — राजा की ओर से उपनिवेश पर शासन करने वाला
definition: a governor ruling a colony or province on behalf of the distant monarch, carrying royal authority
example: With the founder abroad, the COO strutted about the office like a viceroy with borrowed crown jewels.

hindi: उतार-चढ़ाव — भाग्य या परिस्थिति का अचानक बदलना
definition: an unwelcome change of fortune or circumstance, especially among life's rising and falling fortunes
example: Among the vicissitudes of startup life, the free snacks disappear first.

hindi: रसद — खाने-पीने का सामान
definition: food and provisions, especially supplies gathered and packed for eating during a long journey
example: We packed victuals for a four-hour drive and finished them before the motorway.

hindi: नामतः — यानी, विशेष रूप से ये
definition: namely, introducing the precise items or details that clarify a general statement
example: Three suspects remain, videlicet the cat, the toddler and me.

hindi: पुराने ढर्रे का — चलन से बाहर हो चुका
definition: unfashionable and outdated, belonging to habits the stylish world abandoned many years before
example: Sending a fax is now so vieux jeu that it has become ironically fashionable again.

hindi: लघु-चित्र — छोटा, सजीव दृश्य या प्रसंग
definition: a brief, evocative sketch or scene that captures a moment, person or mood
example: Her newsletter opens with a vignette about her cat before getting to the quarterly numbers.

hindi: खलनायक ठहराना — कटु शब्दों में किसी की निंदा करना
definition: speak or write about another person in harshly abusive, insulting and disparaging terms, painting them villainous
example: The tabloids vilified the goalkeeper for a single fumble in the ninetieth minute.

hindi: खलनायक — कहानी या घटना का दुष्ट पात्र
definition: the character or person whose wrongdoing drives the trouble
example: Every founder's story needs a villain, and it is never the man telling the story.

hindi: द्विटेक आवर्ती कविता — उन्नीस पंक्तियों की कविता जिसमें दो पंक्तियाँ बार-बार लौटती हैं
definition: a nineteen-line poem using only two rhymes, with two lines repeating throughout
example: The toddler's bedtime protest has the structure of a villanelle: two lines, repeated until you break.

hindi: बंधुआ किसान — स्वामी की ज़मीन से बँधा मध्यकालीन खेतिहर
definition: a medieval peasant legally bound to a lord's manor, farming land in return for labour
example: The unpaid intern had the working conditions of a villein and the LinkedIn title of Visionary.

hindi: साधारण मदिरा — रोज़मर्रा की सस्ती वाइन
definition: cheap, everyday table wine drunk with meals rather than savoured
example: The label said grand reserve, but everyone at the party knew it was vin ordinaire.

hindi: सही सिद्ध करना — संदेह या आरोप के बाद निर्दोष या उचित साबित करना
definition: clear someone of blame or suspicion by proving they were right from the beginning
example: The outage vindicated the engineer who had warned about the single server for three quarters.

hindi: कलानिपुण — अपनी कला में असाधारण कुशल व्यक्ति
definition: a performer or artist with dazzling technical skill and mastery of their craft
example: A spreadsheet virtuoso, she can make a pivot table weep.

hindi: सद्गुणी — नैतिक रूप से अच्छा और सदाचारी
definition: having high moral standards, behaving in a morally good and honest way
example: Feeling virtuous after one salad, he ordered the double dessert.

hindi: उग्र — अत्यंत तीव्र और घातक (रोग)
definition: of a disease: extremely severe, harmful and spreading quickly through the body
example: A virulent stomach bug took out half the wedding party before the speeches.

hindi: प्रकृति की उपचार-शक्ति — शरीर का स्वयं ठीक होना
definition: the healing power of nature, the body's own tendency to recover without medicine
example: Most colds are cured by vis medicatrix naturae and a week of streaming shows.

hindi: के संबंध में — की तुलना में
definition: borrowed French phrase meaning regarding, concerning, or compared with something else
example: Our coffee spending vis-à-vis our training budget tells you everything about company priorities.

hindi: मुखमंडल — चेहरा, मुखाकृति
definition: a person's face, especially regarding its expression, shape, form and features
example: His stern visage on the company website hides a man who owns eleven cats.

hindi: श्यान — गाढ़ा और चिपचिपा, धीरे बहने वाला
definition: thick and sticky, flowing slowly and heavily like honey, glue or motor grease
example: The viscous office coffee could have held a spoon upright.

hindi: दूषित करना — गुण या वैधता को बिगाड़ देना
definition: to spoil, corrupt or weaken something, destroying its value or legal force
example: One undisclosed conflict of interest vitiated the entire tender.

hindi: द्राक्षाकृषि — अंगूर की बेलों की खेती
definition: the science and craft of cultivating grapevines, especially grapes grown for making wine
example: After two wine tastings he speaks of viticulture as if he personally pruned Burgundy.

hindi: गाली-गलौज — क्रोध भरी तीखी फटकार
definition: bitter, abusive and insulting speech full of angry, harsh condemnation
example: The referee walked off to a chorus of vituperation from both sets of fans.

hindi: गालीभरा — कठोर, अपमानजनक भाषा वाला
definition: bitterly abusive and insulting in speech or writing, full of harsh condemnation
example: His vituperative review of the restaurant ran longer than the menu.

hindi: मौखिक — लिखकर नहीं, बोलकर; मौखिक परीक्षा
definition: by living voice, spoken aloud rather than written, especially an oral examination
example: The thesis looked fine; the viva voce revealed he had not read it.

hindi: मुखर — ऊँची आवाज़ में ज़ोरदार विरोध या माँग करता
definition: expressing opinions loudly and forcefully, shouting demands with vehement, noisy insistence
example: The group chat's most vociferous member had not, it emerged, read the article.

hindi: स्वीकृत जोखिम पर क्षति नहीं — स्वेच्छा से जोखिम लेने वाले का दावा नहीं
definition: the legal principle that someone who willingly accepts a known risk cannot later claim injury
example: He signed the trampoline park waiver, so volenti non fit injuria met him at the emergency desk.

hindi: मोड़ — चतुर्दशपदी में विचार या स्वर का अचानक बदलाव
definition: the turn in a sonnet where the argument, mood or thought shifts direction
example: The review praised the product for eight lines, then came the volta: "However, it caught fire."

hindi: पूर्ण पलटाव — अपनी राय या नीति को एकदम उलट देना
definition: a complete sudden reversal of opinion, policy or position, turning entirely around to face opposite
example: The company's volte-face on remote work arrived the week after the new office lease was signed.

hindi: धाराप्रवाह बोलने वाला — बिना रुके तेज़ी से बातें करने वाला
definition: talking fluently, quickly and constantly, with words flowing easily and without pause
example: Voluble on every subject at dinner, he went strangely quiet when the bill arrived.

hindi: विपुलकाय — बहुत बड़े आयतन या विस्तार वाला
definition: very large in volume or amount; filling or holding much space
example: His voluminous hoodie could shelter a small family during a storm.

hindi: विलासप्रिय — इंद्रिय-सुख को ही जीवन मानने वाला
definition: a person devoted to luxury and sensual pleasure above everything else
example: A committed voluptuary, he books spa days the way others book dentist appointments.

hindi: बुभुक्षु — भारी भूख वाला, जो कभी तृप्त न हो
definition: having a huge, eager appetite for food or for something like books and ideas
example: A voracious reader, she finishes the free sample and buys the whole series before breakfast.

hindi: उपासक — किसी देवता या आदर्श का व्रती भक्त
definition: a person bound by religious vows; hence a devoted, lifelong follower or enthusiast of some pursuit
example: A lifelong votary of the crossword, she treats Sunday's puzzle as sacred scripture.

hindi: मन्नत का — प्रतिज्ञा या मन्नत पूरी करने हेतु अर्पित
definition: offered or dedicated in fulfilment of a solemn promise, prayer or religious pledge made to heaven
example: A votive candle burned beside the server rack, just in case the backups failed.

hindi: कृपापूर्वक देना — अनुग्रह करके प्रदान करना
definition: archaic: to grant, give or reveal graciously, often as a favour from someone superior
example: The landlord at last vouchsafed a reply, three weeks and one flood later.

hindi: जनमत — आम लोगों की सामूहिक आवाज़
definition: the opinion of ordinary people taken as a whole
example: Polling is an attempt to hear the vox populi without leaving the office.

hindi: अशिष्ट धनवान — पैसा बहुत, सलीक़ा नहीं
definition: a person, often wealthy, whose tastes and manners are crude, showy and lacking refinement
example: Only a vulgarian gold-plates the doorbell and then rings it to impress the guests.

hindi: शृगालवत्‌ — लोमड़ी जैसा चालाक, धूर्त और फुर्तीला
definition: like foxes; crafty, cunning, sneaky and quick to spot advantage
example: The recruiter's vulpine smile widened when you mentioned your current salary.

hindi: गृध्रवत्‌ — गिद्ध जैसा दूसरों की विपत्ति पर मँडराने वाला
definition: like vultures; greedily circling and feeding upon the misfortune of others
example: Vulturine resellers bought the whole concert allocation in six seconds flat.

hindi: काष्ठ-आवरण — दीवार के निचले भाग की लकड़ी की पट्टी
definition: wooden panelling lining the lower part of the inside walls of a room in a house
example: The renovation uncovered original oak wainscot and one very surprised family of mice.

hindi: ख़याली पुलाव वाला — वीरता के दिवास्वप्न देखने वाला साधारण व्यक्ति
definition: an ordinary, timid person who escapes into grand heroic daydreams of adventure
example: In meetings he is a Walter Mitty, silently piloting fighter jets behind the spreadsheet.

hindi: म्लान — पीला, कमज़ोर और थका-सा
definition: pale and weak in appearance, looking sickly, faded or worn from strain
example: She gave a wan smile when the meeting was extended for another hour.

hindi: देशाटन की लालसा — दूर-दूर घूमने की तीव्र इच्छा
definition: a strong desire to travel widely and wander through distant places
example: Two hours of airline booking sites cured his wanderlust faster than any mortgage could.

hindi: क्षीण होना — धीरे-धीरे घटते जाना
definition: to decrease gradually in strength, size, power or importance after first reaching its fullest height
example: Interest in the company book club waned after the second 900-page novel.

hindi: जादूगर — काले जादू का साधक पुरुष
definition: a male practitioner of witchcraft and black magic; a sorcerer, wizard or conjurer of spirits
example: The database admin, warlock of the midnight migration, answers no questions before noon.

hindi: युद्धोन्मादी — युद्ध भड़काने वाला
definition: someone who eagerly stirs up hostile feelings and pushes nations toward open warfare
example: The office warmonger forwarded the passive-aggressive email to the entire department, twice.

hindi: पर्व-पान — त्योहार की मसालेदार मदिरा और उसकी मस्ती
definition: spiced festive Christmas drink, and the merry drinking and toasting surrounding it
example: The office party's wassail was mostly cranberry juice and optimism.

hindi: उड़ाऊ निकम्मा — समय और धन गँवाने वाला आलसी
definition: a lazy, idle person who wastes time, money and every good opportunity given
example: The wastrel nephew's only investment was a premium subscription to every streaming service.

hindi: पथिक — पैदल लंबा सफ़र करने वाला यात्री
definition: a traveller, especially one journeying on foot along roads and country paths
example: The café by the trailhead serves wayfarers flat whites at summit prices.

hindi: स्वेच्छाचारी — अपनी मनमानी राह चलने वाला
definition: following its own changeable impulses and whims, stubbornly hard to control, guide or predict
example: A wayward shopping cart drifted across the car park with more ambition than its owner.

hindi: हवा-मुर्ग़ा — हर हवा के साथ राय बदलने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who changes opinion easily and often, turning around with every prevailing wind of fashion
example: The committee's weathercock agreed with whichever speaker had just finished talking.

hindi: समझना — मन में मानना या सोचना
definition: archaic: to think or suppose something likely, holding it quietly as a private belief
example: I ween the landlord will fix the heating sometime after spring arrives.

hindi: गगन — आसमान, आकाश का गुंबद
definition: archaic: the sky, heavens, vault overhead; phrases like 'make the welkin ring' mean shouting loudly
example: The stadium made the welkin ring when the referee finally checked the monitor.

hindi: सुसंस्कारी — अच्छी परवरिश और शिष्ट आचरण वाला
definition: having good manners and refined behaviour learned through careful upbringing
example: The well-bred guest pretended not to notice the host's cat eating the canapés.

hindi: ढेर-भँवर — उलझी चीज़ों का उमड़ता हुआ अंबार
definition: a large confused churning mass of things, like waves tossing in turmoil
example: She returned from vacation to a welter of unread emails and passive-aggressive reminders.

hindi: राह पकड़ना — धीरे-धीरे, घूमते हुए मंज़िल की ओर बढ़ना
definition: proceed slowly and indirectly toward a destination, following a winding route
example: Guests wended their way to the buffet with the solemn focus of pilgrims.

hindi: कहाँ से — किस स्थान या स्रोत से
definition: archaic: from which place or source something comes, originates, arises or first began
example: Nobody could say whence the mystery cake in the office kitchen had come.

hindi: जबकि — इसके विपरीत
definition: formal word setting both statements side by side in contrast, meaning while instead, or considering that
example: He budgets every penny, whereas his flatmate treats payday like a national holiday.

hindi: जिसके द्वारा — जिस उपाय से
definition: formal word meaning through which method, arrangement or means something happens
example: They devised a system whereby whoever breaks the build buys the whole team lunch.

hindi: क्यों — किस कारण से, किस लिए
definition: archaic: for what reason; famously asks the reason something happens rather than where
example: Wherefore does the printer jam only when the deadline is five minutes away?

hindi: जिसमें — जिस बात या स्थान में
definition: formal word meaning inside which, or within which particular matter, place or respect
example: The contract contains a clause wherein the client owns every idea you have, including dreams.

hindi: जिसका — जिसके विषय में
definition: formal word meaning about which, concerning which, or belonging to which thing, especially knowledge
example: He lectured on cryptocurrency, a subject whereof he knew exactly one podcast episode.

hindi: जिस पर — जिसके ऊपर
definition: archaic: upon which particular thing, surface or ground, referring back to something just named
example: The standing desk whereon his laptop rests has not been raised since purchase.

hindi: जिसके उपरांत — जिसके ठीक बाद
definition: immediately after which, and often directly because of which, something else then followed
example: He replied-all with the salary spreadsheet, whereupon the entire company went strangely quiet.

hindi: साधन — आवश्यक धन या संसाधन
definition: the money, means, tools or resources needed to actually accomplish something one wants
example: I have the ambition for a sports car, just not the wherewithal.

hindi: पूर्वकालीन — किसी समय रहा, अब नहीं
definition: archaic: former, once having been something in times long past
example: The whilom king of the karaoke bar now just hums along from the back booth.

hindi: जबकि — जिस समय
definition: chiefly British and literary form of 'while', meaning during that time or although
example: She answered emails whilst pretending to listen, a skill perfected across three reorganisations.

hindi: रँगी हुई कब्र — बाहर से पवित्र, भीतर से भ्रष्ट व्यक्ति
definition: a hypocrite whose respectable, virtuous surface hides inner corruption and moral decay
example: The startup's glossy ethics page turned out to be a whited sepulchre with a cookie banner.

hindi: किधर — किस स्थान की ओर
definition: archaic: to which place, where to; also asking where something is heading, what future awaits
example: Whither the startup, now that its only customer has left?

hindi: ग़रीब का दान — छोटी पर सच्ची भेंट
definition: small gift from someone poor, worth more than larger gifts because it costs them dearly
example: Her ten-dollar donation was a widow's mite beside the billionaire's tax-deductible wing.

hindi: विधवा-वेश — शोक में पहने जाने वाले काले वस्त्र
definition: black mourning clothes traditionally worn by a widow after her husband's death
example: She wore widow's weeds for a week after her favourite show was cancelled.

hindi: छल-कपट — मोहक धूर्त चाल
definition: a cunning trick or charming deceit used to persuade or manipulate someone
example: The puppy used every wile it knew to extract a second breakfast.

hindi: बेंत-सा छरहरा — लंबा, पतला और लचीला
definition: tall, slender and graceful in figure, like a bending willow tree
example: The willowy intern could change every ceiling bulb without the stepladder.

hindi: चालाक — छल भरी चतुराई वाला
definition: skilled at cunning deceit, crafty schemes and clever tricks used to gain advantage
example: The wily landlord scheduled inspections exactly when tenants were at work.

hindi: पवनाभिमुख — जिस ओर से हवा आती है, उस तरफ़ का
definition: facing toward the oncoming wind, on the exposed, unsheltered side of a ship or island
example: The windward end of the patio is where umbrellas go to die.

hindi: मनमोहक — भोलेपन से भरा आकर्षक रूप
definition: attractive and appealing in an innocent, charming manner that quickly wins people over
example: His winsome grin got him out of three parking tickets and one performance review.

hindi: ज्ञानबघारू — जो हर बात में अपनी होशियारी झाड़े
definition: a person who pretends to know everything and annoys others with smug cleverness
example: Every road trip has one wiseacre explaining the map to the person holding it.

hindi: साथ ही — इसके अलावा, फिर भी
definition: archaic: besides, in addition, nevertheless; along with everything else already said or mentioned
example: The hotel was cramped and noisy, withal charming in its crumbling way.

hindi: बुद्धिहीन — जिसमें अक्ल का नामोनिशान न हो
definition: foolish and lacking sense or intelligence; empty of wits and sound thought
example: The witless prank ended with the fire brigade and a very long email.

hindi: झुर्रीदार — उम्र से सूखा और सिकुड़ा हुआ
definition: shrivelled, thin and deeply wrinkled in face and body through advanced years or long dryness
example: The wizened barista has seen every milk alternative come and go.

hindi: ऊँचा मैदान — खुली, बिना पेड़ वाली ऊँची भूमि
definition: a stretch of high, open, gently rolling countryside, almost treeless and lacking hedges
example: The cycling club promised a gentle ride across the wold, a phrase now banned from the group chat.

hindi: स्वभाव — आदत, रोज़ की रीति
definition: formal: someone's customary habit or usual practice, as in the familiar phrase as is their wont
example: As is her wont, she arrived with snacks and no idea what the meeting was about.

hindi: मनोभ्रमण — बेमतलब ख़यालों में खोया रहना
definition: idle daydreaming, letting drifting thoughts wander aimlessly instead of attending
example: Ten minutes of woolgathering at the window and the kettle had boiled, cooled and boiled again.

hindi: प्रेतछाया — किसी व्यक्ति का धुँधला भूत
definition: a ghost or ghostly spirit of a person, often seen as a pale shadowy figure
example: After the all-night release he drifted through the office like a wraith in a hoodie.

hindi: बाल-प्रतिभा — बहुत कम उम्र में असाधारण सफलता पाने वाला
definition: a young person who achieves outstanding success or skill remarkably early in life
example: The Wunderkind founder was twenty-two, brilliant and unable to book his own dentist appointment.

hindi: अतिथि-धर्म — अतिथि और आतिथेय का पवित्र संबंध
definition: the sacred duty of generous hospitality between guests and their hosts
example: Xenia demands that the friend on your sofa gets the good pillow and the wifi password.

hindi: हाँ — निश्चय ही, बल्कि इससे भी अधिक
definition: archaic: indeed, truly, certainly; also introducing a stronger statement, meaning and even more than that
example: The pitch was good, yea, good enough that the investors forgot to ask about revenue.

hindi: स्वतंत्र किसान — अपनी ज़मीन जोतने वाला मेहनती
definition: historically a farmer who owned and worked modest farmland himself, ranking below the gentry; hence a diligent worker
example: She did yeoman work on the spreadsheet while everyone else debated fonts.

hindi: वहाँ दूर — उस दूर स्थान पर, सामने
definition: archaic: over there, at that distant place still within sight; also describing that faraway thing
example: The last free parking space lies yonder, beside a sign saying reserved.

hindi: पुराकाल — बहुत पहले का बीता ज़माना
definition: archaic: times long past, usually remembered fondly in the phrase days of yore
example: In days of yore, meaning 2011, we burned playlists onto actual discs.

hindi: गदराया हुआ — भरे-पूरे, सुडौल शरीर वाला
definition: pleasingly plump and full-figured, especially describing a curvy woman; from Yiddish
example: The zaftig heroine of the new sitcom has finally retired the salad-eating jokes.

hindi: कट्टर — अपने धर्म या मत का उग्र, अंध समर्थक
definition: a fanatical and uncompromising follower of a religion, political cause or belief, intolerant of doubters
example: The keto zealot at table four has already inspected everyone's bread basket.

hindi: शिरोबिंदु — उन्नति का सबसे ऊँचा बिंदु
definition: the highest point reached by something, the peak of power, fame or success
example: At the zenith of his fame he had a verified badge and three ring lights.

hindi: मलयानिल — पश्चिम से चलती मंद, सुखद बयार
definition: gentle, mild breeze, especially from western skies, named after Zephyrus, Greek west wind
example: A zephyr drifted through the open window and carried my unsaved notes across the café.

hindi: युग्मक अलंकार — एक ही क्रिया को दो भिन्न अर्थों वाले शब्दों से जोड़ना
definition: using a single word, usually a verb, to govern a pair of other words in different senses
example: She lost her keys, her patience and, by lunchtime, her faith in smart locks — a zeugma with a locksmith's invoice.

hindi: सोपान-मंदिर — प्राचीन मेसोपोटामिया का सीढ़ीदार मीनार-मंदिर
definition: a stepped temple tower of ancient Mesopotamia, rising in receding terraces toward a shrine
example: The unread books on my nightstand have grown into a ziggurat that could support its own priesthood.

hindi: पशुरूपी — पशु के आकार या रूप वाला
definition: having the shape or form of animals, especially in painting, sculpture, pottery or design
example: The zoomorphic teapot poured through a trunk, which was cute until it dribbled.

hindi: बाप रे — आश्चर्य या क्रोध की कसम
definition: archaic: a mild oath expressing sudden surprise, anger or indignation, shortened from God's wounds
example: Zounds, the electricity bill has more digits than my salary.

hindi: युगल रूप में — केवल दो लोगों के बीच
definition: for or between a pair of people only, often implying intimacy, romance or privacy away from others
example: Dinner à deux was the plan until his phone joined them for every course.

hindi: अलग-अलग मूल्य — हर व्यंजन की अलग कीमत पर
definition: ordered as separate dishes from a restaurant menu, each item priced individually rather than bundled
example: Ordering à la carte seemed thrifty until the side dishes added up to rent.

hindi: प्रचलित — इस समय फ़ैशन में
definition: fashionable and stylish at present, closely following the latest trend that everyone admires
example: Sourdough starters were very à la mode in 2020, then quietly died in fridges.

hindi: अंत तक — पूरी ताक़त से, बिना रुके आख़िरी दम तक
definition: to the uttermost bitter finish, fighting with every possible force and without restraint
example: The two reviewers argued over a variable name à outrance, long after the pull request was merged.

hindi: आभा — प्रभावशाली चमक और शानदार सफलता
definition: brilliant, showy success or striking flair that wins public admiration
example: She launched the product with such éclat that competitors copied the keynote font.

hindi: उमंग — जोशीला और साहसी उत्साह
definition: energetic boldness and spirited confidence, shown with lively dash and style
example: The new manager rewrote the roadmap with élan and without reading the old one.

hindi: प्रवासी निर्वासित — राजनीतिक कारणों से देश छोड़ने वाला
definition: a person who has left their native country, especially for political reasons or exile
example: The émigré café serves nostalgia, strong tea and very loud opinions about the old government.

hindi: परदे के पीछे का सूत्रधार — गुप्त रूप से सत्ता चलाने वाला सलाहकार
definition: a powerful adviser who exercises influence secretly, without holding the official title
example: The minister makes the speeches, but his quiet chief of staff is the real éminence grise.
